It doesn't let you use an ability multiple times in a round though. Start Dash is a free movement, but it can only be used as the first action on your turn. This movement does provoke attacks of opportunity and you can't disengage or feint before it, so you may want to evasive maneuver before your turn begins if you plan to use it while engaged in melee. Steal Time gives you a small boost to your initiative while lowering that of enemy. This may let your allies potentially act before the enemy does on subsequent turns. Secret Art: Rewind lets you do stupid things without being punished for it. You can potentially hit into enemy counters to see what happens, run past suspicious hallways that may be trapped, attempt dangerous jumps across a cliff. If the result is bad, you can simply rewind time and either try again or do something else entirely.

Classes.Name: Transcendent Lightning Style
Classes.Requirements: Cultivator or Martial Artist mastered; any tier 2 mastered.
Classes.Description: Natsuki blinked in confusion at her surroundings, the wind from the mountains tugging at her robes and hair. Lightning danced around her limbs and she was tense, like a battle was upon her. Bells and gongs rang behind her from a village, all indicating some sort of attack. Which would explain why she was there, ready to defend them. But she didn’t remember anything that would have warranted her assuming the Stance of Heavenly Lightning. Had she been training? …No, that wasn’t wise if she was there to defend the village. Like a fog slowly lifting, she remembered being dispatched from the temple to investigate missing villagers nearby and…even a completely wiped out hamlet. In a flash, her mind cleared. A huge face loomed in front of her, lipless mouth spread in a permanent, horrific grin. Empty eye sockets bore down on her as it opened its mouth. Akuma , her mind identified. Too large to be a bakemono, too little devastation to be a kaiju . A kaibutsu, then. And a tricky one at that. She traced the thin, tentacle-like neck back to the main body, a pulsing globule of flesh as large as a house. Other heads grinned at her from their own serpentine necks. They were quiet, no longer singing, as if they wanted to enjoy her terror as she was devoured. Like it had probably picked off villagers one by one, using its song to make everyone forget until it struck again. But the akuma had made a grave mistake. Its weapon was song and sound. But her’s…her’s was what thunder chased and could never catch. The air cracked and the akuma howled in agony as she came to a stop on the other side of it, lighting glittering across her skin and snapping at the wind. “Lightning Release,” she said, the mantra unnecessary but it felt appropriate. “Living Lightning.” All she had to do was kill the akuma before it could sing again. Simple as that. Natsuki clenched her fists and thunder boomed again, desperately giving chase to her lightning.
Classes.Guide: The Transcendent Lightning Style is a martial arts based class focused on speed. Like most martial arts based classes, it expects you to lean heavily into that playstyle. The Heavenly Lightning Stance is their specific stance and is essentially required to use their other two active abilities. Because it goes away when you use a non-melee attack, it's not suited for people that like to use ranged attacks. Its main use is to allow you to move freely across the battlefield, but if you're already engaged in a melee fight you can also use the free sidestep movement to move away safely. Lightning Lariat is your opening attack move of choice, letting you move and attack in the same action. Stance into Lariat gets you in the fight at basically no mana cost, potentially with a trick attack and with extra damage if you moved far enough for your key ability to activate. Living Lightning combo's well with Lightning Lariat but essentially requires you to be in your lightning stance to be usable. It requires you to move in a straight line, similar to horse movement. Because Lightning Lariat already forces you to move like that, you can use living lightning while use that. You can also move through the target you're hitting with the lariat to hit them with the living lightning as well. Your secret art: Lightning Release is best used immediately at the start of the fight unless you have a better secret art available. It gives you buffs that last for the entire encounter and even activates your lightning stance at the same time. As a last note, this style naturally combo's well with the Sky Talon Style due to the lightning stance giving you the benefits of the wind stance as well.

Classes.Name: Transmuter
Classes.Description: In the dust of an artisan's workshop or in the open clearings of a logging company, the hum and chirps of transmutation can be heard. Transmutation is an art, a magic as ancient as Lyr. Long before the shadows of the great calamity, Transmuters were scholars who questioned the very nature of existence. This pursuit led to a mastery over both destruction and creation, spinning the threads of reality itself into a tapestry. Transmutation is the second branch of alchemy and created a revolution in society. It replaced primitive methods such as smelting and manual refinement—which previously had artisans sweating over blazing crucibles into the dark hours of the night. It isn't uncommon for master craftsmen to have a Transmuter in their employ or as a partner, processing material in the atelier or even helping with the crafting itself. In fact, nowadays there is rarely a town across Lyr without at least one person versed in the basics of this ancient art. Transmuters manipulate matter at its core, unraveling its threads and rebuilding them into entire new forms. They can shatter stone into dust, or create small figurines from blocks of wood. The control of Transmutation is only limited by skill and imagination. Transmutation is the second branch of Alchemy, which itself is one of the great pillars of Arcane Magic. Yet with great power comes great peril. Those who understand Transmutation know that creation and destruction are two sides of the same coin. It requires a sound mind and body to walk the delicate balance, making Transmuters some of the most respected Artisans in any community they are in.
Classes.Guide: Transmuter is a class that helps crafting for other classes and provided utility in combat. Transmute weapon is a simple ability that lets you create a weapon for yourself or ally. While you probably don't want to rely entirely on this for your equipment as it costs mana and may not always work, it's good for providing an emergency backup or if there happens to be special material nearby. Transmute wall is a reactionary defense against a ranged attack. Because you'll be able to see the damage you're about to take in most cases, it will be easy to judge how much mana you should spend on this. Because it's a wall and not you blocking, this can help you defend against full pierce type of attacks. Transmute terrain is a versatile ability that lets you create walls, bridges, ledges and other terrain. You can spend a lot of mana on this at once, allowing for some creative use such as completely boxing in a character, pushing yourself 60ft into the air for a sniper position, pushing enemies off a cliff and much more. Deconstruct is an interlude ability that lets you recycle useless items into usable material. Best to use it when you have a large amount of things piled up. In crafting, you have a few unique abilities as well as the ability to co-craft. This costs you nothing to do by default, so use it whenever you can. Two of your co-craft abilities do have a cost and you can also use them in your own crafts. Temperature Shock is useful early when you roll poorly to have a guaranteed number to your next roll. Once your bonus grows higher or if you need to gamble, Alchemic catch will be better as it uses the full bonus you have. If you're co crafting and don't want to spend money, you can just use bouncing ideas for a free small bonus. Finally ragequit is useful if you don't care about profit by itself and only want to make something big. You do lose a lot when using this, so avoid it unless you know what you're doing.

Classes.Name: Trapper
Classes.Description: Carter’s breath came in sharp gasps as he leapt over a fallen log, his boots scraping the moss off the top with how narrowly he cleared it. Behind him, frustrated yells followed him as his pursuers crashed through the thick brush and thorny bushes. He knew the forest around him better than his hometown and that gave him an advantage, but the catfolk chasing him were both faster and more nimble than he was. It was taking every trick he knew to stay ahead of the poachers. The twang of a bowstring had him juking right and diving over a particularly nastily thorny berry bush, just barely avoiding the arrow that snapped past him. He landed and rolled, still careful of his own bow and supply of arrows, and he felt a smile pull at his lips. The forest opened up slightly into a small clearing with limited brush and only a couple fallen trees for cover. The old scorch marks on some of the trees told him that there had likely been a lightning strike that had briefly burned out the area some months ago. This was exactly where he expected to get “caught”. He carefully retreated to the center of the small clearing and collapsed back against one of the scorched logs. He was still catching his breath when the three catfolk pushed into the open area, eyes scanning around before locking on him. They raised their bows and the leader stepped forward a few paces. “Finally! You know there was no way for you to outrun us. Now you’re just gonna die tired,” the poacher boasted. He raised his bow and knocked an arrow. “Just stay still for a second, will you?” Carter grinned. “Sure, buddy.” With the hand that was out of sight of the catfolk, he cut three small lines. There was the horrible snap and crunch of a bear trap snapping closed on a leg followed almost instantly by the surprised shriek of a catgirl suddenly finding herself tangled in a net and hanging twenty feet off the ground. The catfolk caught in the bear trap barely had much time to scream in pain himself before a log swung out of the trees and caught him straight in the chest, carrying him fully out of the clearing in a crash. The poacher leader took a surprised step back and fell with a startled yelp, the support for the pit trap he’d walked over no longer in place. Carter hopped to his feet and jogged over to the hole, absently eyeing the hanging catgirl. She’d dropped her bow and had fumbled her knife in her struggles, so she was good and stuck. He peaked over into the hole with a smug grin, bow in hand and arrow ready. “Why don’t we have a nice conversation about why you don’t poach in my forests, huh?”
Classes.Guide: Trapper is a primarily controller class that relies on preparation time to spring unexpected traps on the enemy. Your main ability is Place Trap. You require at least 1 minute or 1 hour of prep time, but the good thing is that you don't have to choose which trap you're placing until you trigger it. The most important thing to be aware of is that you can only trigger these when an enemy walks into your range. Log Swing is guaranteed damage and a knockback, which can let an enemy potentially trigger multiple traps to approach you again. Snare is the weakest trap, but has the advantage of having multiple uses per trap. Pitfall is the most punishing trap, 20ft down can be deep enough that enemies may struggle to get out. Net is the most offensive trap, as it roots the enemy potentially making them vulnerable to attacks if they are out of AP to instantly free themselves. Ambush Trapper is essentially a free trap use, provided that you ambush the enemy which is something that you want to do as a trapper already anyway. Bear trap is the only trap you can use without preparation time, though it's not a hidden one. Still, in a choke point or if combod with displacement abilities it can be powerful. Your Secret Art: Guiding Shot can also be used to force an enemy into a bear trap in addition to its normal trap activating effect. It's best used on low block enemies that cannot afford to tank a sure hit attack.

Classes.Name: Trickster
Classes.Requirements: Two classes mastered; of which 1 must be a tier 2 class.
Classes.Description: Tricksters are a support class that cause chaos on the battlefield. The world is a stage.
Classes.Guide: The trickster is a support class that provides weird and unique benefits to the team. Assign Decoy gives the unique ability to taunt an enemy by an ally that would normally have no access to it. It can be used to temporarily make an enemy switch targets or if in a party without a tank, can be used to set up a sort of tank rotation. Swap gives the Trickster high control over the battlefield. They can walk near the edge of a clif, then swap an enemy next to it. Forcefully group enemies to setup for a teammates AoE attack. Swap an ally out of danger and much more. Extremely versatile and due to its Rapid nature and low cost can easily be spammed. Misdirected Blow has some conditions for it to be good, but it can turn enemies against each other. Most effective on tricksters with high agility, as it can let you evade blows that will hit most other targets. The Secret Art Grand Theater allows the trickster to set up a magnificent performance. They can force enemies to hit each other and give allies free actions. They just need to be careful, because even their allies are forced to attack and careless use may force them to attack an ally. Their perfect mimicry has little combat potential, but it allows a trickster to truly infiltrate a place and sow chaos.

Classes.Name: True Shinigami Eyes
Classes.Description: Wielders of the shinigami eyes, rare as they are, have the ability to perceive the death of living things. For most of them, that is where it ends. However, there are those who over time grow an even deeper understanding of death. They can see the death not just of living things, but also of objects and even non-physical things such as magic. This enhanced perception has given those wielders the name of the ‘True Shinigami Eyes’.
Classes.Guide: Wielders of the True Shinigami Eyes bring some personal defense and utility to the table. Failing a save can be devastating, but Cut Away gives them an extremely high chance to succeed as most of them possess high Focus. The high focus also helps them with Cut Magic, allowing them to potentially break barriers and other magic effects at little cost. Barriers are the most obvious thing, but even things like Glittershards are considered temporary magic effects. Point of Death II is an upgrade of the original Point of Death ability. Its primary use is to finish off high toughness enemies, but the AP refund makes it a tempting choice against any weak foe. Their key ability allows them to kill non-living things as well as they do living things, and lets them build up marks for their ultimate ability: 7 Points of Death. This Climax Art grows in power the more they attack a single target. It takes several turns to build up and must be used against a weakened enemy, but it has high damage potential. Similar to their previous Secret Art, the damage is static so you know what to expect even if there’s a small risk of missing.

Classes.Name: Vampire
Classes.Requirements: Must have the Curse of Vampirism breakthrough.
Classes.Description: Vampires are those who are cursed, using their cursed abilities to their advantage.
Classes.Guide: Vampires are a versatile class with a slight focus on unarmed combat. Vampire Bite is the only way that vampires can regenerate mana and using it whenever possible is required to keep your mana high. The high AP cost makes it hard to use in a straight up battle. You can combine it with Vampiric Fascination to remove one enemy from the battle. The chosen target will move towards you and you can easily follow it up with your bite on the next turn, dealing guaranteed full pierce damage. Action economy wise, this is still not very efficient though. In harder fights, it may be more worthwhile to fight normally at the start and only start looking for enemies to drain near the end of a fight. Cloak of Bats is a manaless teleport that can also be used offensively. The RP cost on it is higher than that of a basic defense, but the teleport lets you potentially avoid attacks that are undodgeable. Whether you're stuck in bad terrain, about to get hit by an AoE effect or you need to get behind cover, Cloak of Bats will get you out of almost any bad situation. Blood Frenzy is your last resort move. While it lasts you become very difficult to kill, especially if enemies are low on RP and can't avoid your attacks to prevent you from regaining health. It does however, lock you into a very specific set of actions. You can't regain mana through vampire bite or switch to a ranged weapon to hit an enemy that's far away. You also cannot turn it off manually, which may lead you to losing all your mana even when you no longer need the healing effect. This is especially devastating for a vampire, since mana regeneration is a problem for them. Vampire Shapeshift is a cheap utility tool that can be useful for infiltration and sneaking. Shapeshifting into a bat is also an easy way to gain access to flight to reach high ground. The last thing to keep in mind as a vampire is that your vampire bite is not just a combat ability. You are able to use it on willing targets without hurting them, though they still lose mana. You will have to convince them first though, someone charmed by Vampiric Fascination does not count as a willing person.

Classes.Name: Vampire Lord
Classes.Description: Vampire Lords drift through the pages of history like living shadows—accursed souls chained to undeath by the very forces that empower them. In dimly lit taverns, alongside whispered tales of Dragons and other legendary horrors, travelers speak of eerie encounters and boast of glimpses caught at the corner of a moonlit eye. Whether these sightings are truth or fancy, one thing is certain: the name Vampire Lord stirs fear and fascination in equal measure. Unlike lesser Vampires who lose themselves to bloodlust or despair, Vampire Lords have embraced their curse, searching its depths to forge a power all their own. They understand their twisted existence at a level few can rival, developing uncanny resistances to the sun’s harsh sting and other infamous banes of their kind. Yet what truly sets them apart is their mastery over the delicate threads connecting the Arcane, Faith, and Astra—allowing them to skirt the borders of Higher Order Magic. Their Vampiric Domination arises from this warped interplay of energies, a distant, corrupted echo of the Mystic Eye once claimed by the fabled Aseria clan of Sorthen. That unholy gift grants them the power to ensnare weaker minds, exerting a terrible control that echoes across dark corridors and silent chambers. Even so, few mortals have battled a Vampire Lord and returned with their lives, for these lords of night prefer to move in secrecy. Outwardly, they can seem disarmingly regal—yet beneath that lies a being forever dancing on the razor’s edge between life and the endless darkness. Should you cross paths with a Vampire Lord, know this—their secrets run deeper than any mortal can fathom, and their hunger, while tempered, still seeks knowledge and power in their cursed existence.
Classes.Guide: A lot of the vampire lord builds on what the vampire does. Feeding Frenzy gives you a free bite whenever you down someone while in Blood Frenzy, allowing you to regain 1 mana. If fighting a lot of grunts you can reliably kill, this can effectively half the upkeep cost of Blood Frenzy. Vampiric Domination is a stronger version of the fascination. You can choose to have a permanent servant, or you can use it more situationally such as to dominate enemies to extract information from them, dominate people of import to have them aid you. They will know what you did afterwards, so it's recommended not to stay around when you're done with them. Bloodbolt is a simple ranged option that can be lacking as a normal vampire. You can invest HP into it for extra damage, but this might not be worth doing in most cases unless you plan to Blood Frenzy shortly after. Your Secret Art: Bloody Ritual is a powerful AoE ability. The damage is guaranteed unless the tether is broken and if you can hit enough enemies with the ability, you can even refund the mana you spent on it. Due to the range on the ability and the slowing effect, it can be a powerful zoning tool even if enemies do manage to break it.

Classes.Name: Warding Mage
Classes.Description: Warding Mages focus on creating bounded fields that ward off intruders.
Classes.Guide: The warding mage is a utility class that relies on setting up defensive barriers. It is unsuited for many normal campaigns, due to the long casting time and only working when enemies come to you. In a campaign focused more around intrigue or where action takes place around a single place, they can provide peace of mind and creates a zone where enemies will struggle to fight in. Maintaining bounded fields reduces your maximum mana, but they last forever. Maintain the ones you need to and cancel fields once they have exhausted their use. Alarm Ward is the first field you get. It simply warns you (and others) when someone unwanted enters it. Many vaults, treasure rooms or other rooms containing important goodds or information will contain some form of an Alarm Ward. Explosive Ward is your second available field. It is usually placed on containers containing papers with sensitive information on it. If anybody tries to steal it, the papers will be destroyed even if the thief manages to get away. Sapping Ward is your final ward and one that greatly reduces the combat potential of any enemies entering it. The weakened condition is already bad enough, but grunts become stunned as well. Because a stunned target has no AP or RP, they will never be able to escape the ward while it lasts, essentially permanently disabling them for the encounter. Through hidden wards, you are able to hide your fields. With Disable Magic, you are able to disable other fields making Warding Mages good for infiltration as well.

Classes.Name: Wave Palm Style
Classes.Requirements: Cultivator or Martial Artist mastered. Must have at least 1 mystic eye slot open.
Classes.Description: The Wave Palm style does not strike with force, but disrupts the enemies internal lifeforce.
Classes.Guide: The Wave Palm style focuses on disrupting enemy mana usage. Mana Sight lets you see the mana of all enemies. This will let you make better choices on who to attack. Two Point Strike is a light attack that applies the Wave Palm effect, which increases the enemies mana costs. It follows into Four Point Strike, which has greatly reduced costs and appiles a stronger debuff if combo'd. Against many normal monsters, the detonation effect for when your stacks exceed their maximum mana will happen quickly due to their low mana pools. This can potentially shut down powerful abilites they might have. The Mystic Eyes of Light Perception lets you see all HP and Mana, but more importantly it lets you see through cover and you automatically detect all hidden creatures. Very useful when you're under attack by rogues or other stealthy characters. Disrupt Ki is used against mages who are concentrating on spells to make them drop it.

Classes.Name: Wildheart
Classes.Description: A better animal summoner.
Classes.Guide: Wildheart is a continuation of the animal summoner that gets more powerful animals and more control over them. Expanded Menagerie lets you choose which animal you want to summon in exchange for 1 mana, which is well worth for not having to rely on RNG. You gain two buffing tools for your pet as Wildheart. The first being X-Attack, which gives a +1 focus and power buff for a moderate AP cost. With this buff, pets become a more viable dpser and target for Bestial Command. Secret Art: Bestial Wrath pushes this even further (but doesn't stack), giving a +2/+2 and letting pets compete offensively with dps characters. It also makes them not die once, letting them potentially soak another hit if focused. Quick Revive is a situational ability that's there for if you mess up or your pet gets hit by an instakill attack. With it, you don't get locked out of your pet abilities for the entire fight if something like that happens. Leashing is a cheap teleport for your pet that you can use to pull it back to safety, or to help it advance without spendin its own AP.

Classes.Name: Windbringer
Classes.Description: A supportive wind user that speeds up allies and hampers enemies.
Classes.Guide: The windbringer is a wind based support that focuses on movement. They start the battle by giving their allies Tailwind, which increases their initiative and boosts their movement speed. This is especially useful when you start far away from the enemy and have many melee focused fighters in the party. If you need even more movement speed, you can activate Gale-Wind Aura. 20ft movement speed increase is a big boost and since your allies keep it after leaving the aura, they can cross great distances in a single turn. Headwind instead hampers enemy. You need to be somewhat close to an enemy for it to take effect, but it's an otherwise unavoidable slow. Once you and your allies have engaged the front most enemy, Headwind can be used to deny their allies a chance to help. Fly gives flying to yourself or an ally. It has a small mana cost, but the extra movement speed alone makes it worth using.

Classes.Name: Zen Warrior
Classes.Description: Zen Warriors are mobile monks with both offensive and defensive capabilities.
Classes.Guide: The Zen Warrior follows up from the monk and gives them some much needed mobility. Walking away from the Serene Water Stance will no longer instantly save you. Ki Blast II gives you the option to use a Light or Precise attack. This is useful when already in Serene Water stance, since you can follow it up with Flying Kick. Flying Kick can be used immediately after a Ki Blast has hit and places you next to the target. Because it then reduces the AP cost of Strike of Still Water by 1, you can do a Precise Ki Blast→Flying Kick→Strike of Still Water combo. Ki Burst is a damage increase that can be used after you've hit an enemy with an attack. Mostly used for adding small points of damage when an enemy barely survives. Redirected Force takes advantage of the high dodge you will have in serene water stance. You can turn heavy attacks that miss you into attacks the enemy must respond to, or may be completely unable to avoid even when reacting to it. Secret Art: True Serenity is basically a guaranteed dodge for an entire turn unless the enemy uses sure hit attacks. Due to the +17 bonus that applies even when not dodging, even lock-on attacks will find it near impossible to hit you. As a bonus, you also enter Serene Water Stance from it. Best used when you about to take a lot of attacks in a single turn.

Classes.Name: Zephyr Warder
Classes.Description: A supportive wind user that can protect against and help with ranged attacks.
Classes.Guide: The Zephyr Warder specializes in ranged combat, helping both allies hit targets and preventing enemy archers from hitting. Wind Infusion can be cast on every ally over the course of a battle and gives them not only an evasion bonus against ranged attacks, but also damage resistance against wind attacks. Worth using immediately when facing those types of enemies. Wind Shield completely shuts down an enemy ranged attack, granting your ally such a huge bonus along with removing the lock-on and sure hit that the attack is sure to miss. Wind Wall has to be cast in advance, but it can cover a wide chokepoint and removes all keywords that lets them ignore Dodge or Block. The range decrease can also matter a lot, especially if enemies are only using light ranged weapons. The mana cost isn't too bad either. Wind-Empowered Aim buffs all your (heroic) ranged allies, giving a decent bonus to their accuracy rolls. Worth using if you have a lot of ranged attackers in your party or if you get into a shootout. With this buffs and all the anti-ranged buffs you have, you're sure to win a shooting battle.

All Abilities.Name: Abjurer's Blast
All Abilities.Description: You make a Light (1 AP), Heavy (2 AP) or Precise (2 AP) attack against the target that deals Arcane damage. This spell does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

All Abilities.Name: Absorb Ice
All Abilities.Description: You gainAbsorb Ice, which gives you Damage Reduction 100 Frost against the triggering damage. After the damage resolves, if the caster is not you, someone allied to you or from an effect made by you or an ally, you gain Temporary HP until the end of the encounter equal to the amount of damage this ability reduces.
All Abilities.Requirements: You're about to take Frost Damage.

All Abilities.Name: Accelerando
All Abilities.Description: Grant yourself or an ally +4 initiative.

All Abilities.Name: Accelerating Strike
All Abilities.Description: You make a Heavy Attack against the target. Afterwards, you gainAccelerating Strike, which increases your Initiative by up to 2.

All Abilities.Name: Acolyte's Journey
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain proficiency in light armor, shields and a single common group of weapons. This group may include Channeling Weapons, even though they aren't consider common weapons. (But you only get 1 of the possible channeling weapons)., You gain +5 skill points in the Religion skill., You are welcome at establishments for your religion and they are obligated to help you with lodging, advice, food and sometimes equipment.

All Abilities.Name: Adaptive Defense
All Abilities.Description: You take the Block Action. You then gain 4 Adaptive Defense (Type) which grants you Damage Reduction 4 against that damage type until the end of your next turn. You can only have one instance of Adaptive Defense at a time.

All Abilities.Name: Advanced Artificing
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain Artificer Advanced Crafting Abilities

All Abilities.Name: Artifice Modification A2
All Abilities.Description: You add a second A-Type modification to an artifice. See the individual artifice to see if modifications are available.

All Abilities.Name: Artifice Modification B
All Abilities.Description: You add a B-Type modification to an artifice. See the individual artifice to see if modifications are available.

All Abilities.Name: Skeleton Welding
All Abilities.Description: You expertly create the artifice hookup, reducing the artifice weight burden by a further 1 to a total minimum of 0.5.

All Abilities.Name: Weapon Modification B
All Abilities.Description: You add an B-Type modification to the weapon. See the Universal Weapon or Crafting mods page as well as the individual weapon page for details. Each modification has its own cost.

All Abilities.Name: Adventurer Essentials
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain proficiency in 1 common weapon group. In addition, you gain proficiency in 1 common or specialized weapon groups., You gain proficiency in 1 armor category of your choosing. Alternatively, you may pick the shield or greatshield., You may use Presence Concealment.

All Abilities.Name: Aerial Crashdown
All Abilities.Description: You and your mount crash down on the target. You move towards the target and your mount makes a Heavy attack against it. On damage, the target is knocked prone.
All Abilities.Requirements: You are mounted on a flying mount and the target is at least 20ft below you.

All Abilities.Name: Aerial Loop
All Abilities.Description: You and your mount take the Dodge action and gain a +5 bonus to evasion against the attack.
All Abilities.Requirements: You are mounted on a flying mount and you or your mount are the target of a ranged attack

All Abilities.Name: Aftershock
All Abilities.Description: You attack with such force that you create aftershocks when you miss your attack, dealing True Damage to all enemies within 5ft of the missed target. This True Damage equals twice the AP spent on the attack. If your attack targets multiple enemies, this only applies if you miss all enemies.
All Abilities.Requirements: You missed an attack with a Two-Handed Melee Weapon.

All Abilities.Name: Aftershocks
All Abilities.Benefits: You may use Aftershock.

All Abilities.Name: Aimed Shot
All Abilities.Description: You make a Heavy Attack against the target.

All Abilities.Name: Air Stability
All Abilities.Benefits: The cavalier’s Rider & Mount As One ability applies even while flying. Any damage you take while flying on a flying mount will cause you to lose altitude as if your mount took damage.

All Abilities.Name: Alarm Ward
All Abilities.Description: A ward that can be placed on a normal-sized room or can be combined to ward off a house or larger area. Each ward can cover a 40ft radius. For each Alarm Ward placed in the same area as another Alarm Ward, this radius increases by 40ft (For example, 120ft with 3 Alarm Wards). If someone other than you passes through the ward, the ward triggers creating a loud ringing noise that persists until the ward is disabled. Casting this takes 10 minutes of uninterrupted casting. Once triggered, the field remains active for 5 more minutes before vanishing. At the time of casting, you may choose people that can pass through the barrier without triggering it. If not triggered, Alarm Ward lasts until you remove it. For each Alarm Ward you maintain, your maximum mana is reduced by 1. This is considered a tier 1 ward.

All Abilities.Name: Distillation
All Abilities.Description: You extract the highest quality healing materials from herbs, granting Healing +8 to a Potion with a heal or shielding effect.

All Abilities.Name: Explosive Lining
All Abilities.Description: You carefully add an alchemical compound to a pressurized Flask. If the Flask has an area of effect, increases the area by another 5ft (example a 10ft radius becomes 15ft radius).

All Abilities.Name: Masterful Dilution
All Abilities.Description: By diluting the contents to the perfect required amounts, you gain an additional Elixir, Potion, Flask, Potion or Salve upon crafting success. Stacks with Efficient Dilution.

All Abilities.Name: Purify Elixir
All Abilities.Description: You reduce the toxicity of an Elixir that has been detoxified while still maintaining its effect, reducing the damage from taking an Elixir by an additional 5.

All Abilities.Name: Alchemical Detonation
All Abilities.Description: You touch a wall, door or container in front of you, which shatters from deconstructive force, becoming destroyed.  Can destroy up to a 5ftx5ft segment of wall.  Only affects objects made out of common building materials (wood, clay, stone, iron etc), however it affects all walls made out of player abilities.  The GM determines if the object is detonateable.  You can then take a movement action to move 5ft into the space where the wall was.

All Abilities.Name: Create Oil Coating
All Abilities.Description: You create an Oil Coating from Carpenter materials. See Items: Carpenter Materials

All Abilities.Name: Detoxify Elixir
All Abilities.Description: You reduce the toxicity of an Elixir while still maintaining its effect, reducing the damage from taking an Elixir by 3.

All Abilities.Name: Efficient Dilution
All Abilities.Description: By diluting the contents to the perfect required amounts, you gain an additional Elixir, Potion, Flask, Poison or Salve upon crafting success.

All Abilities.Name: Pressurization
All Abilities.Description: You pressurize a Flask carefully. If the Flask has an area of effect, increases the area by 5ft (example a 10ft radius becomes 15ft radius).

All Abilities.Name: Stone Grinding
All Abilities.Description: You extract the highest quality healing materials from herbs, granting Healing +5 to a Potion with a heal or shielding effect.

All Abilities.Name: Volatile Flask
All Abilities.Description: You overload the active ingredients on a Flask, giving it a +5 damage to its damaging effects.

All Abilities.Name: Allow me to clean that~
All Abilities.Description:
You instantly remove a negative effect from the terrain (such as Oil Slick, Sheet Ice, Web etc). Permanent effects such as fissure or effects with HP like a wall cannot be removed with this. A maximum of 15x15ft can be removed in 1 use and you may move to any spot of the cleaned terrain afterwards.

In addition, you may target an ally with this to remove 1 negative physical effect from them instead.

All Abilities.Name: Ambush Trapper
All Abilities.Description:
You may use Place Trap’s 0 RP effect once this encounter, even if you didn’t spend the time to set it up. The GM may rule that the pitfall and net options are unavailable based on the situation.

These activations still cost a Trap when used (but not if you don't use them).
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be stealthed or have surprised the enemy.

All Abilities.Name: Amoxicillin
All Abilities.Description: You choose up to 10 willing units in range.  After spending 1 minute in concentration, you create a cloud of spores that heals a disease that you can identify.
All Abilities.Requirements: You can identify the disease.

All Abilities.Name: Amphibious
All Abilities.Description: You can swim up to your speed and can hold your breath underwater for up to an hour.

All Abilities.Name: Anathema
All Abilities.Description: You choose one target unit and they must save against your Potency or be afflicted byAnathema.Anathemaincreases the next source of damage that the target receives by your Heavy Attack damage.

All Abilities.Name: Angelic Presence
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain Angelic Presence, which gives a +1 to Presence.

All Abilities.Name: Angel's Embrace
All Abilities.Description: You grant the target allyAngel’s Embrace, which grants a Shield against the triggering attack that blocks damage equal to 5 + (2 x Toughness). This Spell does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
All Abilities.Requirements: A creature other than you is attacked.

All Abilities.Name: Antennae
All Abilities.Description: You are able to detect creatures by sensing the vibrations in the air. You gain a +10 expertise bonus to Perception (Vibration Sense) which works up to 40ft from you, but only detects creatures.

All Abilities.Name: Anti-Magic Shield
All Abilities.Description: You grant the target ally 1 RP that must be spend on a basic Dodge or Block action against the triggering attack as well asAnti-Magic Shieldfor the triggering attack.Anti-Magic Shieldreduces the damage the target ally takes by your Focus.
All Abilities.Requirements: Ally is the target of a damage dealing Spell.

All Abilities.Name: Anti-Shield
All Abilities.Description: You weave a web of magic around the target. The target cannot be the target of any abilities with the Shield keyword until the start of your next turn.

All Abilities.Name: Anvil Tactics
All Abilities.Description: A single ally in range may move up to their speed. If they end up in melee range of an enemy and there is an ally on the direct opposite side of that enemy, they may make an Attack of Opportunity. This attack gains Lock On.

All Abilities.Name: Aqua Drill
All Abilities.Description:
You infuse water with your mana firing a spiraling blast of high pressure water, making a heavy attack that deals Water damage against a target within range. You can use either the RP or AP cost for the ability.  The water is used as a projectile and spills anywhere within 5ft of the target at your choice.

If you use an RP for this ability, the mana cost increases by 1.
All Abilities.Requirements: You are touching an amount of water equal to a normal sized bucket of water.

All Abilities.Name: Aquatic Fae
All Abilities.Description:
While swimming, your base movement speed becomes 30, in addition you gain Elemental Mastery: Water.

Your Aqua Drill costs 0 mana when used as RP ability while in natural water.

All Abilities.Name: Arcane Barrier
All Abilities.Description:
You create a Magical Barrier that absorbs damage until it breaks. The barrier has HP equal to 15 + your Focus. The barrier has a Guard of 0 and any damage it takes is subtracted from the barrier’s HP. When the barrier breaks, any remaining damage is subtracted from your HP. The barrier otherwise lasts until the start of your next turn or until you take any action other than the Block action.

This spell does not provoke attacks of opportunity and does not protect against true damage.
All Abilities.Requirements: You're about to take damage.

All Abilities.Name: Arcane Barrier II
All Abilities.Description:
You create a Magical Barrier that absorbs damage until it breaks.

The barrier has HP equal to 15 + your Focus. The barrier has a Guard of 0 + your guard and any damage it takes is subtracted from the barrier’s HP. When the barrier breaks, any remaining damage is subtracted from your HP. The barrier otherwise lasts until the start of your next turn or until you take any action other than the Block action. If using the Block action while the barrier is active, the guard of the barrier also increases.

This spell does not provoke attacks of opportunity and does not protect against true damage.
All Abilities.Requirements: You're about to take damage.

All Abilities.Name: Arcane Buster
All Abilities.Description: You fire a blast of energy, making a Heavy Attack that deals Arcane Damage. This attack has the Shieldbreaker property.

All Abilities.Name: Arcane Explosion
All Abilities.Description: You make a Light Attack that deals Arcane damage against all enemies within 10ft of yourself. This Spell does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

All Abilities.Name: Arcane Power
All Abilities.Description: You gainArcane Power, which adds 3 damage to the damage of all your Arcane Damage rolls until the start of your next turn.

All Abilities.Name: Arcane Pull
All Abilities.Description: You pull the target to an empty square next to you. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity. Your next Block or Dodge action against the target before the start of your next turn costs 0 RP. This Spell does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
All Abilities.Requirements: Target is challenged by you and attacking someone that isn't you.

All Abilities.Name: Armor Up
All Abilities.Description: You gain temporary HP equal to the Block value of your armor and shield, up to a maximum of 40 temporary HP.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be wearing armor and/or a shield.

All Abilities.Name: Armored Blow
All Abilities.Description: You make a Heavy attack against the target. Your next Block against that target costs 0 RP and gains a +10 bonus.
All Abilities.Requirements: May only be used after moving at least 20ft in the previous action. Must be mounted.

All Abilities.Name: Armorsmith Basics
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain proficiency in light armor, medium armor and shields., You gain proficiency in 1 basic melee weapon and can use a smith's hammer as a bludgeoning weapon in which you are proficient., You can craft armors, shields and cloaks using Iron, Tamahagane, Animal Hide and Direhide, as well as alloys., You gain Armorsmith Core Crafting abilities.

All Abilities.Name: Adaptive Layering
All Abilities.Description: You mix a special material into the armor or shield. Each material has its own crafting point cost.

All Abilities.Name: Armorsmith's Modification A
All Abilities.Description: You add an A-Type modification to the weapon or tool. See the Universal Armor page as well as the individual armor pages for details. Each modification has its own cost.

All Abilities.Name: Cloak Layering
All Abilities.Description: You use a special material for the creation of the cloak. Each material has its own crafting point cost. Only cloak special materials can be used and mixing in a special material increases the burden cost of the cloak by 1.

All Abilities.Name: Create Ingot
All Abilities.Description: You create an ingot from armorsmithing base materials or from armorsmithing special materials. See Item: Armorsmithing Materials.

All Abilities.Name: Tan Leather
All Abilities.Description: You create a tanned hide from armorsmithing base leather materials. See item: Armorsmithing materials.

All Abilities.Name: Armorsmithing Expert
All Abilities.Description: Armorsmith's Modification BCost:X Crafting PointsDescription:You add an B-Type modification to the weapon or tool. See the Universal Armor page as well as the individual armor pages for details. Each modification has its own cost.

All Abilities.Name: Arms Mastery
All Abilities.Benefits: You are considered proficient with every melee weapon you wield (This does not count as being proficient for class requirements).

All Abilities.Name: Artery Cut
All Abilities.Description: You change the arc of your weapon and go for a vital spot, turning the hit into a critical hit.
All Abilities.Requirements: One-Handed weapon only, can be used after a light attack hits and is not reacted against.

All Abilities.Name: Artificer Basics
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain Artificer Core Crafting Abilities, You can craft using non-advanced materials and base materials., You can now craft Artifices and Firearms., You gain proficiency in the musket and the Artificer's Multitool.

All Abilities.Name: Advanced Melding
All Abilities.Description: You expertly create the artifice hookup, reducing the artifice weight burden by 1 to a minimum of 0.5.

All Abilities.Name: Artifice Modification A
All Abilities.Description: You add an A-Type modification to an artifice. See the individual artifice to see if modifications are available.

All Abilities.Name: Attach/Detach Artifice
All Abilities.Description: You spend some time connecting the artifice to a weapon with an open artifice slot. If you remove an artifice from a weapon, you can attach it to a different weapon with the same Errand action.

All Abilities.Name: Craft Artifice Parts
All Abilities.Description: You create up to 3000u of artifice parts of the same type of blacksmithing material used to make them at a 1:1 rate. (3000u of Iron Creates 3000u of Iron Artifice Parts.) See Items: Blacksmithing Materials, Artificer Materials. When converting items of a higher tier, you can convert up to 6000 of tamahagane, 9000 of mithril, 12000 of Orihalcum or 15000 of escudo.

All Abilities.Name: Craft Fuel Shells
All Abilities.Description: You craft up to 5 small shells. You can instead craft a medium shell instead of 2 small shells. Small shells require 50 magical fuel, medium shells require 200 magical fuel.

All Abilities.Name: Create Ingot
All Abilities.Description: You create an ingot from blacksmithing base materials or from blacksmithing special materials. See Item: Blacksmithing Materials.

All Abilities.Name: Double Barrel
All Abilities.Description: Can hold up to 2 shells. You still reload 1 shell at a time.

All Abilities.Name: Firearm Alloy
All Abilities.Description: You mix a special material into the firearm or artifice weapon. Each material has its own crafting point cost.

All Abilities.Name: Weapon Modification A
All Abilities.Description: You add an A-Type modification to the weapon. See the Universal Weapon or Crafting mods page as well as the individual weapon page for details. Each modification has its own cost.

All Abilities.Name: Assign Decoy
All Abilities.Description: Choose one willing ally within range and one enemy within range. The enemy is Challenged by the chosen ally until the start of your next turn.

All Abilities.Name: Astral Projection
All Abilities.Description: After a 10 minute channel you arrive at the space between worlds, allowing you to interact with Eidolons that wish to meet with you.

All Abilities.Name: At your side
All Abilities.Description: You teleport next to your VIP.

All Abilities.Name: Attack in Detail
All Abilities.Description: You target one enemy unit. All allied units (including yourself) gain a +1 Damage Bonus when that enemy unit is the target of an attack until the start of your next turn. In addition, all allied units gain +5 Movement Speed when moving towards that enemy unit.

All Abilities.Name: Attacks from the Past
All Abilities.Description:
After making a weapon attack, you may repeat the attack from one of your past self tokens. You may target the same enemy as your original attack.

Can only repeat attacks with a base cost of 2 AP or lower and any mana cost must be paid as normal.

All Abilities.Name: Attune Eidolon
All Abilities.Description:
You attune to a specific Eidolon, paying the attunement cost (if applicable) and then activating its Passive (if applicable).  You gain its Channel Eidolon, Summon Lesser Eidolon and Secret Art: Summon Eidolon abilities provided that you have advanced enough in this class to get them.

You may use this as an Encounter Start ability without paying an AP cost.
All Abilities.Requirements: You have an Eidolon you are contracted to.

All Abilities.Name: Augmented Casting - Increased Reach
All Abilities.Benefits: You may use Increased Reach.

All Abilities.Name: Augmented Casting - Persistent Spell
All Abilities.Benefits: You may use Persistent Spell.

All Abilities.Name: Aura of Protection
All Abilities.Description: You create a 30ft radius Aura of Protection around yourself. While this aura is active, when an ally within 30ft of you takes the Block action you may spend 1 Mana to replace their Block Value with your own. In addition, any abilities with the Aid keyword have their range increased by 20ft while inside the Aura.

All Abilities.Name: Aura of Resistance
All Abilities.Description:
You create a 30ft radius Aura of Resistance around yourself until the end of the encounter.

While this aura is active, when an ally fails a save you may spend 1 Mana to increase their save value by your Toughness.

All Abilities.Name: Ave María
All Abilities.Description: You attack with a swift double slash in the blink of an eye, making a Heavy Attack that deals Light damage + Heavy Holy damage.

All Abilities.Name: Backlash
All Abilities.Description: You make a Light attack against the target. You take true damage equal to half the damage dealt.

All Abilities.Name: Battle Cast
All Abilities.Description: The next Spell you cast before the end of your turn does not provoke an attack of opportunity from being casted in Melee Range of an opponent.

All Abilities.Name: Bear Maul
All Abilities.Description:
You swing your paw at the target and make a Heavy attack against it that deals maximum damage. If the target dodges, this attack automatically misses.

You are considered proficient in unarmed attacks for this attack, even if you normally wouldn’t be.

All Abilities.Name: Bear Shock
All Abilities.Description: You gain a +20 bonus to Deception checks when disguising yourself as something other than a bearfolk.

All Abilities.Name: Bear Trap
All Abilities.Description:
You place down a bear trap in an empty square within range. If an enemy enters that square, they trigger the trap taking Light full pierce damage and becoming rooted until they spend 2 AP to remove the effect.

Against beasts, this does Heavy damage instead of Light damage.

This ability consumes a Trap.

All Abilities.Name: Benevolence
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain Elemental Mastery: Holy, Your attacks do not consume Illumination on miss., You may choose not to use the effect of Illumination on a target.(Must be declared before an attack is made).

All Abilities.Name: Bestial Command
All Abilities.Description:
The summon may take basic actions as if it had 2 AP to spend.

In addition, if your summon is under the effects of Independent Action, it gains Bestial Command until the end of the encounter, it dies or you cancel it for 0 AP. While Bestial Command lasts, its maximum AP and AP recovery are increased by 2 while your AP recovery is lowered by 2.
All Abilities.Requirements: Can only target your summoned animal.

All Abilities.Name: Blackbird
All Abilities.Description: You deploy a Blackbird, a small artifice drone that outputs a grainy image to a device on your wrist.  The blackbird has a maximum range of 3000ft and can observe major movements and structures such as doors and enemies.  The drone cannot display fine movements or detail such as words in a book without being up close, but can see large signs.  The blackbird is the size of a walnut and is relatively quiet, and can only be heard by those with normal human hearing within 10 ft.The fuel shell lasts for one flight, up to 15 minutes.  If your Blackbird is lost or damaged, you must create a new one as an errand action before you can use this again.

All Abilities.Name: Blacksmith’s Modification A
All Abilities.Description: You add an A-Type modification to the weapon or tool. See the Universal Weapon or Crafting mods page as well as the individual weapon page for details. Each modification has its own cost.

All Abilities.Name: Create Ingot
All Abilities.Description: You create an ingot from blacksmithing base materials or from blacksmithing special materials. See Item: Blacksmithing Materials.

All Abilities.Name: Weapon Alloy
All Abilities.Description: You mix a special material into the smithing weapon. Each material has its own crafting point cost.

All Abilities.Name: Blast Away
All Abilities.Description: You fire a point blank shot at an enemy unit. The enemy must save against your Potency or be knocked back 5ft and take Light Damage. This ability does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

All Abilities.Name: Blast Wave
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Light attack that deals Fire damage against every character within 10ft of you. On damage, they are pushed back 10ft. This spell does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

All Abilities.Name: Blinding Dust
All Abilities.Description: You flap your wings and blow dust in the eyes of the attacker, making them Blinded 6 until the end of their attack. If their attack against you misses, you may Sidestep 5ft.
All Abilities.Requirements: You are the target of an attack.

All Abilities.Name: Blocking Move
All Abilities.Description:
You move in front of the target and their movement action immediately ends. Until the end of their turn, they are Challenged by you and your next Block action against them costs 0 RP. If they willingly move from you through any method (including teleports) you may make a Heavy attack against them with Sure Hit.

Your movement may ignore Line Movement restrictions for this ability.
All Abilities.Requirements: You made an opportunity attack against a target moving away from you. Must be mounted.

All Abilities.Name: Blood Drain
All Abilities.Description: You make a Light Attack that deals Dark damage against the target. On damage, you recover HP equal to your Toughness + 3.
All Abilities.Requirements: Target must be a living creature. Target cannot be an ally.

All Abilities.Name: Blood Frenzy
All Abilities.Description:
You go into a blood frenzy, mindlessly attacking enemies near you.

While the blood frenzy lasts, you must attack the nearest enemy target with a basic unarmed attack. If two targets are equally close, you may choose which one you attack. If no enemies are within range, you must use your movement to move closer to the closest visible enemy until you can attack them.

While under the effect of blood frenzy, you heal for half the damage you deal with your unarmed attacks.

You cannot use Vampire Bite while under the effect of Blood Frenzy.

This effect lasts until all visible enemies are dead or until your mana runs out. At the start of your turn, you lose 2 mana.

All Abilities.Name: Blood Shield
All Abilities.Description: You grant the target 1 RP that must be spent on the Block action against the triggering attack. They gain a +5 bonus to their Guard for this Block action. After the attack, the target regains HP equal to half the damage blocked (Blocked meaning the damage reduced through block, not necessarily your total block value).
All Abilities.Requirements: Target is the target of an attack.

All Abilities.Name: Bloodbolt
All Abilities.Description:
You make a Light attack against the target.

Overcharge: You may spend X HP to increase the damage the attack deals by X. X may not exceed your Toughness.

All Abilities.Name: Blue Tide
All Abilities.Description:
You create a 15ft radius zone of 1ft of water in a circle around yourself. This zone of water remains stationary at its original position, even after you move.

This zone lasts until the end of the encounter and automatically replenishes itself when Aqua Drill is used inside of it. You may have multiple of these zones active at once.

All Abilities.Name: Bolting
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Heavy Attack that deals Lightning Damage with a bolt from the sky. On damage, inflict Static X where X equals your Focus x 3. As the attack from the sky, any cover is calculated from above the target rather than from your path to the target.

All Abilities.Name: Bone Armor
All Abilities.Description: You target and destroy a corpse within range to give yourselfBone Armor, which gives you a +2 bonus to your guard. Bone Armor lasts until the end of the encounter or until you take 2 or more damage from an attack.
All Abilities.Requirements: Corpse within range.

All Abilities.Name: Boomerang
All Abilities.Benefits: When you make an attack with a throwing weapon, or take the thrown attack basic action, you may retrieve the weapon or draw a similar weapon at no cost.

All Abilities.Name: Botany Study
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain the ability to detect if foraged food is poisonous or unsafe to eat, nearly guaranteeing its safety.  If it is a common poison, you can also identify its effect., You gain the ability to properly process some poisonous mushrooms, fruits and herbs, making them edible as a Camp Action.  You can process up to 100u at a time., You gain the ability to harvest Tier 2 Foraging Outcrops., You gain proficiency in Artifice Chainsaws and may use it as a gathering tool.

All Abilities.Name: Bottle Smash
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Light Attack against the target. On damage, the target becomes Dazed. After this attack, your improvised weapon breaks.
All Abilities.Requirements: Improvised weapon only.

All Abilities.Name: Bottle Toss
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Light Attack against the target. On damage, the target becomes Dazed. After this attack, your improvised weapon breaks.
All Abilities.Requirements: Improvised weapon only.

All Abilities.Name: Boundless Wind Stance
All Abilities.Description:
You enter the Wind Stance, an unarmed style focusing around aerial combat. While in this stance, you may Hover and Fly up to your speed. If you already have a natural Flying speed or the Flight racial ability, your flying speed is increased  by 10ft.

This stance lasts until you enter a different stance or make an attack with anything other than a melee attack or an ability with the Unarmed Strike keyword.

All Abilities.Name: Brace
All Abilities.Benefits: When using the Prepare action to prepare a melee attack with a polearm, if your target of that prepared attack moved more than 20ft that turn (excluding teleports), your attack gains Full Pierce and does maximum damage. Against a mounted enemy this also gains Sure Hit and on damage, their movement becomes 0 until the start of your turn.

All Abilities.Name: Break Away
All Abilities.Description: You disengage and may move up to half your speed away from the nearest enemy.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be mounted.

All Abilities.Name: Break Free
All Abilities.Description: You may use this ability when you would be affected by a Stun, Root, Fear or a similar effect that would prevent you from acting that's inflicted by an enemy. You may immediately enter Rage Stance without spending any AP or RP. You gain immunity to this effect for the duration of the Rage.
All Abilities.Requirements: Not in Rage Stance.

All Abilities.Name: Brilliance
All Abilities.Description: You make a Light attack against the target dealing Holy(Light) damage. On damage, inflict Illumination X, where X equals your Focus / 2 (rounded down) until the end of your next turn.

All Abilities.Name: Bring out your dead
All Abilities.Description:
You summon 3 zombies, as if you used Raise Undead 3 times. Restrictions on max zombie limit still apply.

Does not require corpses.

All Abilities.Name: Bullet Magnet
All Abilities.Description: Until the start of your next turn, any single target Ranged Weapon Attack made against an ally in range is made against you instead.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be using a greatshield.

All Abilities.Name: Bunshin Tai no Jutsu
All Abilities.Description:
You create a body double of yourself that has the same stats you do at the time of creation. You and the body double share the same HP, Mana, AP and RP. Any buffs applied to your clone also applies to you (but not vice versa). When taking an action, you may choose to let the user be yourself or the body double. However, the body double may only use basic abilities and abilities with the Ninjutsu keyword and cannot create more body doubles of itself.

When you take the movement action or use a non-teleport movement ability, your clone may move for the same amount of distance as you moved.

You may spend 0 AP or 1 RP to dismiss the body double. A clone can never travel more than 300ft from your actual body, but while it lasts you may spend 2 AP to swap locations with it.

A clone lasts until you rest.

All Abilities.Name: Call of the Grave
All Abilities.Description: You make a Heavy Attack against the target that deals Dark damage. On hit, if the target is large or smaller, you pull them to you. They are Challenged until the start of your next turn. This ability does not provoke an attack of opportunity.

All Abilities.Name: Can't Escape Death
All Abilities.Description: You may use this after an enemy leaves your melee range. After the target finishes moving, you may sidestep up to your speed towards them. For 1 RP, you may move double your speed instead.
All Abilities.Requirements: A target Challenged by you leaves your melee range.

All Abilities.Name: Canter
All Abilities.Description: You may Sidestep 10ft.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be mounted and can be used immediately after making a weapon attack.

All Abilities.Name: Carpenter Basics
All Abilities.Benefits: You can use a carpenters chisel as a crafting tool for carpenters crafts and buildings., You can craft using Pine and Maple, as well as alloys., You gain proficiency in axes. You also gain proficiency in either bows or crossbows., You can use the Carpenter's core crafting abilities.

All Abilities.Name: Carpenter's Modification A
All Abilities.Description: You add an A-Type modification to the weapon or tool. See the Universal Weapon page as well as the individual weapon page for details. Each modification has its own cost.

All Abilities.Name: Infuse Wand
All Abilities.Description: You add a drop of Oil Coating into a wand, changing the built in damage type to the element of the oil. Only works with oils that change the damage type. Does not consume the oil.

All Abilities.Name: Joining and Assembling
All Abilities.Description: You mix a special material into the carpentry project. Each material has its own crafting point cost.Create Oil CoatingCost:ErrandDescription:You create an Oil Coating from Carpenter materials. See Items: Carpenter Materials.Create Wood BlockCost:ErrandDescription:You create a Wood Block from Carpenter materials. See Items: Carpenter Materials.

All Abilities.Name: Castling
All Abilities.Description: You swap positions with a Rook puppet piece you control.

All Abilities.Name: Cat Form
All Abilities.Description: You transform intocat form, reducing your Guard to 0 but increasing your Evasion by +3 and Dodge by +6.  Your size is tiny and you are able to occupy the same square as an ally.  While in Cat form the only attack you can make is Light Melee Attack.  If you take damage in Cat Form, you immediately return to your normal form.  You can dispel this form for 0 AP or 1 RP.

All Abilities.Name: Cavalry Charge
All Abilities.Description:
You may spend up to 4 AP on this ability and move as though you had spent that AP on movement. You automatically gain the Trample effect as like the Trample ability once you have moved 20ft.

For every 10ft moved, the attack you make as part of the Trample effect gains +1 bonus damage, up to a maximum of +10.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be mounted.

All Abilities.Name: Cavalry Heal
All Abilities.Description: You heal the target for 11 + (Power x 2). If the target is mounted, their mount gets healed for the same amount.

All Abilities.Name: Cave Raider
All Abilities.Description: Until the start of your next turn, you gain the ability to climb your speed.  In addition if you have rope, you can tie it to a secure object and you can rappel down a cliffside up to 50ft at the cost of 5ft of movement.

All Abilities.Name: Celestial Artillery
All Abilities.Benefits: When attacking an enemy that’s further than 80ft away, your spells with the Celestial keyword gain the Artillery keyword., You may use Comet.

All Abilities.Name: Chain Lightning
All Abilities.Description:
You may make a Heavy Attack against the target dealing Lightning Damage and inflicting Static X where X equals your Focus x 3. On damage, you may repeat this attack against another target within 30ft of the target without paying additional costs. This attack may repeat multiple times like this.

You cannot target the same creature more than once per use of this ability.

All Abilities.Name: Chair Grab
All Abilities.Description: You grab a nearby unattended object and are able to use it as an improvised weapon.

All Abilities.Name: Channel Eidolon
All Abilities.Description: You use the ability granted by your attuned Eidolon. All costs and effects are determined by your attunement.

All Abilities.Name: Channel Eidolon: Distracting Swarm
All Abilities.Description:
You summon a distracting swarm around a target. The target immediately loses any Concentration effects and suffers -5 penalty to Perception checks unless they spend 1 RP to sidestep out of the effect. If they did not move, they also cannot use any abilities with the Concentration keyword until they move.

You can only have 1 Distracting Swarm active at the same time.
All Abilities.Requirements: Ixilune attunement.

All Abilities.Name: Channel Eidolon: Draw Luck
All Abilities.Description:
You draw on your luck, manipulating the circumstances around you to the best possible state. If you are the target of an attack, that attack becomes a 1. If you made a roll, that roll becomes a 20 (despite the pact cost).

May also be used in situations that don’t have you making a roll, such as flipping a coin, but the act that you’re influencing cannot take more than 5 seconds to complete.

After using this ability, you become temporarily afflicted with bad luck. The GM decides what exactly happens and what triggers it, but it could turn your roll into a 1, make an enemy roll a 20 against you or something related to the environment. After a bad luck action happens, the bad luck is removed.

You cannot use this ability again until after the bad luck has been removed.

All Abilities.Name: Channel Eidolon: Vine Wall Cover
All Abilities.Description:
Thick vines sprout from the ground or natural wall as you create a 5x5 wall of vines that is 10ft high. The wall of vines counts as full cover (unless you peek from it) and has HP equal to yourToughnessx6. The vines are sturdy enough to stand on.

Lasts for up to 5 minutes and you can only have 5 instances of Vine Wall Cover at one time.
All Abilities.Requirements: Pipoltr attunement.

All Abilities.Name: Charge
All Abilities.Description: You may spend 2 or 4 AP on this ability and move as though you had spent that AP on movement. After you finish moving, you may spend half of the AP you used on this ability on Light or Heavy Melee Attacks.

All Abilities.Name: Check
All Abilities.Description:
You move a puppet piece in such a way (following Move Piece rules) that it can attack an enemy if it moves again.

At the start of your next turn, you may move that piece as if you used Move Piece without spending AP/Mana or it counting as an ability use.

All Abilities.Name: Chemical Explosive
All Abilities.Description: You place a Chemical Explosive package that detonates after one minute. The explosion has a 15 ft radius and deals Double Heavy damage. The package makes an obvious noise after it has been planted that can be heard within the radius. The explosive charge deals 5x damage against inanimate objects. You can create a Chemical Explosive during an interlude phase for free, but can only carry one at a time. The check to disable a Chemical Explosive is equal to 20 + 2 x Power of the creator.

All Abilities.Name: Chiburi Noto
All Abilities.Description: You clean the blood off your katana and sheath the blade. If your next Iai strike with this weapon during this arc is a hit, its Roll Damage is maximized.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must have used an ability with the Iaijutsu keyword with the chosen weapon this encounter.

All Abilities.Name: Chiburi Noto II
All Abilities.Description: You clean the blood off your katana and sheath the blade. If your next Iai strike with this weapon during this arc is a hit, its Roll Damage is maximized and it gains Full Pierce.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must have used an ability with the Iaijutsu keyword with the chosen weapon this encounter.

All Abilities.Name: Chilling Cold
All Abilities.Description: You can emit a cooling wind within 30ft that counters the effects of most hot weather. You can enable or disable this every 1 second. In addition you gain Elemental Mastery: Frost.

All Abilities.Name: Circle Swing
All Abilities.Description: You make a Light Attack against the target. On damage, you may move the target to anywhere in your weapon range (Max 10ft) , then push it 5ft. The target must remain at the same height it was before this ability was used. Your next Spell or Channeling Weapon attack this turn costs 1 less AP (Min 0).

All Abilities.Name: Clearcasting
All Abilities.Description: The next Spell you cast this encounter has its mana cost reduced by 2. This cannot reduce the mana cost below 0.

All Abilities.Name: Cleave
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Heavy Attack against two different targets in range.
All Abilities.Requirements: Two-Handed weapons only.

All Abilities.Name: Cloak of Bats
All Abilities.Description: You vanish into a swarm of bats and reappear somewhere else within range. If this was used in reaction to an attack, that attack automatically misses you.

All Abilities.Name: Cloud Piercing Claw
All Abilities.Description:
You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, they are knocked airborne 20ft until the end of your turn (if this attack is made outside of your turn, they drop immediately). They are NOT knocked prone from this, but do take fall damage like normal.

You may Sidestep up to 25ft into the air after making this attack, regardless of if you did damage with it.

Combo: If used after entering Boundless Wind Stance, the mana cost of this ability is reduced by 1.

All Abilities.Name: Cloudstep
All Abilities.Description: You may Sidestep up to half your speed. This movement ignores difficult terrain.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be the first movement action in your turn.

All Abilities.Name: Combat Chemistry
All Abilities.Description:
Can only be used once per encounter.

Using your knowledge of alchemy, you jury-rig a special item that has the effect of an an elixir, poison, flask or potion with a cost of 300c or lower.

You can only make the base version of the item with no mods. The item doesn't take up burden, but must be used before the start of your next turn or it is lost. This item can only be used by you.

All Abilities.Name: Comet
All Abilities.Description: You make a Light (1 AP) or Heavy (2 AP) attack against the target that deals Arcane damage.

All Abilities.Name: Compression
All Abilities.Description:
You make a Heavy attack against the target that deals Physical (Crushing) damage.

If the target is Large Size or bigger, the mana cost of this is reduced by 1.

All Abilities.Name: Concealed Shot
All Abilities.Description: You immediately make a new stealth check and remain hidden if enemies fail their perception check.
All Abilities.Requirements: Only usable after attacking with a Sniper Rifle while stealthed.

All Abilities.Name: Conduit
All Abilities.Description:
When Mind Connection is active, you can channel some abilities through others with Mind Connection. You cannot use conduit with abilities that require a physical object to be present, such as a Mystic Eye power or a specific weapon or abilities that require you to interact with a physical object, such as Snatch. Abilities that require your physical body to make an attack, such as Double Punch also don't work.

You still must pay the costs to use the abilities, and your Mind Connection source becomes the origin point of the spell for purposes of range. Abilities with a range of Self cannot be used through Conduit.

Any ability used through Conduit that isn't an Aetherie ability costs +1 AP (or RP) to use.

All Abilities.Name: Consistent Shot
All Abilities.Description:
You may make a Precise Attack against the target. This attack deals Heavy Damage instead.

This attack does not gain Pinpoint.

All Abilities.Name: Consume Enemy
All Abilities.Description: You eat the body of a deceased enemy, healing you for your Toughness x 2, regaining 1 mana and preventing a single injury.

All Abilities.Name: Consume Fire
All Abilities.Description: You gainConsume Fire, which gives you Damage Reduction 100 Fire against the triggering damage. If the attacker is not yourself or from an effect caused by you, you can then spend 2 Mana to heal for the original damage amount, up to 100 HP.
All Abilities.Requirements: You're about to take Fire Damage.

All Abilities.Name: Consume Lightning
All Abilities.Description: You gainConsume Lightning, which gives you Damage Reduction 100 Lightning for the triggering damage. If you reduce damage in any way from this ability and the cause of this damage is not you or from an effect caused by you, you gainLightning Boost. Lightning Boost grants a damage bonus on your next Lightning Elemental Attack equal to the attacker’s power. This damage bonus is doubled on heavy attacks.
All Abilities.Requirements: You are about to take Lightning damage

All Abilities.Name: Controlled Blaze
All Abilities.Benefits: When you deal Fire Damage, you may choose not to ignite flammable objects., You gain Fire Mastery.

All Abilities.Name: Controlled Opportunities
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain Heavy Armor proficiency., When making an attack of opportunity, you gain a +2 bonus to the accuracy and damage roll.

All Abilities.Name: Controlled Wind
All Abilities.Benefits: When pushing a target back or up with a Wind Spell, you may choose to push up to the maximum distance instead of always pushing the maximum distance.

All Abilities.Name: Corona Burst
All Abilities.Description: You make a Heavy attack against the target that deals Fire damage. For every 20ft of distance the target is away from you, this deals +1 damage. (Up to a maximum of +12)

All Abilities.Name: Corpse Domination
All Abilities.Description: You raise the target under your command. A target raised in this way is treated as a non-heroic unit that takes its own actions, however it will try to act in a way that is most helpful to you in the fight. The raised target keeps all of its stats and abilities it had in life, though it only starts with half its maximum health (before any reductions) and whatever mana it had left over when it died. This summon lasts until the end of the encounter or until its HP reaches 0, upon which it immediately dies again and cannot be raised again in any way.
All Abilities.Requirements: Target must be a dead humanoid.

All Abilities.Name: Corpse Explosion
All Abilities.Description: You detonate 1 of your zombies, making a Light Attack that deals Dark damage against all creatures in range but killing the zombie. You may detonate additional zombies when using this ability to increase the damage this deals by 2 for each additional zombie.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must have an active zombie from Raise Undead.

All Abilities.Name: Corpse Puppetry
All Abilities.Description:
You may control a corpse less than a week old within 30ft of you to perform simple actions, such as moving or talking.

A corpse used this way has no combat stats and cannot attack.
All Abilities.Requirements: Target must be dead.

All Abilities.Name: Counter-Potion
All Abilities.Description: You may immediately use a Potion, Elixir, Salve, Poison or Flask that is held in your hand.  X is equal to the AP cost of the action.

All Abilities.Name: Counter Stance
All Abilities.Description:
You enter a stance in which you freely counterattack against enemies that attack you. After an attack against you has resolved, you may make a Melee Attack of Opportunity against that target. While in this stance, you cannot use the Dodge or Block reactions.

You may spend 0 AP or 1 RP to cancel this stance. It otherwise lasts until you enter another stance.

All Abilities.Name: Countershot
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Precise Attack against the incoming attack. If your accuracy check matches or beats the enemy’s accuracy check, you shoot down the incoming arrow and the attack is negated.
All Abilities.Requirements: You or an ally are targeted by a ranged weapon attack.

All Abilities.Name: Counterspell
All Abilities.Description:
You pay RP equal to half the AP spent on the triggering Spell (rounded up) or equal to the RP spent on the triggering spell and Counter it, canceling its effect without refunding the AP. If the AP cost is higher than your RP, you cannot Counterspell it.

If used against a non-Grunt target, you must pay 1 mana for each point of Focus that the target has more than you (minimum 0).

This Spell does not provoke attacks of opportunity, but cannot be used to Counter Spells that have an AP and RP cost of 0.
All Abilities.Requirements: An enemy casts a spell within range

All Abilities.Name: Craft Artificer's Glove
All Abilities.Description:
You create a personalized Artificer’s Glove that only you have proficiency with.  Choose a glove type with properties of your choosing at the time of creation.  You can modify this glove for an errand action to change the property, but you can only have one property at a time and only one Artificer’s glove at a time.

Gamma Glove (Hacker):Artifice Jamming. For 1 RP you can Jam a small shell artifice within 120ft causing it to malfunction and be unusable until the user spends 1 AP to clear the jam.

Sigma Glove (Combat Artificer):Heat Sink.  0 RP, 1 mana.  Your glove emits frost energy that saps heat from an artifice, allowing it to bypass the once per turn limit a single time.Overcharge:1 RP, the mana cost becomes 0.

Delta Glove (Specialist):The glove is specialized for an expertise skill granting you +10 in that skill.  For instance, it might fire an arcane blast to propel you, granting you +10 to jumping. May not choose artisan or gathering skils.

All Abilities.Name: Craft Pemmican
All Abilities.Description:
