Errand. You turn up to 1000u of food into 25 Pemmican Bars (40u of food per bar), which are incredibly shelf stable and easy to eat.  They perform about the same as Military Rations but they are wrapped by special leaves that deter pests—useful and consistent adventure food.

You may also use this as an IP action to convert up to 2000u of food into 50 Pemmican bars.

All Abilities.Name: Craft Weapons
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain Blacksmith Core Crafting Abilities., You can craft using the Iron and Tamahagane base materials, as well as any alloys., You can use a Smith’s Hammer as a crafting tool for blacksmithing crafts. You may also use it as a Bludgeoning weapon in which you are proficient., You gain proficiency in 1 smithing weapon.

All Abilities.Name: Crashing Foam Wave
All Abilities.Description: Creates a wave of water originating from a point of water within range.  Shoves an adjacent target of size large or smaller 10ft away from the point of origin.  If the target is on top of the water, you can choose to shove the target in any direction.  You can use either AP or RP for the cost of this ability.

All Abilities.Name: Create Talisman
All Abilities.Description:
You may create a talisman or scroll by spending an interlude point. Choose an Spell that you know or choose a specialized talisman, such as a Sealing Talisman. You inscribe that Spell onto a piece of paper. A talisman of a Spell allows you to use the Spell at a different time. When you use it, it is consumed. A Spell talisman costs as much AP and mana to use as the original Spell does.

You may craft up to 5 talismans per interlude point. A secret art talisman takes up 3 of these slots. When crafting, you may make no more than 2 of the same spell. A crafted talisman costs 1 burden to carry with you. A Secret Art talisman costs 2 burden and can only be used through the Secret Talisman ability.

Crafting a talisman costs 100 calligraphy units per AP and Mana of the spell. A spell with no AP or Mana costs 50 units. If the spell has an RP cost and no AP cost, it costs 200u per RP. If the spell has a casting time longer than 4 AP (ie 10 minutes), then treat the spell as having a cost of 4 AP.

All Abilities.Name: Crescent Sweep
All Abilities.Description: You make a Light Attack against all enemies in range. On damage, a target falls Prone.
All Abilities.Requirements: Polearm only

All Abilities.Name: Crimson Enmity
All Abilities.Description: When your HP is at or below 50% of your max HP, you gainCrimson Enmity. When you would heal an ally or yourself with an ability from this class (Bloodbinder), you heal for 1.5x that amount.

All Abilities.Name: Crippling Attack
All Abilities.Description: You make a Light Attack against the target. On damage the target is Slowed until the end of their next turn.

All Abilities.Name: Crucified by Radiance
All Abilities.Description:
You make a light attack that deals Holy(Light) to any targets in a 5ft wide line. At any point of the line you can draw a second 55ft long perpendicular line centered on that point of the initial line. You make another Light attack against all caught on this second line and on damage you inflict Illumination X where X is your Focus / 2 (Rounded Down) until the end of your next turn.

If a target gets hit by both lines, the second line deals Heavy damage and inflicts your full Focus in Illumination instead.

All Abilities.Name: Crusader's Advance
All Abilities.Description: You teleport to an empty square next to an enemy you marked with the Mark of Justice.
All Abilities.Requirements: Target has your Mark of Justice on them.

All Abilities.Name: Culinary Basics
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain Culinarian Core Crafting Abilities, You can craft stocks using advanced and base materials., You can use a Frying Pan as a crafting tool for culinarian crafts. You may also use it as a Light Bludgeoning weapon in which you are proficient., You gain proficiency in small weapons.

All Abilities.Name: Create Box or Bundle of Food
All Abilities.Description: You create a perfect mix of ingredients that would be worthy of a stock with 500u of matching material. Example: 500u of Meat can make 1 Box of Fresh Meat. You can make 5 boxes of any kind for one errand action.

All Abilities.Name: Fish Stock
All Abilities.Description: Turns a Gourmet Base Stock into a Fish Stock (does not stack with other stocks), which when added to a cooked meal gives a +1 Toughness Food Bonus that lasts for 24 hours. Requires 1 Box of Fresh Fish.

All Abilities.Name: Herbal Stock
All Abilities.Description: Turns a Gourmet Base Stock into a Herbal Stock (does not stack with other stocks), which when added to a cooked meal gives a +1 Gathering Food Bonus that lasts for 24 hours. Requires 1 bundle of Fresh Cooking Herbs. When gathering from a node with a bonus from this stock, you keep the benefit for that entire node unless you go a day without harvesting from that node.Stir Layered FlavorsCost:30 Crafting PointsDescription:Allows you to add another flavor, allowing you to add a second different flavor. Choose from Mushroom, Meaty, Fish, Vegetable, Spicy or Herbal—then add the corresponding ingredient. For example: A Mushroom stock + Meaty stock becomes a Mushroom-Meaty stock that grants +1 Power / +1 Focus Food Bonus.

All Abilities.Name: Meaty Stock
All Abilities.Description: Turns a Gourmet Base Stock into a Meaty Stock (does not stack with other stocks), which when added to a cooked meal gives a +1 Power Food Bonus that lasts for 24 hours. Requires 1 Box of Fresh Meat.

All Abilities.Name: Mushroom Stock
All Abilities.Description: Turns a Gourmet Base Stock into a Mushroom Stock (does not stack with other stocks), which when added to a cooked meal gives a +1 Focus Food Bonus that lasts for 24 hours. Requires 1 Box of Fresh Mushrooms.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Ingredient
All Abilities.Description: You mix a special material into the stock. Each material has its own crafting point cost.

All Abilities.Name: Spicy Stock
All Abilities.Description: Turns a Gourmet Base Stock into a Spicy Stock (does not stack with other stocks), which when added to a cooked meal gives a +1 Crafting Food Bonus that lasts for 24 hours. Requires 1 bundle of Spicy Peppers.

All Abilities.Name: Use Every Last Drop
All Abilities.Description: Increases the stock yield by 2.

All Abilities.Name: Vegetable Stock
All Abilities.Description: Turns a Gourmet Base Stock into a Vegetable Stock (does not stack with other stocks), which when added to a cooked meal gives a +1 Agility Food Bonus that lasts for 24 hours. Requires 1 Box of Fresh Vegetables.

All Abilities.Name: Cultivator's Journey
All Abilities.Benefits: Your unarmed attack damage is treated as a One-Handed Weapon in which you are proficient., You gain proficiency in light armor, light swords and another weapon of your choice., You gain +5 skill points to spend in Appraise, Athletics, Deception, Perception, Insight, Medicine, Intimidation, Stealth or Common Knowledge. You can exchange any skill point for 2 expertise points, but must spend them in these skills.

All Abilities.Name: Cure Touch
All Abilities.Description: You heal the target for 11 + Power x 2

All Abilities.Name: Cure Touch II
All Abilities.Description: You Heal the target for 22 + (4 x Power)

All Abilities.Name: Cure Water
All Abilities.Description: You cast this ability on water within range, healing a target within 30ft for 11 + Power x 2. You can use either AP or RP for the cost of this ability.

All Abilities.Name: Cursed Evil Eye
All Abilities.Description:
You open your Cursed Mystic Eye that curses everything in sight.

All targets in a 90 degree cone up to range must make a save against your Potency or take Light Dark(Curse) damage.

Upkeep: 1 AP. When you pay the upkeep cost, you may repeat this attack.

All Abilities.Name: Cut Away
All Abilities.Description: Instead of rolling a save normally, you may make a Precise Attack against the Potency of the ability instead. If your accuracy roll beats the Potency, you are treated as having passed the save.
All Abilities.Requirements: You are the target of an ability that forces you to make a save.

All Abilities.Name: Cut Magic
All Abilities.Description:
You make a Heavy Attack against a temporary magic effect. If your accuracy roll is equal or higher than the Potency of the effect, the effect is removed.

Overcharge:You may spend 1 additional AP to turn the Heavy attack into a Precise attack instead.

All Abilities.Name: Cyclone
All Abilities.Description: All targets in a 15x15 ft area must make a save against your Potency or be knocked airborne for 10ft, falling Prone once they land.

All Abilities.Name: Dark Barrier
All Abilities.Description:
You and up to 4 other willing allies within range take Light Dark damage. Afterwards they gain temporary HP until end of encounter equal to double the damage taken.

You may choose to ignore Dark resistance or damage reduction on your allies for this ability.

All Abilities.Name: Dark Bolt
All Abilities.Keywords: Spell, Dark, Half Pierce, Full Pierce
All Abilities.Description: You fire a bolt of darkness at a target, making a Light Attack that deals Dark Damage. You may take true damage equal to your Power + 3 to give this ability Full Pierce.

All Abilities.Name: Dark Healing
All Abilities.Description:
You take Light (1 AP) or Heavy damage (2 AP), then heal a target within range an amount equal to damage taken.

You may choose to ignore Dark resistance or damage reduction on yourself for this damage.

All Abilities.Name: Dark Surge
All Abilities.Benefits: After you deal damage to yourself, you gain Dark Surge for your next unarmed attack that turn. Dark Surge gives you +1 Accuracy.

All Abilities.Name: Darkness
All Abilities.Description:
You conjure a 15x15ft area of pure darkness within range. The darkness blocks line of sight. Targets inside of or within 5ft of the Darkness can only see up to 5ft into or out of Darkness. In addition, any targets within the Darkness that do not have Darkvision or a similar ability that lets them see in darkness are considered Blinded 2 (nightvision does not apply).

This lasts for up to 10 minutes and you may end this effect for 0 AP.

The mana cost of this ability is reduced by 2 during the night.

All Abilities.Name: Darkvision
All Abilities.Description: You touch an ally and share your Darkvision with them until the end of the encounter, letting them see up 60ft in the darkness.

All Abilities.Name: Darkvision (passive)
All Abilities.Description: You gain 60ft darkvision, allowing you to see perfectly in the dark even without a source of light.

All Abilities.Name: Death Mark
All Abilities.Description: You mentally mark a target for death by applying Death Mark, opening them up to your Assassin abilities. When you reduce a character marked by Death Mark to 0 HP or lower, you may move up to your Speed and take the Hide action for 0 RP. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
All Abilities.Requirements: Enemy is surprised.

All Abilities.Name: Death Perception
All Abilities.Description: You can assess the approximate HP percentage of all living units within range until the end of combat. (The DM should enable health bars for the unit). Only affects unit in your line of sight when you use this ability, if more enemies join the fight later they are not affected until you use this ability again.

All Abilities.Name: Decipher Magic
All Abilities.Description:
You may start a skill challenge against a magic effect you can see in an attempt to understand it.

You are able to disable tier 1 bounded fields with this ability.

All Abilities.Name: Deckbreaker
All Abilities.Description:
You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, you inflict Offstep on the target for the next attack against it.

If the target is inflicted with Stagger, the mana cost of this is reduced by 1.

If you're under the effects of Exposing Edge, this attack gains Lock On.
All Abilities.Requirements: One-Handed weapons only.

All Abilities.Name: Deconstruction
All Abilities.Description:
By spending an Interlude Point, you deconstruct a basic item into materials. You gain 500 matching crafting material per ingot or block used in the item. If the item does not use ingots, you instead get 1 matching crafting material per clim value of the item.

Regardless of the material used in the item, you will only gain the base price amount even if using upgraded materials and all alloys and upgrades are lost.  You can deconstruct up to 5 basic items for 1 interlude point.

Alternatively instead of 1 basic item, you can transmute up to 1000u of random junk into up to 250u of usable basic (ie: Iron, Pine etc) Blacksmithing Materials, Armorsmithing Materials, Carpentry Materials, Calligraphy Material, Magical Fuel Materials or Medical Materials units at a 4:1 ratio.You can also use Deconstruction as an Errand Action, but the deconstruction limit is reduced to 1 basic item instead of 5 basic items.

All Abilities.Name: Defensive Flexibility
All Abilities.Description:
You react to the triggering attack with the opposite reaction you used to meet the requirement of this ability. (IE if you used Dodge as your last reaction, you use the Block reaction for this).

The first time each encounter your RP goes below half your maximum RP, you regain the Circuit benefit on this.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be the target of an attack and must have reacted to the previous attack against you with the Dodge or Block action.

All Abilities.Name: Deflect Everything
All Abilities.Benefits: You may use your Parry ability against every kind of attack.

All Abilities.Name: Delay Time
All Abilities.Description:
You choose one or more negative effects on the target that would trigger at the start or end of their turn. They trigger on the turn after the turn they would normally trigger instead.

You may only delay an effect once, but you are able to delay Stasis even though the target is normally immune to all abilities.

Start of turn effects still trigger at the start of the turn and end of turn effects still trigger at the end of the turn.

All Abilities.Name: Delayed Hit
All Abilities.Description: You make a Heavy Attack against the target, but don’t deal damage. On hit, even if it was guarded, the target takes Heavy Damage at the start of your next turn. (This delayed damage is calculated of the target’s Guard at the time it’s applied, not when the attack hit)

All Abilities.Name: Demonblood Regeneration
All Abilities.Description: You heal faster than those of other races. You gain the following benefits:

All Abilities.Name: Dense Frame
All Abilities.Description: When you would be pushed back by an effect, you are shoved for 5ft less.

All Abilities.Name: Dense Mana
All Abilities.Description: You augment your next ability, increasing the Potency of your next ability by 2.

All Abilities.Name: Density Break
All Abilities.Description: You make a Precise attack that deals damage equal to the target’s Toughness.

All Abilities.Name: Despair of Isolation
All Abilities.Description:
Everyone within your Mist of the Vale becomes Slowed until the end of their next turn. They must also make a Save or become Dazed until the end of their next turn. On failure, they also cannot target allies with friendly effects while in the mist until the end of their next turn.

You may spend 1 Mana to exclude allies from this attack.
All Abilities.Requirements: Mist of the Vale must be active.

All Abilities.Name: Destroy Ground
All Abilities.Description:
You destroy natural earth with magical speed, creating up to a 10ft x 10ft x 10ft hole in most natural earth. Those caught in the effect may spend 1 RP to Sidestep 5ft out of the effect. All caught in the effect fall down 10ft into the hole and take falling damage as normal.

The spell requires natural ground to be below the touching surface to function. It may work on the bottom floor of a house, but will fail if used higher up or in some dungeons

All Abilities.Name: Destroying Angel
All Abilities.Description: You make a Precise Attack against an enemy unit within range, dealing Poison Damage. On damage, if the enemy is a Grunt, they are immediately reduced to negative their Max HP and die. On Killing Blow, the current host of Spore Symbiote is healed for 5 + Power x 2.

All Abilities.Name: Detailed Finish
All Abilities.Description: Make a crafting check. Upgrade the dice to 2d8.
All Abilities.Requirements: This is your last crafting dice. Costs 1 Crafting Dice.

All Abilities.Name: Deus Vult
All Abilities.Description: Can use with active Holy Orders. Your next basic attack or Ave Maria against your Holy Order gains the Lock On and Shieldbreaker keywords against your Holy Order.
All Abilities.Requirements: A target of your Holy Order.

All Abilities.Name: Devastating Strike
All Abilities.Description: You make a Light attack against the target.
All Abilities.Requirements: Target must have 0 RP remaining.

All Abilities.Name: Devastating Strike II
All Abilities.Description: You make a Light attack against the target. The dice are maximized instead of rolling.
All Abilities.Requirements: The target has no RP.

All Abilities.Name: Devastating Strike III
All Abilities.Description: You make a Light (1 AP) or Heavy (2 AP) attack against the target.
All Abilities.Requirements: Target must have 0 RP remaining and must be marked by Death Mark. One-handed weapons only.

All Abilities.Name: Devil's Blow
All Abilities.Description:
You make a Heavy attack against the target. This attack does NOT have Full Pierce.

If you roll a 1 on the accuracy check, you take full pierce damage of same the type as the attack equal to the damage roll of the attack. You also regain the mana spent on this.

All Abilities.Name: Devil's Curse
All Abilities.Description:
The attacker takes damage equal to the damage roll of the triggering attack. They cannot Dodge or Block this damage.

Does not work against Secret Arts, Climax Arts or similar level abilities.
All Abilities.Requirements: An enemy accuracy check against you rolls a 1.

All Abilities.Name: Dharani: Blooming Conciousness
All Abilities.Description:
You release all gathered harmony as petals of radiant light that spiral outward from your body.

You consume all Harmony stacks and 1 mana per stack to heal all allies within range for (6 + Your focus) / 2 for each stack consumed.

If you do not have enough mana for all stacks, this ability instead consumes stacks equal to the mana you can spend.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be in Luminous Form Stance and have 5 stacks of Harmony.

All Abilities.Name: Dimensional Armory
All Abilities.Benefits: You can create a pocket dimension with Dimensional Armory.  Creating the pocket dimension and establishing its door takes 1 week and costs 1 errand point.  The entry point can be any regular door that you fit through.  When the creator opens this door, they can decide instead to access the Dimensional Armory, which is a 15ft x 15ft closet.  This closet can hold up to 6 Burden worth of items.  Some magic items can be rejected by the dimensional armory (GM’s discretion), such as Divine Arms not bonded to you.  If the owner of a Dimensional Armory dies, everything inside of it appears in the next unoccupied space possible next to the owner.

All Abilities.Name: Dimensional Armory Expansion
All Abilities.Description: Your burden limit for your Dimensional Armory is increased by 4.  Ahead of time, you designate one armor, one cloak and one weapon/shield or two weapons or one two-handed weapon that are inside of your Dimensional Armory as a “dimensional set”, this process takes 15 minutes of concentration.  You can only have one dimensional set at a time.

All Abilities.Name: Dirge of Despair
All Abilities.Description:
All enemies within range must make a save against your Potency or become affected by this Song. While affected, you may subtract 1d4 from a single roll they make until the start of your next turn. You may choose to add this after seeing the roll.

Upkeep:At the start of your next turn and every turn thereafter, you may spend 1 AP to continue this performance. Enemies that successfully made their save, do not have to save again against this continued performance, but those who were affected continue to be affected.

All Abilities.Name: Disable Magic
All Abilities.Benefits: When using Decipher Magic, you are able to disable both tier 1 and tier 2 level bounded fields., You are able to disable or change who is excluded from your own Bounded Fields for 0 RP.

All Abilities.Name: Disarming Attack
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Light Attack against the target. On damage, you Disarm the target until the start of your next turn.

All Abilities.Name: Disarming Shot
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. If the attack beat the passive evasion of the target (before Dodge bonuses), you Disarm the target until the start of your next turn. The target may spend 1 RP to avoid the disarm effect. This is in addition to any RP the target may spend to avoid the attack itself.

All Abilities.Name: Discern Immunities
All Abilities.Description:
You look at a single target and glean what its resistances are until the end of the encounter. When you are about to use an ability with a negative effect that would be passively negated by the target, you become aware of this and may cancel your action.

Does not apply if the target has an active ability that can remove it, such as a paladin’s Paragon of Virtue for example.

All Abilities.Name: Discipline
All Abilities.Description: Instead of rolling, you can choose instead to accept 10 as the dice value for a skill check.
All Abilities.Requirements: You have at least 5 skill points in the called for skill. Use when you need to roll a skill check.

All Abilities.Name: Dispel Magic
All Abilities.Description: You dispel a temporary magic effect from an area or target. All non-permanent effects within range that are created by an ability with the Spell or Enchantment keyword are affected. Spells that do not have a time limit listed or create a permanent effect such as a Geomancer's fissure are not affected. Bounded Fields and Secret Arts cannot be removed with Dispel Magic.

All Abilities.Name: Disrupt Ki
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Light Attack against the target. On damage, if they have any Concentration ability active, that ability immediately ends as if they had chosen to drop it.

All Abilities.Name: Divine Barrage
All Abilities.Description:
You make a Light attack against the target and instruct others to follow your lead.

X allies other than you within 30ft of you may also make a Light attack against the same target.

All Abilities.Name: Divine Guard
All Abilities.Description: You may immediately use the Block action to guard against the triggering attack with a +5 bonus to Guard.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be transformed by Divine Release and targeted by an attack.

All Abilities.Name: Divine Might
All Abilities.Description: You make a Light Attack against the target.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be transformed by Divine Release.

All Abilities.Name: Divine Providence
All Abilities.Description:
When you use this ability you choose one of the following effects:

Divine Protection:You are protected from harm through divine protection, gaining 100 damage reduction against the next source of damage you take.

Fortune:When used for this effect, this ability becomes Instant. You may reroll your last d20 and take the new result.

Health:You heal someone (or yourself) within touching distance for 15 hp.

Light:You summon a bright light at your position that shines a bright light up to 30ft around you. You may detonate this light by spending 0 AP toDazeall enemies within its range.

Once you use this ability, you may not use it again until after a rest.

All Abilities.Name: Divine Release
All Abilities.Description:
Demons can feed on their own lifeforce to release a brilliant display of divine powers. Horns can elongate, fangs might grow, eyes glow and even wings can sprout as the Demon realizes their Divine Roots.

Upkeep: 11 HP

You transform into your new form and take 11 damage. You may end this form at any time by spending 0 RP. While the form lasts you gain the following benefits:

Fallen Guard:When you take the Block basic action, you gain an additional +5 to guard.Fallen Alacrity:You gain +5 movement speed and the ability to fly.Fallen Might:You gain +1 AP at the start of your turn.Fallen Conviction:When you are reduced to 0 HP, you do not enter the downed state. You still receive the wounded status. While at or below 0 HP, the upkeep for this ability is increased to 16. If you end this ability while at or below 0 HP, you are immediately placed into the downed state. If your HP become equal to or lower than your negative maximum HP, you are immediately incapacitated and this ability ends.

Once you use this ability, you cannot do so again until you finish an interlude rest phase.

All Abilities.Name: Divine Smite
All Abilities.Description:
You may make a Heavy Attack that deals Holy Damage against the target. If your target’s HP is lower than the max damage your attack would deal, this attack gains Full Pierce and does maximum damage instead of rolling.

This calculation only involves your base damage (Base weapon damage + the power). Any other effects added to the damage such as Heavy Blade's bonus damage, Anathema on target etc do not affect the calculation and aren't maximized.
All Abilities.Requirements: Target has your Mark of Justice on them.

All Abilities.Name: Divine Smite II
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Heavy Attack that deals Holy Damage against the target. On damage, you may give yourself or an ally within 30ft temporary HP equal your 5+Power until the end of the encounter.

All Abilities.Name: Divine Storm
All Abilities.Description:
You make a Heavy attack with your weapon against the target of your Mark of Justice.

You then make a Light attack against all other enemies within 5ft and push them back 10ft, regardless of whether the attack hit or not. This light attack is not made with your weapon and always does the damage type of your god (as determined by your Holy weapon key ability).
All Abilities.Requirements: Target has your Mark of Justice on them.

All Abilities.Name: Divining Petalfall
All Abilities.Description: Make a gathering check with a +5 bonus. If the final dice value is even, add it to Node Points. If it’s odd, add it to Lucky Points.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be in a gathering session.

All Abilities.Name: Doctor Jekyll
All Abilities.Description: You draw and either drink a Potion or Elixir, or throw one to a willing ally within 30ft who immediately drinks it.

All Abilities.Name: Dog Form
All Abilities.Description:
You transform into yourDog Form, becoming a medium size dog. You lose 2 guard and 4 block, but gain a +1 Size bonus to Evasion and Dodge.

While in Dog Form, you can only make melee unarmed attacks and you are considered proficient in these attacks.

If you take damage in Dog Form, you immediately return to your normal form. You can dispel this form for 0 AP or 1 RP.

All Abilities.Name: Double Elements
All Abilities.Description: Your next Elemental Strike or Elemental Sweep ability used this turn may add in the effect of another element. This element must be one you have mastered and different from the effect that's already dealt by the attack.

All Abilities.Name: Double Palm Strike
All Abilities.Description: You attack the target for Light Damage. On damage, the target is moved up to 15ft away from you (At least 5 feet).

All Abilities.Name: Double Punch
All Abilities.Description:
You may make two Light Attacks against the same target.

You may not make a dual wield attack until the start of your next turn.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must not have made a dual wield attack this turn.

All Abilities.Name: Double Slam
All Abilities.Description:
You may make up to 2 Light attacks against the target, paying 1 AP and 1 Mana for each. On damage of either hit, the target becomesUnbalanced. If the target is already unbalanced, they are knocked prone.

If you are wielding only 1 Two-Handed weapon, you are limited to 1 attack.
All Abilities.Requirements: Two-Handed weapons only

All Abilities.Name: Downburst
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Heavy Attack that deals Wind damage against the target. On damage, the target immediately plummets to the ground and takes falling damage. This falling damage cannot be negated through the use of abilities that would normally negate falling damage.
All Abilities.Requirements: Target must be Flying.

All Abilities.Name: Downburst II
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Heavy Attack that deals Wind damage against the target. On damage, the target immediately plummets to the ground and takes falling damage. This falling damage cannot be negated through the use of abilities that would normally negate falling damage.
All Abilities.Requirements: Target is knocked airborne or is Flying.

All Abilities.Name: Draconic Presence
All Abilities.Description: You gain a +10 bonus to Negotiation and Intimidation checks against Grunts and against Heroics that have a lower Spirit Core than you.

All Abilities.Name: Dragon Breaks The Ranks
All Abilities.Description:
You gain Flight and surround yourself in fire, then Sidestep to a point in a direct line. You destroy low cover you pass through, though the GM may rule that some cover is too sturdy to be destroyed. In either case, you continue until you reach the target and may make a single melee Heavy Attack against an enemy in range with your weapon. Any other characters in your path may spend 1 RP to move 5ft out of your charge or take Light Fire Damage.

If you have an element mastered, you may change the Fire damage of this ability to the element you have mastered.

This spell does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

All Abilities.Name: Dragonfire Dive
All Abilities.Description: You jump to the target, not provoking any attacks of opportunity, and attacking the target plus all other creatures within 5ft of the target for Heavy Fire Damage.
All Abilities.Requirements: Polearm only.

All Abilities.Name: Dragon's Breath
All Abilities.Keywords: Water, Lightning, Fire, Arcane, Wind, Frost, Scatter, Safe
All Abilities.Description: You exhale a devastating breath attack, making a ranged Light attack against all targets in a 30ft long 60 degree cone. This attack deals the same type of damage as your element chosen in Ryujin's Mastery.

All Abilities.Name: Draw Elements
All Abilities.Description: You may choose an element. Until the start of your next turn, you are considered to have mastered that element.

All Abilities.Name: Draw Elements II
All Abilities.Description: You may choose an element. Until the start of your next turn, you are considered to have mastered that element.

All Abilities.Name: Draw-In
All Abilities.Description:
You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, they are pulled up to 5ft towards you.

Combo: If used after Lunge, the range of this attack and the pullback distance are doubled. This consumes the Lunge effect.
All Abilities.Requirements: Polearm only.

All Abilities.Name: Driftwind Evasion
All Abilities.Description:
You take the Dodge action against the attack and gain a Windflow bonus to your Dodge equal to your Windflow stacks.

Afterwards, you lose all Windflow stacks.

All Abilities.Name: Drink to Battle
All Abilities.Description: You drink some Alcohol in preparation for a battle, granting you 1 stack of Tipsy.
All Abilities.Combined Costs: Other: 2 AP or Encounter Start action
All Abilities.Other Costs: other: 2 AP or Encounter Start action

All Abilities.Name: Dualcast
All Abilities.Description: You immediately repeat the last used ability with the same target. Any cost must be paid as normal.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be used immediately after successfully using an ability with the spell keyword.

All Abilities.Name: Duelist Blow
All Abilities.Description: You make a Heavy Attack against the target. Your next Block or Dodge reaction against that target costs 0 RP. This benefit disappears when you use an RP ability against a target other than the target of this ability.

All Abilities.Name: Dullahan's Mount
All Abilities.Description:
You conjure up a black horse that becomes part of you. You immediately mount when using this ability and upon dismounting, the horse vanishes. While mounted, your movement speed is increased by 30ft and you are considered a large creature, but you may only move in a straight line. When attempting to move through 5ft wide spaces, it is considered difficult terrain for you. You also suffer a -10 penalty to most finesse athletics checks as well as climbing and swimming checks while mounted.

Any attack against the horse is considered an attack against you instead. As the horse is considered part of you, any displacement or teleport abilities move the horse alongside with you. You may dismount by spending 0 AP.

All Abilities.Name: Duplicate
All Abilities.Description:
You attempt to analyze the spell and duplicate it. After the triggering spell resolves, immediately cast a copy of it. You must select a valid target for this copy, pay any additional mana cost originally on the spell as well as pay any costs that are not AP or RP. Failure to do so will make the duplicated spell fizzle, dissipating the magic harmlessly into the air.

Upon successfully copying the spell, it resolves with the same damage and effects as the original spell, though using your stats to resolve them.

The cost is 1 RP for a 0-2 AP spell or 2 RP for a 3-4 AP spell. Spells with a higher cost cannot be duplicated.

Secret Arts and Esoteric Arts also cannot be duplicated and upon attempting to do so, this ability is canceled and any cost refunded. Unique spells by heroic or boss enemies may also be impossible to duplicate (GM's discretion).
All Abilities.Requirements: An enemy in range casts a Spell

All Abilities.Name: Dust Kick
All Abilities.Description:
You kick the ground in front of you, causing a veil of dust to appear. The target becomes Blinded 3 until the attack resolves. If the triggering attack misses, you kick the target and may push it 5ft into any horizontal direction.

If under the effects of Exposing Edge, you apply Blinded 5 instead.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be within 5ft of the ground. An ally or you are being attacked by an enemy in range.

All Abilities.Name: Eagle Hunt
All Abilities.Description: You leap up to 30ft into the air and then horizontally up to twice your Speed, this movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity. You may use Silentium at any point during the movement, gaining the Combo bonus.

All Abilities.Name: Earth Armor
All Abilities.Description: You touch a willing ally’s armor and enchant it with earthen power. Until the end of the encounter, it grants a +1 guard and +4 block bonus.

All Abilities.Name: Earth Infusion
All Abilities.Description:
You surround a willing target in mud and rocks, changing their typing to Earth II.

As an Earth II type, they take half damage from Lightning and Earth damage or attacks with the Lightning or Earth keyword unless that attack deals true damage. They take 50% more damage from Wind damage or attacks with the Wind keyword.

All Abilities.Name: Earth Shield
All Abilities.Description: You grant the target 1 RP they must spend on the Block action against the triggering attack. They gain a bonus to their Block for this action equal to your focus x 2.
All Abilities.Requirements: An ally within range is the target of a melee attack and/or physical attack.

All Abilities.Name: Earth Weapon
All Abilities.Benefits: When attacking with a weapon, you may choose to have the weapon deal Earth Damage instead of its normal damage type. You must declare you chosen damage type before making the accuracy roll.

All Abilities.Name: Earthen Divide
All Abilities.Description:
You create a wall up to 20ft high, 5ft wide and 20ft long in a straight line. Each Segment of the wall has HP equal to 20 + Focus.

Overcharge: You may spend X mana to increase the length by 20 x Xft.

All Abilities.Name: Earthen Guardian
All Abilities.Description: You jump and sidestep towards the attacked ally and the triggering attack resolves against you instead. You automatically take the Block action against this attack.
All Abilities.Requirements: In Steadfast Earth Stance, ally within range is the target of an attack.

All Abilities.Name: Eclipse Breaker
All Abilities.Description:
You make a Heavy attack against all targets in a 15x15ft line.

You must choose the line direction when starting the ability.

All Abilities.Name: Efficient Strike
All Abilities.Description: Make a gathering check.  If this maxes node points, all overflow is converted into lucky points.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must in a gathering session.

All Abilities.Name: Elbow Uppercut
All Abilities.Description: You attack the target for Heavy Damage.Combo:If used after an ability with the Unarmed Strike keyword, this ability gains Full Pierce.

All Abilities.Name: Elemental Mastery: Dark
All Abilities.Description: You gain Elemental Mastery: Dark

All Abilities.Name: Elemental Mastery: Fire
All Abilities.Description: You gain Elemental Mastery: Fire

All Abilities.Name: Elemental Mastery: Frost
All Abilities.Description: You gain Elemental Mastery: Frost

All Abilities.Name: Elemental Mastery: Holy
All Abilities.Description: You gain Elemental Mastery: Holy

All Abilities.Name: Elemental Mastery: Lightning
All Abilities.Description: You gain Elemental Mastery: Lightning.

All Abilities.Name: Elemental Strike
All Abilities.Description:
You make a Light Attack against the target. On damage, your attack applies an additional effect based on one of your attack's damage type. (If you are able to have multiple damage types on the attack such as through Holy weapon, you may pick any of the effects).

Arcane: The target loses 1 mana.Fire: The target becomes Burning X, where X equals your Power x 3.Water: The target becomes Soaked X, where X equals your power/2 (rounded down) for 1 turn or until they take Lightning damage.Lightning: The target is afflicted with Static X, where X equals your Power x 3Earth/Frost: The target becomes Slowed until the start of your next turn.Wind: You may push the target back 10ft.Holy: You gain temporary hit points equal to your Power + 5.Dark: The target becomes Blinded 5 until after their next attack.

All Abilities.Name: Elemental Sweep
All Abilities.Keywords: Burning, Soaked, Static, Slow, Blinded, Blanketing
All Abilities.Description:
You may make a Light Attack against all enemies within range. On damage, your attack applies an additional effect based on one of your attack's damage type. (If you are able to have multiple damage types on the attack such as through Holy weapon, you may pick any of the effects).

Arcane: The target loses 1 mana.Fire: The target becomes Burning X, where X equals your Power x 3.Water: The target becomes Soaked X, where X equals your power/2 (rounded down) for 1 turn or until they take Lightning damage.Lightning: The target is afflicted with Static X, where X equals your Power x 3.Earth/Frost: The target becomes Slowed until the start of your next turn.Wind: You may push the target back 10ft.Holy: You gain temporary hit points equal to your Power+5.Dark: The target becomes Blinded 5 until after their next attack.

All Abilities.Name: Emergency Maneuvers
All Abilities.Description: When you fail a check when operating an airship, you may use this to reroll the check. You must accept the new result and cannot reroll it again.

All Abilities.Name: Emergency Recall
All Abilities.Description: You give your summon 100 Damage Reduction against the attack. Afterwards, if it is still alive, it is immediately unsummoned.
All Abilities.Requirements: Your summon from Summon Animal is the target of an attack.

All Abilities.Name: Emergency Shield
All Abilities.Description: The target gains temporary HP equal to 7 + Power.

All Abilities.Name: Emergency Shields
All Abilities.Benefits: You may cast Power Word: Shield and Power Word: Guardian Shield (when obtained) by spending 1 RP instead of 2 AP.

All Abilities.Name: Empower Mana Shield
All Abilities.Description: You spend X mana to add X*8 to the value of your mana shield until the start of your next turn.

All Abilities.Name: Empty Body
All Abilities.Description: You may reroll the failed saving throw and must accept the new result.
All Abilities.Requirements: You failed a saving throw.

All Abilities.Name: En-dama
All Abilities.Description:
You throw a smoke bomb on the ground within range that blocks line of sight in a 5ft radius (15x15 area total) of where it was thrown. Targets inside or within 5ft of the smoke can only see up to 5ft into or out of the smoke.

If you’re inside of it at the point it's thrown, you may immediately take the Hide action.

The smoke lasts until the start of your next turn. When it ends, if you are inside your smoke, you may immediately move up to your speed and you are considered hidden up until you finish that movement. If you end your movement in cover, you keep being Hidden from people you have cover from.

All Abilities.Name: Enduring Warmth
All Abilities.Description: You can emit comforting heat within 30feet that counters the effects of most cold weather. You can activate or deactivate this heat every 1 second.

All Abilities.Name: Energy Drain
All Abilities.Description: You deal Light true damage to a willing ally other than yourself. You gainHaste, which gives you 2 AP for the rest of this turn. A target can only be affected by haste once per turn.

All Abilities.Name: Escape Artist
All Abilities.Description: You immediately escape the grapple by twisting and kicking. May be used by spending either AP or RP.
All Abilities.Requirements: You are grappled.

All Abilities.Name: Eternal Flames
All Abilities.Benefits: When you would apply Burning on your turn, you instead apply Hellfire. Hellfire functions like Burning, but it can no longer be removed the normal way if not removed before the end of the target’s next turn. Hellfire is automatically removed at the end of the encounter., If you apply Hellfire to a target that is already burning, you deal extra fire damage equal to your Power.

All Abilities.Name: Eternal Mirane Cage
All Abilities.Description: Instead of killing the target, they are reduced to negative their Max HP +1. The target is encased in Magical Ice for 10 years, rooted on the location and cannot be moved.  The Ice never melts despite temperature and can only be dispelled by Higher Order Magic (such as a Divine Arms), or by you. The Spell effect ends if you die. You can extend the duration of the Frost by 10 years for every 2 mana spent.
All Abilities.Requirements: Use when an ally attack would kill a target and target is not an ally.

All Abilities.Name: Eternal Vigil
All Abilities.Description: While in statue mode and sleeping, you make perception checks as if you were awake.

All Abilities.Name: Evasive Maneuver
All Abilities.Description:
You Sidestep 5ft in any direction.

When used on your turn, you may spend 1 mana and 0 AP on this ability instead.

All Abilities.Name: Evil Eye
All Abilities.Benefits: While you have a Mystic Eye active, you gain a +10 Mystic Eye bonus to perception checks relying on sight., One of your eyes becomes an Evil Eye. It may be used to make Mystic Eye type abilities of the appropriate type. An eye can only be a single mystic eye type.

All Abilities.Name: Evil Eye of Death
All Abilities.Description:
You open your Mystic Eye, focus it on a single target and they instantly die.

Upkeep: 3 AP. When you pay the upkeep cost, you may repeat this attack against a new target.
All Abilities.Requirements: Target must be a grunt.

All Abilities.Name: Evil Eye of Fear
All Abilities.Keywords: Mystic Eye, Upkeep, Fear, Mind Affecting
All Abilities.Description:
You open your Mystic Eye and inflict fear on everything in sight.

All targets in a 90 degree cone up to range must make a save against your potency or become Shaken until the start of your next turn.

Upkeep: 1 AP. When you pay the upkeep cost, you may repeat this attack.

All Abilities.Name: Evil Eye of Lethargy
All Abilities.Description:
You open your Mystic Eye and inflict lethargy on everything in sight.

All targets in a 90 degree cone up to range become Slowed until the start of your next turn, unless they spent 1 RP to resist the effect.

Upkeep: 1 AP. When you pay the upkeep cost, you may repeat this attack.

All Abilities.Name: Excavation Crash
All Abilities.Description: Choose one adjacent location 5ft from the target. The target may immediately use a move action for 0 RP to move there if they wish, you cannot make an attack of opportunity during Excavation Crash. If the target does not move to the location, make a heavy attack against them.

All Abilities.Name: Execute Heretic
All Abilities.Description: You deal damage to the target equal to their max HP.
All Abilities.Requirements: Target must be downed.

All Abilities.Name: Execute the Heretic
All Abilities.Benefits: You may use Execute Heretic

All Abilities.Name: Expanded Circuits
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain Expanded Circuits, which gives +2 maximum mana.

All Abilities.Name: Expanded Menagerie
All Abilities.Benefits: You may spend 1 mana with using Summon Animal to choose which animal you summon.

All Abilities.Name: Expert Alchemist
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain Alchemeister Core Crafting Abilities., When using Throw Potion, you may infuse it using your own mana. You spend X mana and the mana cost the target needs to pay to benefit from the potion is reduced by X (the mana cost cannot go below 0).

All Abilities.Name: Expert Farmer
All Abilities.Description:
Greater Infuse QiKeywords:RapidDescription:You infuse one of the planted herbs with Qi, upgrading it from rare to mystic and adding 20 to its difficulty.

Bountiful Harvest IIKeywords:RapidDescription:You bless one of the planted seeds that grants Food units or Alchemy materials. It grants 4 times that amount and you add 10 to its difficulty. Does not stack.

All Abilities.Name: Expert Scribe
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain +5 points in Art: Calligraphy expertise skill. This is not doubled for expertise bonus., You may draw scrolls, talismans or similar objects for 0 AP once per turn. When you do, reduce the AP cost of that talisman by 1. Even if you do not consume the talisman, it only benefits from the AP reduction once per turn.

All Abilities.Name: Expertise Study (Armorsmithing)
All Abilities.Description:
You gain 5 Expertise Points in 2 different armorsmithing crafts. You also gain wielding proficiency in Heavy Armor or Greatshields.

In addition, you always gain the expertise bonus when crafting an armor for yourself. An armor crafted this way cannot be worn by other creatures and is effectively valued at 0 clim.

All Abilities.Name: Expertise Study (Artificing)
All Abilities.Description: You gain 5 expertise points in 3 different Artificing crafts.  You also gain one basic weapon proficiency or one specialized weapon proficiency of your choice.

All Abilities.Name: Expertise Study (Blacksmithing)
All Abilities.Description: You gain 5 Expertise Points in 3 different blacksmithing crafts. You also gain wielding proficiency in one smithing melee weapon of your choice. You may select specialized weapons with this.

All Abilities.Name: Expertise Study (Carpentry)
All Abilities.Description: You gain 5 Expertise Points in 3 different carpentry crafts.  You also gain wielding proficiency in one carpentry weapon of your choice or artifice chainsaws.

All Abilities.Name: Explosive Advance
All Abilities.Description: You immediately activate Horse Step Acceleration and it becomes active for the entire first round of combat.  Immediately make up to 1 AP of movement actions.

All Abilities.Name: Explosive Ward
All Abilities.Description: A ward that can be placed on a door or medium-sized container of some sort. If other than you knowingly tries to open the door or container in any way (whether normal opening, attacking it etc), the ward triggers creating a loud noise and dealing Heavy Fire Damage to all creatures in a 10ft radius around the container. All items inside the container (if any) also take this damage. Once triggered, the bounded field vanishes. Casting this takes 10 minutes of uninterrupted casting. You may at the time of casting choose a number of people equal to your Focus that can also open the container or door without triggering the ward. If not triggered, Explosive Ward lasts until you remove it. For each Explosive Ward you maintain your maximum mana is reduced by 2. This is considered a tier 2 ward.

All Abilities.Name: Exposing Edge
All Abilities.Description:
You sharpen your blades, enhancing the effects of your debuffs.

Upkeep: You may spend 1 AP or 1 mana to continue the effect.

All Abilities.Name: Exposing Stab
All Abilities.Description: You make a Light attack against the damage. On damage, you may use your Devastating Strike against the target until the end of your turn as if the target had 0 RP.

All Abilities.Name: Extending Spear
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Light Attack against all targets in a line up to the range.
All Abilities.Requirements: Polearm only.

All Abilities.Name: Extra Arms
All Abilities.Description: Your next interact with object costs 1 less AP.

All Abilities.Name: Fading Counter
All Abilities.Description: When the enemy attacks you in melee, they instead attack an illusionary clone, missing you. You may then immediately attack the enemy with a basic Light Melee Attack. You may then move up to 5ft in any direction and this movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

All Abilities.Name: Faerie Eyes: Calling
All Abilities.Description: You activate your Faerie Eyes, charming a target to move their Speed towards you. If your Focus is higher than the target’s the target moves up to its speed towards you. The target immediately stops their movement if they are going to take damage from further movement. Against Grunts, this attack always hits regardless of Focus, costs 0 mana, and the target will continue to move even if it will take damage.

All Abilities.Name: Faerie Flash
All Abilities.Description: You Teleport up to twice your Speed to an unoccupied space that you can see. Can only be used once per encounter.

All Abilities.Name: Faerie Flash II
All Abilities.Description: You Teleport up to twice your Speed to an unoccupied space that you can see.

All Abilities.Name: Faerie Light Eyes
All Abilities.Benefits: Faerie Light Eyes provide protection against Illusions, giving you the ability to immediately see the reality warping distortions that illusions cause.  The user is not only notified of illusions, but immune to all but your own., One of your eyes becomes a Faerie Light Eye. It may be used to make Mystic Eye type abilities of the appropriate type. An eye can only be a single mystic eye type.

All Abilities.Name: Faerie Light Eyes:  Empty
All Abilities.Description:
You lock eyes with an enemy, casting an illusion onto the target’s mind. Name an ability that the target had previously used in the current encounter. The target forgets the target ability, being unable to use it completely while the Illusion is in effect. This ability cannot target Secret Arts, Climax Arts or Esoteric Arts. Only one target may be under the effect of this illusion at a time. If the target is non-heroic and under the effect of Faerie Light Eyes: Hold Person, instead the target immediately is rendered insane permanently. An insane target takes no further combat actions.

If used on a grunt under the effects of Hold Person, they do not need to meet the normal requirements for this ability.

Does not work against Boss type enemies. Some abilities such as those granted by items, passives or racial abilities (such as flight) also cannot be removed by this ability (GM's discretion).
All Abilities.Requirements: Enemy has used the target ability

All Abilities.Name: Faerie Light Eyes: Golden Illusion
All Abilities.Description:
You copy the target’s ability that was forgotten and add it to your abilities until the end of the encounter. You must still fulfill all requirements to use this skill. This ability is generated from illusions and gains the keyword, Illusion. You can only have one Golden Illusion ability at a time.

If the target stops being affected by Empty, you lose your Golden Illusion ability.
All Abilities.Requirements: A target is affected by Faerie Light Eyes: Empty.

All Abilities.Name: Faerie Light Eyes: Hold Person
All Abilities.Description: You gaze into the target’s eyes and stun them for 1 turn, reducing their AP and RP to 0. While stunned, the target can also not take any actions.
All Abilities.Requirements: Target must be non-heroic and have eyes.

All Abilities.Name: Faerie Light Eyes: Time Dilation
All Abilities.Description: Flooding your eyes with magic, you cast a self Illusion causes time slow down. You use the Dodge action with a Dodge bonus equal to 2X.
All Abilities.Requirements: You are the target of a single-target attack.

All Abilities.Name: Faithful Shield
All Abilities.Description:
You may use Shelter once at 0 RP cost if the target is your Soulmate. This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

Overcharge:You may spend 4 AP on this ability to instead gain 2 free uses of Shelter.

These free uses ignore the normal limitation of using an ability only once per turn.

All Abilities.Name: Fallen Friend
All Abilities.Benefits: When an Heroic tier ally reaches 0 HP, you may immediately enter Rage Stance for 0 AP and RP as well as 0 mana. You can use this even if you don’t have the Rage ability yet.

All Abilities.Name: Fan of Knives
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Light Attack against all enemies in range. This is considered a Ranged Weapon Attack that does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
All Abilities.Requirements: Throwing Weapon, Set of Missiles or Thrown attack only.

All Abilities.Name: Fancy Footwork
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain proficiency with Dueling Weapons. While wielding a dueling weapon, you also gain the light blades' Nimble ability, even if not wielding or proficient with light blades.

All Abilities.Name: Farming Basics
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain proficiency in the scythe specialized weapon and can use it as farming tool. You also gain proficiency in the Sickle and can use it as a farming tool and One-Handed axe., You can plant seeds in plots of land that sprout into harvestable Food and Alchemy materials. You can work 10 plots of land., You gain Farmer core abilities.

All Abilities.Name: Harvest
All Abilities.Description: You harvest the planted seeds or take care of the plants not ready to be harvested yet. Do a crafting session. Your crafting score is the total value of seeds you can harvest or take care of. If your crafting score is not high enough to harvest or take care of all seeds you planted, you must give up on some of the seeds. Starting from the seed with the highest difficulty, you drop seeds until your total crafting score matches or exceeds the total difficulty of the seeds.Infuse QiKeywords:RapidDescription:You infuse one of the planted herbs with Qi, upgrading it from common to rare and adding 10 to its difficulty. Bountiful HarvestKeywords:RapidDescription:You bless one of the planted seeds that grants Food units or Alchemy materials. It grants double that amount and you add 5 to its difficulty. Does not stack.

All Abilities.Name: Sow Seeds
All Abilities.Description: You may plant seeds in plots of land. You may plant 1 set of seeds in each plot of land you can work.

All Abilities.Name: Spiritual Ground
All Abilities.Description: You infuse the land with your spiritual energy, creating up to 10 plots of land suitable for farming. These plots of lands can grow food and herbs at an accelerated rate and allow the planting of tier 1 rare herbs. All plots of land must be filled with seeds before they begin growing. After creating a spiritual ground, you may immediately use Sow Seeds in it for 0 IP. You can only have 1 spiritual ground at the same time.

All Abilities.Name: Fast Dimensional Equip
All Abilities.Description:
You summon an item from your dimensional armory into your hand. You can also send a held weapon (not wielded or carried by another creature) under your full control to your Dimensional Armory and swap it with another from your Dimensional Armory.

You may use 1 RP to activate this ability. If you do, the Mana cost is reduced by 1.
All Abilities.Requirements: You have a Dimension Armory active.

All Abilities.Name: Fast Hands
All Abilities.Description: You reduce the AP cost of your next Interact with object action this turn by 1.

All Abilities.Name: Fast Runner
All Abilities.Description: Your base movement speed is 25ft instead of 20ft.

All Abilities.Name: Feeding Frenzy
All Abilities.Description:
You may use this after reducing an enemy’s hit points to 0 or less.

You may immediately use your Vampire Bite ability for 0 RP against the enemy you downed.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be under the effects of Blood Frenzy.

All Abilities.Name: Feign Death
All Abilities.Description: The first time you enter the Downed state in an encounter, you may use Play Dead as a reaction for 0 RP. In addition, you gain a +10 bonus to playing dead.

All Abilities.Name: Feigned Retreat
All Abilities.Description:
All allies in a 15x15ft square within range may Sidestep up to their speed towards you.

If they successfully left an enemy’s melee range and are not in an enemy’s melee range after moving, then the first time an enemy enters their melee range before the start of their next turn, they may make an Attack of Opportunity against that enemy.

All Abilities.Name: Feint
All Abilities.Description: You target an enemy. If the target is a Grunt or you have higher Agility than the target, then they cannot make an attack of opportunity against you until the start of your next turn.

All Abilities.Name: Feinting Stab
All Abilities.Description: You make a Heavy attack against the target. If they react to it in any way, you may cancel your attack on them and instead make it against a different enemy in range. Any RP spent by the first target is not refunded.
All Abilities.Requirements: At least two enemies within range.

All Abilities.Name: Felling Strike
All Abilities.Description: Make a heavy attack against a target enemy that is no larger than large size category. On damage, sidestep to any unoccupied space next to the target, of the same elevation as the target, and knockback the target 10ft.
All Abilities.Requirements: Axe, Chainsaw and Giant Scissors Only

All Abilities.Name: Fiery Rebirth
All Abilities.Description:
You regain HP until you are at 1 HP, stand up from prone and deal Light full pierce fire damage to all enemies within 5ft of you.

After using this ability, the mortal wound condition is removed from you and you cannot use Fiery Rebirth again for the rest of the arc.
All Abilities.Requirements: You’ve suffered a mortal wound.

All Abilities.Name: Fight or Flight
All Abilities.Description:
Fight:You immediately gain 2 AP that can be used on basic abilities, but lose 1 RP.

Flight:You immediately gain 1 RP, but recover 2 less AP on your next turn.

You regain the use of this ability after the Encounter Conclusion phase.

All Abilities.Name: Fighter's Journey
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain proficiency in 5 common weapons groups., You gain proficiency in all light armor, medium armor and normal shields., You gain +5 HP.

All Abilities.Name: Fire Stance
All Abilities.Benefits: You may use Tempestuous Fire Stance

All Abilities.Name: Fire Weapon
All Abilities.Benefits: When attacking with a weapon, you may choose to have the weapon deal Fire Damage instead of its normal damage type. You must declare your chosen damage type before making the accuracy roll.

All Abilities.Name: Fireball
All Abilities.Description: You hurl a Fireball at a 15x15ft area, making a Light Attack that deals Fire Damage against all units in the area.

All Abilities.Name: Fireball Barrage
All Abilities.Description: You hurl three Fireballs at three separate 15x15ft areas, making a Light Attack that deals Fire Damage against all units in each area. Each unit can only be attacked once per use of this ability, even if hit by multiple fireballs.

All Abilities.Name: Fireball II
All Abilities.Description: You hurl a Fireball at a 15x15ft area, making a Light Attack that deals Fire Damage against all units in the area. On damage, they become Burning X where X equals your Power x 3Overcharge:You may spend extra mana to increase the size of the area. Every mana spent increases the size by 5ft.

All Abilities.Name: First Response
All Abilities.Description: If you have a Medical Kit, you may use your encounter conclusion to give the Second Wind encounter conclusion effect to someone else. You heal for an additional 1d6+3 (from your Demonblood Regeneration) when doing this.

All Abilities.Name: Fissure
All Abilities.Description:
You slam the ground and create a 15ft wide fissure up to the target point. Those at the edges of the spell’s range may spend 1 RP to Sidestep 5ft out of the effect. All caught in the effect fall down 20ft into the fissure and take falling damage as normal.

The spell requires natural ground to be below the touching surface to function. It may work on the bottom floor of a house, but will fail if used higher up or in some dungeons.
All Abilities.Requirements: Special

All Abilities.Name: Five Harmonies
All Abilities.Benefits: You may use Luminous Form Stance.

All Abilities.Name: Flame Infusion
All Abilities.Description: You surround a willing target in searing flames, changing their typing to Fire II. As a Fire II type, they take half damage from Fire and Frost Damage or attacks with the Fire or Frost keywords unless that attack deals true damage. They take 50% more damage from Water Damage or attacks with the Water keyword. While the ward lasts, they also gain immunity to Burning. The ward lasts until the end of the encounter or until their type is overwritten by a more powerful type.

All Abilities.Name: Flame Shield
All Abilities.Keywords: Fire, Full Pierce, Shield, Spell, Aid, Sure Hit
All Abilities.Description: The attacker immediately takes Light Fire Damage.
All Abilities.Requirements: An ally took damage from a melee attack.

All Abilities.Name: Flame Wall
All Abilities.Description: You create a wall of Fire that is 30ft long, 5ft wide and 30ft high. This wall must be a straight line. Anyone passing through the wall or starting their turn in it takes Heavy Fire Damage. The wall lasts for 10 minutes or until canceled. Those in the wall when it is casted, may spend 1 RP to sidestep out of the wall. A person can only take this damage once per round.

All Abilities.Name: Flame Weapon
All Abilities.Description: You touch one willing ally’s or your own weapon and enchant it with Fire. Until the end of the encounter, the weapon deals Fire Damage and grants a +1 Power Enchantment.

All Abilities.Name: Flash Bomb
All Abilities.Description: You throw a Flash Bomb at a point within range that explodes in an 25x25 area centered on that point. All targets within the area must save against Potency or become Dazed.

All Abilities.Name: Flash Cut
All Abilities.Description: You draw your katana and attack with such Speed it becomes impossible to perceive, making a Heavy Attack against the target, after which you resheathe the weapon. This ability does not break the Iai state.
All Abilities.Requirements: Katana only, must be in Iai state.

All Abilities.Name: Flash Star Style: Photon Line
All Abilities.Description:
You sidestep exactly 25ft in a straight line in any direction and can move over gaps of terrain as long as you end on solid ground. You make a Light attack against all targets that are in your path.  If only one target is in your path, make a Heavy attack instead.

If you were flying at least 10ft above the ground when using this ability, you do not need to end on solid ground.
All Abilities.Requirements: Can move 25ft in a straight line. Light sword, longsword, katana only.

All Abilities.Name: Flash Star Style Secret Art: Twin Nova Pursuit
All Abilities.Description: You teleport to the target and then knock them 25ft in any horizontal direction.  You then teleport in a straight line to them again and make a Heavy attack.  If the attack is responded to with any RP action, knock them straight back 25ft again, teleport in a straight line to them and make another Heavy attack.
All Abilities.Requirements: Light sword, Longsword, Katana only.

All Abilities.Name: Flash Star Style: Starlight Crescent Reversal
All Abilities.Description: You take advantage of the slow windup of the enemy’s attack, countering with a Light attack of your own. You may still Dodge or Block the triggering attack after this counter.
All Abilities.Requirements: You are targeted by a heavy attack. Light sword, Longsword, Katana only.

All Abilities.Name: Flash Star Style: Thunderbolt Slash
All Abilities.Description:
You slash the target in a thunderbolt pattern, making a 3-hit attack.  Make 3 separate Light attacks against the target.

Combo: If used immediately after Flash Star Style: Photon Line, mana cost reduced by 1.
All Abilities.Requirements: Light sword, Longsword, Katana only.

All Abilities.Name: Flight
All Abilities.Description:
You gain controlled Flight up to your speed. If you take damage while flying higher than 5ft above the ground, your altitude drops by 20ft. If this would reduce your altitude to the point where you touch the ground, you become rooted and cannot fly again until the end of your next turn. If the attack that reduced your HP came from a flying creature other than yourself, you do not lose altitude.

When you end your turn within 5ft of the ground, Flight ends.

All Abilities.Name: Flowing Kick
All Abilities.Description: You make a Heavy Attack against the target.Combo:If used after an unarmed attack misses, reduce the AP cost of this by 1.

All Abilities.Name: Flowing Wind Strike
All Abilities.Description:
You make a Light attack against the target that deals additional damage equal to double your Windflow stacks. Afterwards, you lose all Windflow stacks.

Afterwards, you may Sidestep 5ft though this movement does not give a Windflow stack.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must have moved at least 10ft before using this.

All Abilities.Name: Flushing Shot
All Abilities.Description: You make a Heavy attack against the target. The target may choose to sidestep out of cover from your attack to automatically avoid the attack. Otherwise, the attack gains Sure Hit.
All Abilities.Requirements: Target must be in Low or High cover.

All Abilities.Name: Fly
All Abilities.Description: You or the creature you touch gainsFly, which gives them controlled Flight, Hover and their movement speed is doubled while flying until the end of the encounter. If they take damage while flying higher than 5ft above the ground, their altitude drops by 20ft. If this would reduce their altitude to the point where they touch the ground, they become rooted and cannot fly again until the end of their next turn. If the attack that reduced your HP came from an flying creature other than yourself, you do not lose altitude.

All Abilities.Name: Flyby Attack
All Abilities.Description: You sidestep up to your speed. At any point during this movement, you may spend 1 AP to make a Light attack with a weapon or spend 2 AP to make a Heavy attack with a weapon. After this attack, you may change the direction in which you spend the rest of your movement.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be mounted on a flying mount.

All Abilities.Name: Flying Kick
All Abilities.Description: You may Sidestep next to the target within range and make a Light Attack against it. You gain Flight for this movement.Combo:Your Strike of Still Water has its AP cost reduced by 1.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must have hit a target with Ki Blast in the previous action.

All Abilities.Name: Focused Detonation
All Abilities.Description: Make a gathering check against either Node or Lucky points. If this strike would max out it out, you may instead leave it at 1 away from completion and you gain +1 Strike Dice
All Abilities.Requirements: Must in a gathering session.

All Abilities.Name: Focused Power
All Abilities.Description: When you’re about to take the extra damage from Inexorable Shadow Stance, you may choose to maximize the damage instead of rolling. Affects both the self damage and the damage you deal with it.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be in Inexorable Shadow Stance.

All Abilities.Name: Focused Weapons
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain Forgemaster Core Crafting Abilities., You can craft using Mithril and Orihalcum.

All Abilities.Name: Forager's Eye
All Abilities.Description: Initiate a sight and sound based search for hidden plants, fungi, creatures or living enemy units in a 30x30 area within range.  You become automatically aware of the targeted species of plants, fungi or creatures or you can choose to be aware of all hostile enemy units.  You must have line of sight to the target in order to spot them.  After revealing the target your Lifebeat Sense gains (if used immediately after):Combo:  If used after Forager's Eye, the AP and mana cost of this is reduced by 1 and the target's location is known to you and your allies until the end of your next turn. This removes Hiding from them.
All Abilities.Requirements: Can see or hear the target category.

All Abilities.Name: Forager's Path
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain proficiency in Giant Scissors and proficiency in your choice between Axes or Hori. You may use axes for harvesting foraging outcrops., You gain the ability to harvest Tier 1 Foraging Outcrops., You gain the ability to use natural item as replacements for an Adventurers Kit and Torches such as:  using the sun/moss as a compass, using vines as rope etc.  The material must be available (GM’s discretion), You gain the ability to create Wood Blocks as an Errand.  See item: Carpenter Materials

All Abilities.Name: Forest Walker
All Abilities.Description: You ignore difficult terrain created by vines, foliage and similar natural phenomena.

All Abilities.Name: Foretell
All Abilities.Description:
You receive a vision of the near future. Roll a d20 and store that number. When you or your allies are going to roll that dice type, you can instead replace it with your dice roll, you then lose your Foretell dice. You can only have one Foretell dice at a time, casting Foretell again overwrites the previous dice. Foretel dice last until the end of your next turn.

After rolling, you may spend 1 mana to reroll the dice once. After doing this, you can't do so again for this use of the ability.

All Abilities.Name: Forged Knowledge
All Abilities.Description: Using your knowledge of weapons, you infuse the strongest point of your weapon with mana and then strike at the perfect angle dealing maximum weapon damage.  Maximize one damage dice for the attack.
All Abilities.Requirements: Attack must be made with a weapon you crafted.

All Abilities.Name: Forged Knowledge II
All Abilities.Description: Your bond with the weapon allows you to infuse it with mana at a crucial point. Use when determining attack damage, maximize all weapon dice for that attack.
All Abilities.Requirements: You or an ally attacked with a weapon you crafted.

All Abilities.Name: Forgemaster Core Crafting
All Abilities.Description: Blacksmith’s Modification BCost:X Crafting PointsDescription:You add an B-Type modification to the weapon or tool. See the Universal Weapon or Crafting mods page as well as the individual weapon page for details. Each modification has its own cost.

All Abilities.Name: Forked Lightning
All Abilities.Description: You make a Light Attack against two different targets who can be no further than 20ft apart, dealing Lightning Damage and on damage, inflict Static X where X equals your Focus x 2.

All Abilities.Name: Forward Momentum
All Abilities.Description: Until the start of your next turn, on damage of every melee attack you make, you may push the target back 5ft. You must then move 5ft towards that target (if possible to do safely) without provoking attacks of opportunity. This only works with attacks that target a single enemy.

All Abilities.Name: Four Field System
All Abilities.Description: Make a crafting check. Afterwards, whenever you use an ability for crafting that you haven’t used before in this crafting session, it gains a +2 bonus to the crafting points it gives.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be in a crafting session and costs 1 crafting dice.

All Abilities.Name: Four Point Strike
All Abilities.Description:
You may make a Light Attack against the target. On damage, you apply Wave Palm II.

Combo:If used after Two Point Strike or against a target afflicted with Wave Palm I, the mana cost is reduced by 2 and the AP cost by 1. If the target is afflicted with Wave Palm I, you apply Wave Palm III instead of Wave Palm II.

Wave Palm increases the mana cost of the afflicted target’s next ability that uses mana by an amount equal to the amount of stacks applied. If the triggering attack makes the number of total stacks exceed the target's current mana, they lose mana equal to the amount of total stacks and take true damage equal to triple this amount. Wave Palm does not stack with itself, use only the higher value.

If the target has no mana, they immediately take true damage as if their stacks exceeded their current mana.

When the Wave Palm effect triggers, either by increasing the mana cost or by dealing the true damage, the Wave Palm effect is removed.

All Abilities.Name: Freerunner
All Abilities.Description: You do not incur difficult terrain penalties in Forest, Cities or Ruins.

All Abilities.Name: Frost Coffin
All Abilities.Description: You cast a Spell that flash freezes a target Grunt, killing them instantly and creates a two Glacial Wall cube stack at their location. These cubes have HP equal to 15 + Focus. These structures can function as cover. Ice wall segments take double damage from Fire Attacks.

All Abilities.Name: Frost Driver
All Abilities.Description: You send ice spikes along the ground towards a single target, making a Heavy attack that deals Frost Damage. This cannot hit a target higher than 5ft above the ground. On hit, the target is Sloweduntil the end of their next turn.  If the target is already Slowed, they instead become Rooted, making them unable to move until the end of their next turn.Combo: When used after Icicle Nail or White Thunder hits, reduce the mana cost to 0.

All Abilities.Name: Full Dimensional Equip
All Abilities.Description: You swap your armor, cloak and weapons currently wielded with a dimensional set.  The weapon and armor you had equipped as you used to this ability become a Dimensional Set, allowing you to switch back to it.
All Abilities.Requirements: You have a Dimensional Armory active.

All Abilities.Name: Full Power Swing
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Heavy attack that does double heavy damage.
All Abilities.Requirements: Two-handed weapons only.

All Abilities.Name: Fungal Metabolite
All Abilities.Benefits: Due to symbiotic fungi within your body, you become immune to all commonly known poisons., After being infected by an exotic poison or disease and surviving, that poison/disease is added to your list of immunities., Any disease or poison that you are immune to can be used with Amoxicillin.

All Abilities.Name: Gale-Wind Aura
All Abilities.Description: You project aGale-Wind Auraaround yourself that increases the movement speed of allies (excluding yourself) within 60ft of you by 20ft. An ally that starts their movement in the Aura, keeps the Speed increase for that move even if they leave the aura.Upkeep:You must spend 1 AP at the start of each turn or the aura fades.

All Abilities.Name: Genjutsu Kai
All Abilities.Description: You focus your internal energies and dispel any Illusions affecting you or an ally within 5ft of you.
All Abilities.Requirements: Target is under the effects of an Illusion.

All Abilities.Name: Giant Strength
All Abilities.Benefits: While in Rage Stance, you may choose to have your size be treated as one size bigger than it actually is. You get an additional +5 bonus to Fitness checks during Rage stance regardless.

All Abilities.Name: Glacial Bastion
All Abilities.Description:
You encase yourself in a Glacial Wall that fills your space until the start of your next turn, making you untargetable for attacks during the duration. This Glacial Wall has HP equal to 20 + Focus, any remaining damage is transferred to you (mitigated by your armor).  While encased, you can cast White Thunder on your encased Ice for 1 RP which removes Glacial Bastion. Other than White Thunder, you cannot take any other actions while under the effect of Glacial Bastion.

This Spell does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

All Abilities.Name: Glacial Wall
All Abilities.Description: You create 4 * X connected ice structures that are 5ft x 5ft cubes that last for up to 24 hours. These cubes have HP equal to 20 + Focus. These structures can function as low cover. Ice Wall segments take double damage from Fire Attacks.

All Abilities.Name: Gleaming Cut
All Abilities.Description: You attack with blades of pure light making a light attack against the target, dealing Holy(Light) damage. On damage, inflict Illumination  X where X equals your Focus / 2 (Rounded Down) until the end of your next turn.

All Abilities.Name: Glide
All Abilities.Description: You slow down your falling speed to 15ft per round and you are able to move horizontally as if normally moving. If you hit the ground while Glide is active, you do not take any falling damage and this effect ends.

All Abilities.Name: Glittershards
All Abilities.Description: Numerous sparkling arcane crystals swarm the area and block line of sight. Targets inside of or within 5ft of the Glittershards can only see up to 5ft into or out of Glittershards. Glittershards lasts for up to 10 minutes and you can only have 1 Glittershards active at a time. You can end this effect for 0 AP on your turn.

All Abilities.Name: Gloom Infusion
All Abilities.Description:
You surround a willing target in gloom and shadow, changing their typing to Dark II. As a Dark II type, they take half damage from Dark Damage or attacks with the Dark keywords, unless the attack deals true damage. They take 50% more damage from Holy Damage or attacks with the Holy keyword. While the ward lasts, they also gain 60 feet Darkvision and a +4 bonus to saves against mind affecting effects.

The ward lasts until the end of the encounter or until their type is overwritten by a more powerful type.

All Abilities.Name: Gnome Claws
All Abilities.Description: You burrow into natural earth ground, grantingBurrow, making you move underground at your normal speed.  While you are not attacking, you gain a +10/+20 bonus to your dodge except against other burrowed creatures. Using any action except movement or basic defenses cancels Gnome Claws.  Canceling Gnome Claws with a melee attack grants a +2Accuracy Bonusto the attack.

All Abilities.Name: God's Blessing
All Abilities.Description: The AP cost of True Divine Release I is lowered by 4 and the mana cost upkeep is lowered to 0.

All Abilities.Name: Good Fortune
