All Abilities.Description:
You always seem to find money in inexplicable ways.

At the end of an Interlude phase, you gain 500 Clim per Interlude Point spent during the phase.

All Abilities.Name: Goring Charge
All Abilities.Description:
You lower your head and charge in a direction with your horns. You move X times your speed in a straight line. If you move at least 15 feet, you make a Heavy attack against the first target in your path. They may sidestep this attack for 1 RP.

If a target sidesteps your attack, you continue charging for your maximum distance or until you hit an object. If you charge into another creature, you make a Heavy attack against them as well and the process continues. You do not provoke attacks of opportunity from creatures that sidestepped your attack for this movement.

If the object you charge into is destroyable, the GM may also ask you to make a Heavy attack against it.

These attacks are considered unarmed attacks that you are proficient in, even if you normally wouldn't be. It does not benefit from any sort of gauntlet bonuses.

All Abilities.Name: Graceful Landing
All Abilities.Description: You gain Graceful Landing until the start of your next turn, treating all fall distance as 50ft lower.

All Abilities.Name: Graceful Service
All Abilities.Description:
You assist a target character, giving them 1 additional encounter conclusion action.

This uses up your own encounter conclusion action.

All Abilities.Name: Grand Theft Horse
All Abilities.Description:
The target must make a save against your Potency or be immediately dismounted and knocked prone next to their mount. You may then spend 0 RP to immediately mount it.

Does not work against creatures that are considered a mount by themselves such as Dullahans or Centaurs.
All Abilities.Requirements: Target must be mounted.

All Abilities.Name: Gravitational Ki
All Abilities.Description: You target one unit and either push them away from you 5ft or pull them towards you 5ft. Cannot move a creature or object that’s bigger than 5ft and automatically fails against enemy heroic creatures.

All Abilities.Name: Gravitational Push
All Abilities.Description: You push the target 20ft or pull it 20ft towards you.

All Abilities.Name: Gravity Crush
All Abilities.Description: You make a Light (1 AP), Heavy (2 AP) or Precise (2 AP) attack against the target that deals Physical (Crushing) damage.

All Abilities.Name: Gravity Master
All Abilities.Benefits: When you push or pull an enemy on your turn, you may spend 1 mana to increase this distance by 10ft. You may also spend 1 mana to instead ignore the effects of 1 source of Immovable on a target you’re attempting to push, unless that target is permanently Immovable.

All Abilities.Name: Greater Imbue Weapon
All Abilities.Description: You may enchant your weapon as though you had used Imbue Weapon, but it also gains a +1 Power bonus in addition to the normal benefits. If you are not holding the enchanted weapon at the start of your turn, your weapon loses this benefit.

All Abilities.Name: Greatshield Master
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain proficiency in Greatshields. While wearing a Greatshield, any ally standing behind you that is the target of a ranged attack may treat you as high cover.

All Abilities.Name: Grindstone Echo
All Abilities.Description: You make a crafting check. You may choose the dice result from a previous check this crafting session and use that as your roll value.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be in a crafting session.

All Abilities.Name: Grudge
All Abilities.Description: You make a Light attack against the attacker.
All Abilities.Requirements: An enemy hits you with an attack.

All Abilities.Name: Guard Dog
All Abilities.Description:
You redirect the attack towards you instead of your ally and may take the Block action against it for 0 RP.

You may use this even if you’re also a target of the attack and both attacks will resolve against you. Your Block action works against both of these attacks.
All Abilities.Requirements: An ally within range is the target of an attack.

All Abilities.Name: Guided Aim
All Abilities.Description: You gain a bonus to your next accuracy roll equal to the mana spent on this ability. If the attack is a Precise Attack, the bonus gained is doubled.

All Abilities.Name: Gun Martial Arts
All Abilities.Benefits: You can fire your pistols while in melee range of an enemy without provoking attacks of opportunity., You can make unarmed attacks even if carrying a pistol in both hands. If wielding a weapon other than a pistol, this no longer applies. When wielding only pistols and no other weapons, your unarmed attacks benefit from your pistol material bonuses.

All Abilities.Name: Gunslinger's Agility
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain proficiency in pistols., You gain +1 Gunslinger bonus to Initiative.

All Abilities.Name: Half Restore
All Abilities.Description: You heal your summoned animal for 11 + Power x 2 HP. It also removes 1 negative effect from it. If the amount healed exceeds the target’s maximum HP, any extra HP is converted into temporary HP.
All Abilities.Requirements: Can only target your summoned animal.

All Abilities.Name: Hammer and Nail
All Abilities.Description: Make a light attack against the target with Sure Hit and Full Pierce.
All Abilities.Requirements: An ally dealt damage to a target that didn't take a defense action.

All Abilities.Name: Hardening Fist
All Abilities.Description:
You make a Light attack against the target. Afterwards, you gainHardening Fist, which gives +2 guard and +8 Block, but lose 4 evasion (including dodge) until the start of your next turn.

Combo: If used after Steadfast Earth Stance, the mana cost is reduced by 1.

All Abilities.Name: Harvest Moon
All Abilities.Keywords: Slow, Healing, Killing Blow, Concentration, Upkeep
All Abilities.Description:
You call down a harvest moon over the area that shines in a 60ft radius around yourself.

All allies in range may spend 2 Mana at the start of their turn to heal for 15 HP.

All enemies starting their turn in its range must make a Save against your potency or become slowed.

You may end this ability early by choosing to make a 0 AP heavy attack against an enemy slowed by this ability. This attack must be made with a Scythe. On killing blow of that attack, you recover 1 mana.

Upkeep: You must spend 1 mana at the start of your turn to continue this effect.

All Abilities.Name: Haste
All Abilities.Description: Grants the target Haste, granting them 2 AP for the rest of this turn.  A target can only be affected by haste once per turn.

All Abilities.Name: Haunting Bark
All Abilities.Keywords: Mind Affecting, Fear, Shaken, Full Pierce, Sound
All Abilities.Description: You bark at an enemy forcing them to make a Save or become shaken until the end of their next turn. The third time in a combat you use this against the same target, they also take Light Full Pierce Lightning damage in addition to the shaken effect if they fail their save.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be in Dog Form.

All Abilities.Name: Headless
All Abilities.Description: Critical hits rolled against you do not gain Full Pierce and do not automatically deal maximum damage.

All Abilities.Name: Headwind
All Abilities.Description:
You project an aura around you that hinders the movements of enemies.

All enemies that start their movement within 30ft of you become slowed. If an enemy takes a Move basic action outside of your zone and spends more than 1 AP, they are still slowed after calculating each individual AP spent on the move.

Upkeep:1 AP

All Abilities.Name: Hearthlight
All Abilities.Description: You can glow, emitting a comforting light within 30 feet. You can activate or deactivate this light every 1 second.

All Abilities.Name: Heavenfall Descent
All Abilities.Description:
You crash to the ground without taking falling damage and make a Light attack against all enemies within 5ft of you.

May target a point on the floor as long as it’s within 20ft of you horizontally.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be airborne and between 20ft and 120ft above the ground.

All Abilities.Name: Heavenly Lightning Stance
All Abilities.Description:
You enter the Heavenly Lightning Stance, a stance that lets you move with the unpredictability of the heavens. For your first movement of your turn, you may pass through enemies and your movement becomes a Sidestep.

If you have mastered Sky Talon Style, entering this stance also counts as your Wind Stance.

This stance lasts until you enter a different stance or make an attack with anything other than a melee attack or an ability with the Unarmed Strike keyword.

All Abilities.Name: Heavy Cavalry
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain Medium Armor and Heavy Armor proficiency., Every enemy damaged by your Trample effects become Challenged by you until the start of your next turn.

All Abilities.Name: Heavy Trample
All Abilities.Description: When using Trample, you may use your Toughness for the damage roll instead of your mount’s power.

All Abilities.Name: Hibernate
All Abilities.Description: When you take the rest IP action, the temporary HP gained is doubled. When you rest during the night as a rest action, you recover an additional toughness HP.

All Abilities.Name: Hidden Wards
All Abilities.Description: You may choose to hide your Bounded Fields when casting them by making a Stealth check. The casted ward uses the result of your Stealth check. Hidden Bounded Fields cannot be seen with Sense Magic without a successful perception or insight check.

All Abilities.Name: Hide in bush
All Abilities.Description: You take the Hide action and are considered to be in cover for the purposes of remaining stealthed. This lasts until you take any action or speak.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be in natural terrain.

All Abilities.Name: Hide in Shadows
All Abilities.Description:
You jump into a target’s shadow. If you were hidden before using this ability, you remain hidden inside the shadow. Else, the target or any other enemy may attack the shadow as if they were attacking you. If you take damage, you are forced out. While you’re inside the shadow, you travel with the target when it moves, including if it teleports, but cannot take actions other than exiting it.

You may exit the shadow willingly for 0 RP. When you exit it, if you were hidden, your next basic attack that turn against the target whose shadow you were hiding in gains Full Pierce.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be day.

All Abilities.Name: Hit & Run
All Abilities.Description: You make a Light attack against the target. Afterwards, you may move up to your speed.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be mounted.

All Abilities.Name: Hold the line
All Abilities.Description: Your next Block action costs 0 RP. Until the start of your next turn, unless you use the Dodge action, you become Immovable.

All Abilities.Name: Holy Declaration
All Abilities.Description: You take the Block action against the attack. Afterwards, you challenge all enemies within 5ft of you until the start of your next turn.

All Abilities.Name: Holy Light
All Abilities.Description: You Heal the target for 8 + Power

All Abilities.Name: Holy Orders
All Abilities.Description:
You target an enemy unit within range, causing the target to become your Holy Order until the start of your next turn.

While active, only your Holy Order may be chosen as the target for any offensive ability, or must be included as a target to use an offensive action.

If you make an attack of opportunity against your Holy Order, or if they move away from you while in your melee range, you can Sidestep up to twice your Speed towards them for 0 RP after their movement finishes.

Can only be used on your turn before you use an offensive action.

All Abilities.Name: Holy Shield
All Abilities.Description:
Your gainHoly Shield, which gives your next Block action gains a +2 guard bonus (not doubled again). If you reduce the damage you take with your next Block action to 0, you gain 3 temporary HP.

Overcharge:You may spend up to 3 additional AP on this ability. Each extra AP spent increases the Guard bonus and temporary HP gained by 3.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be using a shield.

All Abilities.Name: Holy Weapon
All Abilities.Benefits: When attacking with a weapon, you may choose to have the weapon deal Holy Damage instead of its normal damage type., You may choose to have your weapon emit light as if it was a lantern. You can enable or disable this effect for 1 AP.

All Abilities.Name: Hopping Zombie
All Abilities.Description: You gain +20 to any checks that involve jumping.

All Abilities.Name: Horse Body
All Abilities.Description:
You may carry an ally on your back without lowering your movement speed and your Burden is increased by 2. However, you are considered a large creature. When attempting to move through 5ft wide spaces, it is considered difficult terrain for you and many humanoid buildings will struggle to accommodate you. You also suffer a -10 penalty on most finesse athletics checks, as well as a -10 penalty on climbing and swimming checks.

Picking up an ally takes 1 AP and they cannot take AP actions while on your back. You or they may spend 1 AP to dismount and act like normal.

All Abilities.Name: Horse Step Acceleration
All Abilities.Description: You gainHorse Step Accelerationuntil the start of your next turn, which increases movement speed by 30.  All of your movement is now Line Movement (You may only move in a straight line when making a movement action).

All Abilities.Name: Horse Whistle
All Abilities.Description: Your mount (the last mount you were riding on this arc) may sidestep up to its speed towards you and it gains Trample (as per the ability, if you have it) for this movement. If this movement moves your mount onto your square, you may mount it for 0 RP. If you were prone and mount your mount, you are no longer prone.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must NOT be mounted.

All Abilities.Name: Hover
All Abilities.Description: You can passively hover up to 5ft above the ground. While hovering, you are not an eligible target for abilities that require a target to be flying or airborne unless you'd meet those conditions normally.

All Abilities.Name: Hug tight
All Abilities.Description: You deal Light Damage to the target.
All Abilities.Requirements: Enemy Unit Affected By “Just A Hug”.

All Abilities.Name: Human Adaptability
All Abilities.Description:
As an errand action, you may refund an ability and choose to learn another ability. You cannot pick an ability that makes you ineligible for any of your prerequisites. Your new ability must cost the same as your unlearned one, or you must pay additional normal EXP to make up for the cost difference. If you choose to unlearn a class and learn a new one with this ability, you must spend IP for that new class as normal. Any previous IP spent on learning the class you unlearn is NOT refunded.

If you choose to refund primary stats, secondary stats or skill points and then level up the class again, you must put those points back in the same things you originally put them in.

Does not work on breakthroughs.

All Abilities.Name: Hunting Wolf
All Abilities.Description: You may move towards the target as if you had spent X AP on movement. Your movement speed is doubled for this movement.
All Abilities.Requirements: The target enemy is below half HP.

All Abilities.Name: Hyphal Force
All Abilities.Description:
Your spore symbiote surges the host’s muscles with temporary power. When the host of Spore Symbiote is making a melee attack, increase the damage by your Light Attack Damage. The extra damage dealt is Earth Damage.

This spell does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
All Abilities.Requirements: The host of your Spore Symbiote is making a melee attack.

All Abilities.Name: Iai Strike
All Abilities.Description: You draw your weapon and attack with lightning speed, making a Heavy Attack. You lose the Sheathed state afterwards.
All Abilities.Requirements: Katana only. Must be in the Iai state.

All Abilities.Name: Iaijutsu
All Abilities.Benefits: Enemies don't gain Trick Attack against you when you're surprised., You may sheathe and draw katanas for 0 AP once per turn per katana., You start each battle in the 'Iai' state, which is used for Iai abilities. Making an attack with a katana removes the Iai state for that weapon. Using a skill that requires the Iai state requires the weapon to be sheathed and will remove the Iai state for ALL your weapons, unless specified otherwise.

All Abilities.Name: Ice Cold
All Abilities.Benefits: You are immune to Slows and difficult terrain effects with the Frost keyword., You are immune to regular weather effects involving cold., You gain Frost Mastery.  Mastery of an element allows you to use it in Channeling weapon attacks and use it to perform minor tricks relating to it.

All Abilities.Name: Icicle Nail
All Abilities.Description: You fire a shard of ice at a target unit, making a Light Attack that deals Frost Damage. On hit, the target is Slowed until the end of their next turn.

All Abilities.Name: Idol's Journey
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain proficiency in wands, small weapons and light armor., You gain +5 skill points in Art., You may use One Beat, One Heart

All Abilities.Name: Ignite
All Abilities.Description: You may use this as a reaction after you deal Fire Damage to an enemy to set them on fire, causing them to become Burning X, where X equals your Power x 3.Overcharge:You may target additional enemies with this ability if you hit them with the same ability or attack. You may pay 1 mana per target beyond the first to also affect them with this ability.

All Abilities.Name: Illuminating Flash
All Abilities.Description: You select a point within range. All targets in a 15x15 area centered on the point must make a save against your Potency or be inflicted with Illumination X where X  your Focus / 2 (Rounded Down) until the end of your next turn. They also become Blinded 5 for their next attack.

All Abilities.Name: Imbue Weapon
All Abilities.Description:
You enchant your melee weapon with an element you mastered. Your weapon now deals the chosen element’s damage instead of its normal damage.

If you are not holding the enchanted weapon at the start of your turn, your weapon loses this benefit.

All Abilities.Name: Improved Death Perception
All Abilities.Benefits: You can see the death of non-living things allowing you to automatically do maximum, full pierce damage against objects., You apply 1 Mark of Death every time you hit an enemy with ‘Lines of Death’ or ‘Point of Death’ up to a maximum of 7 marks.

All Abilities.Name: Improvised Defense
All Abilities.Description: You grab a nearby item and use it as cover against the triggering attack while taking the Dodge or Block action. The type of item used determines whether it is light, heavy or full cover.
All Abilities.Requirements: You become the target of an attack.

All Abilities.Name: Improvised Weaponry
All Abilities.Benefits: When using improvised weapons, they deal the same damage as normal weapons would., You may use Chair Grab., Upon mastering this class, your improvised weapon attacks all gain the Prone keyword.

All Abilities.Name: In The Zone
All Abilities.Description: You add a crafting check to the item. This craft gains a +X bonus where X is equal to the amount of crafting dice spent this session.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be in a crafting session. Costs 1 Crafting Dice

All Abilities.Name: Incendiary Ray
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Light Attack that deals Fire damage against all targets in a 10ft wide line up to the range. On damage, inflict Burning X where X is your Power x 3.

All Abilities.Name: Inconspicuous
All Abilities.Benefits: If you're traveling stealthily, you may roll separate stealth checks even if traveling with the party. When doing this, any surprise rounds for you are determined purely off your own rolls and not your parties., During a surprise round, enemies you attack are still treated as having 0 RP even after you attack them until they start their turn. You still gain this benefit, even if your allies attacked them already.

All Abilities.Name: Increased Reach
All Abilities.Description: The range of the next Spell you cast is doubled. Only works on Spells that have a range listed in ft.

All Abilities.Name: Independent Action
All Abilities.Description:
Your animal summoned through the Summon Animal ability gains the ability to act independently. It acts at initiative 0, though you may still control its action. A summon with Independent Action starts with 2 AP and 1 RP and may use those as normal. If they have an ability that costs mana, then you still have to pay that mana cost.

While it is under the effects of Independent Action, you cannot command your summon through the use of your own AP.

A summon targeted by this ability takes up 2 slots towards the summon limit. If this would put you past your limit, you cannot use this ability.
All Abilities.Requirements: Can only target your summoned animal.

All Abilities.Name: Independent Actor
All Abilities.Benefits: When working alone (No known allies within 300ft of you) you gain a +10 bonus to Perception, Insight, Survival and Stealth checks., You gain a +5 bonus in Art (Cartography) expertise. This is not doubled for expertise bonus., You may use Scout’s Retreat., Having an Aetherie or similar connection active automatically fails the ‘No known allies’ requirements.

All Abilities.Name: Inexorable Shadow Stance
All Abilities.Description:
You enter a stance that enhances your attacks at the cost of your own life. Whenever you hit an enemy with an unarmed attack, you may deal Light or Heavy true damage to yourself to increase the damage of the attack by the same amount. This may be done after reactions to the attack have been declared, though an enemy may still choose to react to it again or differently afterwards.

If used with an attack that hits more than 1 target, this extra damage only applies to one of the damage rolls.

This stance lasts until you enter a different stance.

All Abilities.Name: Infernal Bastion
All Abilities.Description: You surround yourself with flames and take the Block action against the attack. If you reduce damage of this attack to 0, inflict Burning X on the target where X is your focus x 3.
All Abilities.Requirements: You are targeted by a melee attack.

All Abilities.Name: Infiltrate
All Abilities.Benefits: When you use Decipher Magic, you may use Roguecraft instead of Magic as the skill for it. In addition, you can modify the effect in such a way that it no longer affects you and your allies rather than completely disabling it.

All Abilities.Name: Inspired Finish
All Abilities.Description: Make a crafting check. The dice is upgraded to 3d10 and you still add your crafting bonus to this. The crafting immediately ends after using this ability and you may not spend Crafting Points to add artisan bonuses, alloys or similar things.
All Abilities.Requirements: This is your last crafting dice. Costs 1 Crafting Dice.

All Abilities.Name: Inspiring Song
All Abilities.Description:
All allies within range (including yourself) may add 1d4 to a single roll they make until the start of your next turn. They may choose to add this after seeing the roll.

Upkeep:At the start of your next turn and every turn thereafter, you may spend 1 AP to continue this performance, granting all allies within range the benefit once again.

All Abilities.Name: Instinct
All Abilities.Description:
The first time per encounter that you are attacked by a Stealth attack, that attack does not gain the Trick Attack benefit. If you become the target of an attack while you're surprised, you may still react to it and any special properties of an attack that require you to be unaware of the attack (such as Killshot) do not apply to it.

In addition, when you are about to take an action that leads to grave harm or death (example: The enemy has an instant death ability), you can receive a premonition from the DM.

All Abilities.Name: Intercept
All Abilities.Description:
You move towards an ally, Sidestepping them 5ft in a direction of their choice and occupying their square. The triggering attack is made against you and you automatically take the Block action against it.

Mounted move rules apply to your movement for this action.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be mounted and an ally is the target of an attack.

All Abilities.Name: Into the Fray
All Abilities.Description: You may move up to twice your movement speed. You must end this movement in range to make a melee attack against an enemy. Can only be used on your turn.

All Abilities.Name: Judgement Shot
All Abilities.Description:
You make a Light attack against the target.

Afterwards, an ally other than you within 30ft of you may make a Light attack against the target. They may spend 1 RP to make this a Heavy or Precise attack instead.

All Abilities.Name: Jump
All Abilities.Description: You leap up to 30ft into the air and then Sidestep up to twice your Speed. You may use Skydive at any point during this movement.

All Abilities.Name: Jump Back
All Abilities.Description: You Jump Back to your previous location. This movement does not provoke any attacks of opportunity.
All Abilities.Requirements: Previous action had the jump keyword.

All Abilities.Name: Just a hug
All Abilities.Description:
You coil and grapple a non-heroic enemy that is not larger than you, rooting both of you and rendering the target incapable of any attacks.  You automatically guard against any attacks made towards the target as if using Block.  You can also use this on a willing ally target.

The target may spend 1 Ap or 1 RP to attempt to escape, granting them escape power equal to their power.  Further escape attempts continue to add escape power.  When the escape power is equal to 8, then the target successfully escapes.  You may end this effect at any time for 0 RP.

All Abilities.Name: Justice Blade
All Abilities.Description: You make a Heavy Attack against the target.
All Abilities.Requirements: Target has your Mark of Justice on them.

All Abilities.Name: Kage Bunshin: Kyomei
All Abilities.Description: Your clone assists in the preparation of your next Ninjutsu, reducing the AP cost of it by 1.
All Abilities.Requirements: You must have a Bunshin clone active and within range.

All Abilities.Name: Kage Shuriken no Jutsu
All Abilities.Description: You attack by throwing two weapons at the target, one hidden in the shadow of the other. Both of these are considered Light Attacks. If you fail your Accuracy roll on the first one, the second gains Sure Hit.
All Abilities.Requirements: Set of Missiles, Throwing Weapon or Thrown attack with small weapon only.

All Abilities.Name: Kawarimi no Jutsu
All Abilities.Description: The triggering attack automatically misses and you may Hide for 0 AP/RP, then move up to your Speed without provoking attacks of opportunity.
All Abilities.Requirements: Targeted by an attack.

All Abilities.Name: Ki Blast
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. This attack deals Arcane damage.

All Abilities.Name: Ki Blast II
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Light (1 AP), Precise (2 AP) or Heavy (2 AP) Attack against the target. This attack deals Arcane Damage.

All Abilities.Name: Ki Burst
All Abilities.Description:
Your attack deals an extra X damage.

If used with a basic attack or double punch, deal 2X extra damage instead up to a maximum of +10 damage. Only affects 1 damage roll even if an attack makes multiple attacks.
All Abilities.Requirements: Can be used after damaging a single opponent with an Unarmed Strike attack.

All Abilities.Name: Ki Circulation
All Abilities.Description: You cycle the Ki inside your body and purge it from negative energy. You remove Bleeding, Shaken, Unbalanced or any Poison effect from yourself.

All Abilities.Name: Ki Recovery
All Abilities.Description: You spend your Encounter Conclusion action to regain 2 mana.

All Abilities.Name: Ki Sense
All Abilities.Description: You send out your Ki and become aware of any creatures without presence concealment within 40ft of you, giving you a rough idea of their location. This does not remove Hiding from them, but their attacks against you do not gain Trick Attack or any other stealth or surprise bonuses until the start of your next turn.

All Abilities.Name: Kibaku Fuda Shuriken
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Heavy Attack by throwing a weapon with an explosive tag attached at a target. Regardless of whether it hits, the target and others within 5ft of the target must then make a save against Potency or take Light Fire Damage.
All Abilities.Requirements: Set of Missiles, Throwing Weapon or Thrown attack with small weapon only.

All Abilities.Name: Killshot
All Abilities.Description:
You may make a Heavy Attack against the target that deals double Heavy Damage instead.

If fired in the first round of combat while all enemies are unaware of you, the target has to spend an additional RP to react to your attack. This stacks with the Trick Attack keyword, but is ineffective against abilities that negate surprise or stealth attacks such as Instinct.
All Abilities.Requirements: Sniper Rifles only

All Abilities.Name: Kiri-tsuke
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. On Killing Blow, you regain the Iai state.
All Abilities.Requirements: Katana only

All Abilities.Name: Kiri-tsuke II
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. On Killing Blow, you regain the Iai state.Combo:If used after Iai Strike, the AP cost is reduced by 1.
All Abilities.Requirements: Katana only.

All Abilities.Name: Knockback Shot
All Abilities.Description: You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, the target is pushed back 20ft.

All Abilities.Name: Knockdown Swing
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Light Attack against the target. On damage, the target is knocked Prone.
All Abilities.Requirements: Two-Handed weapons only.

All Abilities.Name: Knockout Punch
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. On damage if the enemy is a Grunt, they immediately drop to 0 HP and fall unconscious.

All Abilities.Name: Kugeki-zan
All Abilities.Description: You make a Light attack against the target.
All Abilities.Requirements: Target must have 0 RP remaining.

All Abilities.Name: Last Rites
All Abilities.Description: You deal +1 damage to undead creatures. This is increased to a +2 bonus on Heavy attacks.

All Abilities.Name: Last Stand
All Abilities.Description: Until the start of your next turn, you may use the Block action for 0 RP and you gain additional Guard equal to the mana spent on this ability. Once you use this ability, you cannot use it again in this encounter.

All Abilities.Name: Lay on Hands
All Abilities.Description: You Heal the target for 4 + Power.Overcharge:You may spend an additional mana to remove a negative effect from the target. Injuries and Mortal Wounds cannot be removed with this.

All Abilities.Name: Leashing
All Abilities.Description: You teleport your summoned animal to an empty square within 5ft of you.
All Abilities.Requirements: Can only target your summoned animal.

All Abilities.Name: Leg Sweep
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Light Attack against the target. On damage, the target falls Prone.

All Abilities.Name: Lengthened Incantation
All Abilities.Description:
You lengthen the time it takes to cast your next Spell to empower it. You may add up to 2 AP to the cost of your next spell with the Spell gaining additional Light Damage on it. If you cannot pay this AP cost this turn, the Spell also gains the Setup keyword.

If the Spell has multiple attack rolls or different damage rolls, this bonus only applies to one of them.

However, if the spell is a Scattering AoE spell then the bonus damage applies to all targets of that spell. If that Scattering spell hits a target more than once it only applies to one damage roll. If the spell lasts for multiple turns, it only applies to the initial casting.

All Abilities.Name: Lifebeat Sense
All Abilities.Description: You can assess the approximate HP percentage of the target until the end of combat.  (The DM should enable health bars for the unit, or you can ask for an approximate percentage). In addition, the target is afflicted by Expose 1, reducing the target’s crit threshold by 1. (20 to crit becomes 19.) Expose is removed once the target is critically hit (regardless of if they defend or not)

All Abilities.Name: Lifesense
All Abilities.Description:
You know the direction your Soulmate is in and if you’re within 300 feet of them, you know their exact location.

You also know their current HP, Mana and RP.

All Abilities.Name: Light Cavalry
All Abilities.Benefits: While mounted and while you and your mount both wear light armor or no armor, you ignore natural difficult terrain.

All Abilities.Name: Light Work
All Abilities.Description: Only usable as the first crafting action. All material costs are doubled and all produced items are doubled. You may only use basic crafting actions for the rest of the craft. Make a crafting attempt.
All Abilities.Requirements: Costs 1 Crafting Dice.

All Abilities.Name: Lightning Lariat
All Abilities.Keywords: Unarmed Strike, Overcharge, Combo, Trick Attack
All Abilities.Description:
You gather lightning energy and move up to twice your speed in a direct line and make a Heavy attack against a target. If you moved more than 60ft before making the attack, your attack gains the Trick Attack keyword.

Overcharge:You may spend X mana to move an additional 2 x X times your speed.

Combo: If used after Heavenly Lightning Stance or Secret Art: Lightning Release, the mana cost is reduced by 1.

All Abilities.Name: Lightning Rod
All Abilities.Description: You gain Damage Reduction 100 Lightning for the triggering attack. If you reduce damage in any way from this ability and the attacker isn't you, you gain a Power Bonus on your next Lightning Elemental Attack equal to the attacker’s Power.
All Abilities.Requirements: Attack Deals Lightning Damage,

All Abilities.Name: Lightning Strikes Twice
All Abilities.Benefits: When the Static you apply deals damage to an enemy, that enemy becomes afflicted with Static X, where X is the value of the Static that damaged it.

All Abilities.Name: Lightning Weapon
All Abilities.Description: When attacking with a weapon, you may choose to have the weapon deal Lightning Damage instead of its normal damage type. You must declare you chosen damage type before making the accuracy roll.

All Abilities.Name: Light's Care
All Abilities.Description: At the end of combat you may use 1 Encounter Conclusion action to heal a single target for 11 + Power x 2 and grant them First Aid. First Aid: The target can expend an Encounter Conclusion Action to prevent one injury to themself.

All Abilities.Name: Line of Death
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Light Attack against the target.Overcharge:You may spend 1 additional mana and AP to make another Light Attack against the same target.
All Abilities.Requirements: Slashing weapons only.

All Abilities.Name: Living Cover
All Abilities.Benefits: While mounted, any ally within 5ft of you may use you as Low Cover. If an attack would miss them because of your cover benefit, the attack instead hits you.

All Abilities.Name: Living Lightning
All Abilities.Description: You turn into a spark of lightning as you move. For this movement action, you deal Light Lightning damage to all creatures you pass through.
All Abilities.Requirements: Not mounted and must move entirely in a straight line.

All Abilities.Name: Localized Collapse
All Abilities.Description:
You target a 15x15ft square. All in the area take damage equal to your Focus / 2. If a creature occupies multiple squares in your target square, they take damage for each square they occupy.

A creature caught in it may spend 1 RP to avoid the effect.

All Abilities.Name: Long Toss
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. This attack has triple the range it would normally have.
All Abilities.Requirements: Throwing Weapon, Set of Missiles or Thrown attack only.

All Abilities.Name: Lord's Dominion
All Abilities.Benefits: You can partially resist the effect of the sun. You may now spend 1 round in the sun before you start taking damage. Spending a turn outside of the sun resets this effect, giving you another round where you do not suffer the negative effects., You gain +1 Vampire Lord bonus to Presence.

All Abilities.Name: Loyalty
All Abilities.Description: When standing within 5ft of a heroic ally, your Guard is increased by 1 and your Block is increased by 2.

All Abilities.Name: Lucid Sleep
All Abilities.Description: High Fae remain aware of their surroundings while they sleep and do not suffer from Surprised from being asleep.

All Abilities.Name: Luminous Form Stance
All Abilities.Description:
You enter the Luminous Form Stance and create theThreads of Light.These manifest spiritual cloth, spectral arms or something similar that enhances your reach.

While in this stance, you gain an additional 10ft range on your unarmed attacks and your threatened range becomes 5-15ft. Whenever you deal damage to an enemy with an unarmed strike ability (not basic attacks), you gain 1 stack of Harmony up to a maximum of 5. You cannot gain more than 1 Harmony per use of ability.

When you leave this stance all stacks are lost.

This stance lasts until you enter a different stance or you willingly move, with the exception of movement abilities with the unarmed strike keyword. Abilities from allies that allow you to move, such as Gravitional Ki, count as willing movement.

All Abilities.Name: Lunge
All Abilities.Description: The attack range of your next basic Light, Heavy or Precise Attack with a melee weapon is doubled.

All Abilities.Name: Mage Armor
All Abilities.Description:
You gain magical Light Armor, Medium Armor or Heavy Armor until the end of the encounter. This function just as normal armor of that type would, giving the same benefits and penalties. Does not stack with other armor, apply the effects of the Mage Armor This magical armor does not require proficiency of any sort and does not cost any Burden to wear and carry.

You may apply the effects of Barrier, Fortress, Manaweave, Protective Coating or Spidersilk to this armor (It must still meet the requirements, you cannot put fortress on a light armor for example). This can only be done when you first apply it, not if you later change your armor during combat.

If Mage Armor is active, you may spend 2 AP to change its type or to remove it.

All Abilities.Name: Mage Knight
All Abilities.Benefits: You may also use Canter after casting a spell.

All Abilities.Name: Mage of the Tides
All Abilities.Benefits: You can use Blue Tide., You gain Elemental Mastery: Water, You gain the ability to walk on water and skate across its surface—every 10ft of water surface movement only costs 5ft of movement.

All Abilities.Name: Mage's Journey
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain proficiency in the Channeling weapon group's weapons and gain Arcane Mastery. Mastery of an element allows you to use it in Channeling weapon attacks and use it to perform minor tricks relating to it., You gain +5 skill points in the Magic skill., You can use Sense Magic.

All Abilities.Name: Magic Missile
All Abilities.Description:
You fire a highly accurate blast of arcane energy at the target, making a Precise Attack that deals Arcane damage against the target

Overcharge:You may spend 1 extra mana and 1 extra AP to fire an additional missile at the same target.

These attacks do not gain Pinpoint.

All Abilities.Name: Magic Missile II
All Abilities.Description:
You fire a highly accurate blast of arcane energy at the target, making a Precise Attack that deals Arcane damage against the target

This attack does not gain Pinpoint.

All Abilities.Name: Magic Resistance
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain a +2 Anti-Mage bonus to your saves against Spells.

All Abilities.Name: Maid Training
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain proficiency in staves (broom), small weapons, sets of missiles and light armor., You gain 5 skill points to spend in Athletics, Stealth, Roguecraft, Medicine, Common Knowledge, Linguistics, Appraise, History, Perception, Insight, Survival or Intimidation. You can exchange any skill point for 2 expertise points, but must spend them in these skills., You may use Graceful Service.

All Abilities.Name: Malevolent Phantasm
All Abilities.Description: You siphon the energy lost from your allies and make a Heavy Attack against the target that deals Dark Damage.
All Abilities.Requirements: An ally (including yourself) took damage on your turn.

All Abilities.Name: Mana Burst
All Abilities.Description:
You augment your next attack, increasing accuracy by 3 and dealing 3 bonus damage on hit.

You may use AP for this attack instead.

All Abilities.Name: Mana Eater
All Abilities.Description: You cannot consume biological food and instead consume equal monetary value of Magical Fuel for sustenance. You do not need to breathe.

All Abilities.Name: Mana Razor
All Abilities.Description:
Until the end of your turn you gainMana Razorgranting your basic melee attacks an additional 30ft range. Augmenting melee attacks with this ability makes them into ranged attacks.

Overcharge: You may spend 1 mana to have this also affect basic ranged attacks and to remove the Quick keyword from it.

All Abilities.Name: Mana Shield
All Abilities.Description:
You use your Encounter Start action to give yourselfMana Shield,which gives you Temporary HP equal to your Toughness + 3 or Focus + 3 (whichever is higher).

Wearing armor reduces this to 2/3rd, 1/3rd or 0 if wearing Light, Medium or Heavy Armor respectively. While Mana Shield is active, you do not provoke attacks of opportunity from casting Spells from enemies that are Challenged by you.

Until the end of the encounter, at the start of your turn you may spend 1 mana to restore your Mana Shield to its maximum value. (With similarly reduced values for wearing armor)

If you did not use this as an encounter start, you may also spend 1 AP and 1 Mana to activate this.

All Abilities.Name: Mana Sight
All Abilities.Description: You can assess the approximate mana percentage of a unit until the end of combat. (The DM should enable mana bar for the unit).

All Abilities.Name: Mantra: Flowing Perception
All Abilities.Description:
You extend your Threads of Light and make an unarmed light attack against a target within range. On damage, you may pull yourself towards the target and sidestep to the nearest square within 5ft of them.

You may also use this on ally. If you do, this always hits and deals no damage. It still gives you a stack of Harmony.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be in Luminous Form Stance.

All Abilities.Name: Mantra: Pure Intentions
All Abilities.Description:
You wrap your Threads of Light around the chosen ally and channel your Harmony into them.

You may spend up to 5 stacks of Harmony and 1 mana per stack you consume to heal an ally within range for 3+Focus for each stack.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must have at least 1 stack of Harmony.

All Abilities.Name: Mark of Justice
All Abilities.Description:
You mark a single enemy, inflicting Mark of Justice on them. A marked enemy’s movement speed is reduced to 20ft. Abilities that allow for movement cannot move the target for more than 20ft per use. Secret Arts and Esoteric Arts are not affected by this. You can only have a single enemy marked by this at the same time. It lasts until the end of the encounter. Does not work on vehicles.

A marked target may spend 1 mana per AP/RP of the action (with a minimum of 1 mana even for 0 AP abilities) to temporarily ignore the restricting effect for a movement action.

All Abilities.Name: Martial Artist's Journey
All Abilities.Benefits: Your unarmed attack damage is treated as a One-Handed Weapon in which you are proficient., You gain +5 skill points to spend in Athletics, Perception, Insight, Medicine, Intimidation or a relevant Expert Knowledge skill (By DM approval). You can exchange any skill point for 2 expertise points, but must spend them in these skills., You can use Discipline.

All Abilities.Name: Mashup
All Abilities.Description: You may activate another song with the Idol keyword. This song’s AP cost is reduced by 2 and this song may go past your regular maximum song limits.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must have at least 1 song with Idol keyword active.

All Abilities.Name: Master of the Empty Sky
All Abilities.Benefits: When flying and not benefiting from cover, you gain a +2 Sky-Talon bonus to your Evasion and Dodge.

All Abilities.Name: Measured Collapse
All Abilities.Description:
You make a Heavy attack against the target. This attack is always considered to have rolled a 2 for accuracy instead of rolling the d20.

Against creatures that are large size, gain a +2 bonus. If they are huge size, gain a +4 bonus.

All Abilities.Name: Memory of the Grove
All Abilities.Description: After making a gathering check, you may choose to reroll the die. If you do, store the original die result. You may replace a future gathering die result (before bonus) with the stored value.
All Abilities.Requirements: Usable after making a gathering a check.

All Abilities.Name: Mending
All Abilities.Benefits: You may spend an EP to restore a Broken item. Some items (such as consumables) cannot be repaired (GM’s discretion).

All Abilities.Name: Mighty Leap
All Abilities.Description: You jump to a target within range and may make a Light attack against them. All enemies within 5ft of the target must make a save or becomeUnbalanced.
All Abilities.Requirements: Two-Handed melee weapons only.

All Abilities.Name: Mind Connection
All Abilities.Description:
You physically touch up to five willing people, granting them Mind Connection—creating a mind link through you.  While linked, each creature can speak through telepathy to all other creatures linked to the same caster.  Mind Connection has unlimited duration but also reduces your maximum mana by 1, this effect lasts until you cancel Mind Connection.  Mind Connection has a maximum range of 500 ft—breaking this range doesn’t cancel the spell but interrupts the signal until within range again.

While Mind Connection lasts, you may spend 1 AP to transfer view through the eyes of one of the people connected with the mind link.

All Abilities.Name: Mind's Eye
All Abilities.Description: You may ask the GM for the rough best course of action during an encounter based on the information you have. The GM should answer truthfully, but does not need to go in depth. (For example: Retreat, kill the grunts, focus the boss, use magic attacks etc).

All Abilities.Name: Mining Expertise
All Abilities.Description: You may unlock the miner class for 0 EXP. You must still spend the IP on it.

All Abilities.Name: Miracle: Sanctuary
All Abilities.Description: You create an immobile sphere of protection in a 5ft radius that prevents all entry into and out of it. The Shield has health points equal to 20 + Toughness x 8. Attacks and Magical Effects cannot be casted out of or into the Sanctuary, which functions as line-of-sight blocking for the purposes of abilities. Sanctuary lasts until the start of your next turn unless you pay Upkeep (1 Mana). The Spell also ends when the Shield’s health points are reduced to zero. This spell does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

All Abilities.Name: Misdirected Blow
All Abilities.Description:
You may take the Dodge action. If the attack is successfully avoided, the attack is then made against an enemy within 5ft of you and using the same accuracy roll. This enemy must be different from the one making the attack. The new target may react to this attack as normal.

Does not work against Secret Art or Esoteric Art level attacks.
All Abilities.Requirements: You are the target of an attack and have a different enemy within 5ft of you.

All Abilities.Name: Mission Control
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain proficiency in the Aetherie Sensory Station., You may use Mind Connection.

All Abilities.Name: Mist of the Vale
All Abilities.Description:
A mist rolls out from around you, trapping those caught in it in a misty vale in which travelers are doomed to die. All in the mist must make a save against your Potency when they try to escape it. If they fail their save when they attempt to move out, you may finish the remaining movement for them as long as they end within your mist. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

The mist also blocks Line of Sight. Targets inside of or within 5ft of the mist can only see up to 5ft into or out of mist.

The mist is a 15ft radius around yourself, but if flying it does not go below you. You may choose to exclude allies from the trapping effect. If you do, the upkeep mana cost and initial mana cost is increased by 1.

Upkeep:1 AP
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be played on a flute.

All Abilities.Name: Molten Domain
All Abilities.Description:
Until the start of your next turn, the ground 5ft around you becomes like burning ground.

Any enemy willingly leaving or moving through this area other than entering it becomes Burning X, where X is your Focus x 3.

The domain burns away other friendly damage aura effects while in effect. Effects that would normally trigger upon ending the turn in it (such as Poison Spore) don't trigger if someone ends their turn in the Molten Domain.

All Abilities.Name: Momentum
All Abilities.Description: You make a Heavy attack against the target. For every 10ft moved during your last action this turn, this attack gains +1 damage up to a maximum of +10 damage. Abilities with the Teleport keyword do not apply for this.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be mounted.

All Abilities.Name: Mordschlag
All Abilities.Description: You attack the target with the pommel or crossguard making a Heavy Attack against the target.
All Abilities.Requirements: Longsword, Heavy Blades and Bludgeoning weapons only.

All Abilities.Name: Mountain Slayer
All Abilities.Description: You make a Light attack against a target.
All Abilities.Requirements: Target can be affected by Shieldbreaker.

All Abilities.Name: Mounted Basics
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain proficiency in Polearms, Lances, Light armor, Shields and one other common weapon group of your choice., You gain 5 skill points in Riding. You can exchange any skill point for 2 expertise points, but must spend them in these skills., You may use Spirit Jump., If you have mastered cavalier, your mount can withstand one lethal blow. If your mount would be reduced to 0 HP or below by an attack, it instead is reduced to 1 HP. Only works once per encounter.

All Abilities.Name: Mounted Casting
All Abilities.Description: You may cast a Spell with an AP cost of 2 or less.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be mounted and taking a movement action.

All Abilities.Name: Move Piece
All Abilities.Description:
You move a puppet piece you can see that's under your control. The way it moves depends on the type of piece. When a piece moves, it's a Sidestep.

Pawn: Moves up to 2 squares orthogonally or 1 square diagonally in a straight line.

Knight: Moves 1 square orthogonally, then 1 square diagonal in the same direction it moved in orthogonally (like a knight in chess). Can pass through allies and enemies.

Bishop: Moves up to 8 squares diagonally in a straight line.

Rook: Moves up to 8 squares orthogonally in a straight line.

Queen: Moves up to 8 squares orthogonally or diagonally in a straight line.

Except for the Knight, chess pieces cannot move through allies and stop their movement when they hit an object or creature. If this happens, it makes a Heavy attack against that target with your stats. A knight that makes an attack and does not kill the target remains in its original spot.

On damage, a piece is promoted into a higher rank (Pawn -> Bishop/Knight -> Rook -> Queen). A queen cannot promote.

On Killing Blow, a piece occupies the square of the thing it attacked.

All Abilities.Name: Movement Burst
All Abilities.Description:
You may move up to your Speed + up to 15ft per mana spent on this ability. Any unspent movement is lost afterwards.

If you spend more than 1 Mana on this ability, it loses the Stealth keyword.

All Abilities.Name: Mud Wall
All Abilities.Description:
You create a wall 4ft high, 1ft thick and up to 20ft long that serves as low cover. Anybody attempting to get over the wall treats it as difficult terrain. Walls must be placed on solid ground and cannot be stacked on top of eachother.

Each 5ft of wall has 60 HP and dissolves if it reaches 0. It otherwise lasts until the end of the encounter.

You may spend 1 RP instead of 2 AP on this ability instead.

All Abilities.Name: Mudra: First Sensation
All Abilities.Description:
You deliver the first motion, a graceful strike that awakens awareness in both you and your foe and you make a Light attack against the target. On hit, you gain a Harmony stack (In addition to the one you might get if this deals damage.)

Combo: When used after entering Luminous Form Stance, the mana cost is reduced by 1.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be in Luminous Form Stance

All Abilities.Name: Multishot
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Heavy Attack against two different targets.Overcharge:You may spend X extra mana to attack 2 + X targets instead.

All Abilities.Name: Mystic Eyes of Life Perception
All Abilities.Description: You temporarily empower your eyes. While active, you gain 360 degree vision and automatically detect all enemies within a 30ft radius of you that are not behind at least 1ft of full cover. In addition, you can see the approximate HP and Mana percentage of all enemies in this range. This lasts for 5 minutes or until you turn it off.

All Abilities.Name: Nature's Grasp
All Abilities.Description:
You shoot out a vine that wraps around the target and make a Light Attack against the target that only deals 1 Earth damage. On damage, the target becomes Rooted until the start of your next turn or until they spend 2 AP to remove the root with a slashing or fire based attack.

Against Grunts, this attack costs 0 Mana and gains Sure Hit.

All Abilities.Name: Nightstalker
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain 60ft darkvision, allowing you to see perfectly in the dark even without a source of light. If you already have darkvision, the range of it improves by 60ft.

All Abilities.Name: Nightvision
All Abilities.Description: As long as there is a source of weak light (even a weak moon) you do not suffer penalties to your vision due to darkness up to 120ft.

All Abilities.Name: Ninja Run
All Abilities.Description: For your next movement action, you may treat the surface you’re walking on as horizontal ground, allowing you to walk over water or up walls.

All Abilities.Name: Ninja Style
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain proficiency in both Small Weapons and Sets of Missiles., You may use Ninja Run.

All Abilities.Name: Ninja Techniques
All Abilities.Benefits: Your Ninja Run now lasts for the entire turn., You may use Genjutsu Kai

All Abilities.Name: No getting past!
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Light (0 RP) or Heavy (1 RP) attack against the target. On damage, the target becomes Slowed until the end of their turn. If the target is already Slowed, they become Rooted. This ability is treated as an attack of opportunity.
All Abilities.Requirements: Only usable when you would be able to make an attack of opportunity.

All Abilities.Name: Oil Slick
All Abilities.Description: You throw a bottle of oil on the ground within range, creating a 15x15 area of slippery oil. If the target contacts the oil at any point of movement (even the start or end) and they moved more than 5ft in a single movement action, they immediately fall prone. The slick lasts until the start of your next turn.

All Abilities.Name: On my terms
All Abilities.Benefits: While you are at 1 HP or higher, damage (including true damage) you take during your own turn cannot reduce you below 1 HP., When you roll a 1 on a skill check, something unexpected may happen (GM's discretion). This is usually bad, but it could also turn out to be a blessing in disguise.

All Abilities.Name: One Beat, One Heart
All Abilities.Description:
All allies within range gain a +1 Song bonus to their accuracy. This bonus is doubled on Precise attacks.

Upkeep: 1 AP

All Abilities.Name: Order: Retreat
All Abilities.Description: You order one willing allied unit to retreat, moving up to their Speed. All movement must be made towards you, and does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

All Abilities.Name: Ore Hunter
All Abilities.Benefits: You can gather Tier 2 mining outcrops., You are an expert and tying knots. Using rope, you can secure yourself to objects and safely rappel down to investigate down cliffsides.

All Abilities.Name: Ougi: Taju Bunshin no Jutsu
All Abilities.Description:
You create 3 illusionary copies of yourself within 10ft of yourself or your Bunshin clone. These copies can take actions similar to your Bunshin Tai no Jutsu, but each of them may also act with its own 2 AP from the start of your next turn.

Each clone has 1 HP and upon taking any damage, they vanish. You may use RP for these clones as normal.

Upkeep:2 AP

All Abilities.Name: Overclock
All Abilities.Description: You may add 1d10 crafting points to the item. The item starts in theBrokencondition. Cannot be used for Alchemy crafting.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be in a crafting session.

All Abilities.Name: Overpower
All Abilities.Description:
You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. For every point of Power you have over the target, you deal 1 additional damage. If the enemy is Prone, each point of Power you have over the target adds 2 additional damage instead.

Combo:If used after Knockdown Swing, the AP cost is reduced by 1.
All Abilities.Requirements: Two-Handed weapons only.

All Abilities.Name: Overtime again?
All Abilities.Description:
When you take the Heal Injury, Appraise or Mentor IP actions, you may do the same action again for an EP.

In addition, if you take the Rest interlude action you may give the benefit to a different character instead. This does not stack with any Rest bonuses they may have already.

All Abilities.Name: Overwhelming Critical
All Abilities.Benefits: When you roll a critical hit you may use Aftershock even if the attack didn’t miss. This use doesn’t count against the normal use limit of it and this effect still applies even if the critical hit was blocked or otherwise defended against.

All Abilities.Name: Own Mount
All Abilities.Description: You count as mounted for the purposes of abilities that require you to be mounted. This does not let you be a mount to other creatures.

All Abilities.Name: Pack Tactics
All Abilities.Description: Select a target within range. Until the end of your turn, while the target has one of your allies within 5ft of it, you gainPack Tactics, which gives a +2 bonus on accuracy checks for melee attacks against that target.

All Abilities.Name: Panda Roll
All Abilities.Description: You prepare to roll from an incoming attack. Your next Dodge action before the start of your next turn costs 0 RP. If you successfully avoid an attack with this Dodge action, you may Sidestep 5ft.

All Abilities.Name: Panda Stance
All Abilities.Description:
You enter a stance in which you use your tail for extra balance. When you would be knocked back or prone, you may end this stance to negate the effect. This stance then ends.

Otherwise, the stance lasts until you enter a different stance.

You may use AP or RP for this ability.

All Abilities.Name: Paragon of Virtue
All Abilities.Description: You may remove a single negative non-physical effect from yourself (ie, fears, charms but not things such as bleed). If you are afflicted with more than 1 negative effect that is a valid target, you may choose which one you remove.

All Abilities.Name: Parry
All Abilities.Description:
Roll your Heavy Weapon Damage, but add your Focus instead of Power to the roll and treat that as your Block against the attack targeting you. If Parry reduces the damage to 0, you regain 1 RP (cannot go higher than your max RP). On hit effects and maces do not gain their effect if you reduce the damage to 0.

When using Parry against an attack, that attack cannot land a critical hit against you.
All Abilities.Requirements: Target of a melee attack, wielding a One-Handed melee weapon.

All Abilities.Name: Past Self
All Abilities.Description:
You place a past self token at your current position that lasts until the end of the encounter. Your past self tokens are used for other abilities and cannot be attacked normally.

When you make a weapon attack, you may have the attack come from a past self token. After a past self token attacks, it becomes targetable by attacks and effects for 1 round as if you were in that position though you cannot be hit more than once by the same attack because of this.

All Abilities.Name: Pathfinder
All Abilities.Description: You may move up to your speed and you ignore difficult terrain penalties for this movement. Until the start of your next turn, all terrain within 20ft of you is not considered difficult terrain for your allies.

All Abilities.Name: Penetrating Shot
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. This attack penetrates through thin layers of cover such as wood planks (GM’s decision), negating the bonus it would give.
All Abilities.Requirements: Sniper Rifles only.

All Abilities.Name: Pepper Spray
All Abilities.Description:
You reach into your pocket and pull out a handful of ground chili pepper that you throw in front of you in a 15ft cube. Inflicts all targets withPepper Spray, causing Blinded 4 and the inability to smell.  The target or an ally of the target within 5ft can spend 1 AP to wipe it off. Otherwise the effect ends at the end of the target’s next turn.

You may spend 1 RP and 1 additional mana instead of paying the AP cost.

All Abilities.Name: Perfect Mimicry
All Abilities.Benefits: When given enough preparation time and enough knowledge about the subject, you are able to perfectly impersonate another person (GM’s discretion on what is ‘enough’). When disguised in this way, other people are unable to see through your disguise through normal means unless you act or say things that are strange enough to draw suspicions. This disguise is partially magical in nature, but cannot make up for obvious size or shape differences.

All Abilities.Name: Perfect Seasoning
All Abilities.Description: Make a crafting check with a +3 Bonus.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be in a crafting session. Must have added a special ingredient (box of food, alloy materials) in your last action.

All Abilities.Name: Perfect Shot
All Abilities.Keywords: Full Pierce, Prone, Setup, Sure Hit
All Abilities.Description:
You line up the perfect shot, striking an enemy for double Heavy Damage with Sure Hit and Full Pierce.

Automatically fails if the target has cover when this ability finishes.

All Abilities.Name: Persistent Spell
All Abilities.Description: If the next Spell you cast applies a buff or debuff, the duration of this buff or debuff is extended by 1 turn. If the Spell allows for a save, the target may make another save after the original effect is over to resist the duration extension.

All Abilities.Name: Phantom Thief
All Abilities.Benefits: You are able to disable and modify t2 and t3 bounded fields.

All Abilities.Name: Phantoms of the Mist
All Abilities.Description:
You conjure several phantoms in the mist and make a Light attack against all creatures within your Mist of the Vale.

You may spend 1 Mana to exclude allies from this attack.
All Abilities.Requirements: Mist of the Vale must be active.

All Abilities.Name: Phoenix Tears
All Abilities.Description: At the end of combat you may use 1 Encounter Conclusion action to heal a single target other than yourself for Power and prevent one injury on them.

All Abilities.Name: Piercing Stab
All Abilities.Range: A target in melee weapon range and a target directly behind the first target in melee weapon range.
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target and the target directly behind it.
All Abilities.Requirements: Polearm only.

All Abilities.Name: Pillar of Earth
All Abilities.Description:
You create a 5x5, 20ft high pillar below someone. The target may spend 1 RP to step out of the way.

Each block of the pillar has HP equal to 20+Focus and the entire pillar collapses if one block is removed from it.

All Abilities.Name: Pinning Shot
All Abilities.Description: You make a Light attack against the target with your weapon. On damage, if there is a wall or similar object directly behind the target, they become pinned against it. A pinned target is considered Rooted until they spend 2 AP to remove the arrow pinning them.
All Abilities.Requirements: Bow or Crossbow only.

All Abilities.Name: Pistol Whip
All Abilities.Description:
You make a Light Attack with a pistol in your hand. On damage, the target becomes Unbalanced.

This attack benefits from alloys and material bonuses on your pistol (but not from any on your unarmed strike).
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be holding a pistol.

All Abilities.Name: Pixie Flight
All Abilities.Description: You gain controlled Flight and Hover up to your speed.  This ability ends at the start of your next turn unless you pay Upkeep 3 Mana, if you choose to not pay upkeep, you cannot use Pixie Flight until the start of your next turn.

All Abilities.Name: Place Trap
All Abilities.Description:
You choose to spend either 1 minute or 1 hour to place an undetermined trap in an area. You may only have 2 traps placed at a time in this way.When an enemy comes within 20ft of you, you may spend 0 RP to determine the effects of a trap and trigger it. If you spent 1 minute, you may choose a Simple Trap. If you spent 1 hour, you may choose either a Simple Trap or a Complex Trap.Log Swing (Simple):The target takes Light bludgeoning damage and is knocked back 20ft.Snare (Simple): You place up to 3 snare traps, each within 20ft of each other. When triggered, the target’s movement is interrupted and they fall prone.Net (Complex):The target is caught in a net and raised up into the air. It remains rooted there until the net is destroyed by dealing 15 damage, after which the target falls prone on the ground below it.Pitfall (Complex):The target falls down a 5x5, 20ft deep pit and takes falling damage as normal.

A used trap cannot be reused. Setting a trap consumes a Trapper's Trap.
All Abilities.Requirements: Sufficient time (see description)

All Abilities.Name: Plaguebringer
All Abilities.Description: When you damage an enemy with a melee attack while infected with a disease or suffering from poison, you inflict that disease or poison on the enemy. They can make a save against it as normal, if the original disease or poison allowed for it.

All Abilities.Name: Please Hold Still~
All Abilities.Description: You apply Illumination X to the target where X is your Focus. You cannot benefit from this Illumination yourself, but also cannot consume it.

All Abilities.Name: Plow the fields
All Abilities.Description: You strike the ground with magical power and make a Light attack against all enemies in a 15ft wide line up to range. The terrain within this range becomes difficult terrain until the start of your next turn.

All Abilities.Name: Plume-Treading Art
All Abilities.Description:
After you use Cloudstep, you treat air as regular walkable terrain until the end of your turn. At the end of your turn, if still standing on air and not Flying, you float back down to the ground without taking fall damage.

In addition, after each AP spent on the Move action or an ability that lets you move, you gain 1 Windflow up to a maximum of 6. Each stack of Windflow gives a +5 Windflow bonus to your movement speed. These stacks last until the end of the encounter or until you end your turn without having moved.

Cloudstep also always gives you 1 stack, up to your normal cap.

All Abilities.Name: Point Blank Shot
All Abilities.Description: You make a Heavy Attack against the target.
All Abilities.Requirements: Pistol only.

All Abilities.Name: Point of Death
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. This attack deals maximum damage instead of rolling for the damage.
All Abilities.Requirements: Target is below half HP of their original max HP (Before True Death reductions).

All Abilities.Name: Point of Death II
All Abilities.Description:
You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. This attack deals maximum damage instead of rolling for the damage.

On killing blow, refund the mana and AP cost spent on this ability.
All Abilities.Requirements: Target is below half HP of their original max HP (Before True Death reductions).

All Abilities.Name: Poison Spore
All Abilities.Range: Self or The Host of Poison Spore. 15ft x 15ft Area with the target at the center.
All Abilities.Description:
You may spend either 2 AP or 1 RP to use this ability.

You create an Area of Poison Spores around you or the Host of Spore Symbiote. Units who end their turn in the Poison Spore take Full Pierce Poison damage equal to your Power + 2. You and the host of Spore Symbiote are immune to your own Poison Spore. Poison Spore lasts until the end of the encounter but you can only have one instance of Poison Spore active at a time.

The spore stays centered around the original target, even if the target of this ability moves. If the original target of this ability was the symbiote target and you swap the symbiote target, the location of the poison spore moves with it.

All Abilities.Name: Position Rewind
All Abilities.Description: You teleport to where you were at the start of your last turn. (Use a token to mark the position)

All Abilities.Name: Power Jump
All Abilities.Description:
You jump up to 60ft vertically straight up into the air.  You can additionally move 5ft horizontally afterwards.  Unless flying, you automatically land straight down from your position at the end of your turn or for 0 AP, this falling movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity and you don’t take fall damage from it. If you land inside an occupied square, you are shunted 5ft into an empty square (your original one if possible).

You cannot make any non-teleport movement actions while in the air unless you’re flying, but can still take other actions (such as attacking) while airborne.

All Abilities.Name: Power Rock Strike
All Abilities.Description: Make a gathering check at only half of your gathering bonus (rounded down) add the rolled amount to both node and lucky points.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must in a gathering session.

All Abilities.Name: Power Strike
All Abilities.Description:
You make a Light (1 AP), Heavy (2 AP) or Precise (2 AP) attack against the enemy.

This attack does a minimum damage equal to your power if it hits.

All Abilities.Name: Power Word: Barrier
All Abilities.Description:
Up to 5 target allies within range (including yourself) gain temporary HP until the end of the encounter equal to 10 + Power.

You may pay either the AP or RP cost for this ability, you don't need to pay both.

All Abilities.Name: Power Word: Guardian Shield
All Abilities.Description:
The target gains temporary HP until the end of the encounter equal to 11 + 2 x Power. While this temporary HP lasts, on damage effects do not trigger on them unless the damage dealt does damage to their actual HP.

If this source of temporary HP is overwritten by a stronger source, this effect is lost.

All Abilities.Name: Power Word: Reinforce
All Abilities.Description:
The target gains temporary HP equal to 2 x their current temporary HP.

After the attack is done resolving, the target's temporary HP is set to the value it was before this ability was used unless the target's current temporary HP is lower than that.
All Abilities.Requirements: An ally is the target of an attack.

All Abilities.Name: Power Word: Shield
All Abilities.Description: The target gains temporary HP until the end of the encounter equal to 11 + (2 x Power).

All Abilities.Name: Precise Thrust
All Abilities.Description:
You may make a Heavy Attack against the target.

This attack does not disable the dueling weapon ability.

All Abilities.Name: Predict
All Abilities.Description: You may take the Dodge action and remove the Lock On effect from the triggering attack.
All Abilities.Requirements: You are the target of an attack.

All Abilities.Name: Prediction
All Abilities.Description: You remove the keyword Sure Hit and Lock On from the triggering attack and the target gains a +2 Dodge Bonus for their next Dodge action.
All Abilities.Requirements: An ally is the target of an attack.

All Abilities.Name: Prehensile Tail
All Abilities.Description: You may carry objects with your tail, allowing you to interact with objects as normal even when you have both hands full. The action you are performing must not require physical strength and you cannot wield weapons with your tail.

All Abilities.Name: Prepared Talisman
All Abilities.Description:
You may place a Talisman on a surface or on a target within range. This costs the same amount of AP and Mana as it would normally cost and placing it on an unwilling target requires an accuracy roll that the target may dodge as normal. A target may spend AP equal to the AP cost of the talisman (before reductions) to remove the talisman from themselves.

After placing it, until the end of the encounter or for the next 5 minutes, you may spend 0 RP to instantly trigger the effect of the talisman. You cannot trigger it anymore once a talisman has been removed or is in the process of being removed and a removed talisman loses its power entirely. A talisman placed on a creature gains Sure Hit against the creature it's on when triggered.

You can only have 1 talisman prepared in this way at the same time and Sealing Talisman cannot be prepared like this. A placed talisman cannot have an AP cost of greater than 4 (or 10 seconds for casting times).
All Abilities.Requirements: Special

All Abilities.Name: Preparedness
All Abilities.Description: Up to 3 talismans, scrolls or similar objects you carry do not count towards your burden.

All Abilities.Name: Presence Concealment
All Abilities.Description: By suppressing your mana output you conceal your presence, gaining Presence Concealment.  You cannot use any abilites that cost mana or any abilities with the aura keyword while in Presence Concealment.  You can end this effect for 0 RP but the inability to use abilities that cost mana or abilities with the aura keyword persists until the end of your next turn.

All Abilities.Name: Presence of Mind
All Abilities.Description: You reduce the AP cost of your next Spell this turn by 2 AP.

All Abilities.Name: Prone Cover
All Abilities.Description: You become Prone. While Prone from this ability, you gain the benefits of low cover against ranged attacks. In addition, all Ranged Weapon Attacks gain the Prone keyword.
All Abilities.Requirements: Cannot be used while Flying.

All Abilities.Name: Provide Milk
All Abilities.Description: You may spend an EP to produce 400u worth of milk.

All Abilities.Name: Provoke
All Abilities.Description: You Challenge an enemy until the start of your next turn.

All Abilities.Name: Provoke II
All Abilities.Description: You Challenge the enemy until the end of the encounter. You may only have 1 target Challenged at the same time through this ability.

All Abilities.Name: Psychometry
All Abilities.Description: By touching the door to a room you gain information as to the physical layout of the room and objects within it as if you were able to see inside of the room.  By reading the Auras of all creatures within the room, you can also get a general idea of any creatures within, which you see as blobs of light—brighter for more powerful auras.  You can also use this effect on containers as well to get a general idea of the layout within containers like backpacks, and chests.  This ability can be used at unlimited range as long as a creature under the effect of Mind Connection touches the door or container.

All Abilities.Name: Pull the weeds
All Abilities.Description: You destroy one of your planted seeds to give yourself +5 crafting points for this session.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be in a crafting session. Only applies to a farming crafting session.

All Abilities.Name: Puppet Grandmaster
All Abilities.Benefits: You can summon puppets under your control using Summon Piece. While these puppets follow movement rules as described in the abilities and are always Medium size, they can appear as whatever you wish, decided when you take this class., As an EP action, you may change the appearance of your pieces.

All Abilities.Name: Purification Circle
All Abilities.Description: You remove all stacks of single debuff from all allies in a 20ft radius circle from target point.

All Abilities.Name: Purify
All Abilities.Description: You cleanse a target, removing all stacks of a negative effect of your choice that you are able to identify.

All Abilities.Name: Purifying Shields
All Abilities.Description: You remove all stacks of a debuff from every ally within range that has temporary HP.

All Abilities.Name: Quick Artifice Reload
All Abilities.Description: You quickly reload one shell into an artifice in range using one of your shells.

All Abilities.Name: Quick Assist
All Abilities.Description:
You teleport next to your soulmate and force the triggering attack to resolve against you, gaining the benefit of the Block action against it.

Afterwards, if your Soulmate is in range of the attacker, they may make an Attack of Opportunity against it.

If you were already next to your Soulmate before you used this ability, the mana cost is reduced by 1.
All Abilities.Requirements: Your soulmate is the target of an attack.

All Abilities.Name: Quick Getaway
All Abilities.Description: You may move as if you had spent 2 AP on the movement action.Combo:If used after Feint or the Disengage action, the AP cost of this is reduced by 2.

All Abilities.Name: Quick Revive
All Abilities.Description: You immediately resummon the summon from your Summon Animal that was killed in this current encounter. If multiple of your summons have died, you summon the one that died most recently.

All Abilities.Name: Quickdraw
All Abilities.Description: You may draw a pistol and make a Light Attack with the drawn pistol against the target. The target may not react to this shot.
All Abilities.Requirements: Pistol only.

All Abilities.Name: Quickdraw Alchemy
All Abilities.Description: You draw an Alchemy item from your combat inventory.

All Abilities.Name: Radiant Halo
All Abilities.Description:
You Heal all allied targets in a 15ft radius from the target point for 11 + (2 x Power).

You may use 1 RP instead of 2 AP for this ability. When using RP on this ability, you may use it even when it is not your turn.

All Abilities.Name: Rage Stance
All Abilities.Description: You enter a Stance in which you prioritize offense over defense. The Stance lasts until the encounter ends, you get Downed or up to an hour.
