While the Stance lasts, gain 2 additional AP that can only be used on melee attacks each turn (including the turn you use this), but cannot use actions that use RP other than attack of opportunity unless they have the Rage keyword. You also cannot use abilities with the Spell keyword, unless they also have the Rage keyword. You are treated as having 0 RP for abilities with that as a requirement. While in your Rage Stance, you gain a +1 bonus to Guard and a +5 bonus to all Fitness checks.

All Abilities.Name: Raise Undead
All Abilities.Description:
You raise the target corpse as a basic undead, such as a zombie. This zombie is treated as a non-heroic unit that you can command directly. You can have multiple zombies under your command, up to your Necromancer level + 1. However, the zombies act as a group under the same token rather than having an individual token. The group acts on your Initiative.

Each zombie has a single point of HP and immediately dies, but you only lose 1 zombie per attack the group takes, including AoE attacks that do not deal Holy Damage. AoE attacks that deal Holy damage remove a number of zombies equal to the damage taken. The zombie group has a focus and power of 3 + 1 for every 3 zombies, rounded down. They have an Agility of 2 and Toughness equal to 4. They have access to all basic actions, but otherwise have no special abilities. As a non-heroic entity, they only have access to a single RP. Because they are undead, they are immune to all mind-affecting effects.

A raised undead lasts until the end of the arc or until killed, after which the corpse cannot be raised again in any way.
All Abilities.Requirements: Target must be a dead humanoid.

All Abilities.Name: Ranger's Journey
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain proficiency in light and medium armor, a common ranged weapon group and a common melee weapon group., You gain 5 points in one of the following: Appraise, Athletics, Stealth, Medicine, Perception, Survival, Animal Husbandry or Common Knowledge. You can exchange any skill point for 2 expertise points, but must spend them in these skills., You can use Status Assessment.

All Abilities.Name: Rapid Blasts
All Abilities.Benefits: You may use Ki Blast II.

All Abilities.Name: Rapid Correction
All Abilities.Description: You turn your Light attack into a Precise attack.
All Abilities.Requirements: You miss with a ranged weapon Light attack.

All Abilities.Name: Rappelling Dagger
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Light Attack against the target. On damage, you may move to the closest available spot within 5ft of the target. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity. Can be used against non-living objects and the on damage part always applies when used in that way.
All Abilities.Requirements: Throwing Weapon or Thrown attack only.

All Abilities.Name: Receive Oracle
All Abilities.Description: You seek divine knowledge on a topic and can ask up to three yes or no questions.  You then receive a vision on the answers from an unknown entity.  The DM chooses the information you receive.  You regain the use of Receive Oracle after a rest.

All Abilities.Name: Reckless Strike
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target.

All Abilities.Name: Recover Power
All Abilities.Benefits: Any temporary HP on you at the end of an encounter is converted into healing. You regain HP equal to half the value of temporary HP you have remaining.

All Abilities.Name: Redirected Force
All Abilities.Description:
You redirect the incoming attack back onto the attacker, using the same attack roll. The attacker may react to this attack as normal.

Can not be used against the same attack used to enter the Serene Water stance.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be in Serene Water stance and after a melee attack against you missed.

All Abilities.Name: Redistribute
All Abilities.Description:
You may transfer temporary HP from a single willing ally within range to any number of other allies within range. The total amount of temporary HP must be the same after the transfer.

May only redistribute temporary HP you applied through the use of a Shieldwarden or Veilguard ability. Does not affect temporary HP added through Reinforce.

All Abilities.Name: Refreshing Stream
All Abilities.Description: You cast this ability on water within range, recovering fatigue and granting a target within 15ft of that point 1 RP.  The target cannot go over their max RP from this.

All Abilities.Name: Regrowing Limbs
All Abilities.Description: You regrow a lost limb, restoring it to full use.
All Abilities.Requirements: Costs 1 Interlude Point

All Abilities.Name: Reinforce Armor
All Abilities.Description:
Until the start of your next turn, the guard and block value gained from an armor and shield you crafted and are wearing is doubled.

Does not affect armor plates.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be wearing armor or a shield you crafted.

All Abilities.Name: Repair Armor
All Abilities.Description: Errand. You repair a broken armor.

All Abilities.Name: Repair Artifice
All Abilities.Description: Errand. You repair a broken artifice.

All Abilities.Name: Repair Weapon
All Abilities.Description: Errand. You repair a broken smithing weapon.

All Abilities.Name: Repair Wood Weapon
All Abilities.Description: Errand. You repair a broken carpentry weapon.

All Abilities.Name: Rescue
All Abilities.Description: You Teleport a willing ally within range to an empty square next to you. If the target is mounted, you may also teleport their mount together with the target.

All Abilities.Name: Rescue & Drop
All Abilities.Description:
You pick up a willing ally and put them on your mount. They travel with you on the back of your mount until either you or they spend 0 AP or 1 RP to place them back on the ground. An ally that is being rescued can not take any other actions until they are dropped.

Only 1 ally can be rescued at a time.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be mounted.

All Abilities.Name: Resheathe
All Abilities.Description: You regain the Iai state. In addition, your next Iai strike this encounter gains Full Pierce.
All Abilities.Requirements: Not in Iai state.

All Abilities.Name: Revealing Light
All Abilities.Description: You clap your hands and send out a pulse of solar light in a 40ft radius around you. All creatures within that range are immediately revealed, canceling any stealth, invisibility or similar technique to hide themselves. They glow brightly until the start of your next turn, giving them a -20 penalty to stealth checks.

All Abilities.Name: Reverse Polarity
All Abilities.Description: You invert the roll result. (1 becomes 10, 2 becomes 9 etc)
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be in a crafting session.

All Abilities.Name: Ricochet
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Light (1 AP) or Heavy (2 AP) Attack against the target. The target does not benefit from Light Cover against this attack.
All Abilities.Requirements: Pistol only.

All Abilities.Name: Rider & Mount As One
All Abilities.Description: While you are mounted and not flying you and your mount are considered the same entity for the purposes of what can target you. This means that while you are mounted, your mount cannot be targeted by anything (including allied effects) unless the effect specifically says it does. Any debuff or buff on you also affects your mount's movement and speed as if it was placed on the mount.

All Abilities.Name: Riposte
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target that you used your Parry ability against.
All Abilities.Requirements: May only be used after you use the Parry fencer ability and you regained the RP.

All Abilities.Name: Riposte II
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target that you used your Parry ability against.
All Abilities.Requirements: May only be used after you use the Parry fencer ability and you regained the RP.

All Abilities.Name: Rock and Stone
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain proficiency in 1 armor or in the shield. You also gain proficiency in the Pickaxe specialty weapon., You gain the ability to gather mining outcrops., You gain the ability to create Ingots as an Errand.  See item: Blacksmithing Materials

All Abilities.Name: Rock Fang
All Abilities.Description: Make a heavy attack against the target. On damage the target is affected byArmor Sunder 2, reducing their guard by 2 until the start of your next turn. This attack also immediately benefits from the Sunder effect.
All Abilities.Requirements: Pickaxe only

All Abilities.Name: Rogue's Journey
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain proficiency with light armor and with a group of One-Handed weapons. This list currently is: Small weapons, Light swords, Dueling weapons and Set of missiles., You gain +5 skill points in Roguecraft and +5 skill points to spend in Athletics, Stealth, Deception, Perception, Insight, Negotiation, Intimidation or a relevant Expert Knowledge skill (By DM Approval).  You can exchange any skill point for 2 expertise points, but must spend them in these skills., You can use Feint.

All Abilities.Name: Rolling Thunder
All Abilities.Benefits: After moving at least 40ft in a turn, your next unarmed strike that turn gains a +2 Transcendent Lightning bonus to accuracy and damage.

All Abilities.Name: Ruminant Metabolism
All Abilities.Description: You can go a day without eating before starvation applies.

All Abilities.Name: Running Shot
All Abilities.Description: You make a Heavy attack against the target.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be mounted and taking a movement action.

All Abilities.Name: Rushing Knee Drop
All Abilities.Description: You may spend either 1 AP or 1 RP to leap up to 15 ft and crush a prone enemy within 5ft with a knee attack, dealing Light Damage. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
All Abilities.Requirements: An enemy is prone in range.

All Abilities.Name: Ryujin's Mastery
All Abilities.Description: You gain one of Elemental Mastery of your choice from the following options: Fire, Water, Ice, Wind, Lightning, or Earth.

All Abilities.Name: Sable Grace
All Abilities.Description: You take the Dodge action against the triggering attack. You remove Lock-On from this attack and treat your Dodge as 99 against it.
All Abilities.Requirements: You become the target of an attack. Can only be used during the night.

All Abilities.Name: Saboteur
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain proficiency in Saboteur Thread Daggers., You may use Presence Concealment.

All Abilities.Name: Sacrament
All Abilities.Description: You touch one willing ally’s or your own weapon and bless it. Until the end of the encounter, the weapon deals Holy Damage and grants a +1 Power Enchantment.

All Abilities.Name: Sanctity Aura
All Abilities.Description:
You project an aura 30ft around you that blesses your allies.

When an ally makes an attack as part of one of your Gun Paladin abilities, they may choose to make the damage type of that attack the same as your Holy Weapon damage type.

All Abilities.Name: Sapping Ward
All Abilities.Description: A ward that can be placed on a normal-sized room or can be combined to ward off a house or larger area. Each ward can cover a 20ft radius and for each Sapping Ward placed in the same area as another Sapping Ward, this radius increases by 20ft (For example, 60ft with 3 Sapping Wards) If someone other than you enters the area, they must make a save against your Potency or become Weakened. Non-heroic units that enter the area must make a save or become Stunned instead. These conditions last while they remain inside the field and for an additional 2 rounds after exiting it. Casting this takes 10 minutes of uninterrupted casting. Once triggered, the field remains active for 5 more minutes before vanishing. You may at the time of casting choose a number of people equal to your Focus that can enter the area without triggering the ward. If not triggered, Sapping Ward lasts until you remove it. While it remains, your maximum mana is reduced by 2 for each instance of Sapping Ward you have active. This is considered a tier 2 ward.

All Abilities.Name: Saprophytic Bolt
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Light Attack against the target, dealing Earth damage. On damage, the current host of Spore Symbiote is Healed for your Power + 3.

All Abilities.Name: Scarecrow's Gaze
All Abilities.Description: You summon the appearance of whatever someone fears the most. Every enemy within range must make a Save against your potency. On failure, they may not walk closer to you until the start of your next turn unless they have no valid targets to attack without doing so.

All Abilities.Name: Scent
All Abilities.Description: You gain a +5 Expertise bonus to Perception (Smell).

All Abilities.Name: Scent of Blood
All Abilities.Description: You sniff the air and become aware of all targets within range that have below half of their maximum HP. This doesnotreveal their HP percentage.

All Abilities.Name: Schadenfreude
All Abilities.Description: You redirect an attack to another ally in range of the triggering attack. If they don't react to this, your next Malevolent  Phantasm ignores the requirement and costs no mana.
All Abilities.Requirements: You are targeted by an attack.

All Abilities.Name: Scholar of Tactics
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain proficiency in Pistols., You may use Take Cover!.

All Abilities.Name: Scorching Reprisal
All Abilities.Description: You make a Heavy attack of opportunity against the target. Your next basic attack of opportunity against that target costs 0 RP.
All Abilities.Requirements: An enemy provokes an attack of opportunity.

All Abilities.Name: Scouting Ahead
All Abilities.Description: When traveling stealthily across the map, you can choose to move slightly ahead of the party when moving. If you do, you treat your roll as the lowest roll of the party.

All Abilities.Name: Scout's Retreat
All Abilities.Description: You disengage and may move up to two times your speed away from enemies towards the closest escape point.
All Abilities.Requirements: No known allies within 300ft of you

All Abilities.Name: Scry
All Abilities.Description:
You designate a point that you can see within range, creating a magical ward at that point.  If you focus you can shift your perception to that ward and see and hear everything within line of the sight of that ward in a 30ft radius.  The ward can persist as long as you want over any distance, but you can only have one instance of Scry active at a time.

The ward is invisible and inaudible, but can be detected through magical means.

All Abilities.Name: Scurry Away
All Abilities.Description: After using the Disengage or Feint action, your movement speed increases by 10ft until the end of your turn.

All Abilities.Name: Seal Cloak
All Abilities.Description: You manifest and don a seal cloak that has been with you since you were born, transforming you into your Seal Form.  While in seal form you gain a swim speed of 80 feet but you can only take basic actions while in Seal Form and you are proficient in melee attacking without weapons in seal form.  While in Seal Form, you can hold your breath underwater for up to 2 hours and your land speed is reduced to 5.  You can remove the cloak for 0 AP.

All Abilities.Name: Sealing Talisman
All Abilities.Description: You attach a Sealing Talisman to the target. Non-heroics become Stunned immediately, while heroic targets must spend 2 AP to remove it from themselves. If they do not remove it by the end of their turn, they become Stunned. While the talisman remains attached, the target is stunned. Anyone within touching distance of the talisman may spend 2 AP to remove the talisman, immediately removing the stun effect. If the talisman is not removed, it lasts until the end of encounter or until the target takes damage. A person can only be affected by 1 Sealing Talisman at a time.
All Abilities.Requirements: The target has 0 RP. Must have a Sealing Talisman in hand.

All Abilities.Name: Second Tremor
All Abilities.Description: The enemy falls prone and takes Light damage.
All Abilities.Requirements: An enemy stands up from prone or takes falling damage without falling prone.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: 7 Points of Death
All Abilities.Description: You make a number of Precise Attacks up to the amount of Marks of Death on the target. Each attack deals damage equal to your Focus + Power instead of rolling for damage.
All Abilities.Requirements: Target is below half HP and has at least 1 Mark of Death.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Absolute Compression
All Abilities.Keywords: Spell, Gravity, Full Pierce, Trick Attack
All Abilities.Description: You make an attack against the target that deals Double Heavy Physical(Crushing) damage.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: All of Creation
All Abilities.Description: Change the damage type of the target attack into any damage type except True.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Ambush Shot
All Abilities.Keywords: Secret Art, Sure Hit, Full Pierce
All Abilities.Description: You make a Heavy attack that does maximum damage instead of rolling. This attack does not break your stealth.
All Abilities.Requirements: Enemy must be unaware of your presence. Can only be used on the first turn of an encounter and must be your first attack.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Assassinate
All Abilities.Keywords: Full Pierce, Secret Art, Sure Hit
All Abilities.Description:
You attack the target for Heavy Damage.

If you surprised the enemy, are currently stealthed and have not been spotted by an enemy this entire encounter, this attack deals double heavy damage. You may move next to an enemy and still qualify as being stealthed and not spotted, provided you use this ability immediately after that movement ends.
All Abilities.Requirements: Target must be marked by Death Mark. One-handed weapons only.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Beaver Timber Fang
All Abilities.Description: Make a normal heavy attack against the target. Afterwards make a light attack against the target with Sure Hit that immediately renders the target prone, even if the damage is reduced to 0.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Bestial Wrath
All Abilities.Description: Your summon gains Bestial Wrath and AP equal to its maximum AP they may immediately use. Bestial Wrath gives +2 Focus and +2 Power and prevents the summon from dropping below 1 HP. This effect lasts for 3 rounds or until the summon is reduced to 1 HP.
All Abilities.Requirements: Can only target your summoned animal.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Black Hole
All Abilities.Description:
You create a Black Hole at a target location within range. When you cast this and when you pay upkeep, all enemies within 120ft of the black hole must make a save or get pulled 20ft towards it.

All enemies within 120ft of the black hole that are moving away from it are considered slowed for that movement.

Upkeep: 1 Mana. Instead of paying upkeep, you may detonate the Black Hole making a Heavy attack against all enemies within 15ft of the black hole.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Bladestorm
All Abilities.Description:
You enter a stance in which you continuously spin your weapon around your body. When activating this ability, you may make a Heavy attack against all enemies within your melee weapon range. While the stance lasts you may make a Heavy attack against all enemies within your melee weapon range at the start of your turn.

You can move while in this stance. If you move close enough to an enemy for them to be within your melee weapon range, you may make a Heavy attack against them.

You can only attack a creature once per round through this ability, regardless of how many times you move closer to them.

Upkeep: 2 Mana, 1 AP
All Abilities.Requirements: Two-handed weapons only. Slashing weapons only.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Bloody Ritual
All Abilities.Keywords: Secret Art, Slow, Blanketing, Sure Hit
All Abilities.Description:
You create a blood tether to all enemies within range, causing them to be Slowed. The tether lasts until the start of your next turn or until they move out of the range of this ability.

At the start of your next turn, the tethers explode, dealing Heavy damage to all tethered enemies as it sucks the life energy from them. For every enemy dealt damage with this ability, you recover 1 Mana or 5 HP (your choice). If an enemy dies while under the effect of the tether but before it explodes, you also gain this regeneration effect.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Chase the Horizon
All Abilities.Description:
You focus on a single enemy and maintain a constant position from them. Whenever the target moves, you may move the same amount as they did (up to your movement speed) away from them for 0 RP. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity from the target, but does provoke from other enemies.

Every time this happens, you may make a Light attack against the target with a ranged weapon. If the target spends multiple AP on a single movement action, you may make an amount of Light attacks equal to the AP they spent.

Lasts until the start of your next turn or until you can no longer see the target.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be mounted.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Checkmate
All Abilities.Description: You may move all your pieces as if you used Move Piece on them.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Divine Judgement
All Abilities.Keywords: Secret Art, Sure Hit, Full Pierce
All Abilities.Description:
You make a Heavy attack that deals Holy damage against the target. If your target’s HP is lower than the max damage your attack would deal, this attack gains Full Pierce and does maximum damage instead of rolling.

This calculation only involves your base damage (Base weapon damage + the power). Any other effects added to the damage such as Heavy Blade's bonus damage, Anathema on target etc do not affect the calculation and aren't maximized.

An enemy reduced to 0 HP or lower with this ability is immediately killed.
All Abilities.Requirements: Target has your Mark of Justice on them.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Divine Shield
All Abilities.Description:
Until the start of your next turn, you gain Damage Reduction 1000 against all damage types, but you only deal half damage.

You gain 2 AP.

Must be used as the first action in your turn.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Double Accel
All Abilities.Description: You gain 4 AP. Your AP recovery is lowered by 3 until the end of your next turn.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Dragonslaying Jump
All Abilities.Keywords: Full Pierce, Jump, Overcharge, Secret Art, Sure Hit
All Abilities.Description: You Jump up to the target, not provoking any attacks of opportunity, and make a Heavy Attack against it. On damage, the target plummets to the ground taking falling damage as normal.Overcharge:You may spend additional AP on this ability to increase the range by 60ft for every extra AP spent. If this increases the AP cost to more than what you currently have, it gains the Setup keyword.
All Abilities.Requirements: Target must be airborne, polearm only.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Dynamic Duo
All Abilities.Description: You challenge all enemies in range until the start of your next turn. Any time you would be allowed to make an Attack of Opportunity, your Soulmate may make it instead. They may Sidestep up to their speed before making each Attack of Opportunity.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Earthquake
All Abilities.Description:
You make a Light attack that deals Earth damage against all enemies in range that are touching the ground. On damage, they fall prone.

You also make a Light attack that deals Earth damage against all magically created walls and similar inanimate objects created by magic. You deal 10x damage against those targets.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Efficient Spirit Control
All Abilities.Description:
You reduce the cost of your next non-healing keyword action by 2 mana. This cannot reduce the mana cost below 0.

Also resets your Circuits, allowing abilities with the Circuit keyword to be used for their reduced mana cost once more.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Endless Waltz
All Abilities.Description:
You make two Light Attacks against the same target. On damage of this attack, you may repeat this attack for 0 AP.

Killing Blow:You may move up to twice your speed without provoking attacks of opportunity.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Entropic Magic Pulse
All Abilities.Description:
You send out a wave of energy that disrupts spirit circuits that cancels all temporary magic effects in range. All non-permanent effects within range that are created by an ability with the Spell or Enchantment keyword are affected. Spells that do not have a time limit listed or create a permanent effect such as a Geomancer's fissure are not affected.

Bounded Fields and Secret Arts cannot be removed by this ability.

In addition, artifices cannot be used by anyone except you until the end of your next turn.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Everything, Everywhere, All At Once
All Abilities.Description:
You make a Heavy Attack against the enemy.

You may then repeat this attack from each of your past selves and may target the same enemy multiple times.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Fan the hammer
All Abilities.Description:
You may make 4 Heavy Attacks against the target. Afterwards, the weapon used for this ability cannot be used again until the end of the encounter.

If an enemy reacts to this ability with a Dodge or Block type reaction, that reaction is valid for all 4 attacks.
All Abilities.Requirements: Pistol only

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Gae Bolg
All Abilities.Description:
Make a Heavy attack against the target. Unless your accuracy roll is a 1, your roll is treated as if you rolled a 20 and it gains Sure Hit.

It is treated as a critical hit even though it's Sure Hit, unless the target blocks.
All Abilities.Requirements: Polearm only.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Galaxy Stop
All Abilities.Description: You create a space-time anomaly that freezes time itself in a local area for a short while, affecting all but the strong-willed.  All non-heroic units in range cannot take any actions until the end of their next turn.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Gate of Fate
All Abilities.Description: You subvert fate and a bad end, twisting reality into its most fortunate outcome.  When a target ally rolls a 1, you can instead change it to a 20.
All Abilities.Requirements: An ally rolls a 1.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Guiding Shot
All Abilities.Description:
You may make a Heavy attack against the target. The target may spend 1 RP to avoid the attack. If they do, you may Sidestep them up to 20ft in a direction of your choice and then trigger a Place Trap effect, provided you have at least one set up.

This trap effect does not count towards your per encounter limitation. You may not Sidestep an enemy into a hazard (such as off a cliff or into fire) apart from your trap, unless the target has nowhere else to go.

Alternatively, you may choose to move an enemy into a Bear Trap you set up within the 20ft movement instead of a Place Trap effect. You can only choose one of these two options, not both.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Jade Skin
All Abilities.Description: You take the Block action against the triggering attack. If you reduce the damage to 0, the attacker becomes Disarmed until the start of their next turn.
All Abilities.Requirements: You are attacked by a Melee attack.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Life Bet
All Abilities.Description:
You reduce your HP to 1 and make a Heavy attack against the target. You gain a bonus to the damage roll of this attack equal to the amount of HP you lost through this ability.

If this attack fails to meet the base evasion of the target, the HP you lost is refunded. It still counts as your one secret art use of the fight regardless.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Life Sacrifice
All Abilities.Description:
You lose HP until your HP reaches 1. Target ally within range recovers that much HP. Any HP that exceeds the target’s max HP becomes temporary HP.

This HP loss cannot be mitigated in any way and ignores temporary HP. This does not trigger effects that would trigger upon taking damage.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Lifesaver
All Abilities.Description: The target gains temporary HP until the end of the encounter equal to their missing HP.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Lightning Field
All Abilities.Description:
You conjure a statically charged field around you, applying Static X where X equals your Focus x 3 to all enemies within 30ft of you. Enemies already afflicted by Static immediately take damage equal to 3 + half the static value. While within your Lightning Field, the Static on enemies is not removed at the end of their turn.

This field lasts until the end of your next turn.

Upkeep:You may pay 1 Mana at the start of your turn to repeat the initial effect and extend the duration of the field by 1 turn.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Lightning Release
All Abilities.Description:
You infuse yourself with Lightning and gainLightning Releaseuntil the end of the encounter, allowing you to deal Lightning damage with your unarmed attacks and immediately enter the Heavenly Lightning Stance. While this lasts, you also gain the following benefits:

If you ever leave the Lightning Stance, you lose the benefit of this.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Meteor
All Abilities.Keywords: Fire, Overcharge, Spell, Sure Hit, Secret Art, Blanketing
All Abilities.Description: You mark a 30x30ft area and begin summoning a meteor to strike it at the start of your next turn. Those in the area when it lands take Heavy Fire Damage. You cannot use the Prepare action on this ability. Overcharge: You may spend extra AP on this ability to increase the damage and size of it. For every extra 2 AP spent on it, the size increases by 5ft and the damage increases by your Power. If the Overcharge increases the AP cost to above 4, this ability gains the Setup keyword. You mark the area of this ability when you have finished spending all AP on it and not before. The maximum AP you can spend on this ability is 16 AP.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Moving Castle
All Abilities.Description:
You project a defensive aura up to 15ft around you, granting all allies (excluding yourself) theBulwarkbuff. While under the effects of Bulwark, allies take 3 less damage.

While projecting this aura, you may spend 0 RP to sidestep up to your movement. After you do so, you may not do so again until the start of your next turn.

Upkeep: You must spend 1 mana at the start of your turn to continue this effect.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Mushroomize
All Abilities.Description: You fill your target with mycelium from your spore symbiote, allowing them to act fully despite being Downed. Removing Spore Symbiote from the target cancels this effect. This effect ends at the start of your next turn unless you spend 1 mana to continue the effect.  When paying upkeep, if the target is below 0 HP, heal the target for your power + 3.This effect ends if the target’s HP is reduced to negative their maximum HP amount.You can use 1 RP instead of 2 AP to use this ability.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be used on your Spore Symbiote target that is in the Downed state.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Mythical Awakening
All Abilities.Description:
You channel your power into your mount, allowing it to unleash a devastating attack based on what type of mount it is.

Pegasus: Bellerophon: You Sidestep towards a target within 60ft and make a Heavy attack against it. This attack has Lock-on and costs 1 RP and 2 Mana

Wyvern: Reginliev: You make a Heavy attack against all enemies in a 5ft wide line up to a point within 60ft. You also make a Heavy attack against all enemies within 10ft of the selected point, though enemies can also take an attack from this ability once. This attack costs 2 AP and 2 Mana.

Dragonfly: Darting Mirage: You move at incredible speed and create several illusionary afterimages in your wake. Until the start of your next turn, every attack against you or your mount that is not a critical hit or does not have the Sure Hit keyword  automatically misses. This is an Illusion effect. This ability costs 0 AP and 4 Mana.

All these attacks are made with your mount’s stats instead of your own.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be mounted on a mount mentioned in the description.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Nightcaller
All Abilities.Description: Until the end of the encounter, it is considered night for all your abilities and items that are affected by it.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Overcharge
All Abilities.Description: Reduces the mana cost of your next Spell cast this turn by 3. You cannot gain mana from this.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Override
All Abilities.Keywords: Secret Art, Sure Hit, Pass, Blanketing
All Abilities.Description: You make a Heavy attack against all enemies in a line and move through them. You keep moving through enemies until you reach an empty spot you can stand in. If there is no valid end position due to an ally occupying the spot or terrain (such as a wall) being in the way, you cannot use this ability.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be mounted.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Perfect Repetition
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. On damage, on the next turn, you may repeat this attack against the same target using the same accuracy check as the initial attack. You may continue to repeat this attack on subsequent turns until you spend a turn not using this move or if the attack fails to deal damage.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Pyroblast
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target that deals double Heavy Fire Damage. This attack gains Lock On against a target that has the Burning condition that you inflicted on it.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Razor Hurricane
All Abilities.Keywords: Concentration, Full Pierce, Secret Art, Spell, Wind, Scatter
All Abilities.Description: You create a rapid spinning hurricane with a 15x15 size and 50ft in height in the target location. All creatures caught in the hurricane immediately take Wind Light Damage and are pushed out of the Hurricane. Every creature that enters the hurricane immediately takes Wind Light Damage and must succeed at a save against your Potency or be pushed back 20ft. Leaving the hurricane does no damage and requires no save.Upkeep:You must spend 1 Mana and 2 AP at the start of each turn or the spell ends. When you pay this Upkeep, you may move the hurricane up to 20ft. Any creature that comes into contact with the hurricane during this move takes damage and must make a save as if they had entered it.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art:  Revitalize
All Abilities.Description:
You pray for a Downed ally. The ally’s HP becomes 0 and then heals for your Power x 3. They may stand up from prone after this healing.

Overcharge:You may pay X extra mana to make the target heal + 7 HP for every additional point of mana spent.

This ability does not work on Mortally Wounded allies.
All Abilities.Requirements: Ally is downed.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Rewind
All Abilities.Description: You rewind time to before your last action. All results based on your last action are reversed- All HP, Mana, AP and RP are returned to how they were. The ability you used in that action is no longer considered used, but this ability is.
All Abilities.Requirements: Can only be used on your turn.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Ride of the Valkyrie
All Abilities.Description:
You Sidestep up to your speed and can move through enemies for this movement. You and every ally you pass through are healed for 11 + (Power x 2).

This movement must always be in a straight line, regardless of your mount type.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be mounted.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Seventeen Dissection
All Abilities.Keywords: Full Pierce, Secret Art, Sure Hit
All Abilities.Description: You deal 17 true damage to the target. If this damage lowers the target’s HP to 0 or lower, they immediately die.If the target of this attack is a non-heroic unit, they instantly die regardless of their remaining HP.
All Abilities.Requirements: Slashing weapons only.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Shatter
All Abilities.Description: You make a Heavy Attack against the target using a Blacksmith’s Hammer. If the target chooses to Block the attack, they gain 100 damage reduction against it. If they do, choose one equipped non-divine arms weapon in their hand that has equal or less crafted enhancements than your hammer and destroy that item, giving it the Broken condition.
All Abilities.Requirements: Attack must be made with a Blacksmith's Hammer.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Shield Wall
All Abilities.Description: You and your allies in range gainShield Wall, which reduces the damage they take from the triggering attack by 75.
All Abilities.Requirements: Usable when you are the target of an ability that affects an area, using a shield.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Shock & Awe
All Abilities.Description:
You and up to 3 other allies within range gain 3 AP they must spend immediately. On their next turn, they regain 1 less AP.

These AP may not be spent on Setup abilities and normal once per turn ability limitations apply.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Spectrum Blade
All Abilities.Description:
Until the end of the encounter, you enchant your weapon with every single element. When using Elemental Strike or Elemental Sweep, you may choose which effect you want regardless of the damage type your attack deals. When you deal damage, you apply the damage type that would deal the most damage.

In addition, your weapon gains a +1 Power bonus until the end of the encounter. If it already had a +1 Power bonus through an enchantment, this bonus is instead increased to +2.

If you are not holding the enchanted weapon at the start of your turn, your weapon loses this benefit.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Spirit Stigma
All Abilities.Description: You stigmatize the targets spirit, they are inflicted with Spirit Stigma until the start of your next turn. A target with Spirit Stigma counts as a willing ally for your Eremancer abilities and damaging them fulfills the Malevolent  Phantasm requirement.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Summon Eidolon
All Abilities.Description:
Your contracted Eidolon hears your call and sends a proxy of themselves to fight for you.  The Eidolon called and the costs are dependent on your attunement.  Lasts up to 5 minutes.  You must pay the upkeep cost under the Eidolon’sSummonSkill or the Eidolon vanishes.

Unless the summon has a skill that says otherwise, a summon acts after you on initiative, but cannot act the round it is summoned, except for RP actions.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: The Grand Theater
All Abilities.Description:
All allies within range may sidestep up to their movement speed.

You may Sidestep all enemies within range up to their movement speed.

After all targets have moved, everyone that was originally in range of this ability immediately gains 2 AP they must spend on attacks against other creatures if possible.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Titan Blade
All Abilities.Keywords: Sure Hit, Full Pierce, Secret Art, Scatter
All Abilities.Description:
You greatly increase the size and weight of your weapons, then slam them down in a direction. You make a melee Heavy attack against all enemies in a 15ft wide line up to the range. On damage, a target is knocked prone.

After the initial hit, a shockwave follows. You make another Heavy attack against any enemy still in the original line’s range. This second attack has the Sure Hit and Full Pierce qualities against a prone target.
All Abilities.Requirements: Two-Handed melee weapons only.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Transmute Proto Armatae
All Abilities.Description:
You touch the ground, transmuting a Proto Armatae of your own design.  The Proto Armatae lifts you up and immediately encases you into its cockpit.   The Proto Armatae is 15ft tall and is a large creature that occupies a 15ftx15ft space.  All creatures and moveable objects surrounding the Proto Armatae are pushed back away from its zone of control in a burst of steam.  The Armatae also gains a temporary shield with 20 HP that disappears at the start of your next turn.

You must use your own actions to cause the Proto Armatae to move and attack.  You can eject from a transmutation hatch on the top at the center of the Proto Armatae for 1 AP, in which the Proto Armatae stops functioning.  When you re-enter you must close the hatch for 1 AP before the Proto Armatae functions again.

The Proto Armatae has health equal to 15 + 5x Focus and it uses your AP and RP for actions.  You can channel your Transmuter abilities through the Proto Armatae, and Transmute Weapon can create a giant sized weapon for the Armatae to use.

You may also spend 1 RP to use this ability instead of the AP cost.

Only usable once.  You regain the use of this ability when you gain an Interlude Point.

Proto Armatae

HP: –

Evasion: 9/19

Guard: 4/14

Mini Transmutation Cannon (Right Arm)

Cost: 0 AP

Range: 40ft

Description:  Fires a mini transmutation cannon of deconstructive energy making a light attack against a target.  Doesn’t provoke attacks of opportunity.

Humanoid Gripper (Left Arm)

Description: Humanoid Gripper can make all basic attacks.  It is proficient in any transmuted weapon it holds.  Its regular melee attacks deal light weapon damage and any transmuted weapon it wields gains the benefit of that weapon category.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: True Serenity
All Abilities.Description: You enter the Serene Water stance and gain an additional +17 bonus to your Evasion until the start of your next turn.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Tsubame Gaeshi
All Abilities.Keywords: Lock On, Secret Art, Sure Hit
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target 3 times. On the first miss, the next attacks gain Lock On. On the second miss, the next attack gains Sure Hit. These only apply to attacks made during Tsubame Gaeshi.
All Abilities.Requirements: Katana only.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Ultimate Spell
All Abilities.Description: The next Spell you cast this turn with an AP cost lower than 5 deals true damage.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Unholy Strength
All Abilities.Description:
You GainUnholy Strengthwhich grants +2 Power and Focus. While Unholy Strength is active your attacks/abilities that use your melee weapon to deal physical damage inflict Dark Damage instead and yourBone Armorwill not break from damage.

Upkeep:1 Mana.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Unstoppable Onslaught
All Abilities.Keywords: Secret Art, Sure Hit, Mind Affecting, Fear, Challenge, Shaken
All Abilities.Description: You may move up to your speed in a line. All enemies you pass through and all enemies within 15ft of your ending position take Light damage, become Challenged and Shaken until the start of your next turn.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be mounted.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Vanishing Thousand Steps
All Abilities.Description:
You may sidestep to a target within range and make a Heavy attack against them.

Then, until the end of the turn, you may Sidestep to any enemy you can see as part of a melee attack you are about to make. You gain Windflow stacks as if you spent AP on the movement equal to the AP spent on the attack.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Walking Church
All Abilities.Description: Blesses the target, granting them the status of a church. Until the end of your next turn, the target gains Damage Reduction 1000 against all damage types.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Whirling Death
All Abilities.Description:
You enter the Whirling Death stance, spinning wildly and shooting at enemies within range. While in this Stance you may spend 2 AP to make a basic Light Attack with a pistol against all enemies within 20ft.

When you kill an enemy or make them enter the downed state from with this attack, you may repeat the attack.The Stance lasts until you enter a different Stance or until you make an attack that is not tied to this ability.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Whiteout
All Abilities.Keywords: Encounter Start, Frost, Spell, Upkeep, Concentration, Secret Art
All Abilities.Description:
You create a sudden snowstorm that obscures sight, creating difficult battle conditions.

Attack accuracy for all affected units is reduced by your Focus and sight range is reduced to 60ft. A creature can only target something within their sight range.

You and creatures with Frost Immunity are not affected by this ability.

You may activate this ability as an Encounter Start action during the Encounter Start phase of an encounter. If you do, you do not pay the RP or initial mana cost.

Upkeep: You must pay 2 mana at the start of your turn or the effect ends at the end of that turn.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Art: Within This Ink, The Perfect Answer
All Abilities.Description:
You draw and immediately use a special talisman.

This talisman may have any spell in the base game on it (meaning it’s on the website), though it cannot be a secret or esoteric art. Any costs for this spell must be paid as normal. You must pay the required calligraphy units as if you made the spell yourself. If you can’t pay the required amount, you go into ‘debt’. While in debt, you cannot create any more talisman or use this ability.

To clear the debt, you must pay the required amount of calligraphy units at any point.

After you use this ability, you cannot do so again until the end of the arc.

All Abilities.Name: Secret Talisman
All Abilities.Description: You use a talisman you possess that contains a Secret Art. This functions like using a normal talisman. You may only use this once per encounter. Does not count towards your Secret Art usage for this encounter.
All Abilities.Requirements: Special

All Abilities.Name: Seismic Shove
All Abilities.Description: You make a Light attack that deals Earth damage against the target. On damage, you may push the target 5ft in any direction.

All Abilities.Name: Selective Casting
All Abilities.Description:
For the next Spell you cast, you may choose to have it not affect a number of targets equal to your Focus.

Only affects spells with an instantaneous effect (excluding setup things). Lingering spell effects such as Glittershards cannot be used with Selective Casting.

All Abilities.Name: Send To Armory
All Abilities.Description:
You touch an item not held or carried by another creature and immediately teleport it to your Dimensional Armory into an unoccupied space (if there is room).  If there is no space the spell fails.  Some magic items can be rejected by the dimensional armory.  Living creatures cannot be teleported into the Dimensional Armory.

Overcharge:You spend 1 minute instead of 2 AP, reducing the mana cost by 1.
All Abilities.Requirements: You have a Dimensional Armory active.

All Abilities.Name: Sense Magic
All Abilities.Description:
You can detect active magical effects that aren’t hidden within range.

Hidden magical effects may require a Perception or Insight check.
All Abilities.Requirements: None

All Abilities.Name: Separate wheat from chaff
All Abilities.Keywords: Killing Blow, Fear, Mind Affecting, Scatter
All Abilities.Description: You make a Light attack against all enemies in range. On damage, you push the target back 5ft. If you landed a Killing Blow, all that took damage become Shaken as well.
All Abilities.Requirements: Scythe only

All Abilities.Name: Serene Water Stance
All Abilities.Description: You enter the Serene Water Stance. While in this Stance, you gain a +3 bonus to your evasion and you may move 5ft everytime an accuracy check against you misses. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity. This Stance lasts until you enter a different Stance, you use the Block action or until you move, with the exceptions of this ability and movement abilities with the Unarmed Strike keyword. Making an attack does not cancel this Stance.
All Abilities.Requirements: An attack against you misses.

All Abilities.Name: Shade Form
All Abilities.Description: You become like a shade becoming near weightless and gaining the ability to pass through spaces occupied by other creatures. You can also slip through small cracks in walls or doors, as long as they are at least 1inch wide and tall.Upkeep:You must pay 2 mana at the start of each turn or this ability ends. During the night, the mana cost and Upkeep of this is reduced by 2.

All Abilities.Name: Shadow Cloak
All Abilities.Description: You cloak yourself in Shadows, giving you a +5 bonus on Stealth checks for 1 hour or until end of encounter. It also allows you to hide even when not behind cover or concealment. During the night, the mana cost of this is reduced by 2.

All Abilities.Name: Shadow Counter
All Abilities.Description:
You prepare a powerful heavy attack against a single enemy. This attack deals extra damage based on half your missing health.

If that enemy provokes an AoO while you are charging this ability, you may immediately use this ability as if you finished charging it.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be in Inexorable Shadow Stance.

All Abilities.Name: Shadow Step
All Abilities.Description: You may Teleport up to twice your movement speed. During the night, the mana cost of this is reduced by 2.

All Abilities.Name: Share Armor
All Abilities.Description:
Your ally may treat their guard and block as if they were wearing your armor until the end of the current creature’s turn. If multiple creatures of the same type move on the same initiative, it lasts through all of their turns.

Any temporary increases to the guard/block of this armor (such as through reinforce armor) is not transferred over.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be wearing armor.

All Abilities.Name: Shared Darkness
All Abilities.Benefits: The range of your darkvision increases by 60ft., You may use Darkvision.

All Abilities.Name: Shared Defense
All Abilities.Description: Your mount (the last mount you were riding on this arc) may use your defenses instead of its own while within range. In addition, you may spend RP for it while dismounted if your mount is in range.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be dismounted.

All Abilities.Name: Shatter
All Abilities.Description: Every enemy within range must make a save against your Potency or take Light Damage. Any unattended objects made of glass or a similar vulnerable material also shatter.

All Abilities.Name: Shatter Time
All Abilities.Description:
For this encounter you may act during different parts of a round. When you end your turn with AP remaining, you may choose to act immediately after another creature ends their turn. You do not regain AP or RP and these extra actions are not considered turns. You may take these extra actions multiple times during a round, provided you have AP remaining.

You cannot use Setup abilities during this extra actions.

All Abilities.Name: Sheet Ice
All Abilities.Description: You freeze the ground in a 20x20 area, creating difficult terrain that lasts until the end of your next turn.  You may use 1 mana per instance of this spell to continue the effect until the end of your next turn.

All Abilities.Name: Shelter
All Abilities.Description: The attack targeting your VIP instead targets you. You may use this even if you’re also a target of the attack and both attacks will resolve against you. You also gain the benefits of the Block action against the triggering attack.
All Abilities.Requirements: Your VIP is the target of an attack.

All Abilities.Name: Shield Burst
All Abilities.Description:
You heal the target for an amount equal to half the temporary HP they have, then all temporary HP on them is removed. All enemies within 5ft of the target must make a save against your Potency or be pushed back 10ft.

You may use 1 AP instead of 1 RP for this ability.
All Abilities.Requirements: Target must have temporary HP applied by you.

All Abilities.Name: Shield the Fallen
All Abilities.Description: You give the ally temporary HP equal to the damage they would take from the attack.
All Abilities.Requirements: Downed ally takes damage from an attack.

All Abilities.Name: Shieldcrusher
All Abilities.Description: You make a Heavy attack against the target. If they Block against this attack and are wielding a shield or greatshield, that shield becomes Broken.
All Abilities.Requirements: Two-handed weapons only.

All Abilities.Name: Shielding Fist
All Abilities.Benefits: While you have at least 1 hand empty and aren't wielding a shield, you gain a +4 Shield bonus to your block.

All Abilities.Name: Shooting Form
All Abilities.Description:
You transform a melee weapon you’re holding into a Wand Channeling Weapon or return a transformed weapon back to normal. While transformed, the weapon keeps any relevant enchants and functions exactly like how a wand would. You are considered proficient in this wand, even if you normally wouldn’t be and can fire Arcane Elemental shots with it, even if you normally wouldn’t be able to.

Lasts until the end of the encounter, for 5 minutes or until the weapon leaves your possession.

All Abilities.Name: Shrug it off
All Abilities.Benefits: You may use Vital Drive II.

All Abilities.Name: Silentium
All Abilities.Description: You infuse a light thrown weapon with Sacred Power and Light Attack the target for Light Holy Damage. On damage the weapon disrupts the target’s magic circuits, breaking concentration and preventing the target from using abilities with the Spell keyword. The lodged weapon can be removed for 1 RP or 2 AP, removing the disruption.Combo:If used after Eagle’s Hunt, reduce the AP cost to 0 from 2.
All Abilities.Requirements: One-handed Thrown Weapon or Sets of missiles Only.

All Abilities.Name: Single-Minded Fury
All Abilities.Description: You choose a single enemy as the target of your Single-Minded Fury. Your movement speed is doubled when moving towards your target plus you gain immunity to Slowed and difficult terrain. You also gain immunity to any mind-affecting effect that would prevent you from chasing or attacking your target. You gain a 1d4 bonus to accuracy rolls against that target, but suffer a 2d4 penalty to accuracy rolls against any other target. This effect lasts until the end of the encounter or until the target falls to 0 HP or lower.
All Abilities.Requirements: In Rage Stance, ability is not already active.

All Abilities.Name: Singularity Collapse
All Abilities.Description: You target a 25x25 square and all creatures within that square must make a save or be pulled 10ft towards the center.

All Abilities.Name: Siphon Material
All Abilities.Description:
Errand. You siphon the alloyed material from an item if possible, removing the effects that the original item would’ve had. If you cannot remove the effect then the skill fails.

You remove the alloy and regain its original form, while also maintaining the form of the item minus the effect. The special material is retrieved in raw units.

All Abilities.Name: Siren Song
All Abilities.Description:
All enemies in range must make a save against your Potency. If they fail, they may only spend AP on their next turn to move closer to you using the most direct path possible and cannot make attacks before that. To move closer, they may take actions that would help in getting closer such as standing up from prone or using fae flash.

If this path leads them through an obviously harmful hazard such as off a cliff, they are no longer affected by this ability. Otherwise, this ability lasts until they are within 5ft of you or until they take damage. While playing this Song, you can take no other actions. Taking any other action cancels the Song, immediately freeing all enemies from its effects. A creature can only be affected by this ability once per encounter.

All Abilities.Name: Skillfull Blow
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target.

All Abilities.Name: Skydive
All Abilities.Description: You target an enemy below you, no more than 5ft away from you horizontally. You then immediately dive down to that target, making a Heavy Attack against them. You deal an additional point of damage for every 10ft you fell before making the attack, up to 10 extra damage.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be airborne, polearm only.

All Abilities.Name: Slam
All Abilities.Description:
You attack a single target for Light Damage. On damage, the target is moved 5ft away from you if they are a Grunt or if your Power is higher than theirs, in addition the target must be no more than one size larger than you.

You may spend 1 Mana to ignore the Power requirement.

All Abilities.Name: Slide & Shoot
All Abilities.Description:
You slide forward up to 20ft towards your target. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity and you may pass through enemy space while moving. At the same time, you may make a Light Attack with your pistol against the target at any point during this movement.

Your next ability gainsCombo: If this attack is an unarmed attack, its AP cost is reduced by 1.
All Abilities.Requirements: Pistol only.

All Abilities.Name: Slime Body
All Abilities.Description: You gainSlime Body, which gives Damage Reduction 100 against physical damage against the next attack.

All Abilities.Name: Slow
All Abilities.Description: The target is slowed until the start of your next turn unless the target pays 1 RP to resist this effect.

All Abilities.Name: Smash through the pain
All Abilities.Description: You gainSmash through the pain, which reduces the damage taken by the next attack by an amount equal to 3 + Power

All Abilities.Name: Snack Time Everyone!~
All Abilities.Description:
You present a tray of refreshing Health and Mana snacks to your allies. All allies within 5ft of you may spend 0 RP to eat a snack.

Health: The ally may spend 2 Mana to heal for 15 HP.

Mana: The ally recovers 1 Mana. This counts as a character’s one food for the day and a character cannot benefit from this ability if they already had food. Does not count as a meal for the purposes of fending of starvation.

You keep the tray of snacks up for 1 turn and a character walking within 5ft of you while it’s up may also spend the 0 RP to eat a snack.

Allies may also spend 0 AP to eat another snack. They can do this once per turn.

Upkeep:1 Mana, you keep the tray up for an additional turn.
All Abilities.Requirements: At least 1 hand free

All Abilities.Name: Snap Shot
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target with a ranged weapon or a thrown weapon. You do not add your Focus to the accuracy roll.

All Abilities.Name: Snap Shot II
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Light Attack against the target. You do not add your focus to this roll.

All Abilities.Name: Snatch
All Abilities.Description:
You may use this when a target in range uses the interact with object action. If you can hold the object the target is interacting with in one hand, you steal it from them.

Any AP they may have spent on their action is not refunded to them.
All Abilities.Requirements: At least 1 hand free.

All Abilities.Name: Sneak Attack
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target.

All Abilities.Name: Snipe
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain proficiency in Sniper Rifles., If you did not move this turn or the previous turn you gain a +1d4 Snipe bonus to your accuracy roll on attacks made with a Sniper Rifle.

All Abilities.Name: Solar Radiance
All Abilities.Description: You shine brightly like the sun in a 60ft radius around you. You cannot turn this off, but you can lower the range to just 5ft. This light counts as sunlight, though any negative effects a creature suffers from it are halved. It also counts as bright light for creatures weak to light.

All Abilities.Name: Song without Song
All Abilities.Benefits: You may have 1 additional song active at the same time., You learn the language 'Music'.

All Abilities.Name: Soul Absorption
All Abilities.Keywords: Spell, Dark, Full Pierce, Sure Hit
All Abilities.Description: You make a Light Attack against a willing target that deals Light Dark damage. Your next Dark type Spell or Attack other than Soul Absorption gains extra damage equal to damage taken by the target. (Does not stack)

All Abilities.Name: Soul Bond
All Abilities.Benefits: When you acquire this ability, choose 1 willing person. That person is treated as your Soulmate and several of the class abilities only work on your Soulmate. This cannot be changed unless your Soulmate dies., Your Soulmate is always treated as your VIP for any bodyguard abilities. You may still designate another VIP as normal.

All Abilities.Name: Soul Strike
All Abilities.Description: After landing a killing blow, you can use Soul Strike once on that target.  If they are still at 0 HP or less, you raise an orb of divine energy out of the target, killing them instantly.  You then use that orb against a second target, making a light attack that deals dark damage.  It is possible to use Soul Strike while in Cat Form.Overcharge:You may spend 1 extra AP to instead deal heavy damage.
All Abilities.Requirements: You land a killing blow.

All Abilities.Name: Soulreap
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. On Killing Blow, you instantly kill the target and immediately cast Raise Undead on the target for 0 AP.

All Abilities.Name: Sound the retreat
All Abilities.Description: You sidestep 4 times your speed, moving as far away from visible enemies as possible. After that, your allies may sidestep up to twice their speed towards you.

All Abilities.Name: Speak with dead
All Abilities.Description:
You attempt to communicate with the soul of a person who has died recently. This requires you to perform a ritual that takes an hour, that must be performed next to the corpse or where the person died. You must be aware of the identity of the person you’re trying to contact. Finally, you must have a tool such as an ouija board that allows the spirit to communicate with you.

Even if the ritual succeeds, the spirit is not forced to answer your questions if hostile to you or it might answer in cryptic ways.
All Abilities.Requirements: Special

All Abilities.Name: Spear Charge
All Abilities.Description:
You may spend 2 or 4 AP on this ability and move as though you had spent that AP on movement. After you finish moving, you may spend half of the AP you used on this ability on a single Light or Heavy attack.

For every 10ft moved, this attack gains +1 damage up to a maximum of +10.

If you spent 4 AP on this ability, you may also choose to use Wild Thrusts instead of making a Light or Heavy attack. These attacks do not gain the damage bonus listed above, but Wild Thrusts mana cost is reduced to 0 if used in this way.
All Abilities.Requirements: Polearm only.

All Abilities.Name: Spell Challenge
All Abilities.Benefits: When targeting or damaging an enemy with a spell, you may choose to inflict Challenge on them until the end of your next turn., When an enemy that is Challenged by you provokes an attack of opportunity from you, you may instead use Abjurer's Blast against them. The heavy and precise version of this cost 1 RP, while the light version costs 0 RP.

All Abilities.Name: Spell Transfer
All Abilities.Benefits: When you use the Create Talisman ability, an ally may spend their Errand action to use one of their spells to put on the talisman instead of your own. You only create 1 copy of this talisman per Errand action and cannot use Secret Art spells with it.

All Abilities.Name: Spellblade's Preparation
All Abilities.Description:
You unsheathe your weapon and enchant your weapon with an element you've mastered. Your weapon now deals the chosen element’s damage instead of its normal damage.

If you are not holding the enchanted weapon at the start of your turn, your weapon loses this benefit.

The weapon gains a +1 Power bonus to attacks until the end of the encounter.

All Abilities.Name: Spellsteal
All Abilities.Description: You attempt to steal an effect from the target, removing it from the target and applying it to yourself for the same duration, provided you meet the requirements (if any). You must pay mana equal to the effects original mana cost. Effects granted through stances, transformations and permanent effects cannot be stolen. After stealing an effect, you can’t use this again until the stolen effect has ended. The stolen effect also cannot be re-applied on the target until it has faded from you. You must have seen the effect be applied or otherwise identified an effect before you can steal it.

All Abilities.Name: Spellstrike
All Abilities.Description:
You choose an ability with the Spell keyword that you can use. You make a melee attack against a target in range for the same AP and mana as the Spell.

Your attack functions like the chosen Spell does, but does not provoke an Attack of Opportunity and is not treated as casting a Spell (meaning it can be used while Raging and Anti-Spell effects don't work). If the chosen spell was an AoE effect, the target point would be the target you strike with the spell. The requirements for applying any effects remain the same.

The spell you chose cannot be used again in the same round like normal, and if used with Secret Arts it counts as your Secret Art use for that encounter.

Only works with Spells that are attacks.

All Abilities.Name: Spider Climb
All Abilities.Description:
You do not suffer any penalties from moving across webs, either natural or created through magic or items. You may climb up walls without using any tools or making any checks at half your normal movement speed and can remain attached to the wall.

If you take any action other than moving or climbing, you become vulnerable to be knocked off the wall you're climbing until the start of your next turn. When you take damage, you slide down 20ft. If you are hanging on a ceiling or similar surface, you instead fall down from it falling prone and taking fall damage as normal.

All Abilities.Name: Spike Field
All Abilities.Description:
You create a 20x20ft field of spikes. Any creature moving more than 5ft per movement action across it takes full pierce damage equal to your Focus for each 5ft they move across the field.

If the movement through it was forced movement, you only take the damage once.

Lasts until the start of your next turn.

Upkeep: 1 mana, extends the duration of the spike field by 1 turn.

All Abilities.Name: Spiked Armor
All Abilities.Description: Until the start of your next turn, the spikes on your armor and shield reflect damage when you are attacked. When an enemy hits you with a melee attack, they take 4 full pierce damage.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be wearing armor and/or a shield.

All Abilities.Name: Spirit Circuit Crash
All Abilities.Description: You send a wave of magic energy onto the target, afflicting them with Spirit Circuit Crash— jamming their Spirit Circuits.  The target cannot use Secret Arts or any abilities that require mana until the end of their next turn.  The target may choose to take damage equal to your heavy attack damage to cancel this effect.You can cast this through a creature affected by Mind Connection.

All Abilities.Name: Spirit Jump
All Abilities.Description:
You and your mount jump up to 60ft vertically straight up into the air.  You can additionally move 5ft horizontally afterwards.  Unless your mount can fly, you automatically land straight down from your position at the end of your turn or for 0 AP, this falling movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity and you do not take fall damage from it.  You cannot make any non-teleport movement actions while in the air, but can still take other actions (such as attacking) while airborne.

You may trade height to move horizontally as part of the initial jump, moving 5ft horizontally as part of the jump in exchange for 5ft of height. You may move up to 40ft extra horizontally with this.

Instead of spending mana, you may instead spend a minute preparing this ability before activating it. When you do, this ability costs 0 mana.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be mounted.

All Abilities.Name: Spirited Bravado
All Abilities.Description: When you are under the effect of Tipsy, you gain a Spirited Bravado which grants +1 Power.

All Abilities.Name: Spiritual Reading
All Abilities.Description:
You are able to check the aura of a creature or object within range.

If you check a creature, you can see whether a creature is non-heroic, weaker than you, around the same as you, stronger than you or much stronger than you. The GM may also give you their Spirit Core value if it has one. You also are aware if someone is concealing their spirit core level, but can’t get an accurate reading of their strength if they are. In addition, you are able to see their mana % until the end of the encounter.

If you check an item, you can determine whether it’s magical in nature. If it is, you may immediately make a Magic check against it to determine its effect as if you were using Decipher Magic with a +5 bonus.

All Abilities.Name: Spiritual Sync
All Abilities.Description:
If you paid mana for this ability, you gain Temporary HP equal to 8X. Any Temporary HP from this ability remaining after the encounter conclusion phase is turned back into mana at a ratio of 8 Temporary HP to 1 mana.

You may instead pay HP for this ability. If you do, you gain 1 Temporary Mana for every 8 HP you spend. You cannot spend more HP than you currently have. Any Temporary mana is lost at the encounter conclusion phase.

You may spend a maximum of 3 mana or 24 HP on this ability.

Once you use this ability, you may not use it again until after an encounter conclusion phase.

All Abilities.Name: Spore Burst
All Abilities.Description: You create an explosion of spores in front of you. Make a Heavy Attack against the target that deals Poison damage. Afterwards, knock back the target 5ft and knock yourself back 5ft. This Spell does not trigger attacks of opportunity.

All Abilities.Name: Spore Symbiote
All Abilities.Description: You send a Spore Symbiote to an ally or yourself.  The Spore Symbiote lasts until the end of combat, or you move it to another target (You can only have one Spore Symbiote active at a time).  If the host of Spore Symbiote moves more than 240 feet away from you, the Spore Symbiote ends.

All Abilities.Name: Squadsight
All Abilities.Description: An ally that can see or hear you within range may use your Perception score until the start of your next turn. They may also see from your position rather than their own and they may calculate their ranged weapon range (but not LoS) from your position instead of their own. This new range may not exceed twice their normal range.

All Abilities.Name: Stab & Throw
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Heavy Attack against a target in melee range. You may then use the same weapon to Heavy Attack a different target within your ranged weapon range or thrown attack range. This second attack does not provoke attacks of opportunity from the target of your first attack.
All Abilities.Requirements: Throwing Weapon, Set of Missiles or Thrown attack only.

All Abilities.Name: Stable Foundation
All Abilities.Description: Make a crafting check, afterwards all future crafting dice for this session cannot roll below a 3.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be the first crafting dice in a crafting session. Costs 1 Crafting Dice

All Abilities.Name: Staggering Slice
All Abilities.Description:
You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, you inflict Stagger 1 until the end of your next turn..

If you're under the effects of Exposing Edge, you inflict Stagger 2 on damage instead.
All Abilities.Requirements: One-Handed weapons only.

All Abilities.Name: Stalks of Comparison
All Abilities.Description: Make a gathering check and apply it to either Node Points or Lucky Points. If the result of this check (before bonuses) is higher than your previous roll this session, gain a bonus to the result equal to your Foraging skill (max +10).
All Abilities.Requirements: Costs 1 Strike Dice

All Abilities.Name: Stardust Reverie
All Abilities.Description:
Declare a distance up to the range of this spell. You create a celestial dome at that range from you that harm those that pass through it.

Until the start of your next turn, whenever a creature willingly enters that distance from you, you may make a Light attack against them that deals Arcane damage. You may choose to spend an RP before making this attack to make it a Heavy attack. A character that Sidesteps or Teleports through your stars does not provoke this attack.

Upkeep: 1 mana. When you pay the upkeep cost, you may change the distance of the stars.

All Abilities.Name: Starfall
All Abilities.Description:
You target a 25x25 square within range. On the start of your next turn, 4 stars fall down in the area.

At the start of your next turn, you make 4 light attacks that deal Arcane damage, evenly divided amongst enemies in the area. If there are less enemies than stars, you may hit an enemy more than once (though you must still attempt to hit each enemy an equal amount of times if possible).

All Abilities.Name: Starlance
All Abilities.Description: You make a Precise attack against the target that deals Arcane damage.

All Abilities.Name: Start Dash
All Abilities.Description: You move up to your speed.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be the first action in your turn.

All Abilities.Name: Stasis
All Abilities.Description: You put a Grunt level character or any willing ally into Stasis until the start of your next turn. While in Stasis, they cannot be affected by any ability, attack or anything similar but they also cannot take any actions.

All Abilities.Name: Static Discharge
All Abilities.Description:
A single target in range must make a save or the Static stacks on them immediately discharge, triggering the Static effect as though it was the end of the target’s turn.

Whether the target succeeds at or fails the save, they lose all Static charges.
All Abilities.Requirements: The target must be afflicted with Static you applied.

All Abilities.Name: Static Overload
All Abilities.Description: A single target in range must make a save or immediately take Lightning damage equal to their Static and become inflicted withDaze.
All Abilities.Requirements: The target must be afflicted with Static you applied.

All Abilities.Name: Statue Form
All Abilities.Description:
You turn yourself into a statue, petrifying yourself and the items on you. While in this mode, you gain a +5 bonus to your guard but cannot take any actions except Block. You may leave this mode by spending 0 AP.

You may rest as normal while in this form. While staying in this form, you do not need to eat.

You gain a +10 bonus to your Deception for convincing others that you are just a statue.

All Abilities.Name: Status Assessment
All Abilities.Description: You can assess the approximate HP percentage of a unit until the end of combat. (The DM should enable health bars for the unit). You can also determine which parts of a creature can be targeted and destroyed, if any.

All Abilities.Name: Status Assessment II
All Abilities.Description: You can assess the approximate HP percentage of a unit until the end of combat. (The DM should enable health bars for the unit). You can also assess any damage type weaknesses and strengths that the enemy has at the current time. You can also determine which parts of a creature can be targeted and destroyed, if any.

All Abilities.Name: Status Assessment III
All Abilities.Description: You can assess the approximate HP and RP percentage of a unit until the end of combat. (The DM should enable health bars for the unit). You can also assess any damage type weaknesses and strengths that the enemy has at the current time. You can also determine which parts of a creature can be targeted and destroyed, if any.

All Abilities.Name: Stay Here With Me!
All Abilities.Description:
All allies within range heal for 8 HP.

Upkeep: 1 AP, 2 Mana. When you pay upkeep, you heal all allies for 8 HP again.

All Abilities.Name: Steadfast Earth Stance
All Abilities.Description:
You enter a stance that grants you the toughness of the earth. You gain a +2 bonus to your guard and a +6 bonus to your Block.

This stance lasts until you enter a different stance.
All Abilities.Requirements: Not wearing any armor (including armor plates)

All Abilities.Name: Steady Craft II
All Abilities.Description: You add a crafting check to the item. The crafting dice is automatically a 7.
All Abilities.Requirements: 1 Crafting Dice.

All Abilities.Name: Steady Ground
All Abilities.Description:
The target gains Immovable until the start of their next turn.

You may also use this for 2 AP instead.
All Abilities.Requirements: The target must be touching the ground.

All Abilities.Name: Steady Stance
All Abilities.Description:
You enter a Stance in which you become Immovable unless the enemy has more Power than you. If they do, you may pay an additional mana to retain the effect against them if they would prone you or knock you back.

This stance lasts until you enter a different stance.

All Abilities.Name: Steal Heart
All Abilities.Description:
The target must make a save or become Charmed until the end of the encounter.

If you use this on a Grunt level enemy and you charm them, you may choose their actions when it's their turn in addition to Charm’s normal effect.

You may only have 1 target charmed at the same time.

All Abilities.Name: Steal Time
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Light Attack against the target. On damage, you inflictTime Stolen, which lowers their Initiative by 1 and you gainStolen Time, which increases yours by 1. This effect can stack both on you and on enemies.

All Abilities.Name: Steel Aura
All Abilities.Description: You gainSteel Aura, granting you 3 additional guard, but you can no longer use any RP actions besides block. You can end this effect at any time for 0 RP. This effect ends at the start of your next turn.

All Abilities.Name: Stolen Power
All Abilities.Description:
Make a Light (1 AP), Precise (2 AP) or Heavy (2 AP) attack that deals Arcane damage against the target. You use their Power for the damage calculation.

This spell does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

All Abilities.Name: Stolen Skill
All Abilities.Description:
You may name one skill (such as perception, athletics) and force the target to make a save against your Potency. On failure, you steal their skill points spent into the skill until the end of the encounter. You gain their skill points they have in that skill to your skill while they lose all of theirs.

Only affects skill points spent, not any other bonuses from abilities or stats.

Can not be used on artisan and gathering skills.

You may only have 1 instance of Stolen Skill active at the same time, but you may choose to drop your current stolen one for 0 AP.

All Abilities.Name: Stoneskin
All Abilities.Description: You gainStoneskin, which grants +1 guard and +4 block, but also -2 evasion and dodge.

All Abilities.Name: Store Time
All Abilities.Description: You gainStore Time, granting you 1 extra AP at the start of your next turn.

All Abilities.Name: Store/Consume Item
