All Abilities.Description: You store a consumable item within your body, this item still counts towards weight limits.  Without needing to equip the item, you can consume an item to gain its effects.

All Abilities.Name: Strata Cut
All Abilities.Description:
You make a Precise attack against the target.

Combo: If used after Tectonic Overhead, the mana cost is reduced by 1.

All Abilities.Name: Stratagem: Lightning
All Abilities.Range: All allies in sight, including yourself.
All Abilities.Description: All allied units (including yourself) gain +1 to Initiative and may immediately move up to their Speed.

All Abilities.Name: Strengthening the Bond
All Abilities.Description:
You swap places with a willing ally. This movement does not trigger any attacks of opportunity. You cannot use this ability if it causes an ally unit to occupy an invalid space. Before or after the swap you can take a 5ft step, but the swap must occur.

You may spend either 0 AP or 1 RP to use this ability.
All Abilities.Requirements: A willing ally is within 10ft range.

All Abilities.Name: Strike of Still Water
All Abilities.Keywords: Full Pierce, Sure Hit, Unarmed Strike
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be in Serene Water Stance.

All Abilities.Name: Studied Healer
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain +5 skill points in the Religion skill., Followers of your Religion are more obligated to listen to you, granting you a +5 Negotiation Bonus when dealing with them.

All Abilities.Name: Study Target
All Abilities.Keywords: Lock On, Full Pierce, Sure Hit, Overcharge, Stealth
All Abilities.Description:
Your next basic attack against the target gains the Lock On keyword OR you apply Death Mark to the target.

Overcharge:You may spend 2 additional AP to instead make the next basic attack gain the Sure hit and Full Pierce keywords.

All Abilities.Name: Stygian Comprehension
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain Elemental Mastery: Dark, You may use Dark Bolt.

All Abilities.Name: Stygian Screen
All Abilities.Description: You create a wall of darkness that is 20ft long, 5ft wide and 10ft high. This wall must be a straight line.  This wall blocks line of sight. Targets inside of the wall can only see 5ft away

All Abilities.Name: Suckerpunch
All Abilities.Keywords: Encounter Start, Sure Hit, Unarmed Strike
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. On damage, the target becomes Unbalanced.

All Abilities.Name: Summon Animal
All Abilities.Description:
You summon a randomly chosen animal to a location you can see within range. The summon does not act by itself, but you may spend AP to make it act. The AP cost for these actions is the same as they would be for you taking the basic actions. (Example, you can spend 2 AP to make the summon do a Heavy attack).

The summon also gains access to the abilities the summoned creature normally has. The costs for these have to be paid by you, same as they would be for basic actions. Any attacks it makes are made with its own stats. When an animal summoned through this ability dies, you cannot use this ability again until the end of the encounter. You can undo the summoning manually for 0 AP.

The pool of creatures that can be summoned is the following: Wolf, Boar, Giant Spider.

All Abilities.Name: Summon Lesser Eidolon
All Abilities.Description:
Your contracted Eidolon hears your call and sends their minions to fight for you. The summon called and costs are dependent on your attunement. Lasts up to 5 minutes. You must pay the upkeep cost under the Summon’sSummonSkill or the Summon vanishes.

Unless the summon has a skill that says otherwise, a summon acts after you on initiative, but cannot act the round it is summoned except for RP actions.

All Abilities.Name: Summon Piece
All Abilities.Description:
You summon a Pawn puppet under your control. It (and other puppets from this class) have HP equal to 20 + Focus, no evasion and no guard. These puppets are not living targets and are generally treated as structures rather than creatures.

Overcharge: You may spend extra mana to summon the following puppets instead:

1 Mana: Knight or Bishop

2 Mana: Rook

3 Mana: Queen

All Abilities.Name: Summoning Basics
All Abilities.Benefits: You may channel for 10 minutes after which you arrive at the space between worlds, allowing you to interact with Eidolons that wish to meet with you., You may use Attune Eidolon.

All Abilities.Name: Superconductor
All Abilities.Benefits: When you make an attack that deals Lightning damage to a target afflicted with Static, you gain a +1 accuracy bonus., You gain Elemental Mastery: Lightning.

All Abilities.Name: Superior Assessment
All Abilities.Benefits: You may use Status Assessment III.

All Abilities.Name: Surgical Precision
All Abilities.Benefits: When you deal damage with a one-handed melee weapon that is both Sure Hit and Full Pierce or a critical hit, you inflict Bleeding on the target for 1 turn. This effect stacks with other Bleeds effects and itself up to 3 times.

All Abilities.Name: Swallow Acrobatics
All Abilities.Description: Your next movement before the end of your turn does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
All Abilities.Requirements: Can be used after you make a melee attack while flying.

All Abilities.Name: Swap
All Abilities.Description:
You Swap positions with a chosen willing ally or any non-heroic enemy.

You may use either AP or RP for this ability. You don't need to pay the cost of both.

All Abilities.Name: Sweeping Stance
All Abilities.Description:
You enter a stance in which you spin your weapon around in a circular motion and lash out against any enemy that approaches. When an enemy enters your weapon’s range you may make an Attack of Opportunity against them. An enemy moving while already being in your attack range does not provoke. Your weapon's range for these attacks of opportunities is increased by 5ft (This does not affect your normal threaten range).

The stance lasts until you make an attack that isn’t an Attack of Opportunity.
All Abilities.Requirements: Two-handed weapons only.

All Abilities.Name: Swift Wind Palm
All Abilities.Description:
You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, the target is knocked down 30ft or until they hit the floor (on top of any other height loss from being hit while flying) and you may Sidestep next to them afterwards.

A target knocked down on to the ground with this ability is knocked prone and takes falling damage as normal. They do not take the normal extra damage as result of being knocked into the floor.
All Abilities.Requirements: You and thetarget must be airborne

All Abilities.Name: Sword Riding Art
All Abilities.Description:
You jump onto a light sword, versatile melee weapon, greatshield, bayonet musket or two-handed melee weapon you’re carrying and use it to move around. While riding on top of the sword, you gain Flight. You can fly this way for up to 5 minutes.

If you take damage while flying higher than 5ft above the ground, your altitude drops by 20ft. If this would reduce your altitude to the point where you touch the ground, you may hop off your weapon and put it back into your hand if possible for 0 RP. After this happens, your Sword Riding ends. If the attack that reduced your HP came from a flying creature other than yourself, you do not lose altitude but instead become unbalanced.

If you are knocked back by an effect, you must make a save against the attacker's potency. Else, you are blown off your sword.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must have a Light Sword or two-handed melee weapon in your hand.

All Abilities.Name: Tackle
All Abilities.Description: You attempt to tackle the target and may make a Heavy Attack against them. This attack deals no damage. On hit and if the target did not use the Block action against this ability, you and the target fall Prone. If the target successfully dodges this ability, you fall Prone.

All Abilities.Name: Tag Rotation
All Abilities.Range: Two ally units, or yourself and an ally unit that are adjacent to each other that you can see.
All Abilities.Description: The target willing allies, or yourself and a target willing ally switch places.  This movement does not trigger any attacks of opportunity.  You cannot use this if it causes an ally unit to occupy an invalid space. You may use either AP or RP for this ability.

All Abilities.Name: Tailwind
All Abilities.Description: You and all allies within 40ft gain Tailwind, which provides a +1 bonus to initiative and doubles movement speed in the first round of combat.

All Abilities.Name: Take Cover!
All Abilities.Description: All Low Cover in a 20x20 area becomes High Cover for your allies (including yourself).  This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

All Abilities.Name: Take it easy
All Abilities.Description: Do not make a gathering check. Instead, immediately collect 25% of the Outcrop’s base material as a bonus (doesn’t affect material totals), but no Node or Lucky progress is made.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must in a gathering session.

All Abilities.Name: Take the advantage
All Abilities.Benefits: When attacking a target inflicted with Offstep, Stagger or Blinded, you gain a +1 accuracy bonus against them.

All Abilities.Name: Talisman Recursion
All Abilities.Description:
After using a Talisman, you may immediately spend the cost of that talisman (before reductions) to repeat the effect without consuming another talisman. If the talisman had a target, you must choose the same target.

Does not work with Secret Talismans.

All Abilities.Name: Tap Cracker
All Abilities.Description:
You open a door or interact with an object remotely.  You can cast this through a creature affected by Mind Connection.

Overcharge:You can pay 1 mana to magically unlock most doors and objects (DM can decide if an object is too complicated, and still make you roll a Skill Check).
All Abilities.Requirements: Object is in a room affected by Psychometry

All Abilities.Name: Tectonic Overhead
All Abilities.Description: You make a slow, powerful overhead swing and make a Heavy attack against the target. Their evasion (but not dodge) is doubled for this attack.

All Abilities.Name: Tempestuous Fire Stance
All Abilities.Description: You enter the Tempestuous Fire Stance. While in this Stance, before you make an attack with the Unarmed Strike keyword, you may choose to move 5ft per AP spent on the move. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity. This Stance lasts until you enter a different stance or until you move, with the exceptions of this ability and movement abilities with the Unarmed Strike keyword. Making an attack does not cancel this stance.

All Abilities.Name: Temporary Protection
All Abilities.Description: Until the end of the encounter, the target ally you selected is also treated as your VIP.

All Abilities.Name: Tengu Aura Weapon
All Abilities.Description: Your infuse your weapons with fiend killing aura, making them equivalent to Silver weapons for the purposes of harming fiends. Attacking a fiend with a silver weapon disables their regeneration.

All Abilities.Name: Tengu Mask
All Abilities.Description: You manifest and don a Tengu Mask of your desired design, grantingPresence Concealment.   You cannot use any mana abilities or Aura abilities while in Presence Concealment.  You can end this effect for 1 AP or 1 RP, to either remove your mask or to wear it on your head in a way that doesn't cover your face.

All Abilities.Name: Terracing
All Abilities.Description:
You raise the ground around you in a 25x25ft square centered on yourself. The ground is raised upwards by 10ft. Can only be used on natural ground and cannot be used on ground that’s already been raised.

Overcharge: You may spend 1 AP and 1 Mana to raise it upwards by another 10ft.

All Abilities.Name: Terrifying Charge
All Abilities.Benefits: When dealing damage with the trample effect or with your Secret Art: Override, any non-heroic target you damage becomes Shaken until the end of their next turn.

All Abilities.Name: Tetsuzanko
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. This attack deals additional Light Damage added to the Heavy Damage.Combo:If used after an ability that moved the target, you may push the target for an equal distance again.

All Abilities.Name: The Alchemist
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain Alchemist Core Crafting Abilities, and proficiency in 1 basic weapon., You can craft using non-advanced materials and base materials., You can use an Alchemist's Alembic as crafting tool for alchemy crafts., You craft 3 of the same Elixir, Potion, Flask, Poison or Salve when using an interlude point instead of 1. You only need to pay the listed cost once.

All Abilities.Name: Thefts of the past
All Abilities.Benefits: When making a check with the Roguecraft skill, you may treat the object or person you’re interacting with as being up to an hour in the past. This may allow you to steal things not currently carried, open doors before they were locked and more. Does not work in combat and an item that is consumed cannot be stolen., Using the Delay encounter start action does not consume your encounter start action use and you may use it multiple times.

All Abilities.Name: Thermal Quench
All Abilities.Description: You make a crafting check. For each time you rolled a 5 or higher this craft, this check gains a +1 bonus.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be in a crafting session.

All Abilities.Name: Thermal Vision
All Abilities.Description: You can perfectly see and detect heat sources up to 120ft away, including stealthed creatures. This cannot detect things hidden by magical means. You can no longer discern a difference in heat once something reaches freezing temperatures.

All Abilities.Name: Thick Skull
All Abilities.Description: When you would get Dazed, you may make a Save against the effect even if it would normally not allow for one. If you already had to make a save to avoid it, then you don’t get another.

All Abilities.Name: This is our moment!
All Abilities.Description:
All allies within range gain a +1 Song bonus to their damage rolls. This bonus is doubled on Heavy attacks.

Upkeep: 1 AP

All Abilities.Name: Threatening Aura
All Abilities.Description: Until the start of your next turn, all enemies in your melee range are considered Challenged by you.

All Abilities.Name: Throw Potion
All Abilities.Description: You throw a Potion in your hands at a willing ally unit within range. The unit may pay the mana cost (if any) to receive the effect of the Potion.

All Abilities.Name: Thunderstorm
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Light Attack that deals Lightning damage against all target enemies in range. As the attack comes from the sky, any cover is calculated from above the target rather than from your path to the target.

All Abilities.Name: Timberwright's Core Crafting
All Abilities.Description: Carpenter's Modification BCost:X Crafting PointsDescription:You add an B-Type modification to the weapon or tool. See the Universal Weapon page as well as the individual weapon page for details. Each modification has its own cost.

All Abilities.Name: Tiny Pixie
All Abilities.Description:
Your size is tiny and you are able to occupy the same square as an ally or enemy. Your Toughness is reduced by 2 and your Agility is increased by 2.

When walking (and not hovering or flying), your movement speed is reduced to 5ft.

All Abilities.Name: Tireless Undead
All Abilities.Description: Jiangshi do not know pain or fatigue, making them terrifying warriors. You are always counted as rested despite the most inhospitable conditions. You also do not need to sleep.

All Abilities.Name: Titan's Grip
All Abilities.Benefits: You may wield a Two-Handed weapon in 1 hand allowing you to use a second (Two-Handed) weapon or shield in your offhand., While dual wielding heavy weapons, you may make dual wield attacks as if they were light weapons.

All Abilities.Name: Torture Techniques
All Abilities.Description: You twist the knife and inflict a debilitating wound on the enemy. You inflict one of the following conditions: Slowed, Unbalanced or Bleeding. These last until the end of the target’s next turn.
All Abilities.Requirements: You landed a crit on the enemy (and it wasn't blocked or dodged).

All Abilities.Name: Toss a coin
All Abilities.Benefits: As an Errand action, you may perform in a city or town and earn Clim equal to your relevant Art roll x 10 up to a maximum of 300 clim.

All Abilities.Name: Track
All Abilities.Description: You find any tracks that aren’t hidden.  Once you find tracks, you can follow them at normal speed without having to make checks.

All Abilities.Name: Trail Mix
All Abilities.Description: For a camp action you create up to 5 servings of a trail meal.  It costs 20u of food per serving and only gives 1 mana (0 for Mirane), but it keeps starvation away.  Does not require a culinary kit, and does not count as cooking for the purposes of culinary actions such as using stocks.
All Abilities.Requirements: 20u of Food Per Serving

All Abilities.Name: Trailblazer
All Abilities.Description: You move up to your speed. Any allies within 30ft of where you started moving may spend 1 RP to move up to twice their speed towards you. They ignore the effects of natural difficult terrain for this movement.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be mounted and meet the requirements of your Light Cavalry key ability.

All Abilities.Name: Trample
All Abilities.Description:
You may activate this after moving at least 20ft in a movement action to gain Trample until you stop moving. Abilities with the Teleport keyword do not apply for this, but declaring multiple AP to move at the same time counts as 1 action. While under the effects of trample, you don't provoke attacks of opportunity by moving and you can move into enemies that are at least one size smaller than your mount. An enemy may spend 1 RP to move out of the way to an empty spot within 5ft of them.

If they don’t move out of the way, you make a Sure Hit Light attack against them with your mount, using your mount’s stats. On damage, you knock them prone into the square you came from and keep moving, occupying the square they were in. Otherwise your movement action ends.

Each enemy can only be affected by trample once per activation of the ability, regardless of whether they are attacked or move out of it.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be mounted.

All Abilities.Name: Tranquil Prayers
All Abilities.Benefits: Your Acolyte, Priest and High Priest Healing abilities heal for 2x value when used out of combat.

All Abilities.Name: Transfusion
All Abilities.Description:
You lose HP up to your Toughness x 2. Target ally within range heals for the same amount of HP you lost.

This HP loss cannot be mitigated in any way and ignores temporary HP. This does not trigger effects that would trigger upon taking damage.

All Abilities.Name: Transmutation Basics
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain Transmuter Core Crafting Abilities. You may use one of these abilities in a crafting session. If you use one of these abilities, other transmuters can no longer use their co craft abilities with you. Similarly, if a co crafter uses one of these abilities for you, you can no longer use any of these abilities., You can craft using non-advanced materials and base materials., You can now craft Elixirs, Potions, Flasks and Salves. You craft 3 of the same Elixir, Potion, Flask or Salve when using an interlude point instead of 1. You only need to pay the listed cost once., You gain proficiency in alchemist’s tools and 1 basic weapon type.

All Abilities.Name: Craft Fuel Shells
All Abilities.Description: You craft up to 5 small shells. You can instead craft a medium shell instead of 2 small shells. Small shells require 50 magical fuel, medium shells require 200 magical fuel.

All Abilities.Name: Create Artifice Parts
All Abilities.Description: You create up to 3000u of artifice parts of the same type of blacksmithing material used to make them at a 1:1 rate. (3000u of Iron Creates 3000u of Iron Artifice Parts.) See Items: Blacksmithing Materials, Artificer Materials. When converting items of a higher tier, you can convert up to 6000 of tamahagane, 9000 of mithril, 12000 of Orihalcum or 15000 of escudo.

All Abilities.Name: Create Box or Bundle of Food
All Abilities.Description: You create a perfect mix of ingredients that would be worthy of a stock with 500u of matching material. Example: 500u of Meat can make 1 Box of Fresh Meat. You can make 5 boxes of any kind for one errand action.

All Abilities.Name: Create Ingot
All Abilities.Description: You create an ingot from blacksmithing base materials or from blacksmithing special materials. See Item: Blacksmithing Materials.

All Abilities.Name: Create Oil Coating
All Abilities.Description: You create an Oil Coating from Carpenter materials. See Items: Carpenter Materials

All Abilities.Name: Create Wood Block
All Abilities.Description: You create a Wood Block from Carpenter materials. See Items: Carpenter Materials

All Abilities.Name: Rage Quit
All Abilities.Description: Co-Craft. Only usable once per crafting IP. Destroy the uncrafted item and all materials invested into the craft. You may immediately start another crafting session. If you use this as a Co-Craft it requires 1 crafting dice from the main crafter. Bouncing IdeasDescription:Co-Craft. You assist with crafting adding 1d4 crafting points to the current craft.

All Abilities.Name: Tan Leather
All Abilities.Description: You create a tanned hide from armorsmithing base leather materials. See item: Armorsmthing materials.

All Abilities.Name: Transmutation Tricks
All Abilities.Benefits: For 1 AP, You can create small items using transmuting to provide temporary comforts and curiosities— a cup to drink out of, a chair to sit down on, a figurine etc.  These items cannot have significant gameplay factors (such as a key or a tool).  If you’d like to create something small to give away or sell, you must utilize x amount of commodities of whatever quantity and type the GM decides., You may use your transmuter abilities a second time during a craft or co craft., You may use the following abilities:

All Abilities.Name: Transmute Effective Implement
All Abilities.Description:
From the surrounding material you construct an “Effective Implement”, granting you a +5 to the skill of your choice.  You must explain how this implement will be effective towards the check using the relevant skill (example:  creating a springboard to jump higher with athletics) and the GM determines the validity or this ability has no effect.  Does not work with crafting or gathering skills. This implement lasts until you have attempted the specific check it was created for.

You may also spend 1 RP instead of 1 AP for this ability.

Overcharge:  You can spend 1 additional mana to increase the skill bonus to +10.

All Abilities.Name: Transmute Terrain
All Abilities.Description:
Creates a connected transmuted terrain that grows from the point of origin.  For every mana spent, you can create up to 4 5ft squares of terrain that must be connected.  Choose solid ground normal terrain or difficult terrain.  Removes effects on the terrain such as ice, fire. The terrain can push objects and creatures in the direction its being created.  If the transmute terrain deals damage to a creature, the spell stops after and the 5ft segment that contacted them is destroyed.  Each segment of wall has HP equal to 20+Focus

Heroics caught in the terrain may spend 1 RP to step out of it. Once they do, they can't be shoved within this use of transmute terrain even if you attempt to hit them with it again.

All Abilities.Name: Transmute Wall
All Abilities.Description: You quickly transmute multiple walls to defend against an incoming ranged attack.   Each wall you summon reduces the damage of the incoming attack by 2* Focus, you can summon as many walls as you like against the incoming attack for 1 mana per wall. After the attack resolves, every wall you made vanishes regardless of remaining HP.
All Abilities.Requirements: You or an ally in range is the target of a ranged attack.

All Abilities.Name: Transmute Weapon
All Abilities.Description:
Using the available materials around you, you transmute any basic weapon or shield into your hand or next to an ally, your ally can grab the weapon at the time of its creation for 0 RP, as well as sheathe their weapons.  The weapon lasts until the end of the encounter and is destroyed.

You can transmute weapons out of special material if there is enough of it in the area, or if you have one (such as an ingot) but the material is destroyed afterwards.  The DM determines if this is possible in the specific case.
All Abilities.Requirements: There is suitable material available. (GM decides)

All Abilities.Name: Transmuter Tricks
All Abilities.Description:
Stabilize MatterDescription:Co-Craft. Use a transmutation that stabilizes the material, making it easier to work with. The next crafting d10 cannot roll lower than a 6.

A Small Bit of CreationCost:One herb with a rarity higher than common.Description:You deconstruct and reconstruct the structure of an harvested alchemy herb. By lowering its energy level you attune an herb to another element. Choose one herb and lower its rarity by one step and then change its element into the element of your choice.

All Abilities.Name: Trap Basics
All Abilities.Benefits: You may convert 100u of junk into a Trapper's Trap you can use for your abilities. You may do so as a Rest action or as an Errand action. Trapper's Traps are a special item that cost 1 burden., You may carry up to 3 Trapper's Traps without them costing Burden., When resting at your camp outdoors, you may set traps that will alert you to enemies approaching by using a rest action. These do not consume a Trapper's Trap,  but allow you to use Survival to detect enemies instead of Perception. After each of such rests, you obtain 1d10 x 5 food units.

All Abilities.Name: Traveler's End
All Abilities.Description:
You play the final tunes of the melody that signals the traveler’s ending.

While Traveler’s End remains active, the Potency of your Mist of the Vale and Despair of Isolation is increased by 3. Your Mist of the Vale can no longer be removed and any effect that would remove it instead dispels Traveler’s End.

At any point after activating this song, you may spend 1 RP and 5 Mana to make a Sure Hit Heavy attack against all enemies within your Mist of the Vale. On killing blow, you regain 1 mana you spend on the attack (up to 5). Afterwards, the Mist of the Vale ends and cannot be reused in this encounter.

Traveler’s End otherwise lasts until the end of the encounter or until the Mist of the Vale is gone.

Upkeep:1 Mana
All Abilities.Requirements: Mist of the Vale must be active for at least 1 turn.

All Abilities.Name: Tremorsense
All Abilities.Description:
You become aware of the presence and exact location of any creature within range that is touching the ground until the end of your turn.

Overcharge: You may spend extra mana to increase the range by an additional 40ft per mana spent.

All Abilities.Name: Trial By Fire
All Abilities.Description:
You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, they are challenged by you until the start of your next turn.

If this does not deal damage, they cannot be challenged by you until the start of your next turn.

All Abilities.Name: True Death
All Abilities.Description: Damage from melee weapon attacks made by you also reduces the target’s max HP by the same amount. This lasts until the end of the encounter.

All Abilities.Name: True Divine Release
All Abilities.Description: You unleash your latent angelic powers and transform into a semi-divine being for up to an hour. While transformed, you gain controlled flight and +5 movement speed.Upkeep:2 mana After using this ability, you cannot do so again until the interlude rest phase.
All Abilities.Requirements: Not already transformed

All Abilities.Name: Twin Verdict
All Abilities.Description: You make two Heavy attacks against the target.

All Abilities.Name: Twinkle Step
All Abilities.Description:
All allies within range gain a +1 Song bonus to their Evasion and Dodge.

Upkeep: 1 AP

All Abilities.Name: Two Point Strike
All Abilities.Description:
You may make a Light Attack against the target. On damage, you apply Wave Palm I.

Wave Palm increases the mana cost of the afflicted target’s next ability that uses mana by an amount equal to the amount of stacks applied. If the triggering attack makes the number of total stacks exceed the target's current mana, they lose mana equal to the amount of total stacks and take true damage equal to triple this amount. Wave Palm does not stack with itself, use only the higher value.

If the target has no mana, they immediately take true damage as if their stacks exceeded their current mana.

When the Wave Palm effect triggers, either by increasing the mana cost or by dealing the true damage, the Wave Palm effect is removed.

All Abilities.Name: Two Sword Crush
All Abilities.Description: You may add your Light damage to the attack.
All Abilities.Requirements: Can be used after hitting an attack with a Two-Handed melee weapon. Must be dual wielding.

All Abilities.Name: Uke Nagashi
All Abilities.Description: Roll Heavy Damage and treat that as your Guard against the attack that’s targeting you. If you reduce the damage to 0, the attacker becomes Unbalanced. On hit effects and maces do not gain their effect if you reduce the damage to 0. After the attack is resolved, you may immediately make an Iai Strike against the attacker for 0 RP. This Iai Strike gains the Sure Hit keyword against an Unbalanced target.
All Abilities.Requirements: Katana only, target of a melee attack and must be in the Iai state.

All Abilities.Name: Unconventional Weapon
All Abilities.Description: You may treat the weapon you’re currently wielding as a weapon of a different group for the next attack in addition to its normal group. In addition to receiving the base weapon properties of both weapon groups, this allows it to meet the requirements of abilities that require a certain group, and allows you to change its damage type to the chosen weapon’s damage type. The GM may rule that some abilities still cannot be performed with your equipped weapon.

All Abilities.Name: Undying Justice
All Abilities.Description: If the damage would reduce your HP to 0 or lower, it instead lowers your HP to 1.
All Abilities.Requirements: You take damage. Your HP is higher than 1.

All Abilities.Name: Unerring Aim
All Abilities.Description: When you aim at an object not being worn or wielded within your ranged weapon range, you always hit your target.

All Abilities.Name: Unholy Pact
All Abilities.Description: You remove yourBone Armorto heal yourself for Power x 2 and gain a +2 Power bonus on your next attack.
All Abilities.Requirements: Bone Armor is active on you.

All Abilities.Name: Unrelenting Assault
All Abilities.Description:
You may use this ability when an enemy willingly moves out of your melee weapon range to make a Heavy attack against them. You can use this even if they took the disengage action or a similar action that would not make them provoke attacks of opportunity. If the target uses a teleport type move, then you cannot use this ability, unless they Teleport into your weapon range.

This is treated as an opportunity attack.
All Abilities.Requirements: An enemy moves out of your range.

All Abilities.Name: Unsummon
All Abilities.Description:
Unsummon your Eidolon or Lesser Eidolon.  Recover mana equal to half of the mana cost of the summon cost.

You may use this as an Encounter Conclusion action.
All Abilities.Requirements: You have an active Eidolon or Lesser Eidolon.

All Abilities.Name: Vampire Bite
All Abilities.Description:
You may make a Light Attack against the target. On damage, you drain 1 mana from the target, recovering 1 mana yourself. If the target has no mana remaining, you instead deal an additional Light damage.

This unarmed strike must be made with your fangs, but may be made even with both hands full.

Damage done by this ability also reduces the target’s max HP until the target finishes a rest.

A target reduced to 0 HP by this ability is killed and if the target was a heroic unit, it has a chance (GM’s decision) to turn into a vampire subservient to you.

If the target has any mana remaining and is a willing target, you may choose to not deal damage with this attack.

All Abilities.Name: Vampire Shapeshift
All Abilities.Description:
You are able to change your form to that of a rat or bat.

While in this form, your size changes to that of the chosen animal and you are treated as a normal animal of that type. You cannot make any attacks or use any abilities while in this form.

You may exit this form at any time for 0 RP.

All Abilities.Name: Vampiric Domination
All Abilities.Description:
You mentally dominate the target. The target immediately considers you their master and they will serve you like a loyal servant. You may command them and they will obey most commands. Any command that is obviously suicidal or completely goes against their nature (for example: telling a servant to jump off a cliff or to kill their own child) will end the domination prematurely. This effect lasts until dispelled, they die or until you use Vampiric Domination on another target.

After the effect ends, the target will remember everything it was forced to do while it was your servant and it cannot be affected by Vampiric Domination again for a year.
All Abilities.Requirements: Target must be under the effects of Vampiric Fascination

All Abilities.Name: Vampiric Fascination
All Abilities.Description:
You charm a non-heroic creature within range. While charmed, the target must spend its AP during its turns on moving towards you in the most direct path possible while avoiding any dangers it is aware of. If it is already next to you, it instead takes no actions.

At the start of your next turn, you may spend 4 AP to continue the charm. If so, the charm continues until you stop paying the AP cost or until the target takes damage from an attack other than a Vampire Bite.

While you have a target under the influence of Vampiric Fascination, your Vampire Bite costs 0 AP and has Sure Hit plus Full Pierce against that target the first time you use it each turn.
All Abilities.Requirements: Target must be able to see or hear you, Target must be non-heroic.

All Abilities.Name: Vampiric Strength
All Abilities.Benefits: Your unarmed attack damage is treated as a One-Handed Weapon in which you are proficient. Your unarmed attacks cannot deal non-lethal damage., You may use the Vampire Bite ability.

All Abilities.Name: Vanish
All Abilities.Description:
You may immediately take the Hide action.

During the night, the mana cost of this is reduced by 1.

All Abilities.Name: Vengeance
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. If your VIP is at 0 HP or lower, this attack gains Lock On and Guard Crush.
All Abilities.Requirements: Your VIP was attacked last turn and you re-directed an attack from them to you or your VIP is downed.

All Abilities.Name: Verdant Instinct
All Abilities.Description: Make a gathering check. After rolling, roll two more dice that will be used as your next 2 strike dice values. You may reorder them or replace one with a 5.
All Abilities.Requirements: Must be in a gathering session.

All Abilities.Name: Versatile Range
All Abilities.Benefits: You may treat your polearm’s threatened range as 5ft instead of 5-10ft. You must declare this during your turn and it lasts until the start of your next turn.

All Abilities.Name: Victory or Death
All Abilities.Description:
All melee weapon attacks that you make this turn deal maximum damage on hit. All weapon attacks made against you until the start of your next turn also deal maximum damage on hit.

Once used, this cannot be used again until the end of the encounter.
All Abilities.Requirements: In rage stance.

All Abilities.Name: VIP Protection
All Abilities.Description:
You change the target of the attack to you instead of your VIP.

This attack automatically hits you and you may not use the Dodge and Block or similar reactions against it.

The re-directed attack is treated as having most the requirements met as if it was still targeting the original target, including effects that are conditional such as Full Pierce on a downed target, and you are considered to be in the original target's spot for the purposes of range of the attack you're re-directing.

GM's may rule some conditional effects are based on you rather than the original target, such as attacks with effects based on race.

Does not work against Attacks of Opportunity.
All Abilities.Requirements: Your VIP is within 5ft of you and is the target of an attack that does not target you as well.

All Abilities.Name: Vital Drain
All Abilities.Description: You make a Precise Attack against the target creature that deals Earth damage equal to their Toughnesswith Full Pierce.On damage the current host of Spore Symbiote is healed for the damage dealt.Vital Drain can be casted from the location of the host of your Spore Symbiote.

All Abilities.Name: Vital Drive
All Abilities.Description: You regain HP equal to 5 times the mana spent.

All Abilities.Name: Vital Drive II
All Abilities.Description: You regain HP equal to five times the mana spent. Vital Drive II cannot heal more than the damage you took from the triggering attack.
All Abilities.Requirements: You took damage from an attack.

All Abilities.Name: Vivisect
All Abilities.Description: You cut the target in half with your scissors or chainsaw, killing them instantly.
All Abilities.Requirements: Giant Scissors or Chainsaw only. Target is affected by Expose and is a grunt.

All Abilities.Name: Volley
All Abilities.Description: You make a Light attack against all targets in a 25x25ft area.

All Abilities.Name: Wall Formation
All Abilities.Description: Until the start of your next turn, every ally within range gainsWall Formation. If they are adjacent to another ally gains a +1 bonus to their guard and a +4 bonus to their block value.

All Abilities.Name: Wall Ride
All Abilities.Benefits: When you create a wall on your turn using your Geomancer or Geomaster abilities, you may move along the wall as it is created. You can jump off at any point of the wall creation, ending in an empty square next to the wall.

All Abilities.Name: Warm Together
All Abilities.Description: When you have “Just A Hug” active. You and the target gain resistance to cold from environmental effects.

All Abilities.Name: Warning Shot
All Abilities.Description: You fire a warning shot against a target in your range. Your next basic attack or Ricochet ability with a pistol against that target gains the Trick Attack keyword.

All Abilities.Name: Weapon Maintenance
All Abilities.Description:
You recall having previously assisted an ally in maintaining their weapon, causing it to be in top shape for battle. This weapon gains a +1 Power Artisan Bonus or +1 Focus Artisan Bonus. If you smithed the weapon it gains both. This Artisan bonus is considered the same bonus as from a weapon's material like Tamahagane and does not stack with it.

If the weapon you choose gets no bonus from this ability, it's critical range instead improves by 1. (A normal weapon now crits on a 19 and 20, a katana on a 18, 19 and 20).
All Abilities.Requirements: 1 Ally’s Smithed Weapon, or your own smithed weapon.

All Abilities.Name: Weighing the Heart
All Abilities.Description: You get a +5 Expertise bonus to insight checks when looking to discern if someone is lying to you.

All Abilities.Name: Weight of the Mountain
All Abilities.Description:
You prepare to strike with enhanced power.

Your next attack with a two-handed melee weapon this turn loses the keywords: Lock On and Sure Hit. In addition, you do not gain accuracy from your Focus on the enhanced attack. The attack also cannot benefit from Offstep and similar effects that guarantee the attack hits.

Instead, the attack deals extra damage equal to the accuracy lost from not gaining Focus due to Weight of the Mountain. If the attack is a heavy or precise attack, it deals extra damage equal to double the accuracy lost instead.

If the attack made with this effect already did not benefit from focus, this ability has no effect.

All Abilities.Name: Weight of the World
All Abilities.Description: You increase the target’s gravity, reducing their elevation by 40ft. This may interrupt movement and if you reduce their elevation down to 0, you slam them into the ground dealing fall damage for the distance they failed to move and knocking them prone.
All Abilities.Requirements: Target enemy is flying or jumping.

All Abilities.Name: White Thunder
All Abilities.Description: You target a Glacial Wall in range and fire a bolt of Frost energy that requires line of sight. On impact, the wall is destroyed and explodes into blades of ice, attacking all enemies within 5ft of the destroyed wall with a Precise attack that deals Frost damage. On damage, the target is Slowed until the end of their next turn.

All Abilities.Name: Wild Thrusts
All Abilities.Description:
You rapidly thrust your weapon in front of you, making a Light attack against all enemies in a 15ft wide, 10ft long box in front of you. Until the start of your next turn, you may make Attacks of Opportunity against any enemy walking through that box. You cannot make any other Attacks of Opportunity while this effect lasts.

You may cancel this effect for 0 RP.
All Abilities.Requirements: Polearm only.

All Abilities.Name: Wind Blast
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Light Attack that deals Wind against the target. On damage, you push the target back 20ft. Targets knocked into other characters or an object take damage as if they fell a distance equal to distance they failed to move.

All Abilities.Name: Wind Blast II
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Light (1 AP), Precise (2 AP) or Heavy Attack (2 AP) that deals Wind damage against the target. On damage, you push the target back 20ft.

All Abilities.Name: Wind Buffet
All Abilities.Description: You blow wind in a 30ft, 60ft degree cone in your chosen direction. All caught in the cone must make a save against your Potency or be blown back to the end of the cone and knocked Prone. Enemies with a size smaller than you suffer a 1d4 penalty to this roll, while enemies bigger than you get a 1d4 bonus instead. Targets knocked into other characters or an object take damage as if they fell a distance equal to distance they failed to move.

All Abilities.Name: Wind-Empowered Aim
All Abilities.Description: You projectWind-Empowered Aim auraaround yourself that empowers the ranged attacks of your allies. When a heroic ally within 20ft of you (including yourself) makes a ranged attack, they may add 1d4 to the accuracy roll.Upkeep:You must spend 1 AP at the start of each turn or the Aura fades.

All Abilities.Name: Wind Infusion
All Abilities.Description: You surround the willing target in protective winds, changing their typing to Wind II. As a Wind II type, they take regular damage from all other elements, but only half damage from Wind or Earth damage or from attacks with the Wind or Earth keyword unless that attack deals true damage. They take 50% more damage from Frost damage or attacks with the Frost keyword. While the ward lasts, they gain a +2 bonus to their Evasion against ranged weapon attacks. The ward lasts until the end of the encounter or until their type is overwritten by a more powerful type.

All Abilities.Name: Wind Master
All Abilities.Benefits: You gain Wind Mastery., You can use Glide.

All Abilities.Name: Wind Scatter
All Abilities.Description:
You select a point within range. All targets in a 15x15 area must make a save against Potency or be pushed back 15ft away from the point you selected.

Targets knocked into other characters or an object take damage as if they fell a distance equal to distance they failed to move.

All Abilities.Name: Wind Shield
All Abilities.Description: You grant the target  1 RP that must be spent on the basic Dodge or Block action against the triggering attack as well asWind Shield. Wind Shield grants a bonus to Dodge equal to your Focus against the triggering attack. The triggering attack can also no longer benefit from Lock On or Sure Hit
All Abilities.Requirements: Ally is targeted by a ranged attack.

All Abilities.Name: Wind-up Punch
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Heavy attack against the target.Overcharge:You may spend additional AP when using this ability to deal an additional Light Damage per AP used. Add all of this damage together before applying damage reduction from Guard or abilities.

All Abilities.Name: Wind Wall
All Abilities.Description: You create a wall of wind that is 30ft long, 5ft wide and 10ft high that slows down all ranged weapon attacks passing through it, treating them as having only half the normal range. This wall must be a straight line. These attacks also lose the Lock On, Sure Hit, Half Pierce, Guard Crush and Full Pierce keywords. In addition, the targets of those attacks are treated as having +2 Evasion and +1 Guard. Any Spells that are considered attacks (those that require an accuracy roll against a person that isn’t using the Block reaction) that pass through the wall also suffer this penalty.

All Abilities.Name: Wire Sweep
All Abilities.Description: You whip your wire to ensnare the target. If they fail their save against your Potency+2 they are rendered Prone and take Light Damage.
All Abilities.Requirements: Saboteur Threaded Dagger only.

All Abilities.Name: Wither the Stalk
All Abilities.Description:
You strike an enemy with an attack that saps their strength. You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, the target cannot add their Power for damage to their next attack.

Does not work against Boss enemies.
All Abilities.Requirements: Scythe only

All Abilities.Name: X-Attack
All Abilities.Description: You give your summon a +1 Focus and +1 Power buff.
All Abilities.Requirements: Can only target your summoned animal.

All Abilities.Name: Zap
All Abilities.Description: You may make a Light attack against the target, dealing Lightning damage. On damage, inflict Static X where X equals your Focus X 3.

All Abilities.Name: Zhen Jiao
All Abilities.Description: When you move toward an enemy as part of a Martial Artist or Bajiquan ability due to Fire Stance or an inherent move effect of the ability (such as Rushing Knee Drop), your attack deals three extra points of damage for every 5ft moved. If your attack hits more than once or more than one target, you only apply this damage once.

All Items.Name: Adjustable Lens Refractor Gun
All Items.Description: An artifice gun with cartridges that lets it fire blasts of arcane energy through a series of lenses rather than bullets. Attacks with this weapon deal Arcane damage. By spending 1 AP per lens, the user may adjust the strength of the gun at the cost of accuracy. Each lens adjusted for power lets the user treat their attacks with the weapon as if their power was 1 higher than it actually is, at the cost of their focus being treated as 1 lower than it actually is. Up to 3 lenses can be modified in this way. Exists in Musket and Sniper Rifle variants.Mods:Uses normal musket and sniper rifle mods.

All Items.Name: Advanced Surgery Kit
All Items.Description: Surgery kits contain stitches, bandages and other items used for more serious wounds.Rest Action: You perform minor surgery on an ally or yourself. Requires at least 5 points in Medicine (or a relevant expertise in Medicine) to use. Make a medicine check against DC 15. On success you can negate the effect of one injury suffered this campaign until the end of the campaign. An injury can only be negated once by this effect, and one person can only have one negated injury at a time. The injury must still be dealt with after the campaign ends.With an advanced surgery kit, you can heal two injuries from a single person instead of just one. The DC to heal two injuries is DC30.

All Items.Name: Adventurer's Kit
All Items.Description: Adventuring kits contain all of the basic tools for adventuring. Included in the kit: Backpack, Flint and steel, Rope, Notebook, Pen, Compass, Bedroll, Torches, Hand Mirror.Effect: You can use the items for their various purposes within reason. Can store up to 5 burden of Adventuring Essentials, a Northi Lantern or items included in this kit in a combat ready state for 0 burden and contains a torch/lantern holster for hands off torch/lantern use for light purposes. Cannot store kits or other burden reducing items in this combat ready state.

All Items.Name: Aerial Staff (Sparrow Model)
All Items.Description: The Sparrow Model Aerial Staff design is the most simple entry level Aerial Staff. It has a base speed of 20 feet and does not include integrated shielding or any weapon systems. Often used for training, its fuel efficiency is fairly high. Its user can use it to fly. It has a speed of a 20ft.Requires 1 hand to operate while flying.ModificationsA Modification, Jury-Rigged Shield. Adds a shield generator, granting the airship a 15 HP shield. This shield can be switched on and off, but can only be replenished by changing the fuel cell. A Modification, Jury-Rigged Cannon. Adds a small star cannon that fires an arcane blast from the front that deals heavy attack damage for 2 AP with 120ft Range. A Modification, Medivac Rig. Allows a downed ally to be hauled on the underbelly of the staff. But reduces the speed by 10ft while hauling. B Modification, Upgraded Airship Engine. Increases the speed to 50ft but adds Line Movement: The airship may only move in a straight line when making a movement action. B Modification, Sorthen Shield Generator. Requires Jury-Rigged Shield. Installs a Sorthen style Shield Generator increasing the shield value by 15 HP.

All Items.Name: Aetherie Sensory Station
All Items.Description: A large stationary artifice chair an Aetherie connects themselves to that drastically boosts Mind Connection range by 250 miles.

All Items.Name: Alchemist's Alembic
All Items.Description: Core crafting tool. Allows you to craft items as an alchemist.

All Items.Description: Alchemy Herbs:RarityFire Water Earth Wind Arcane Common 60 Clim 50 Clim 55 Clim 55 Clim 65 ClimRare 300 Clim 250 Clim 275 Clim 275 Clim 325 ClimMystic 600 Clim 500 Clim 550 Clim 550 Clim 650 ClimSupreme 1200 Clim 1000 Clim 1100 Clim 1100 Clim 1300 ClimAlchemy Herb MixingWhen crafting as an alchemist, you may add additional herbs and alchemy materials into the mix. By adding in an extra amount of alchemy units as well as the exact same herbs as the recipe needs, you get extra dice.Small Herb MixRequired extra's: 2x recipe's original cost.Effect: +1 Crafting DiceMedium Herb MixRequired extra's: 4x recipe's original cost.Effect: +2 Crafting DiceLarge Herb MixRequired extra's: 8x recipe's original cost.Effect: +3 Crafting DiceSupreme Herb MixRequired extra's: 14x recipe's original cost.Effect: +4 Crafting Dice

All Items.Name: Alchemy Rig (Deluxe)
All Items.Description: A carrier that allows easy access to Elixirs, Flasks, Potions, Poisons and Salves. You can only equip one alchemy rig at a time, whether it's the normal alchemy rig or the deluxe version.Stores up to 5 burden worth of Elixirs, Flasks, Potions and Salves.

All Items.Name: Alchemy Rig
All Items.Description: A carrier that allows easy access to Elixirs, Flasks, Potions, Poisons and Salves. You can only equip one alchemy rig at a time, whether it's the normal alchemy rig or the deluxe version.Stores up to 2 burden worth of Elixirs, Flasks, Potions and Salves.

All Items.Name: Anti-Air Weapon Sight
All Items.Description: An artifice designed to combat against aerial mages. Provides tracking assistance against the more predictable movement of air units. Attaches to ranged weapons. Increases the accuracy of weapon attacks against flying targets by +4 until the start of your next turn.Modifications:A Modification, Holographic Optic. Increases the accuracy against flying targets by +1B Modification, Wide Targeting. Decreases the accuracy bonus by -2 but now works on all targets.B Modification, Wing Outlining. Increases the aerial knockdown of the first attack made after activating by 20ft.

All Items.Name: Antidote Shot Potion
All Items.Description: Created with Goblin Medical Science, a universal antidote for all common poisons. Stored inside of a glass vial syringe that is injected into the body. When used, immediately removes a single common poison effect and grants immunity to that poison for the next hour.Crafting:Materials: 1400 Alchemy MaterialsHerbs:1x Mystic Earth1x Rare Water

All Items.Name: Armor (Clothing)
All Items.Description: A high quality set of clothing. Does not provide any bonuses by itself, but if crafted by an armorsmith, can accept Flamellon mods.Cannot be worn at the same time as regular armor.Mods:A modsReinforced Clothing (0 points): This clothing can benefit from material bonuses, but its burden is increased by 1.Mage Robes (20 points): You gain +1 maximum mana, but lose 1 guard.B modsCloud Robes (50 points): Your movement speed is increased by 5ft.Battle Casting (80 points): The first spell you cast each turn does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

All Items.Name: Armor (Heavy)
All Items.Description: Increases your Guard by 3 and your Block by 12, but reduces your Initiative by 3 and your Evasion and Dodge by 6.ModsA mods:Berserker Armor II (10 points): This armor reduces your RP by 3, but does not reduce your evasion and dodge.Fortress (20 points): Reduces the Initiative penalty by 1 and the Evasion/Dodge penalty by 2, but it also reduces the movement speed by 5ft.B mods:Deflecting Armor (25 points): An accuracy roll against you that rolls a 1 always misses.Beacon Armor (25 points): The guard of this armor is reduced by 1, but unarmored allies (except armor plates) within 40ft of you gain +1 guard.Weighted Greaves (50 points): You become immovable while on the ground.Titan Armor (50 points): You are treated as having a size category 1 step higher (maximum Large).

All Items.Name: Armor (Light)
All Items.Description: Increases your Guard by 1 and your Block by 4, but reduces your Initiative by 1 and your Evasion and Dodge by 2.Mods:A modsAgile Weave (35 points): No armor penalty, but no guard/block bonus. You gain +1 evasion (but no additional dodge).Acrobat's Harness (10 points): You gain +10 bonus to athletics while wearing this armor.Camo (10 points): Pick a color theme. You gain +5 to stealth when hiding in environments of that theme, but -5 when hiding elsewhere. A GM may approve new environments, defaults are: green camo (jungle, woodland, prone in grass), yellow camo (desert, savannas), white camo (snow, arctic), dark camo (night, caves, rocky terrain), blue camo (rivers or oceanic)B modsPorcupine Hide (25 points): Enemies grappling you take 1d6 full pierce damage. When escaping a grapple, you also deal 1d6 full pierce damage to the creature grappling you.Sleek (25 points): If you spend RP dodging an attack of opportunity, you may dodge any other attacks of opportunity made in reaction to the same action at the first for free.Padded (25 points): Increase guard vs light attacks by 1, doesn't affect heavy damage.Mistweave (50 points): You no longer provoke attacks of opportunity, but all attacks against you gain Half Pierce.

All Items.Name: Armor (Medium)
All Items.Description: Increases your Guard by 2 and your Block by 8, but reduces your Initiative by 2 and your Evasion and Dodge by 4.Mods:A mods:Berserker Armor (10 points): This armor reduces your RP by 2, but does not reduce your evasion and dodge.B mods:Chain Links (25 points): Increases the block gained from this armor by 4.Flexible Armor (50 points): When you take the Dodge action, your next Block gains a +8 bonus. When you take the Block action, your next Dodge action gains a +4 bonus. Lasts until the start of your next turn. Can activate multiple times per turn, but does not stack.

All Items.Name: Armor (Sensory Mage Suit)
All Items.Description: A skintight artifice suit with spirit circuit boosting conduits. Does not give any defensive benefits but boosts the range of Mind Connection and Scry by 10x. Also reduces the mana cost of Psychometry by 1.Catgirl not included in purchase.

All Items.Name: Armor Plates
All Items.Description: Can be attached to an armor to increase its guard, but make it bulkier.Gives the armor they are attached to +1 Guard (and +2 block), but increases the Burden of it by 3.Attaching it or removing it from an armor takes 10 minutes.Can be used together with other armor modifications. Can be put on regular clothing, but always requires an armor proficiency to have an effect. While you can wear multiple armor plates, the effect does not stack.Despite being craftable by an armorsmith, the item cannot be modified during crafting.

A mithril or primehide armor would thus give +1 evasion, dodge and guard as well as +2 Block.Shield: Each stat bonus gives a +1 dodge bonus or a +2 block bonus. All Items.Description: An Alchemical mix that splashes acid onto a target, making armor brittle. May be thrown up to 40ft away. When thrown, the target of the flask takes 1 damage. On contact, their armor value is reduced by 3 (min 0) until they spend 2 AP to wipe the substance of.Crafting:Materials: 450 Alchemy MaterialsHerbs:1x Rare Fire

All Items.Name: Counter-Magic Shackles
All Items.Description: Special Shackles that were created for restraining targets with high magic levels. They disrupt the shackled target’s magic circuits— making them unable to use any magic or mana abilities. Because of the nature of the magic circuit restriction, they can only be used on unconscious targets. Modifications:B Modification, Zero Suppression. Lowers the target’s visible aura to 0 while wearing these, making them difficult to locate by magical means.

All Items.Name: Crossbow (One-Handed)
All Items.Description: Armor Pierce: Treats the enemy's Guard as if it was 1 lower if within 30ft of the target.Range: 60ftModsA mods:Wrist-mounted (35 points): One handed crossbow only, range lowered to 30ft. Is mounted on your wrist and is always considered drawn + can hold a weapon in that hand.Windlass Arbalest (35 points): Two handed crossbow only. Basic attacks with this weapon gain full pierce within 30 ft. However must be reloaded for 2 AP or 1 RP before it can be used again.B mods:Extended Draw (50 points): Your armor piercing effect range is increased to 60ft. If combined with a wrist mounted crossbow, increases the range but not the armor piercing range to 60ft.Repeater (80 points): When you make 3 attacks with this weapon in 1 turn, you may make an additional light attack.

All Items.Name: Crossbow (Two-Handed)
All Items.Description: Armor Pierce: Treats the enemy's Guard as if it was 2 lower if within 30ft of the target.Range: 120ftModsA mods:Wrist-mounted (35 points): One handed crossbow only, range lowered to 30ft. Is mounted on your wrist and is always considered drawn + can hold a weapon in that hand.Windlass Arbalest (35 points): Two handed crossbow only. Basic attacks with this weapon gain full pierce within 30 ft. However must be reloaded for 2 AP or 1 RP before it can be used again.B mods:Extended Draw (50 points): Your armor piercing effect range is increased to 60ft.Repeater (80 points): When you make 3 attacks with this weapon in 1 turn, you may make an additional light attack.

All Items.Name: Culinarian Ingredients
All Items.Description: The base material for crafting food is Food Units. These units can be any kind of food/filler material for example:100u of Flour50u of Fish100u of NoodlesOther than that there are special materials used for making different cooking stocks:Box of Fresh Mushrooms (250c)Box of Fresh Meat (250c)Box of Fresh Fish (250c)Box of Fresh Vegetables (250c)Bundle of Spicy Peppers (250c)Bundle of Fresh Cooking Herbs (250c)In addition you can add special ingredients.King Chungus Fungus (1250 Clim / 30 Crafting Points)An extremely rare mushroom known for extreme deliciousness. Gives +1 Mana Regeneration to a Stock when eating food made with the stock.

All Items.Name: Culinary Kit
All Items.Description: Culinary Kits come with easily portable cooking knives, a pot and a pan and preserved food. Has a special compartment to draw the pan as a weapon in a pinch! The included pan isn't tough enough for a skilled chef, but good enough for a novice.Rest Action: You cook a meal for your party at the cost of 40 units of food (equal to 20 Clim) per person, giving you the benefits of food (2 mana) for the rest.

All Items.Name: Demonblood Potion
All Items.Description: Not actually made out of Demonblood, it refers to Demon tenacity. The potion is an intense stimulant that allows a character to fight through pain and injury. When drank, you ignore the penalties of one injury until the end of the encounter.Crafting:Materials: 250 Alchemy MaterialsHerbs:1x Rare Arcane1x Rare Fire

All Items.Name: Diamondize Potion
All Items.Description: Temporarily encases the user in hard crystal, rendering them nearly impervious to damage but incapacitating them in stasis. While in stasis, you cannot take any actions but all damage (including true damage) you take is reduced by 200. Lasts for 10 minutes and can be used while downed.Crafting:Materials: 4400 Alchemy MaterialsHerbs:1x Supreme Earth1x Mystic Arcane1x Mystic Water

All Items.Name: Displacement Potion
All Items.Description: When drunk, you teleport 40ft in a random direction (roll 1d8 to determine this, 1 being north and 5 being south etc). If this would place you inside a wall or otherwise occupied place, the teleport fails and the potion is wasted.Crafting:Materials: 350 Alchemy MaterialsHerbs:1x Rare Wind

All Items.Name: Dueling Weapon (One-Handed)
All Items.Description: Dueling: When attacking a single enemy during a turn at least 3 times with this weapon, your next Dodge or Block against that enemy costs 0 RP until the start of your next turn. This property cannot be used if you target any other enemy during your turn or if you spend AP making a Heavy attack against the target.ModsA mods:Spade Lunga (10 points): When moving at least 40ft towards an enemy, increases the range of your next attack made with this weapon by 5 ft.Ornate Blade (35 points): Moving into the target’s threatened zone the first time in a turn counts as 1 attack for the requirement to activate Dueling.B mods:Paired Duelers (25 points): When wielding two dueling weapons with paired duelers, your offhand extra attack counts as one attack for your dueling bonus on your main hand weapon.Passato Sotto (80 points): You may make 1 Heavy attack with this weapon and still gain the dueling effect.Ferrobri Grip (80 points): Dueling weapon passive changes to Aggressive Dueling: When attacking a single enemy 3 times with this weapon, your next basic attack has its cost reduced by 1 AP.

All Items.Name: Elemental Immunity Elixir
All Items.Description: An elixir that raises your resistance against a type of damage. When drunk, you take 11 true damage. You gain 10 damage reduction against a single type of damage, determined by the type of elixir. This lasts until the end of the encounter. There exist elixirs for Arcane, Fire, Water, Frost, Lightning, Wind, Earth, Holy and Dark resistance.Crafting:Materials: 1250 Alchemy MaterialsHerbs:3x Rare herb of matching element (Arcane for holy/dark, Wind for Lightning, Water for Frost)

All Items.Name: Elemental Mixture Flask
All Items.Description: A flask that when thrown explodes in a 15x15ft area dealing damage based on the type of flask. May be thrown up to 40ft away. You may make a light attack against all caught in the explosion area. The damage type of this is determined by the type of flask. There exist flasks that deal Arcane, Fire, Water, Frost, Wind, Lightning, Earth, Holy and Dark damage.Crafting:Materials: 0 Alchemy MaterialsHerbs:1x Rare herb of the element (Arcane for holy/dark, Wind for Lightning, Water for Frost)

All Items.Name: Elemental Resistance Elixir
All Items.Description: An elixir that raises your resistance against a type of damage. When drunk, you take 11 true damage. You gain 5 damage reduction against a single type of damage, determined by the type of elixir. This lasts until the end of the encounter.There exist elixirs for Arcane, Fire, Water, Frost, Lightning, Wind, Earth, Holy and Dark resistance.Crafting:Materials: 350 Alchemy MaterialsHerbs:1x Rare herb of matching element (Arcane for holy/dark, Wind for Lightning, Water for Frost)

All Items.Name: Elemental Weapon Artifice
All Items.Description: An artifice that sends energy through the weapon. The type is predetermined and can not be changed. The appearance and effect are based on the type. For example, a fire weapon might cover the weapon in flames and deal fire damage. When your attacks with this weapon deal damage, the type of damage they deal changes based on this weapon’s element. This effect lasts for 1 minute. Can only be applied to melee weapons.

All Items.Name: Equipment Patching Kit
All Items.Description: Contains all the necessary materials to jury rig a fix on damaged weapons.Rest Action: You can patch a broken piece of equipment, allowing it to be usable until the end of the scenario if it is repairable. The equipment still counts as broken at the end of the scenario and cannot be patched again until fully repaired.
