They are not heartless, but they value purpose above sentiment. Their sense of duty is absolute, and many of them refuse to step away from their warded locations, even when the world has long forgotten them.Some Nio now wander, their temples lost to time or desecrated by war. These unbounded Nio seek new causes or companions to protect, and may imprint upon individuals they deem righteous. Others serve monasteries or empires as living monuments, standing sentinel in gardens, courtyards, and graveyards alike.Nio adventurers lean towards frontline roles, many of them relying on their hardened skin to absorb blows. By nature, most of them are also more accustomed to using melee weapons or unarmed combat as statues with other weapons are simply less common.Those traveling with an Nio will find a reliable and loyal ally. Just don’t expect great conversations.“The world may forget. But I remain.”Size: M

Races.Name: Cowfolk
Races.Description: Cowfolk are a sub-race of Chimera, native to the rolling foothills around the northern mountains of Northi. Technically the same sub-race as Bullfolk, the extreme sexual dimorphism between Cowfolk and Bullfolk make them physically and visibly distinct. While Bullfolk tower over those around them with muscular builds, Cowfolk possess short and curvy figures. However, it is only the foolish that believe the dainty stature of Cowfolk is a vulnerability, as they are deceptively resilient and strong for their size.Cowfolk culture prizes bonds more than any one thing. Bonds between friends, family, and partners. If a Cowfolk offers you their honest friendship, it is a friendship they will maintain and protect fiercely. If they offer you their partnership, they will never stray. This level of devotion can be off putting to some as it is often devoid of any need or requirement for reciprocation. Sometimes, especially for those used to betrayal in their lives, it feels “too good to be true”. And many don’t get the full extent of their devotion until their Cowfolk friend follows them on a harrowing journey or stands defiantly in front of a monster to protect them. But beware betraying a Cowfolk that has formed that bond with you. Because it is not your friend you will have to worry about, but their family should they ever learn about it. When they settle in one place for long enough, Cowfolk often get incredibly domestic and there has never been an account of an uncomfortable or unwelcoming Cowfolk home. It doesn’t matter if it’s a home, an inn room, or a long term camp site, leave a Cowfolk in one place for long enough and you’ll begin to find trinkets, warm blankets, hand made cushions, and well stocked food supplies building up over time. However, they are rarely tied down to any location and will cheerfully pack everything up or even leave things behind to continue traveling.Cowfolk adventurers are almost always a friend joining someone they care for on a journey, although some simply travel from their homes for the sheer novelty of seeing the rest of the world. They often take up frontline roles to directly support or protect their friends as a sturdy foundation of any party’s composition.And most importantly: never, ever as a Cowfolk for her milk unless you share a very, very close bond with her.Female onlySize: M
Races.Abilities: Provide Milk; Dense Frame; Ruminant Metabolism

Races.Name: Dryad
Races.Description: Dryads, an enchanting subrace of the Fae, are deeply intertwined with the natural world, making them rare visitors beyond the verdant expanses of their forest homes. Predominantly hailing from the enchanted woods of Easter, a select few have established their presence in the forest territories of Susururu in Northi. While urban environments are seldom their preference, some Dryads venture into cities driven by necessity or purpose, often finding solace only in their work as they navigate the concrete jungles far from their beloved woodlands. Their existence is a harmonious blend of isolation and duty, maintaining a delicate balance between their innate connection to nature and the demands of the wider world.Central to Dryad culture is the sacred tradition of planting a new tree with each birth, symbolizing a celebration of life and the enduring bond within their communities. These family groves serve as living testaments to their heritage, meticulously tended by each generation to honor their lineage and the cycle of life. Regardless of where their paths may lead, Dryads are bound by an unwavering commitment to return and pay respects to their families, reinforcing the importance of kinship and continuity. Visually, Dryads are a breathtaking embodiment of nature's diversity, adorned with green or leafy hair, plant-like or wooden skin, and an array of natural features that reflect their individual connection to the flora around them. Playing a Dryad allows one to channel the grace and resilience of the forest, bringing a profound sense of harmony and natural beauty to any adventuring party.Size: Medium

Breakthroughs.Name: 8 Eyes (Spiderfolk)
Breakthroughs.Description: You may have up to 8 Mystic Eyes instead of the regular 2.

Breakthroughs.Name: Angelblooded (Human) (Restricted)
Breakthroughs.Requirements: Must be a human, only a human. Requires GM Approval
Breakthroughs.Description: You have the blood of angels in you. You may purchase the Angelblooded class.

Breakthroughs.Name: Arachne (Spiderfolk)
Breakthroughs.Requirements: Must be a spiderfolk. Can only be taken at character creation
Breakthroughs.Description:
You lose your extra arms racial ability. In exchange, you become Large size and your max burden is increased by 2. When attempting to move through 5ft wide spaces, it is considered difficult terrain for you and many humanoid buildings will struggle to accommodate you. You also suffer a -10 penalty to swimming checks, but you may climb through your spider climb ability at your normal speed instead of half speed.

In addition, you count as mounted for the purposes of abilities that require you to be mounted. This does not let you be a mount to other creatures.

Breakthroughs.Name: Become Fire (Salamander)
Breakthroughs.Description: The RP cost of Consume Fire is reduced to 0.

Breakthroughs.Name: Become Ice (Yuki-Onna)
Breakthroughs.Description: The RP cost of Absorb Ice is reduced to 0 the first time you use it per round. Cost is reset back to 0 when it becomes your turn

Breakthroughs.Name: Become Lightning (Raijin)
Breakthroughs.Description: The RP cost of Consume Lightning is reduced to 0 the first time you use it per round. Cost is reset back to 0 when it becomes your turn. Any Power bonus you gain from using Consume Lightning does not stack.

Breakthroughs.Name: Blend In II (Slimefolk)
Breakthroughs.Description: You may disguise as a different race in addition to your chosen race during Blend In. You may take this breakthrough multiple times, selecting a new race to disguise as each time.

Breakthroughs.Name: Blend In (Slimefolk)
Breakthroughs.Description: You disguise your appearance using magic to be that of another race (and gain a +30 bonus to hide this magical effect from things such as sense magic). This skill does not allow you to change your appearance at will, but instead lets you appear as you would as a different race.  You choose this race when this breakthrough is picked up and cannot change it.In addition, the first time you use Slime Body while disguised in this way, it costs 0 RP instead of 1 RP but reveals your actual race.  This effect does not work if the attacker knows that you are a Slimefolk.

Breakthroughs.Name: Blessed by Kari (Human)
Breakthroughs.Description: After using Divine Providence you may use it a second time before resting, but the cost increases to 1 RP. This second use must pick a different option then your first one.

Breakthroughs.Name: Bully
Breakthroughs.Description: You gain a +5 bonus to intimidation skill checks against targets with less Fitness than you.

Breakthroughs.Name: Celestial Dragon (Ryujin)
Breakthroughs.Requirements: Must be a Ryujin. Can only be taken at character creation
Breakthroughs.Description: Your elemental mastery from your Ryujin's Mastery may be Holy or Dark as well. In addition, you can use Flight.

Breakthroughs.Name: Combat Doggy (Cu Sith)
Breakthroughs.Description:
You may use abilities like normal while in Dog Form and may use One-Handed weapon. Any abilities that require a specific armor or other specific physical requirements still cannot be used.

Your Dog Form no longer breaks upon taking damage.

Breakthroughs.Name: Combat Kitty (Cait Sith)
Breakthroughs.Description:
You may use abilities like normal while in cat form and may use One-Handed weapon. Any abilities that require a specific armor or other specific physical requirements still cannot be used.

Your cat form no longer breaks on damage.

Breakthroughs.Name: Curse of Vampirism
Breakthroughs.Requirements: Must be taken at character creation or after being killed by a vampire's bite
Breakthroughs.Description:
You rise as a vampire, an immortal creature that feeds on the blood of living creatures andimmediately gain the Vampire racial style class and its key ability. Your race changes to ‘Vampire’, but you keep the benefits of your previous race.

As a vampire, you no longer age and your physical appearance changes slightly. Your skin becomes more pale and you grow a pair of fangs. You still need to eat, drink and breathe as normal.

A vampire’s spirit core is cracked, making it difficult for it to regenerate mana naturally and requiring it to obtain it from other creatures. You no longer regenerate mana from eating (including potions), resting and can no longer use the Draw Mana encounter conclusion action. You still recover full mana at the start of a new arc.

You are weak to sunlight. Every round you spend in sunlight without proper protection you take 10 true damage and your maximum HP is lowered by 10. Your maximum HP remains lowered until you finish a rest. You may carry a parasol or similar object in one hand to protect yourself from the sun and can do so even in combat.

In addition to these drawbacks, you no longer receive Wounds unless the damage that reduced your HP to 0 was fire, holy or true damage. You also gain 60ft Darkvision. Darkvision lets you see in total darkness, even if there's no source of light.

Breakthroughs.Name: Deep Connection
Breakthroughs.Description: You may command your mount to move and attack even if you're not mounted on it. This still using AP, Mana etc like normal as if you were mounted.

Breakthroughs.Name: Deus Ex Machina
Breakthroughs.Description: The first time you would die from a mortal wound at Encounter Conclusion, the mortal wound is removed and you instead receive a normal injury. The benefit of this breakthrough is then lost and you may not choose this breakthrough again after.

Breakthroughs.Name: Divine Luck I
Breakthroughs.Description: Once per rest, you may roll an additional dice when making a check and take the higher result.

Breakthroughs.Name: Divine Luck II
Breakthroughs.Requirements: Must have purchased Divine Luck I
Breakthroughs.Description: Once per arc, you may choose to automatically succeed on a check (if success is possible).

Breakthroughs.Name: Drag along (Lamia)
Breakthroughs.Description:
When you have a target under the effect of "Just a hug", you can still move at half of your normal movement speed while under theJust a hugroot effect and you still count as rooted for all other purposes.

When moving, you can drag along the target of Just a hug, but they still count as rooted at your new location.

In addition, your grapple power increases by +1.

Breakthroughs.Name: Dual Personality
Breakthroughs.Description:
Whether through magical or non-magical means, you have more than a single personality or entity within you through either physical or magical means. When under the influence of a Charm, Illusion or other mind-influencing effect you may spend 1 AP to switch personalities/entities and act as normal.

You may only do this once per encounter.

Breakthroughs.Name: Early Ascension
Breakthroughs.Requirements: Must be taken at character creation
Breakthroughs.Description: You are treated as having 1 class mastered for the purposes of selecting a tier 2 class that has “Any class mastered” or similar requirement. This does not apply to any class that requires a specific class to be mastered and it doesn't automatically qualify you for other requirements such as weapon proficiencies.

Breakthroughs.Name: Elemental Affinity
Breakthroughs.Description:
You gain Elemental Mastery in an element of your choice.

You may pick this breakthrough more than once, choosing a different element each time.

Breakthroughs.Name: Elemental Breath (Ryujin)
Breakthroughs.Description: You may let your Dragon Breath do the damage of any element that you have mastered.

Breakthroughs.Name: Elixir Addict
Breakthroughs.Requirements: Must have used at least 3 elixirs
Breakthroughs.Description:
You have become used to the effects of drinking elixirs, too used in fact. At the end of your turn in combat, if you do not have an Elixir active you take 6 true damage. The HP cost of drinking all elixirs is reduced by 11.

This breakthrough may be removed during an interlude phase by spending 1 IP.

Breakthroughs.Name: Fae Flash Acrobat (Fae)
Breakthroughs.Description: While using Fae Flash, you may teleport a partial distance and materialize there to redirect your teleport. In a single Fae Step, you may teleport multiple times, reappearing each time you stop, to teleport from that new position. You are still limited by your maximum teleport distance and cannot take any other actions between each teleport.

Breakthroughs.Name: Faerie-Chimera Hybrid (Race)
Breakthroughs.Requirements: Must be chosen at character creation. Must choose Faerie or Chimera race
Breakthroughs.Description:
An extremely rare condition in which a Chimera parent and a Faerie parent produces a child with Chimera traits. The odds are said to be less than 1%.

If your main race is Chimera, you may choose a Fae subrace instead of a Chimera one. If your main race is Fae, you may choose a Chimera subrace instead of a Fae one.

You do not get any of the base traits from the other race and keep the ones from your chosen main race. However, you do get the language from the other race (or a dialect of choosing a chimera subrace)

If you pick High Fae as your subrace, you gain Fae Flash instead of Fae Flash II.

Breakthroughs.Name: Faerie Flash Master (Fae)
Breakthroughs.Description: When using your Faerie Flash ability, you may spend X additional mana to increase your teleport distance by X times your movement speed.

Breakthroughs.Name: Fast Metabolism
Breakthroughs.Description: Once per arc you may eat food and gain the benefits even if you already had gotten the benefits from eating food that day.

Breakthroughs.Name: Fast Movement (Centaur)
Breakthroughs.Requirements: Must be Centaur or Arachne Spiderfolk
Breakthroughs.Description: Your base movement speed increases by 5ft.

Breakthroughs.Name: Fearless
Breakthroughs.Description: Whenever you are afflicted by a Fear type condition, you may spend 1 RP or 0 AP to remove it.

Breakthroughs.Name: Fight and Flight (Chimera)
Breakthroughs.Description: When using Fight or Flight, you no longer receive the drawback.

Breakthroughs.Name: Flesheater (Jiangshi)
Breakthroughs.Description: When using Consume Enemy, you may consider that your food for the day and regain mana equal to a normal ration. You cannot gain this benefit if you already regained mana from food that day and using this benefit prevents you from regaining mana from food until you’ve rested.

Breakthroughs.Name: Flying Counter (Kitsune)
Breakthroughs.Description: When using Fading Counter, you may move up to your movement speed instead of 5ft. This movement has Flight and still does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

Breakthroughs.Name: Four Paw Sprint (Catfolk)
Breakthroughs.Description: When spending at least 3 AP of movement, your base movement speed is increased to 40ft instead of 25.

Breakthroughs.Name: Greatshield Training
Breakthroughs.Requirements: You must be proficient with shields
Breakthroughs.Description: You gain proficiency with Greatshields.

Breakthroughs.Name: Heavy Armor Training
Breakthroughs.Requirements: You must be proficient with Light, Medium armor
Breakthroughs.Description: You gain proficiency with Heavy Armor.

Breakthroughs.Name: Hide Behind Ally (Pixie)
Breakthroughs.Description: When occupying the same space as a conscious ally that's at least a size bigger than you, you may choose to become untargetable to single target attacks. The ally must be willing to take the hits for you, though they may react to these attacks as normal. While occupying the same space as a conscious ally, any effect that triggers upon not being targeted by an enemy (such as Challenge) will not be triggered. Does not work against Attacks of Opportunity.

Breakthroughs.Name: Human-Chimera Hybrid (Race)
Breakthroughs.Requirements: Must be chosen at character creation. Must choose Human race
Breakthroughs.Description:
While most unions of Human and Chimera parents result in the offspring being fully of Human or fully of Chimera, there are rare instances in which the Chimera traits are still present in a human offspring.

Choose one Chimera Subrace and gain all of its features. You do not gain any of the Chimera base traits and instead have the Human ones, including Divine Providence. You do not get the 100 extra exp that humans normally get or human adaptability.

Breakthroughs.Name: Improved Demonic Divine Release (Demon)
Breakthroughs.Description:
When activating your divine release you may choose to reduce your max HP by 22. When you do, you do not pay any additional HP cost to activate it and the HP Upkeep is reduced to 0 while above 0 HP.

When you fall below 0 HP, you pay the increased Upkeep cost as normal.

Breakthroughs.Name: In Sync (Youkai)
Breakthroughs.Description:
After you use Spiritual Sync, you may cancel the effect for 0 RP at any time. If you do, you regain mana like it is described in the ability or 8 HP for each temporary mana you still had remaining.

In addition, the maximum mana or HP you can spend on Spiritual Sync is doubled.

Breakthroughs.Name: Kit Expert
Breakthroughs.Description: You may reduce the Burden cost of a single kit in your inventory by 2.

Breakthroughs.Name: Language Training
Breakthroughs.Description:
You learn a language of your choice. Rare, dead or similar languages may be unavailable (GM’s discretion).

You may take this breakthrough multiple times, picking a different language each time.

Breakthroughs.Name: Large Specimen (Nio, Bullfolk or Bearfolk)
Breakthroughs.Requirements: Must be a Nio, Bullfolk or Bearfolk
Breakthroughs.Description: Your size becomes Large.

Breakthroughs.Name: Light Armor Training
Breakthroughs.Description: You gain proficiency with Light Armor and shields.

Breakthroughs.Name: Light Sleeper
Breakthroughs.Description: When asleep, you may roll Perception rolls as if you were awake to be aware of danger approaching.

Breakthroughs.Name: Mark of Conflict
Breakthroughs.Requirements: Must be an Unknown Paladin that follows Eisen. Must have the Mark of Justice ability
Breakthroughs.Description:
The effect of your Mark of Justice changes to the following:

“You mark a single enemy, inflicting the Mark of Conflict on them. If an enemy spends AP or RP to move away from you and not towards another ally, they take Full Pierce physical damage equal to your Power for each AP or RP they spent walking away from you.”

The range and AP cost remain the same.

Breakthroughs.Name: Medium Armor Training
Breakthroughs.Requirements: You must be proficient with Light Armor
Breakthroughs.Description: You gain proficiency with Medium Armor.

Breakthroughs.Name: Mental Torture (Unseelie)
Breakthroughs.Description: When you roll a natural 20 on your accuracy roll, you may apply the effects of Torture Techniques even if the enemy Dodges or Blocks it.

Breakthroughs.Name: Mixed House (Demon)
Breakthroughs.Description: You choose another house to gain the benefit of.

Breakthroughs.Name: Mystic Eyes of Faerie Light (Fae)
Breakthroughs.Description:
Your Fae eyes have developed into the Eyes of Faerie Light.  You may purchase the Faerie Light Eyes class.

In addition, you can make a Perception check at +10 bonus to determine if something is an illusion. You are not immune to these illusions however.

Breakthroughs.Name: Natural Immunity (Ratfolk)
Breakthroughs.Description: When you successfully resist the effect of a disease or poison (or are immune to the effect), you may choose to become afflicted anyway. You suffer no effects from a disease or poison you choose to accept this way. This poison or disease lasts the normal duration or until the end of the encounter, whichever is shorter.

Breakthroughs.Name: On the draw
Breakthroughs.Description: You gain +1 to your initiative.

Breakthroughs.Name: Organized Inventory
Breakthroughs.Description: Increases your in-combat burden capacity by 1.

Breakthroughs.Name: Organized Inventory II
Breakthroughs.Requirements: Must have the Organized Inventory breakthrough
Breakthroughs.Description: Your in-combat Burden capacity is increased by 1.

Breakthroughs.Name: Organized Inventory III
Breakthroughs.Requirements: Must have the Organized Inventory II breakthrough
Breakthroughs.Description: Your in-combat Burden capacity is increased by 1.

Breakthroughs.Name: Overrun (Centaur)
Breakthroughs.Description: When using the Charge or Spear Charge ability your movement speed is increased by 5ft and if your attack made through the Charge ability does damage, it knocks the target prone.

Breakthroughs.Name: Panda Martial Arts (Red Panda)
Breakthroughs.Description:
You can be in Panda stance at the same time as another stance without either stance ending.

Other rules for stance breaking (such as entering 2 non-panda stances) still apply.

Breakthroughs.Name: Photosynthesis (Dryad)
Breakthroughs.Description: By spending at least an hour in the direct sunlight, you may gain the benefits of having eaten food and you do not need to eat or drink for the next 24 hours.

Breakthroughs.Name: Power Saving Mode (Ancient Marionette)
Breakthroughs.Description: If you are at maximum mana during your meal, you only need to consume half the normal amount to be well fed.

Breakthroughs.Name: Powerful Ki (Oni)
Breakthroughs.Description: When using Gravitational Ki, the range increases by 30ft. The push and pull distance increases by up to 10ft. In addition, you may spend 1 AP instead of 1 RP on it.

Breakthroughs.Name: Primary Stat Training
Breakthroughs.Description:
You gain a +1 bonus to Focus, Power, Agility or Toughness.

This breakthrough can be selected multiple times. The effects stack. Each time you take this breakthrough the cost increases by 100, up to a maximum of 700.

Breakthroughs.Name: Racial Flight
Breakthroughs.Requirements: Must be Phoenix, Mothfolk, Lizardfolk or Willowisp race
Breakthroughs.Description: You may use Flight.

Breakthroughs.Name: Rapid Flash (High Fae)
Breakthroughs.Description: Your Fae Flash gains the Rapid keyword.

Breakthroughs.Name: Rich Parents
Breakthroughs.Requirements: Must be taken at character creation
Breakthroughs.Description: You start the game with an additional 3000 Clim of funds.

Breakthroughs.Name: Secondary Stat Training
Breakthroughs.Description:
You gain a +1 bonus to Fitness, Cunning, Reason, Awareness or Presence.

This breakthrough can be selected multiple times. The effects stack.

Breakthroughs.Name: Skill Training
Breakthroughs.Description:
You gain a single skill point or two expertise points to spend on a skill. Crafting skills cannot be selected with this training.

You may select this breakthrough multiple times. Its effects can stack.

Breakthroughs.Name: Skilled Flier
Breakthroughs.Requirements: Must have Flight racial ability or Racial Flight breakthrough
Breakthroughs.Description:
When you are about to lose Height from taking damage due to your Flight ability, you may instead spend 3 Mana to negate losing height from the flight mechanic until the start of your next turn.

Abilities that make you lose height not part of the Flight ability (such as downburst) may still knock you out of the air.

Breakthroughs.Name: Slime Summoner
Breakthroughs.Requirements: Must be a mastered Animal Summoner
Breakthroughs.Description:
When using the Summon Animal ability, you may instead choose to summon slimes. You roll randomly from the following slimes: Slime, Fire Slime, Earth Slime, Water Slime, Wind Slime or Mana Slime.

Even if you have the Wildheart class, you still cannot choose which slime you summon except you may choose to summon the regular Slime.

Breakthroughs.Name: Slow Starter
Breakthroughs.Requirements: Must be taken at character creation
Breakthroughs.Description: You receive 200 less EXP at character creation to spend on classes and abilities. Every time you get EXP after character creation, you get twice as much. This lasts until you’ve received a total of 500 (1000 when doubled) exp.

Breakthroughs.Name: Small Doggy (Cu Sith)
Breakthroughs.Description: When you enter your Dog Form, you become a small dog instead. Instead of the usual bonuses and penalties, you instead lose 4 guard and 8 Block but gain a +2 Size bonus to Evasion and Dodge.

Breakthroughs.Name: Small Specimen (Cowfolk)
Breakthroughs.Requirements: Cowfolk only. Must be taken at character creation
Breakthroughs.Description: Your size is Small instead of Medium.

Breakthroughs.Name: Speciality Weapon Training
Breakthroughs.Description:
You gain proficiency with a Speciality Weapon group.

This breakthrough can be selected multiple times. You must select a different weapon group each time you select it.

Breakthroughs.Name: Summon Contract: Fortuna, Lady Luck
Breakthroughs.Requirements: Must be a summoner, have visited the eidolon
Breakthroughs.Description:
Appearance: Fortuna appears as a beautiful lady wearing clothing of the highest quality. Her clothes change each time she appears, but she always carries with her a parasol designed like a roulette wheel.Desires: Fortuna desires to see gambling. To have people bet their all on impossible odds.Pact Cost: You can never naturally roll 20 again. Every 20 you roll is reduced to 19.Attunement Cost:NoneRe-Summon Cost: Roll a natural 20 (before the pact cost reduces it) on an attack or skill check with consequences for failure (GM’s decision).

When you contract Fortuna, you are able to attune to it. While attuned, you gain access to the Draw Luck ability through your Channel Eidolon ability. You summon the Jack of Hearts for your Lesser Eidolon and Fortuna for your Eidolon (The stats for these are listed under monsters).

Breakthroughs.Name: Summon Contract: Ixilune, The Swarm
Breakthroughs.Requirements: Must be a summoner, have visited the eidolon
Breakthroughs.Description:
Appearance:Hot bug lady.Desires:Ixilune desires to consume everything.Pact Cost:You need to eat 1.5x as much food to be fed.Attunement Cost:NoneRe-Summon Cost:Must eat the flesh of a creature of the same (main) race.

When you contract Ixilune, you are able to attune to it. While attuned, you gain access the Distracting Swarm ability through your Channel Eidolon ability. You summon the Devouring Swarm for your Lesser Eidolon and Ixilune for your Eidolon. (The stats for these are listed under monsters.)

Breakthroughs.Name: Summon Contract: Pipoltr, The Gardener
Breakthroughs.Requirements: Must be a summoner, have visited the eidolon
Breakthroughs.Description: When you contract Pipoltr, you are able to attune to it. While attuned, you gain access the Vine Wall Cover ability through your Channel Eidolon ability. You summon the Rhinoceros Beetle for your Lesser Eidolon and Pipoltr for your Eidolon. (The stats for these are listed under monsters.)

Breakthroughs.Name: Superior Escapist (Rabbitfolk)
Breakthroughs.Description: You may use your Escape Artist when Rooted to remove it in addition to grapples.

Breakthroughs.Name: Tengu Defensive Aura (Tengu)
Breakthroughs.Description: Your resistance to astra corruption is increased by 1 (Your SC is treated as 500 higher when determining if you suffer from astra corruption). In addition, you do not suffer any negative effects when the astra level is raised artificially. (such as from Exousiai's).

Breakthroughs.Name: The Unknown Paladin
Breakthroughs.Description: Despite not being human, you fulfill the human requirement to become a Paladin. In addition, your Smite skill's damage type changes to one that represents your chosen Divine. The paladin holy weapon key ability also changes its damage type to the one that represents your chosen Divine (all physical in the case of Eisen).

Breakthroughs.Name: Touched by Death
Breakthroughs.Requirements: Must be taken at character creation or after your HP has dropped below 0 in an encounter
Breakthroughs.Description:
Near-death experiences sometimes leave people more sensitive to death itself, manifesting in what is called the Shinigami’s Eyes. You may purchase the Shinigami Eyes class.

In addition, you may spend 1 AP to see the HP percentage and weak spots (if any) of all creatures for 1 turn.

Breakthroughs.Name: Universal Training
Breakthroughs.Description:
You gain +1 to any primary stat, +1 to any secondary stat and 5 skill points. You may put these skill points into any normal skill, except crafting and gathering skills.

This breakthrough may be taken multiple times. The effects stack.

Breakthroughs.Name: Weapon Training
Breakthroughs.Description:
You gain proficiency with a weapon group. You may not select Speciality Weapons with this.

This breakthrough can be selected multiple times. You must select a different weapon group each time you select it.

Breakthroughs.Name: Wide Circuits I
Breakthroughs.Description: Your maximum mana increases by 1.

Breakthroughs.Name: Wide Circuits II
Breakthroughs.Requirements: Must have the Wide Circuits breakthrough
Breakthroughs.Description: Your maximum Mana is increased by 1.

Breakthroughs.Name: Wide Circuits III
Breakthroughs.Requirements: Must have the Wide Circuits II breakthrough
Breakthroughs.Description: Your maximum Mana is increased by 1.

Breakthroughs.Name: Wide Circuits IV
Breakthroughs.Requirements: Must have the Wide Circuits III breakthrough
Breakthroughs.Description:
Your maximum Mana is increased by 1.

You may take this breakthrough multiple times. The effects stack.

Breakthroughs: You may have up to 8 Mystic Eyes instead of the regular 2.
Must be a human, only a human. Requires GM Approval
You have the blood of angels in you. You may purchase the Angelblooded class.
Must be a spiderfolk. Can only be taken at character creation

You lose your extra arms racial ability. In exchange, you become Large size and your max burden is increased by 2. When attempting to move through 5ft wide spaces, it is considered difficult terrain for you and many humanoid buildings will struggle to accommodate you. You also suffer a -10 penalty to swimming checks, but you may climb through your spider climb ability at your normal speed instead of half speed.

In addition, you count as mounted for the purposes of abilities that require you to be mounted. This does not let you be a mount to other creatures.
The RP cost of Consume Fire is reduced to 0.
The RP cost of Absorb Ice is reduced to 0 the first time you use it per round. Cost is reset back to 0 when it becomes your turn

The RP cost of Consume Lightning is reduced to 0 the first time you use it per round. Cost is reset back to 0 when it becomes your turn. Any Power bonus you gain from using Consume Lightning does not stack.
You may disguise as a different race in addition to your chosen race during Blend In. You may take this breakthrough multiple times, selecting a new race to disguise as each time.

You disguise your appearance using magic to be that of another race (and gain a +30 bonus to hide this magical effect from things such as sense magic). This skill does not allow you to change your appearance at will, but instead lets you appear as you would as a different race.  You choose this race when this breakthrough is picked up and cannot change it.In addition, the first time you use Slime Body while disguised in this way, it costs 0 RP instead of 1 RP but reveals your actual race.  This effect does not work if the attacker knows that you are a Slimefolk.
After using Divine Providence you may use it a second time before resting, but the cost increases to 1 RP. This second use must pick a different option then your first one.
You gain a +5 bonus to intimidation skill checks against targets with less Fitness than you.
Must be a Ryujin. Can only be taken at character creation
Your elemental mastery from your Ryujin's Mastery may be Holy or Dark as well. In addition, you can use Flight.

You may use abilities like normal while in Dog Form and may use One-Handed weapon. Any abilities that require a specific armor or other specific physical requirements still cannot be used.

Your Dog Form no longer breaks upon taking damage.

You may use abilities like normal while in cat form and may use One-Handed weapon. Any abilities that require a specific armor or other specific physical requirements still cannot be used.

Your cat form no longer breaks on damage.
Must be taken at character creation or after being killed by a vampire's bite

You rise as a vampire, an immortal creature that feeds on the blood of living creatures andimmediately gain the Vampire racial style class and its key ability. Your race changes to ‘Vampire’, but you keep the benefits of your previous race.

As a vampire, you no longer age and your physical appearance changes slightly. Your skin becomes more pale and you grow a pair of fangs. You still need to eat, drink and breathe as normal.

A vampire’s spirit core is cracked, making it difficult for it to regenerate mana naturally and requiring it to obtain it from other creatures. You no longer regenerate mana from eating (including potions), resting and can no longer use the Draw Mana encounter conclusion action. You still recover full mana at the start of a new arc.

You are weak to sunlight. Every round you spend in sunlight without proper protection you take 10 true damage and your maximum HP is lowered by 10. Your maximum HP remains lowered until you finish a rest. You may carry a parasol or similar object in one hand to protect yourself from the sun and can do so even in combat.

In addition to these drawbacks, you no longer receive Wounds unless the damage that reduced your HP to 0 was fire, holy or true damage. You also gain 60ft Darkvision. Darkvision lets you see in total darkness, even if there's no source of light.
You may command your mount to move and attack even if you're not mounted on it. This still using AP, Mana etc like normal as if you were mounted.

The first time you would die from a mortal wound at Encounter Conclusion, the mortal wound is removed and you instead receive a normal injury. The benefit of this breakthrough is then lost and you may not choose this breakthrough again after.
Once per rest, you may roll an additional dice when making a check and take the higher result.
Must have purchased Divine Luck I
Once per arc, you may choose to automatically succeed on a check (if success is possible).

When you have a target under the effect of "Just a hug", you can still move at half of your normal movement speed while under theJust a hugroot effect and you still count as rooted for all other purposes.

When moving, you can drag along the target of Just a hug, but they still count as rooted at your new location.

In addition, your grapple power increases by +1.

Whether through magical or non-magical means, you have more than a single personality or entity within you through either physical or magical means. When under the influence of a Charm, Illusion or other mind-influencing effect you may spend 1 AP to switch personalities/entities and act as normal.

You may only do this once per encounter.
Must be taken at character creation

You are treated as having 1 class mastered for the purposes of selecting a tier 2 class that has “Any class mastered” or similar requirement. This does not apply to any class that requires a specific class to be mastered and it doesn't automatically qualify you for other requirements such as weapon proficiencies.

You gain Elemental Mastery in an element of your choice.

You may pick this breakthrough more than once, choosing a different element each time.
You may let your Dragon Breath do the damage of any element that you have mastered.
Must have used at least 3 elixirs

You have become used to the effects of drinking elixirs, too used in fact. At the end of your turn in combat, if you do not have an Elixir active you take 6 true damage. The HP cost of drinking all elixirs is reduced by 11.

This breakthrough may be removed during an interlude phase by spending 1 IP.

While using Fae Flash, you may teleport a partial distance and materialize there to redirect your teleport. In a single Fae Step, you may teleport multiple times, reappearing each time you stop, to teleport from that new position. You are still limited by your maximum teleport distance and cannot take any other actions between each teleport.
Must be chosen at character creation. Must choose Faerie or Chimera race

An extremely rare condition in which a Chimera parent and a Faerie parent produces a child with Chimera traits. The odds are said to be less than 1%.

If your main race is Chimera, you may choose a Fae subrace instead of a Chimera one. If your main race is Fae, you may choose a Chimera subrace instead of a Fae one.

You do not get any of the base traits from the other race and keep the ones from your chosen main race. However, you do get the language from the other race (or a dialect of choosing a chimera subrace)

If you pick High Fae as your subrace, you gain Fae Flash instead of Fae Flash II.
When using your Faerie Flash ability, you may spend X additional mana to increase your teleport distance by X times your movement speed.
Once per arc you may eat food and gain the benefits even if you already had gotten the benefits from eating food that day.
Must be Centaur or Arachne Spiderfolk
Your base movement speed increases by 5ft.
Whenever you are afflicted by a Fear type condition, you may spend 1 RP or 0 AP to remove it.
When using Fight or Flight, you no longer receive the drawback.

When using Consume Enemy, you may consider that your food for the day and regain mana equal to a normal ration. You cannot gain this benefit if you already regained mana from food that day and using this benefit prevents you from regaining mana from food until you’ve rested.
When using Fading Counter, you may move up to your movement speed instead of 5ft. This movement has Flight and still does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
When spending at least 3 AP of movement, your base movement speed is increased to 40ft instead of 25.
You must be proficient with shields
You must be proficient with Light, Medium armor
You gain proficiency with Heavy Armor.

When occupying the same space as a conscious ally that's at least a size bigger than you, you may choose to become untargetable to single target attacks. The ally must be willing to take the hits for you, though they may react to these attacks as normal. While occupying the same space as a conscious ally, any effect that triggers upon not being targeted by an enemy (such as Challenge) will not be triggered. Does not work against Attacks of Opportunity.
Must be chosen at character creation. Must choose Human race

While most unions of Human and Chimera parents result in the offspring being fully of Human or fully of Chimera, there are rare instances in which the Chimera traits are still present in a human offspring.

Choose one Chimera Subrace and gain all of its features. You do not gain any of the Chimera base traits and instead have the Human ones, including Divine Providence. You do not get the 100 extra exp that humans normally get or human adaptability.

When activating your divine release you may choose to reduce your max HP by 22. When you do, you do not pay any additional HP cost to activate it and the HP Upkeep is reduced to 0 while above 0 HP.

When you fall below 0 HP, you pay the increased Upkeep cost as normal.

After you use Spiritual Sync, you may cancel the effect for 0 RP at any time. If you do, you regain mana like it is described in the ability or 8 HP for each temporary mana you still had remaining.

In addition, the maximum mana or HP you can spend on Spiritual Sync is doubled.
You may reduce the Burden cost of a single kit in your inventory by 2.

You gainAbsorb Ice, which gives you Damage Reduction 100 Frost against the triggering damage. After the damage resolves, if the caster is not you, someone allied to you or from an effect made by you or an ally, you gain Temporary HP until the end of the encounter equal to the amount of damage this ability reduces.
You're about to take Frost Damage.
Grant yourself or an ally +4 initiative.
You make a Heavy Attack against the target. Afterwards, you gainAccelerating Strike, which increases your Initiative by up to 2.

You gain proficiency in light armor, shields and a single common group of weapons. This group may include Channeling Weapons, even though they aren't consider common weapons. (But you only get 1 of the possible channeling weapons)., You gain +5 skill points in the Religion skill., You are welcome at establishments for your religion and they are obligated to help you with lodging, advice, food and sometimes equipment.

You take the Block Action. You then gain 4 Adaptive Defense (Type) which grants you Damage Reduction 4 against that damage type until the end of your next turn. You can only have one instance of Adaptive Defense at a time.
You gain Artificer Advanced Crafting Abilities
You add a second A-Type modification to an artifice. See the individual artifice to see if modifications are available.
You add a B-Type modification to an artifice. See the individual artifice to see if modifications are available.
You expertly create the artifice hookup, reducing the artifice weight burden by a further 1 to a total minimum of 0.5.
You add an B-Type modification to the weapon. See the Universal Weapon or Crafting mods page as well as the individual weapon page for details. Each modification has its own cost.

You gain proficiency in 1 common weapon group. In addition, you gain proficiency in 1 common or specialized weapon groups., You gain proficiency in 1 armor category of your choosing. Alternatively, you may pick the shield or greatshield., You may use Presence Concealment.
You and your mount crash down on the target. You move towards the target and your mount makes a Heavy attack against it. On damage, the target is knocked prone.
You are mounted on a flying mount and the target is at least 20ft below you.
You and your mount take the Dodge action and gain a +5 bonus to evasion against the attack.

You create a personalized Artificer’s Glove that only you have proficiency with.  Choose a glove type with properties of your choosing at the time of creation.  You can modify this glove for an errand action to change the property, but you can only have one property at a time and only one Artificer’s glove at a time.

Gamma Glove (Hacker):Artifice Jamming. For 1 RP you can Jam a small shell artifice within 120ft causing it to malfunction and be unusable until the user spends 1 AP to clear the jam.

Sigma Glove (Combat Artificer):Heat Sink.  0 RP, 1 mana.  Your glove emits frost energy that saps heat from an artifice, allowing it to bypass the once per turn limit a single time.Overcharge:1 RP, the mana cost becomes 0.

Delta Glove (Specialist):The glove is specialized for an expertise skill granting you +10 in that skill.  For instance, it might fire an arcane blast to propel you, granting you +10 to jumping. May not choose artisan or gathering skils.

Errand. You turn up to 1000u of food into 25 Pemmican Bars (40u of food per bar), which are incredibly shelf stable and easy to eat.  They perform about the same as Military Rations but they are wrapped by special leaves that deter pests—useful and consistent adventure food.

You may also use this as an IP action to convert up to 2000u of food into 50 Pemmican bars.

Creates a wave of water originating from a point of water within range.  Shoves an adjacent target of size large or smaller 10ft away from the point of origin.  If the target is on top of the water, you can choose to shove the target in any direction.  You can use either AP or RP for the cost of this ability.

You may create a talisman or scroll by spending an interlude point. Choose an Spell that you know or choose a specialized talisman, such as a Sealing Talisman. You inscribe that Spell onto a piece of paper. A talisman of a Spell allows you to use the Spell at a different time. When you use it, it is consumed. A Spell talisman costs as much AP and mana to use as the original Spell does.

You may craft up to 5 talismans per interlude point. A secret art talisman takes up 3 of these slots. When crafting, you may make no more than 2 of the same spell. A crafted talisman costs 1 burden to carry with you. A Secret Art talisman costs 2 burden and can only be used through the Secret Talisman ability.

Crafting a talisman costs 100 calligraphy units per AP and Mana of the spell. A spell with no AP or Mana costs 50 units. If the spell has an RP cost and no AP cost, it costs 200u per RP. If the spell has a casting time longer than 4 AP (ie 10 minutes), then treat the spell as having a cost of 4 AP.

You make a light attack that deals Holy(Light) to any targets in a 5ft wide line. At any point of the line you can draw a second 55ft long perpendicular line centered on that point of the initial line. You make another Light attack against all caught on this second line and on damage you inflict Illumination X where X is your Focus / 2 (Rounded Down) until the end of your next turn.

If a target gets hit by both lines, the second line deals Heavy damage and inflicts your full Focus in Illumination instead.

You can create a pocket dimension with Dimensional Armory.  Creating the pocket dimension and establishing its door takes 1 week and costs 1 errand point. This closet can hold up to 6 Burden worth of items.  Some magic items can be rejected by the dimensional armory (GM’s discretion), such as Divine Arms not bonded to you.  If the owner of a Dimensional Armory dies, everything inside of it appears in the next unoccupied space possible next to the owner.

Your burden limit for your Dimensional Armory is increased by 4.  Ahead of time, you designate one armor, one cloak and one weapon/shield or two weapons or one two-handed weapon that are inside of your Dimensional Armory as a “dimensional set”, this process takes 15 minutes of concentration.  You can only have one dimensional set at a time.

Health: The ally may spend 2 Mana to heal for 15 HP.

Mana: The ally recovers 1 Mana. This counts as a character’s one food for the day and a character cannot benefit from this ability if they already had food. Does not count as a meal for the purposes of fending of starvation.

You keep the tray of snacks up for 1 turn and a character walking within 5ft of you while it’s up may also spend the 0 RP to eat a snack.

Allies may also spend 0 AP to eat another snack. They can do this once per turn.

Upkeep:1 Mana, you keep the tray up for an additional turn.
You may make a Heavy Attack against the target with a ranged weapon or a thrown weapon. You do not add your Focus to the accuracy roll.
You may make a Light Attack against the target. You do not add your focus to this roll.

You may use this when a target in range uses the interact with object action. If you can hold the object the target is interacting with in one hand, you steal it from them.

Any AP they may have spent on their action is not refunded to them.
You may make a Heavy Attack against the target.
You gain proficiency in Sniper Rifles., If you did not move this turn or the previous turn you gain a +1d4 Snipe bonus to your accuracy roll on attacks made with a Sniper Rifle.

You shine brightly like the sun in a 60ft radius around you. You cannot turn this off, but you can lower the range to just 5ft. This light counts as sunlight, though any negative effects a creature suffers from it are halved. It also counts as bright light for creatures weak to light.
You may have 1 additional song active at the same time., You learn the language 'Music'.
Spell, Dark, Full Pierce, Sure Hit

You make a Light Attack against a willing target that deals Light Dark damage. Your next Dark type Spell or Attack other than Soul Absorption gains extra damage equal to damage taken by the target. (Does not stack)

When you acquire this ability, choose 1 willing person. That person is treated as your Soulmate and several of the class abilities only work on your Soulmate. This cannot be changed unless your Soulmate dies., Your Soulmate is always treated as your VIP for any bodyguard abilities. You may still designate another VIP as normal.

After landing a killing blow, you can use Soul Strike once on that target.  If they are still at 0 HP or less, you raise an orb of divine energy out of the target, killing them instantly.  You then use that orb against a second target, making a light attack that deals dark damage.  It is possible to use Soul Strike while in Cat Form.Overcharge:You may spend 1 extra AP to instead deal heavy damage.
You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. On Killing Blow, you instantly kill the target and immediately cast Raise Undead on the target for 0 AP.
You sidestep 4 times your speed, moving as far away from visible enemies as possible. After that, your allies may sidestep up to twice their speed towards you.

You attempt to communicate with the soul of a person who has died recently. This requires you to perform a ritual that takes an hour, that must be performed next to the corpse or where the person died. You must be aware of the identity of the person you’re trying to contact. Finally, you must have a tool such as an ouija board that allows the spirit to communicate with you.

Even if the ritual succeeds, the spirit is not forced to answer your questions if hostile to you or it might answer in cryptic ways.

You may spend 2 or 4 AP on this ability and move as though you had spent that AP on movement. After you finish moving, you may spend half of the AP you used on this ability on a single Light or Heavy attack.

For every 10ft moved, this attack gains +1 damage up to a maximum of +10.

If you spent 4 AP on this ability, you may also choose to use Wild Thrusts instead of making a Light or Heavy attack. These attacks do not gain the damage bonus listed above, but Wild Thrusts mana cost is reduced to 0 if used in this way.

When targeting or damaging an enemy with a spell, you may choose to inflict Challenge on them until the end of your next turn., When an enemy that is Challenged by you provokes an attack of opportunity from you, you may instead use Abjurer's Blast against them. The heavy and precise version of this cost 1 RP, while the light version costs 0 RP.

When you use the Create Talisman ability, an ally may spend their Errand action to use one of their spells to put on the talisman instead of your own. You only create 1 copy of this talisman per Errand action and cannot use Secret Art spells with it.

You unsheathe your weapon and enchant your weapon with an element you've mastered. Your weapon now deals the chosen element’s damage instead of its normal damage.

If you are not holding the enchanted weapon at the start of your turn, your weapon loses this benefit.

The weapon gains a +1 Power bonus to attacks until the end of the encounter.

You attempt to steal an effect from the target, removing it from the target and applying it to yourself for the same duration, provided you meet the requirements (if any). You must pay mana equal to the effects original mana cost. Effects granted through stances, transformations and permanent effects cannot be stolen. After stealing an effect, you can’t use this again until the stolen effect has ended. The stolen effect also cannot be re-applied on the target until it has faded from you. You must have seen the effect be applied or otherwise identified an effect before you can steal it.

You choose an ability with the Spell keyword that you can use. You make a melee attack against a target in range for the same AP and mana as the Spell.

Your attack functions like the chosen Spell does, but does not provoke an Attack of Opportunity and is not treated as casting a Spell (meaning it can be used while Raging and Anti-Spell effects don't work). If the chosen spell was an AoE effect, the target point would be the target you strike with the spell. The requirements for applying any effects remain the same.

The spell you chose cannot be used again in the same round like normal, and if used with Secret Arts it counts as your Secret Art use for that encounter.

Only works with Spells that are attacks.

You do not suffer any penalties from moving across webs, either natural or created through magic or items. You may climb up walls without using any tools or making any checks at half your normal movement speed and can remain attached to the wall.

If you take any action other than moving or climbing, you become vulnerable to be knocked off the wall you're climbing until the start of your next turn. When you take damage, you slide down 20ft. If you are hanging on a ceiling or similar surface, you instead fall down from it falling prone and taking fall damage as normal.

You create a 20x20ft field of spikes. Any creature moving more than 5ft per movement action across it takes full pierce damage equal to your Focus for each 5ft they move across the field.

If the movement through it was forced movement, you only take the damage once.

Lasts until the start of your next turn.

Upkeep: 1 mana, extends the duration of the spike field by 1 turn.
Until the start of your next turn, the spikes on your armor and shield reflect damage when you are attacked. When an enemy hits you with a melee attack, they take 4 full pierce damage.
Must be wearing armor and/or a shield.

You send a wave of magic energy onto the target, afflicting them with Spirit Circuit Crash— jamming their Spirit Circuits.  The target cannot use Secret Arts or any abilities that require mana until the end of their next turn.  The target may choose to take damage equal to your heavy attack damage to cancel this effect.You can cast this through a creature affected by Mind Connection.

You and your mount jump up to 60ft vertically straight up into the air.  You can additionally move 5ft horizontally afterwards.  Unless your mount can fly, you automatically land straight down from your position at the end of your turn or for 0 AP, this falling movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity and you do not take fall damage from it.  You cannot make any non-teleport movement actions while in the air, but can still take other actions (such as attacking) while airborne.

You may trade height to move horizontally as part of the initial jump, moving 5ft horizontally as part of the jump in exchange for 5ft of height. You may move up to 40ft extra horizontally with this.

Instead of spending mana, you may instead spend a minute preparing this ability before activating it. When you do, this ability costs 0 mana.
When you are under the effect of Tipsy, you gain a Spirited Bravado which grants +1 Power.

You are able to check the aura of a creature or object within range.

If you check a creature, you can see whether a creature is non-heroic, weaker than you, around the same as you, stronger than you or much stronger than you. The GM may also give you their Spirit Core value if it has one. You also are aware if someone is concealing their spirit core level, but can’t get an accurate reading of their strength if they are. In addition, you are able to see their mana % until the end of the encounter.

If you check an item, you can determine whether it’s magical in nature. If it is, you may immediately make a Magic check against it to determine its effect as if you were using Decipher Magic with a +5 bonus.

If you paid mana for this ability, you gain Temporary HP equal to 8X. Any Temporary HP from this ability remaining after the encounter conclusion phase is turned back into mana at a ratio of 8 Temporary HP to 1 mana.

You may instead pay HP for this ability. If you do, you gain 1 Temporary Mana for every 8 HP you spend. You cannot spend more HP than you currently have. Any Temporary mana is lost at the encounter conclusion phase.

You may spend a maximum of 3 mana or 24 HP on this ability.

Once you use this ability, you may not use it again until after an encounter conclusion phase.

You create an explosion of spores in front of you. Make a Heavy Attack against the target that deals Poison damage. Afterwards, knock back the target 5ft and knock yourself back 5ft. This Spell does not trigger attacks of opportunity.

You send a Spore Symbiote to an ally or yourself.  The Spore Symbiote lasts until the end of combat, or you move it to another target (You can only have one Spore Symbiote active at a time).  If the host of Spore Symbiote moves more than 240 feet away from you, the Spore Symbiote ends.

An ally that can see or hear you within range may use your Perception score until the start of your next turn. They may also see from your position rather than their own and they may calculate their ranged weapon range (but not LoS) from your position instead of their own. This new range may not exceed twice their normal range.

You may make a Heavy Attack against a target in melee range. You may then use the same weapon to Heavy Attack a different target within your ranged weapon range or thrown attack range. This second attack does not provoke attacks of opportunity from the target of your first attack.
Throwing Weapon, Set of Missiles or Thrown attack only.
Make a crafting check, afterwards all future crafting dice for this session cannot roll below a 3.
Must be the first crafting dice in a crafting session. Costs 1 Crafting Dice

You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, you inflict Stagger 1 until the end of your next turn..

If you're under the effects of Exposing Edge, you inflict Stagger 2 on damage instead.

Make a gathering check and apply it to either Node Points or Lucky Points. If the result of this check (before bonuses) is higher than your previous roll this session, gain a bonus to the result equal to your Foraging skill (max +10).

Declare a distance up to the range of this spell. You create a celestial dome at that range from you that harm those that pass through it.

Until the start of your next turn, whenever a creature willingly enters that distance from you, you may make a Light attack against them that deals Arcane damage. You may choose to spend an RP before making this attack to make it a Heavy attack. A character that Sidesteps or Teleports through your stars does not provoke this attack.

Upkeep: 1 mana. When you pay the upkeep cost, you may change the distance of the stars.

You target a 25x25 square within range. On the start of your next turn, 4 stars fall down in the area.

At the start of your next turn, you make 4 light attacks that deal Arcane damage, evenly divided amongst enemies in the area. If there are less enemies than stars, you may hit an enemy more than once (though you must still attempt to hit each enemy an equal amount of times if possible).
You make a Precise attack against the target that deals Arcane damage.
You move up to your speed.
Must be the first action in your turn.

You put a Grunt level character or any willing ally into Stasis until the start of your next turn. While in Stasis, they cannot be affected by any ability, attack or anything similar but they also cannot take any actions.

A single target in range must make a save or the Static stacks on them immediately discharge, triggering the Static effect as though it was the end of the target’s turn.

Whether the target succeeds at or fails the save, they lose all Static charges.
The target must be afflicted with Static you applied.
A single target in range must make a save or immediately take Lightning damage equal to their Static and become inflicted withDaze.
The target must be afflicted with Static you applied.

You turn yourself into a statue, petrifying yourself and the items on you. While in this mode, you gain a +5 bonus to your guard but cannot take any actions except Block. You may leave this mode by spending 0 AP.

You may rest as normal while in this form. While staying in this form, you do not need to eat.

You gain a +10 bonus to your Deception for convincing others that you are just a statue.

You can assess the approximate HP percentage of a unit until the end of combat. (The DM should enable health bars for the unit). You can also determine which parts of a creature can be targeted and destroyed, if any.

You can assess the approximate HP percentage of a unit until the end of combat. (The DM should enable health bars for the unit). You can also assess any damage type weaknesses and strengths that the enemy has at the current time. You can also determine which parts of a creature can be targeted and destroyed, if any.

You can assess the approximate HP and RP percentage of a unit until the end of combat. (The DM should enable health bars for the unit). You can also assess any damage type weaknesses and strengths that the enemy has at the current time. You can also determine which parts of a creature can be targeted and destroyed, if any.

All allies within range heal for 8 HP.

Upkeep: 1 AP, 2 Mana. When you pay upkeep, you heal all allies for 8 HP again.

You enter a stance that grants you the toughness of the earth. You gain a +2 bonus to your guard and a +6 bonus to your Block.

This stance lasts until you enter a different stance.
Not wearing any armor (including armor plates)
You add a crafting check to the item. The crafting dice is automatically a 7.

The target gains Immovable until the start of their next turn.

You may also use this for 2 AP instead.
The target must be touching the ground.

You enter a Stance in which you become Immovable unless the enemy has more Power than you. If they do, you may pay an additional mana to retain the effect against them if they would prone you or knock you back.

This stance lasts until you enter a different stance.

The target must make a save or become Charmed until the end of the encounter.

If you use this on a Grunt level enemy and you charm them, you may choose their actions when it's their turn in addition to Charm’s normal effect.

You may only have 1 target charmed at the same time.

You may make a Light Attack against the target. On damage, you inflictTime Stolen, which lowers their Initiative by 1 and you gainStolen Time, which increases yours by 1. This effect can stack both on you and on enemies.

You gainSteel Aura, granting you 3 additional guard, but you can no longer use any RP actions besides block. You can end this effect at any time for 0 RP. This effect ends at the start of your next turn.

Make a Light (1 AP), Precise (2 AP) or Heavy (2 AP) attack that deals Arcane damage against the target. You use their Power for the damage calculation.

This spell does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

You may name one skill (such as perception, athletics) and force the target to make a save against your Potency. On failure, you steal their skill points spent into the skill until the end of the encounter. You gain their skill points they have in that skill to your skill while they lose all of theirs.

Only affects skill points spent, not any other bonuses from abilities or stats.

Can not be used on artisan and gathering skills.

You may only have 1 instance of Stolen Skill active at the same time, but you may choose to drop your current stolen one for 0 AP.
You gainStoneskin, which grants +1 guard and +4 block, but also -2 evasion and dodge.
You gainStore Time, granting you 1 extra AP at the start of your next turn.
You store a consumable item within your body, this item still counts towards weight limits.  Without needing to equip the item, you can consume an item to gain its effects.

You make a Precise attack against the target.

Combo: If used after Tectonic Overhead, the mana cost is reduced by 1.
All allies in sight, including yourself.
All allied units (including yourself) gain +1 to Initiative and may immediately move up to their Speed.

You swap places with a willing ally. This movement does not trigger any attacks of opportunity. You cannot use this ability if it causes an ally unit to occupy an invalid space. Before or after the swap you can take a 5ft step, but the swap must occur.

You may spend either 0 AP or 1 RP to use this ability.
A willing ally is within 10ft range.

You may make a Heavy Attack against the target.
Must be in Serene Water Stance.
You gain +5 skill points in the Religion skill., Followers of your Religion are more obligated to listen to you, granting you a +5 Negotiation Bonus when dealing with them.
