Your next basic attack against the target gains the Lock On keyword OR you apply Death Mark to the target.

Overcharge:You may spend 2 additional AP to instead make the next basic attack gain the Sure hit and Full Pierce keywords.
You gain Elemental Mastery: Dark, You may use Dark Bolt.
You create a wall of darkness that is 20ft long, 5ft wide and 10ft high. This wall must be a straight line.  This wall blocks line of sight. Targets inside of the wall can only see 5ft away
Encounter Start, Sure Hit, Unarmed Strike
You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. On damage, the target becomes Unbalanced.

You summon a randomly chosen animal to a location you can see within range. The summon does not act by itself, but you may spend AP to make it act. The AP cost for these actions is the same as they would be for you taking the basic actions. (Example, you can spend 2 AP to make the summon do a Heavy attack).

The summon also gains access to the abilities the summoned creature normally has. The costs for these have to be paid by you, same as they would be for basic actions. Any attacks it makes are made with its own stats. When an animal summoned through this ability dies, you cannot use this ability again until the end of the encounter. You can undo the summoning manually for 0 AP.

The pool of creatures that can be summoned is the following: Wolf, Boar, Giant Spider.

Your contracted Eidolon hears your call and sends their minions to fight for you. The summon called and costs are dependent on your attunement. Lasts up to 5 minutes. You must pay the upkeep cost under the Summon’sSummonSkill or the Summon vanishes.

Unless the summon has a skill that says otherwise, a summon acts after you on initiative, but cannot act the round it is summoned except for RP actions.

You summon a Pawn puppet under your control. It (and other puppets from this class) have HP equal to 20 + Focus, no evasion and no guard. These puppets are not living targets and are generally treated as structures rather than creatures.

Overcharge: You may spend extra mana to summon the following puppets instead:

1 Mana: Knight or Bishop

2 Mana: Rook

3 Mana: Queen
You may channel for 10 minutes after which you arrive at the space between worlds, allowing you to interact with Eidolons that wish to meet with you., You may use Attune Eidolon.
When you make an attack that deals Lightning damage to a target afflicted with Static, you gain a +1 accuracy bonus., You gain Elemental Mastery: Lightning.
You may use Status Assessment III.

When you deal damage with a one-handed melee weapon that is both Sure Hit and Full Pierce or a critical hit, you inflict Bleeding on the target for 1 turn. This effect stacks with other Bleeds effects and itself up to 3 times.
Your next movement before the end of your turn does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
Can be used after you make a melee attack while flying.

You Swap positions with a chosen willing ally or any non-heroic enemy.

You may use either AP or RP for this ability. You don't need to pay the cost of both.

You enter a stance in which you spin your weapon around in a circular motion and lash out against any enemy that approaches. When an enemy enters your weapon’s range you may make an Attack of Opportunity against them. An enemy moving while already being in your attack range does not provoke. Your weapon's range for these attacks of opportunities is increased by 5ft (This does not affect your normal threaten range).

The stance lasts until you make an attack that isn’t an Attack of Opportunity.

You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, the target is knocked down 30ft or until they hit the floor (on top of any other height loss from being hit while flying) and you may Sidestep next to them afterwards.

A target knocked down on to the ground with this ability is knocked prone and takes falling damage as normal. They do not take the normal extra damage as result of being knocked into the floor.
You and thetarget must be airborne

You jump onto a light sword, versatile melee weapon, greatshield, bayonet musket or two-handed melee weapon you’re carrying and use it to move around. While riding on top of the sword, you gain Flight. You can fly this way for up to 5 minutes.

If you take damage while flying higher than 5ft above the ground, your altitude drops by 20ft. If this would reduce your altitude to the point where you touch the ground, you may hop off your weapon and put it back into your hand if possible for 0 RP. After this happens, your Sword Riding ends. If the attack that reduced your HP came from a flying creature other than yourself, you do not lose altitude but instead become unbalanced.

If you are knocked back by an effect, you must make a save against the attacker's potency. Else, you are blown off your sword.
Must have a Light Sword or two-handed melee weapon in your hand.

You attempt to tackle the target and may make a Heavy Attack against them. This attack deals no damage. On hit and if the target did not use the Block action against this ability, you and the target fall Prone. If the target successfully dodges this ability, you fall Prone.
Two ally units, or yourself and an ally unit that are adjacent to each other that you can see.

The target willing allies, or yourself and a target willing ally switch places.  This movement does not trigger any attacks of opportunity.  You cannot use this if it causes an ally unit to occupy an invalid space. You may use either AP or RP for this ability.
You and all allies within 40ft gain Tailwind, which provides a +1 bonus to initiative and doubles movement speed in the first round of combat.
All Low Cover in a 20x20 area becomes High Cover for your allies (including yourself).  This effect lasts until the start of your next turn.
Do not make a gathering check. Instead, immediately collect 25% of the Outcrop’s base material as a bonus (doesn’t affect material totals), but no Node or Lucky progress is made.
When attacking a target inflicted with Offstep, Stagger or Blinded, you gain a +1 accuracy bonus against them.

After using a Talisman, you may immediately spend the cost of that talisman (before reductions) to repeat the effect without consuming another talisman. If the talisman had a target, you must choose the same target.

Does not work with Secret Talismans.

You open a door or interact with an object remotely.  You can cast this through a creature affected by Mind Connection.

Overcharge:You can pay 1 mana to magically unlock most doors and objects (DM can decide if an object is too complicated, and still make you roll a Skill Check).
Object is in a room affected by Psychometry
You make a slow, powerful overhead swing and make a Heavy attack against the target. Their evasion (but not dodge) is doubled for this attack.

You enter the Tempestuous Fire Stance. While in this Stance, before you make an attack with the Unarmed Strike keyword, you may choose to move 5ft per AP spent on the move. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity. This Stance lasts until you enter a different stance or until you move, with the exceptions of this ability and movement abilities with the Unarmed Strike keyword. Making an attack does not cancel this stance.
Until the end of the encounter, the target ally you selected is also treated as your VIP.
Your infuse your weapons with fiend killing aura, making them equivalent to Silver weapons for the purposes of harming fiends. Attacking a fiend with a silver weapon disables their regeneration.

You manifest and don a Tengu Mask of your desired design, grantingPresence Concealment.   You cannot use any mana abilities or Aura abilities while in Presence Concealment.  You can end this effect for 1 AP or 1 RP, to either remove your mask or to wear it on your head in a way that doesn't cover your face.

You raise the ground around you in a 25x25ft square centered on yourself. The ground is raised upwards by 10ft. Can only be used on natural ground and cannot be used on ground that’s already been raised.

Overcharge: You may spend 1 AP and 1 Mana to raise it upwards by another 10ft.
When dealing damage with the trample effect or with your Secret Art: Override, any non-heroic target you damage becomes Shaken until the end of their next turn.

You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. This attack deals additional Light Damage added to the Heavy Damage.Combo:If used after an ability that moved the target, you may push the target for an equal distance again.

You gain Alchemist Core Crafting Abilities, and proficiency in 1 basic weapon., You can craft using non-advanced materials and base materials., You can use an Alchemist's Alembic as crafting tool for alchemy crafts., You craft 3 of the same Elixir, Potion, Flask, Poison or Salve when using an interlude point instead of 1. You only need to pay the listed cost once.

When making a check with the Roguecraft skill, you may treat the object or person you’re interacting with as being up to an hour in the past. This may allow you to steal things not currently carried, open doors before they were locked and more. Does not work in combat and an item that is consumed cannot be stolen., Using the Delay encounter start action does not consume your encounter start action use and you may use it multiple times.
You make a crafting check. For each time you rolled a 5 or higher this craft, this check gains a +1 bonus.
Must be in a crafting session.

You can perfectly see and detect heat sources up to 120ft away, including stealthed creatures. This cannot detect things hidden by magical means. You can no longer discern a difference in heat once something reaches freezing temperatures.
When you would get Dazed, you may make a Save against the effect even if it would normally not allow for one. If you already had to make a save to avoid it, then you don’t get another.

All allies within range gain a +1 Song bonus to their damage rolls. This bonus is doubled on Heavy attacks.

Upkeep: 1 AP
Until the start of your next turn, all enemies in your melee range are considered Challenged by you.
You throw a Potion in your hands at a willing ally unit within range. The unit may pay the mana cost (if any) to receive the effect of the Potion.

You may make a Light Attack that deals Lightning damage against all target enemies in range. As the attack comes from the sky, any cover is calculated from above the target rather than from your path to the target.

Carpenter's Modification BCost:X Crafting PointsDescription:You add an B-Type modification to the weapon or tool. See the Universal Weapon page as well as the individual weapon page for details. Each modification has its own cost.

Your size is tiny and you are able to occupy the same square as an ally or enemy. Your Toughness is reduced by 2 and your Agility is increased by 2.

When walking (and not hovering or flying), your movement speed is reduced to 5ft.
Jiangshi do not know pain or fatigue, making them terrifying warriors. You are always counted as rested despite the most inhospitable conditions. You also do not need to sleep.

You may wield a Two-Handed weapon in 1 hand allowing you to use a second (Two-Handed) weapon or shield in your offhand., While dual wielding heavy weapons, you may make dual wield attacks as if they were light weapons.
You twist the knife and inflict a debilitating wound on the enemy. You inflict one of the following conditions: Slowed, Unbalanced or Bleeding. These last until the end of the target’s next turn.
You landed a crit on the enemy (and it wasn't blocked or dodged).
As an Errand action, you may perform in a city or town and earn Clim equal to your relevant Art roll x 10 up to a maximum of 300 clim.
You find any tracks that aren’t hidden.  Once you find tracks, you can follow them at normal speed without having to make checks.

For a camp action you create up to 5 servings of a trail meal.  It costs 20u of food per serving and only gives 1 mana (0 for Mirane), but it keeps starvation away.  Does not require a culinary kit, and does not count as cooking for the purposes of culinary actions such as using stocks.

You move up to your speed. Any allies within 30ft of where you started moving may spend 1 RP to move up to twice their speed towards you. They ignore the effects of natural difficult terrain for this movement.
Must be mounted and meet the requirements of your Light Cavalry key ability.

You may activate this after moving at least 20ft in a movement action to gain Trample until you stop moving. Abilities with the Teleport keyword do not apply for this, but declaring multiple AP to move at the same time counts as 1 action. While under the effects of trample, you don't provoke attacks of opportunity by moving and you can move into enemies that are at least one size smaller than your mount. An enemy may spend 1 RP to move out of the way to an empty spot within 5ft of them.

If they don’t move out of the way, you make a Sure Hit Light attack against them with your mount, using your mount’s stats. On damage, you knock them prone into the square you came from and keep moving, occupying the square they were in. Otherwise your movement action ends.

Each enemy can only be affected by trample once per activation of the ability, regardless of whether they are attacked or move out of it.
Your Acolyte, Priest and High Priest Healing abilities heal for 2x value when used out of combat.

You lose HP up to your Toughness x 2. Target ally within range heals for the same amount of HP you lost.

This HP loss cannot be mitigated in any way and ignores temporary HP. This does not trigger effects that would trigger upon taking damage.

You gain Transmuter Core Crafting Abilities. You may use one of these abilities in a crafting session. If you use one of these abilities, other transmuters can no longer use their co craft abilities with you. Similarly, if a co crafter uses one of these abilities for you, you can no longer use any of these abilities., You can craft using non-advanced materials and base materials., You can now craft Elixirs, Potions, Flasks and Salves. You craft 3 of the same Elixir, Potion, Flask or Salve when using an interlude point instead of 1. You only need to pay the listed cost once., You gain proficiency in alchemist’s tools and 1 basic weapon type.
You craft up to 5 small shells. You can instead craft a medium shell instead of 2 small shells. Small shells require 50 magical fuel, medium shells require 200 magical fuel.

You create up to 3000u of artifice parts of the same type of blacksmithing material used to make them at a 1:1 rate. (3000u of Iron Creates 3000u of Iron Artifice Parts.) See Items: Blacksmithing Materials, Artificer Materials. When converting items of a higher tier, you can convert up to 6000 of tamahagane, 9000 of mithril, 12000 of Orihalcum or 15000 of escudo.
Create Box or Bundle of Food

You create a perfect mix of ingredients that would be worthy of a stock with 500u of matching material. Example: 500u of Meat can make 1 Box of Fresh Meat. You can make 5 boxes of any kind for one errand action.
You create an ingot from blacksmithing base materials or from blacksmithing special materials. See Item: Blacksmithing Materials.
You create an Oil Coating from Carpenter materials. See Items: Carpenter Materials
You create a Wood Block from Carpenter materials. See Items: Carpenter Materials

Co-Craft. Only usable once per crafting IP. Destroy the uncrafted item and all materials invested into the craft. You may immediately start another crafting session. You create a tanned hide from armorsmithing base leather materials. See item: Armorsmthing materials.

For 1 AP, You can create small items using transmuting to provide temporary comforts and curiosities— a cup to drink out of, a chair to sit down on, a figurine etc.  These items cannot have significant gameplay factors (such as a key or a tool).  If you’d like to create something small to give away or sell, you must utilize x amount of commodities of whatever quantity and type the GM decides., You may use your transmuter abilities a second time during a craft or co craft., You may use the following abilities:

From the surrounding material you construct an “Effective Implement”, granting you a +5 to the skill of your choice.  You must explain how this implement will be effective towards the check using the relevant skill (example:  creating a springboard to jump higher with athletics) and the GM determines the validity or this ability has no effect.  Does not work with crafting or gathering skills. This implement lasts until you have attempted the specific check it was created for.

You may also spend 1 RP instead of 1 AP for this ability.

Overcharge:  You can spend 1 additional mana to increase the skill bonus to +10.

Creates a connected transmuted terrain that grows from the point of origin.  For every mana spent, you can create up to 4 5ft squares of terrain that must be connected.  Choose solid ground normal terrain or difficult terrain.  Removes effects on the terrain such as ice, fire. The terrain can push objects and creatures in the direction its being created.  If the transmute terrain deals damage to a creature, the spell stops after and the 5ft segment that contacted them is destroyed.  Each segment of wall has HP equal to 20+Focus

Heroics caught in the terrain may spend 1 RP to step out of it. Once they do, they can't be shoved within this use of transmute terrain even if you attempt to hit them with it again.

You quickly transmute multiple walls to defend against an incoming ranged attack.   Each wall you summon reduces the damage of the incoming attack by 2* Focus, you can summon as many walls as you like against the incoming attack for 1 mana per wall. After the attack resolves, every wall you made vanishes regardless of remaining HP.
You or an ally in range is the target of a ranged attack.

Using the available materials around you, you transmute any basic weapon or shield into your hand or next to an ally, your ally can grab the weapon at the time of its creation for 0 RP, as well as sheathe their weapons.  The weapon lasts until the end of the encounter and is destroyed.

You can transmute weapons out of special material if there is enough of it in the area, or if you have one (such as an ingot) but the material is destroyed afterwards.  The DM determines if this is possible in the specific case.
There is suitable material available. (GM decides)

Stabilize MatterDescription:Co-Craft. Use a transmutation that stabilizes the material, making it easier to work with. The next crafting d10 cannot roll lower than a 6.

A Small Bit of CreationCost:One herb with a rarity higher than common.Description:You deconstruct and reconstruct the structure of an harvested alchemy herb. By lowering its energy level you attune an herb to another element. Choose one herb and lower its rarity by one step and then change its element into the element of your choice.

You may convert 100u of junk into a Trapper's Trap you can use for your abilities. You may do so as a Rest action or as an Errand action. Trapper's Traps are a special item that cost 1 burden., You may carry up to 3 Trapper's Traps without them costing Burden., When resting at your camp outdoors, you may set traps that will alert you to enemies approaching by using a rest action. These do not consume a Trapper's Trap,  but allow you to use Survival to detect enemies instead of Perception. After each of such rests, you obtain 1d10 x 5 food units.

You play the final tunes of the melody that signals the traveler’s ending.

While Traveler’s End remains active, the Potency of your Mist of the Vale and Despair of Isolation is increased by 3. Your Mist of the Vale can no longer be removed and any effect that would remove it instead dispels Traveler’s End.

At any point after activating this song, you may spend 1 RP and 5 Mana to make a Sure Hit Heavy attack against all enemies within your Mist of the Vale. On killing blow, you regain 1 mana you spend on the attack (up to 5). Afterwards, the Mist of the Vale ends and cannot be reused in this encounter.

Traveler’s End otherwise lasts until the end of the encounter or until the Mist of the Vale is gone.

Upkeep:1 Mana
Mist of the Vale must be active for at least 1 turn.

You become aware of the presence and exact location of any creature within range that is touching the ground until the end of your turn.

Overcharge: You may spend extra mana to increase the range by an additional 40ft per mana spent.

You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, they are challenged by you until the start of your next turn.

If this does not deal damage, they cannot be challenged by you until the start of your next turn.
Damage from melee weapon attacks made by you also reduces the target’s max HP by the same amount. This lasts until the end of the encounter.

You unleash your latent angelic powers and transform into a semi-divine being for up to an hour. While transformed, you gain controlled flight and +5 movement speed.Upkeep:2 mana After using this ability, you cannot do so again until the interlude rest phase.
You make two Heavy attacks against the target.

All allies within range gain a +1 Song bonus to their Evasion and Dodge.

Upkeep: 1 AP

You may make a Light Attack against the target. On damage, you apply Wave Palm I.

Wave Palm increases the mana cost of the afflicted target’s next ability that uses mana by an amount equal to the amount of stacks applied. If the triggering attack makes the number of total stacks exceed the target's current mana, they lose mana equal to the amount of total stacks and take true damage equal to triple this amount. Wave Palm does not stack with itself, use only the higher value.

If the target has no mana, they immediately take true damage as if their stacks exceeded their current mana.

When the Wave Palm effect triggers, either by increasing the mana cost or by dealing the true damage, the Wave Palm effect is removed.
You may add your Light damage to the attack.
Can be used after hitting an attack with a Two-Handed melee weapon. Must be dual wielding.

Roll Heavy Damage and treat that as your Guard against the attack that’s targeting you. If you reduce the damage to 0, the attacker becomes Unbalanced. On hit effects and maces do not gain their effect if you reduce the damage to 0. After the attack is resolved, you may immediately make an Iai Strike against the attacker for 0 RP. This Iai Strike gains the Sure Hit keyword against an Unbalanced target.
Katana only, target of a melee attack and must be in the Iai state.

You may treat the weapon you’re currently wielding as a weapon of a different group for the next attack in addition to its normal group. In addition to receiving the base weapon properties of both weapon groups, this allows it to meet the requirements of abilities that require a certain group, and allows you to change its damage type to the chosen weapon’s damage type. The GM may rule that some abilities still cannot be performed with your equipped weapon.
If the damage would reduce your HP to 0 or lower, it instead lowers your HP to 1.
You take damage. Your HP is higher than 1.
When you aim at an object not being worn or wielded within your ranged weapon range, you always hit your target.
You remove yourBone Armorto heal yourself for Power x 2 and gain a +2 Power bonus on your next attack.
Bone Armor is active on you.

You may use this ability when an enemy willingly moves out of your melee weapon range to make a Heavy attack against them. You can use this even if they took the disengage action or a similar action that would not make them provoke attacks of opportunity. If the target uses a teleport type move, then you cannot use this ability, unless they Teleport into your weapon range.

This is treated as an opportunity attack.
An enemy moves out of your range.

Unsummon your Eidolon or Lesser Eidolon.  Recover mana equal to half of the mana cost of the summon cost.

You may use this as an Encounter Conclusion action.
You have an active Eidolon or Lesser Eidolon.

You may make a Light Attack against the target. On damage, you drain 1 mana from the target, recovering 1 mana yourself. If the target has no mana remaining, you instead deal an additional Light damage.

This unarmed strike must be made with your fangs, but may be made even with both hands full.

Damage done by this ability also reduces the target’s max HP until the target finishes a rest.

A target reduced to 0 HP by this ability is killed and if the target was a heroic unit, it has a chance (GM’s decision) to turn into a vampire subservient to you.

If the target has any mana remaining and is a willing target, you may choose to not deal damage with this attack.

You are able to change your form to that of a rat or bat.

While in this form, your size changes to that of the chosen animal and you are treated as a normal animal of that type. You cannot make any attacks or use any abilities while in this form.

You may exit this form at any time for 0 RP.

You mentally dominate the target. The target immediately considers you their master and they will serve you like a loyal servant. You may command them and they will obey most commands. Any command that is obviously suicidal or completely goes against their nature (for example: telling a servant to jump off a cliff or to kill their own child) will end the domination prematurely. This effect lasts until dispelled, they die or until you use Vampiric Domination on another target.

After the effect ends, the target will remember everything it was forced to do while it was your servant and it cannot be affected by Vampiric Domination again for a year.
Target must be under the effects of Vampiric Fascination

You charm a non-heroic creature within range. While charmed, the target must spend its AP during its turns on moving towards you in the most direct path possible while avoiding any dangers it is aware of. If it is already next to you, it instead takes no actions.

At the start of your next turn, you may spend 4 AP to continue the charm. If so, the charm continues until you stop paying the AP cost or until the target takes damage from an attack other than a Vampire Bite.

While you have a target under the influence of Vampiric Fascination, your Vampire Bite costs 0 AP and has Sure Hit plus Full Pierce against that target the first time you use it each turn.
Target must be able to see or hear you, Target must be non-heroic.
Your unarmed attack damage is treated as a One-Handed Weapon in which you are proficient. Your unarmed attacks cannot deal non-lethal damage., You may use the Vampire Bite ability.

You may immediately take the Hide action.

During the night, the mana cost of this is reduced by 1.
You may make a Heavy Attack against the target. If your VIP is at 0 HP or lower, this attack gains Lock On and Guard Crush.
Your VIP was attacked last turn and you re-directed an attack from them to you or your VIP is downed.
Make a gathering check. After rolling, roll two more dice that will be used as your next 2 strike dice values. You may reorder them or replace one with a 5.
Must be in a gathering session.
You may treat your polearm’s threatened range as 5ft instead of 5-10ft. You must declare this during your turn and it lasts until the start of your next turn.

All melee weapon attacks that you make this turn deal maximum damage on hit. All weapon attacks made against you until the start of your next turn also deal maximum damage on hit.

Once used, this cannot be used again until the end of the encounter.

You change the target of the attack to you instead of your VIP.

This attack automatically hits you and you may not use the Dodge and Block or similar reactions against it.

The re-directed attack is treated as having most the requirements met as if it was still targeting the original target, including effects that are conditional such as Full Pierce on a downed target, and you are considered to be in the original target's spot for the purposes of range of the attack you're re-directing.

GM's may rule some conditional effects are based on you rather than the original target, such as attacks with effects based on race.

Does not work against Attacks of Opportunity.
Your VIP is within 5ft of you and is the target of an attack that does not target you as well.

You make a Precise Attack against the target creature that deals Earth damage equal to their Toughnesswith Full Pierce.On damage the current host of Spore Symbiote is healed for the damage dealt.Vital Drain can be casted from the location of the host of your Spore Symbiote.
You regain HP equal to 5 times the mana spent.
You regain HP equal to five times the mana spent. Vital Drive II cannot heal more than the damage you took from the triggering attack.
You took damage from an attack.
You cut the target in half with your scissors or chainsaw, killing them instantly.
Giant Scissors or Chainsaw only. Target is affected by Expose and is a grunt.
You make a Light attack against all targets in a 25x25ft area.
Until the start of your next turn, every ally within range gainsWall Formation. If they are adjacent to another ally gains a +1 bonus to their guard and a +4 bonus to their block value.

When you create a wall on your turn using your Geomancer or Geomaster abilities, you may move along the wall as it is created. You can jump off at any point of the wall creation, ending in an empty square next to the wall.
When you have “Just A Hug” active. You and the target gain resistance to cold from environmental effects.
You fire a warning shot against a target in your range. Your next basic attack or Ricochet ability with a pistol against that target gains the Trick Attack keyword.

You recall having previously assisted an ally in maintaining their weapon, causing it to be in top shape for battle. This weapon gains a +1 Power Artisan Bonus or +1 Focus Artisan Bonus. If you smithed the weapon it gains both. This Artisan bonus is considered the same bonus as from a weapon's material like Tamahagane and does not stack with it.

If the weapon you choose gets no bonus from this ability, it's critical range instead improves by 1. (A normal weapon now crits on a 19 and 20, a katana on a 18, 19 and 20).
1 Ally’s Smithed Weapon, or your own smithed weapon.
You get a +5 Expertise bonus to insight checks when looking to discern if someone is lying to you.

You prepare to strike with enhanced power.

Your next attack with a two-handed melee weapon this turn loses the keywords: Lock On and Sure Hit. In addition, you do not gain accuracy from your Focus on the enhanced attack. The attack also cannot benefit from Offstep and similar effects that guarantee the attack hits.

Instead, the attack deals extra damage equal to the accuracy lost from not gaining Focus due to Weight of the Mountain. If the attack is a heavy or precise attack, it deals extra damage equal to double the accuracy lost instead.

If the attack made with this effect already did not benefit from focus, this ability has no effect.

You increase the target’s gravity, reducing their elevation by 40ft. This may interrupt movement and if you reduce their elevation down to 0, you slam them into the ground dealing fall damage for the distance they failed to move and knocking them prone.
Target enemy is flying or jumping.

You target a Glacial Wall in range and fire a bolt of Frost energy that requires line of sight. On impact, the wall is destroyed and explodes into blades of ice, attacking all enemies within 5ft of the destroyed wall with a Precise attack that deals Frost damage. On damage, the target is Slowed until the end of their next turn.

You rapidly thrust your weapon in front of you, making a Light attack against all enemies in a 15ft wide, 10ft long box in front of you. Until the start of your next turn, you may make Attacks of Opportunity against any enemy walking through that box. You cannot make any other Attacks of Opportunity while this effect lasts.

You may cancel this effect for 0 RP.

You may make a Light Attack that deals Wind against the target. On damage, you push the target back 20ft. Targets knocked into other characters or an object take damage as if they fell a distance equal to distance they failed to move.
You may make a Light (1 AP), Precise (2 AP) or Heavy Attack (2 AP) that deals Wind damage against the target. On damage, you push the target back 20ft.

You blow wind in a 30ft, 60ft degree cone in your chosen direction. All caught in the cone must make a save against your Potency or be blown back to the end of the cone and knocked Prone. Enemies with a size smaller than you suffer a 1d4 penalty to this roll, while enemies bigger than you get a 1d4 bonus instead. Targets knocked into other characters or an object take damage as if they fell a distance equal to distance they failed to move.

You projectWind-Empowered Aim auraaround yourself that empowers the ranged attacks of your allies. When a heroic ally within 20ft of you (including yourself) makes a ranged attack, they may add 1d4 to the accuracy roll.Upkeep:You must spend 1 AP at the start of each turn or the Aura fades.

You surround the willing target in protective winds, changing their typing to Wind II. As a Wind II type, they take regular damage from all other elements, but only half damage from Wind or Earth damage or from attacks with the Wind or Earth keyword unless that attack deals true damage. They take 50% more damage from Frost damage or attacks with the Frost keyword. While the ward lasts, they gain a +2 bonus to their Evasion against ranged weapon attacks. The ward lasts until the end of the encounter or until their type is overwritten by a more powerful type.
You gain Wind Mastery., You can use Glide.

You select a point within range. All targets in a 15x15 area must make a save against Potency or be pushed back 15ft away from the point you selected.

Targets knocked into other characters or an object take damage as if they fell a distance equal to distance they failed to move.

You grant the target  1 RP that must be spent on the basic Dodge or Block action against the triggering attack as well asWind Shield. Wind Shield grants a bonus to Dodge equal to your Focus against the triggering attack. The triggering attack can also no longer benefit from Lock On or Sure Hit
Ally is targeted by a ranged attack.

You may make a Heavy attack against the target.Overcharge:You may spend additional AP when using this ability to deal an additional Light Damage per AP used. Add all of this damage together before applying damage reduction from Guard or abilities.

You create a wall of wind that is 30ft long, 5ft wide and 10ft high that slows down all ranged weapon attacks passing through it, treating them as having only half the normal range. This wall must be a straight line. These attacks also lose the Lock On, Sure Hit, Half Pierce, Guard Crush and Full Pierce keywords. In addition, the targets of those attacks are treated as having +2 Evasion and +1 Guard. Any Spells that are considered attacks (those that require an accuracy roll against a person that isn’t using the Block reaction) that pass through the wall also suffer this penalty.
You whip your wire to ensnare the target. If they fail their save against your Potency+2 they are rendered Prone and take Light Damage.

You strike an enemy with an attack that saps their strength. You make a Light attack against the target. On damage, the target cannot add their Power for damage to their next attack.

Does not work against Boss enemies.
You give your summon a +1 Focus and +1 Power buff.
Can only target your summoned animal.
You may make a Light attack against the target, dealing Lightning damage. On damage, inflict Static X where X equals your Focus X 3.

When you move toward an enemy as part of a Martial Artist or Bajiquan ability due to Fire Stance or an inherent move effect of the ability (such as Rushing Knee Drop), your attack deals three extra points of damage for every 5ft moved. If your attack hits more than once or more than one target, you only apply this damage once.
All Items: An artifice gun with cartridges that lets it fire blasts of arcane energy through a series of lenses rather than bullets. Attacks with this weapon deal Arcane damage. By spending 1 AP per lens, the user may adjust the strength of the gun at the cost of accuracy. Each lens adjusted for power lets the user treat their attacks with the weapon as if their power was 1 higher than it actually is, at the cost of their focus being treated as 1 lower than it actually is. Up to 3 lenses can be modified in this way. Exists in Musket and Sniper Rifle variants.Mods:Uses normal musket and sniper rifle mods.

Surgery kits contain stitches, bandages and other items used for more serious wounds.Rest Action: You perform minor surgery on an ally or yourself. Requires at least 5 points in Medicine (or a relevant expertise in Medicine) to use. Make a medicine check against DC 15. On success you can negate the effect of one injury suffered this campaign until the end of the campaign. An injury can only be negated once by this effect, and one person can only have one negated injury at a time. The injury must still be dealt with after the campaign ends.With an advanced surgery kit, you can heal two injuries from a single person instead of just one. The DC to heal two injuries is DC30.

Adventuring kits contain all of the basic tools for adventuring. Can store up to 5 burden of Adventuring Essentials, a Northi Lantern or items included in this kit in a combat ready state for 0 burden and contains a torch/lantern holster for hands off torch/lantern use for light purposes. Cannot store kits or other burden reducing items in this combat ready state.

Core crafting tool. Allows you to craft items as a carpenter.

A simple cart used for storing items. May store an additional 2000 units worth of every material.Must be pulled by a large creature or reduce traveling speed by half.(Costs 1 Wood Block to craft.)May be crafted using Maple / Ash / Yew / Yggdrasil wood to hold an additional 1000 / 3000 / 6000 / 10000 units of every material.

Cartographer’s Kits contain a compass, gridded parchment, graphite pencils, a measuring rod, a protractor, and a travel logbook. Perfect for mapping unknown terrain and recording vital landmarks.Effect: You can use the cartographer's kit to make maps to trade to others and can accurately mark things on the map. You may also use it to perfectly copy other maps by making an Art (Cartography) check against DC15.

Let it rip: After making an attack with this weapon, subsequent attacks with this weapon deal +1 damage.You may consume 1 shell to empower the artifice until the end of your turn. While empowered, the damage bonus of subsequent attacks stacks.Mods:A mods:Multi Gear Chaindrive (20 points): On activate. Heavy attacks grant 2 stacks instead of 1.Turbo Engine (10 points): If a heavy attack is the first attack used, it grants the damage stack immediately.B mods:B Modification, Redline Engine (80 points): The activation ability begins at +2 stacks, but the artifice cannot use the empower ability again after it ends until the end of the arc.
A common cloak made from animal hides. Helps protects the wearer from cold weather, but offers no additional benefits.

An Alchemical mix that splashes acid onto a target, making armor brittle. May be thrown up to 40ft away. When thrown, the target of the flask takes 1 damage. On contact, their armor value is reduced by 3 (min 0) until they spend 2 AP to wipe the substance of.Crafting:Materials: 450 Alchemy MaterialsHerbs:1x Rare Fire

Special Shackles that were created for restraining targets with high magic levels. They disrupt the shackled target’s magic circuits— making them unable to use any magic or mana abilities. Because of the nature of the magic circuit restriction, they can only be used on unconscious targets. Modifications:B Modification, Zero Suppression. Lowers the target’s visible aura to 0 while wearing these, making them difficult to locate by magical means.

Armor Pierce: Treats the enemy's Guard as if it was 1 lower if within 30ft of the target.Range: 60ftModsA mods:Wrist-mounted (35 points): One handed crossbow only, range lowered to 30ft. Is mounted on your wrist and is always considered drawn + can hold a weapon in that hand.Windlass Arbalest (35 points): Two handed crossbow only. Basic attacks with this weapon gain full pierce within 30 ft. However must be reloaded for 2 AP or 1 RP before it can be used again.B mods:Extended Draw (50 points): Your armor piercing effect range is increased to 60ft. If combined with a wrist mounted crossbow, increases the range but not the armor piercing range to 60ft.Repeater (80 points): When you make 3 attacks with this weapon in 1 turn, you may make an additional light attack.

Armor Pierce: Treats the enemy's Guard as if it was 2 lower if within 30ft of the target.Range: 120ftModsA mods:Wrist-mounted (35 points): One handed crossbow only, range lowered to 30ft. Is mounted on your wrist and is always considered drawn + can hold a weapon in that hand.Windlass Arbalest (35 points): Two handed crossbow only. Basic attacks with this weapon gain full pierce within 30 ft. However must be reloaded for 2 AP or 1 RP before it can be used again.B mods:Extended Draw (50 points): Your armor piercing effect range is increased to 60ft.Repeater (80 points): When you make 3 attacks with this weapon in 1 turn, you may make an additional light attack.

The base material for crafting food is Food Units. These units can be any kind of food/filler material for example:100u of Flour50u of Fish100u of NoodlesOther than that there are special materials used for making different cooking stocks:Box of Fresh Mushrooms (250c)Box of Fresh Meat (250c)Box of Fresh Fish (250c)Box of Fresh Vegetables (250c)Bundle of Spicy Peppers (250c)Bundle of Fresh Cooking Herbs (250c)In addition you can add special ingredients.King Chungus Fungus (1250 Clim / 30 Crafting Points)An extremely rare mushroom known for extreme deliciousness. Gives +1 Mana Regeneration to a Stock when eating food made with the stock.

Culinary Kits come with easily portable cooking knives, a pot and a pan and preserved food. Has a special compartment to draw the pan as a weapon in a pinch! The included pan isn't tough enough for a skilled chef, but good enough for a novice.Rest Action: You cook a meal for your party at the cost of 40 units of food (equal to 20 Clim) per person, giving you the benefits of food (2 mana) for the rest.

Not actually made out of Demonblood, it refers to Demon tenacity. The potion is an intense stimulant that allows a character to fight through pain and injury. When drank, you ignore the penalties of one injury until the end of the encounter.Crafting:Materials: 250 Alchemy MaterialsHerbs:1x Rare Arcane1x Rare Fire

Temporarily encases the user in hard crystal, rendering them nearly impervious to damage but incapacitating them in stasis. While in stasis, you cannot take any actions but all damage (including true damage) you take is reduced by 200. Lasts for 10 minutes and can be used while downed.Crafting:Materials: 4400 Alchemy MaterialsHerbs:1x Supreme Earth1x Mystic Arcane1x Mystic Water

When drunk, you teleport 40ft in a random direction (roll 1d8 to determine this, 1 being north and 5 being south etc). If this would place you inside a wall or otherwise occupied place, the teleport fails and the potion is wasted.Crafting:Materials: 350 Alchemy MaterialsHerbs:1x Rare Wind

Dueling: When attacking a single enemy during a turn at least 3 times with this weapon, your next Dodge or Block against that enemy costs 0 RP until the start of your next turn. This property cannot be used if you target any other enemy during your turn or if you spend AP making a Heavy attack against the target.ModsA mods:Spade Lunga (10 points): When moving at least 40ft towards an enemy, increases the range of your next attack made with this weapon by 5 ft.Ornate Blade (35 points): Moving into the target’s threatened zone the first time in a turn counts as 1 attack for the requirement to activate Dueling.B mods:Paired Duelers (25 points): When wielding two dueling weapons with paired duelers, your offhand extra attack counts as one attack for your dueling bonus on your main hand weapon.Passato Sotto (80 points): You may make 1 Heavy attack with this weapon and still gain the dueling effect.Ferrobri Grip (80 points): Dueling weapon passive changes to Aggressive Dueling: When attacking a single enemy 3 times with this weapon, your next basic attack has its cost reduced by 1 AP.

An elixir that raises your resistance against a type of damage. When drunk, you take 11 true damage. You gain 10 damage reduction against a single type of damage, determined by the type of elixir. This lasts until the end of the encounter. There exist elixirs for Arcane, Fire, Water, Frost, Lightning, Wind, Earth, Holy and Dark resistance.Crafting:Materials: 1250 Alchemy MaterialsHerbs:3x Rare herb of matching element (Arcane for holy/dark, Wind for Lightning, Water for Frost)

A flask that when thrown explodes in a 15x15ft area dealing damage based on the type of flask. May be thrown up to 40ft away. You may make a light attack against all caught in the explosion area. The damage type of this is determined by the type of flask. There exist flasks that deal Arcane, Fire, Water, Frost, Wind, Lightning, Earth, Holy and Dark damage.Crafting:Materials: 0 Alchemy MaterialsHerbs:1x Rare herb of the element (Arcane for holy/dark, Wind for Lightning, Water for Frost)

An elixir that raises your resistance against a type of damage. When drunk, you take 11 true damage. You gain 5 damage reduction against a single type of damage, determined by the type of elixir. This lasts until the end of the encounter.There exist elixirs for Arcane, Fire, Water, Frost, Lightning, Wind, Earth, Holy and Dark resistance.Crafting:Materials: 350 Alchemy MaterialsHerbs:1x Rare herb of matching element (Arcane for holy/dark, Wind for Lightning, Water for Frost)

An artifice that sends energy through the weapon. The type is predetermined and can not be changed. The appearance and effect are based on the type. For example, a fire weapon might cover the weapon in flames and deal fire damage. When your attacks with this weapon deal damage, the type of damage they deal changes based on this weapon’s element. This effect lasts for 1 minute. Can only be applied to melee weapons.

When drunk, you take 11 true damage. You gain the ability to fly with a speed equal to your normal speed. The effect lasts for 10 rounds.Crafting:Materials: 1250 Alchemy MaterialsHerbs:1x Mystic Wind1x Rare Arcane

Seeds:There are several basic seeds farmers can use:Food Units:Cost: 5 ClimDifficulty: 5Yields: 150 Food unitsGrowing time: 1Alchemy Units:Cost: 5 ClimDifficulty: 5Yields: 150 Alchemy unitsGrowing time: 1Alchemy Herbs:Cost: 10 ClimDifficulty: 5Yields: 1 common herb of the element of the seedGrowing time: 1Cost is the value of the seed.Difficulty is how much crafting points it takes to gather the yield when harvesting.Yield is what the seed gives once harvested.Growing time is how long a seed takes to be harvested. A growing time of 1 means it can be harvested immediately once you have enough IP to use the Harvest ability. When a seed has a growing time longer than 1, it takes harvests equal to the growing time to receive the yield. When resolving a harvest with a seed with a growing time of more than 1 remaining, you still need to pay the difficulty to take care of the seed like normal.Special Seeds:These function like normal seeds, but are not typically available in stores.Moon-Phase Seeds:Cost: 25 ClimDifficulty 15Yield: 1 rare herb of the element of the seedGrowing time 1Special: If you let it grow for another season after the first, the yield changes to a Mystic Herb of the same element.Fertilizer:Average:Cost: 250 ClimEffect: +1 Crafting diceGoodCost: 500 ClimEffect: +2 Crafting diceExcellent:Cost: 1000 ClimEffect: +3 Crafting DiceSupreme:Cost: 2000 ClimEffect: +4 Crafting DiceFertilizer can be applied during the harvesting part. You can only apply 1 fertilizer at the same time.

A red robe with a design based of a Divine Arms. Keeps the wearer cool in even the hottest of weathers by repelling the heat.Can be activated to give the wearer 5 damage reduction against fire damage until the end of the encounter. When this effect ends, the shell inside the robe is immediately used up and needs to be replaced for the weather repelling effect to function.

An Alchemical mix that creates an area of flame. May be thrown up to 40ft away. Creates a 15x15ft area of fire that lasts until the start of your next turn. Any creature ending their turn in the area takes 20 full pierce fire damage.Crafting:Materials: 330 Alchemy MaterialsHerbs:1x Common Fire

A generic term for items attuned to a Flamelic Polarity.These items are valued at the usual 2 units for 1 clim.For example, you could have 500 corpse dust that has an Undead Flamelic Polarity. This 500 dust would be valued at 250 clim.

An Alchemical mix that explodes in a bright flash and loud noise when exposed to air. May be thrown up to 40ft away. All targets caught within a 25x25ft area become Dazed.Crafting:Materials: 420 Alchemy MaterialsHerbs:3x Common Wind
Core crafting tool. Allows you to craft items as a culinarian.
A bag that stores magical fuel shells. Each shell is shaped like a cartridge.Stores up to 20 burden worth of Fuel Shells, reducing their burden to 0.

Unarmed Combat: Attacks with this weapon count as unarmed attacks for the purposes of Unarmed Strike. If you are proficient in unarmed attacks, you are automatically proficient in this weapon. Otherwise, you are never proficient in this weapon.ModsA mods:Martial Mastery (35 points): You may have your attacks deal Elemental damage instead of physical based on your mastered classes. Bajiquan for Fire, Monk for Water, Sky Talon for Wind and Still Stone for Earth, Transcendant Lightning for Lightning, Five Harmonies for Holy, Black Oath for Dark.B mods:Wrist Claw (25 points): While wearing this item, you may still hold an item in that hand as if it was empty.Katar (50 points): Grants Nimble. Nimble: After attacking an enemy with a light attack on your turn, you may move 5ft. This movement only provokes attacks of opportunity if that movement would put you out of melee range of the target.

A translucent potion that when drunk gives you the phase through trait for 1 minute. This Lets you move through solid objects and creatures. When thrown at a creature with the phase through and/or incorporeal traits, they lose these traits for a minute. Can be thrown up to 40ft.Crafting:Materials: 300 Alchemy MaterialsHerbs:1x Rare Arcane1x Rare Wind

Current Wielder: UnknownA weapon that mimics the movement and attacks of ghostly creatures. Level 1:For your first 20ft of movement during a turn, you become Ethereal. You do not provoke attacks of opportunity and may move through solid objects. Level 2:Once per arc, you may use Soul Pierce Soul PierceCost: 2 APKeywords: Sure Hit, Full PierceRange: Melee Weapon RangeRequirement: -Description: You may make a Precise attack against the target that deals maximum Heavy damage and lowers the target’s mana by 5. If the target has 0 or less mana after this, they take an additional maximum Heavy damage.

A dragonfly trained to be used in combat. Stats:HP: 18Focus: 3Power: 2Agility: 6Toughness: 1Speed: 30ftSize: Small Special Qualities:Tiny Flying Mount: Your mount can fly. While moving only on the ground, your speed is reduced to 5ft. You may use the cavalier’s ability Rider & Mount As One to re-direct attacks away from your mount even while flying. Any damage you take while using this will cause you to lose altitude as if your mount took damage.Spectral Trample: You may apply the trample effect to creatures of any size, but your attack does not gain Sure Hit, displace the enemy or knock them prone. If they dodge your attack, your trample movement is not canceled.

Giant Scissors are used by Foragers in their activities. With proficiency, they count as a 2h weapon that can be used as a foraging tool.Shearing: You deal +1 damage against unarmored targets. ModsA mods:Elegant Executioner (35 points): Reduces Vivisect AP cost by 1.Diamond Tip (35 points): Shearing now always deals +1 damage regardless of armor.B mods:Executioner's Blade (50 points): Heavy basic attacks strike an adjacent target in range with a light attack. Once per turnSeparation (80 points): You can separate the Giant Scissors into two pieces for 0 AP (Quick), allowing you to dual wield them. You can use Separation again to put them back together. The passive changes from Shearing to Shearing Flurry which instead grants +1 accuracy to unarmored targets.

Can be added to meals to make gourmet meals. When cooking food during rest actions, you can create gourmet food which grants non-stacking buffs. Can only be used when cooking fresh food with a Culinary Kit or a Kitchen. Cooking stocks typically come in a pack of 10 and it uses one cooking stock per meal. If you are cooking a big meal for your party members, you need one stock per serving. When using the Culinary Kit action with a stock, you must have enough stock to cover all of the food being made, otherwise the effect does not work. For example, if you are cooking for 4 people, you need 160u of food and 4 cooking stocks to get the cooking stock effect. (Remember, you can only use your culinary kit once per rest).To make a cooking stock you start with a base, which requires 500u of any mix of food. Mushroom Stock (+Focus)Meaty Stock (+Power)Fish Stock (+Toughness)Vegetable Stock (+Agility)Spicy Stock (+Crafting)Herbal Stock (+Gathering)Culinarians can make multi-flavored stocks as well, which can increase more than one attribute at once.When using a Gourmet stock, the meal counts as a gourmet meal and gives +1 mana.When crafting a stock, you make 10 at a time.Using stock from scratch example:Obtain 500u of Mushrooms.Errand action to create a box of fresh mushrooms.Craft Base Stock for 500u of any food.Change base stock to mushroom stock by putting in the box of fresh mushrooms and using the Culinarian skill.Use Stir Layered Flavors to add another ingredient. Adding a box of fresh meat to make a Meaty Mushroom stock.Use Every Last Drop to increase stock yield by 2.You obtain 10+2 Meaty Mushroom Stock which grants +1 Focus and +1 Power Food Bonus for 24 hours.During a rest action, cooking for 5 people, you add 5 Meaty Mushroom Stock and 200u of food to make 5 Meaty Mushroom Dishes to feed your party and give them buffs.

An Alchemical mix that explodes when shattered, sending small metal balls in all directions. May be thrown up to 40ft away. All targets within a 15x15ft area take 5 full pierce physical damage.Crafting:Materials: 180 Alchemy MaterialsHerbs:1x Common Fire

A handheld cylinder shaped artifice that fires out a pin with a 40ft rope attached to it. The pin attaches itself to any non-living surface it hits and it can support the weight of up to four people. The GM may require an accuracy check for distant or hard to hit surfaces.After the pin is attached, you may spend 0 AP to reel yourself in and move towards where the pin is attached to. Any allies within 5ft of you may grab onto you and be moved alongside you for 0 RP (Up to 3 allies total).Modifications:A Modification, Belt Attachment. The Grappling Hook Artifice is modified to be mounted onto the belt, allowing for operation while wielding items in both hands via a switch mounted on the arm.A Modification, Drive By Model. The Grappling Hook Artifice loses the ability to move allies, but you can now make attacks at any point while being reeled as long as you have actions. While you are moving in this way, you do not provoke attacks of opportunity.B Modification, Scorpion Tip. The range of the Grappling Hook Artifice is lowered to 20ft, but can be used to make a light attack that does exactly 1 damage with full pierce. On damage, the target can be pulled up to 20ft towards the user.B Modification, Swing Engine. The grappling hook artifice can be used to swing from the point the pin is embedded instead of pulling straight towards it, in addition the rope length is increased by 20ft. The pin automatically detaches and reels in when you move to your destination for smooth traveling.

Healing liquid in a vial made from various herbs and reagents. Spurs the body’s natural healing by converting mana into regeneration. Much purer and more difficult to create, uses special materials. When drank, you heal for 30 HP.Crafting:Materials: 970 Alchemy MaterialsHerbs:1x Rare Water3x Common Earth

Healing liquid in a vial made from various herbs and reagents. Spurs the body’s natural healing by converting mana into regeneration. When drank, you heal 15 HP.Crafting:Materials: 450 Alchemy MaterialsHerbs: None required

Overpower: When you land a critical hit with a Heavy Blade, you deal an additional 1d4 damage if it was a light attack or an additional 1d12 damage if it was a heavy attack. This extra damage is not automatically maximized from rolling a critical hit, but you keep the extra damage even if the target blocked the critical hit.ModsA mods:Overwhelming Edge (20 points): You cannot be disarmed or parried.Wide Blade (35 points): When you are wielding this in two hands and don’t make an attack with this weapon on your turn you can grant yourself or an adjacent ally low cover against ranged attacks for 0 RP until the start of your next turn. Can only use this once per turn.B mods:Quakemaker (25 points): Critical hits render the target prone regardless of if they hit or not.Gutsy Blade (50 points): The crit threshold of this weapon is lowered by 5, but you no longer maximize damage dice or gain full pierce on a crit.Executioner's Blade (50 points): Heavy basic attacks strike an adjacent target in range with a light attack. Once per turnUnreasonable Mass (80 points): Heavy attacks gain 1 additional dice in damage (5d6->6d6) but suffer -1 accuracy on all attacks.

Hori knives are used by Foragers in their activities. With proficiency, they count as small weapons that can be used as a foraging tool.Hidden Weapon: You may draw this weapon for 0 AP. Each combat, after you draw the weapon if the next attack you make that round is using this weapon and is a basic Light or Heavy attack, it gains the Trick Attack keyword. After benefiting from this bonus, you cannot do so again the same combat even if drawing a different weapon with this ability.ModsA mods:Aerodynamic Design (10 points): Boomerang/Return effects cannot be used with this. For 1 RP you can throw the dagger, making a light ranged attack. On damage, the target is slowed until the end of its next turn.Compact Ergonomics (20 points): When your other hand is free and you take a movement action that costs RP, that movement range is increased by 5ft. Parrying Dagger (20 points): If you don’t use this weapon to make an attack during your turn, you gain a +4 bonus to your Block until the start of your next turn. You also gain a +4 bonus to your ‘damage’ roll when using the Parry ability.Flat Pommel (35 points): When your other hand is free, you use your free hand to push the target into targets increasing melee heavy attack damage to 5d6.B mods:Poisoner Weapon (25 points): Applying poison to this weapon costs -1 AP (min 0).Butterfly Knife (50 points): Your first light attack each turn with this weapon gains Trick Attack, but it can no longer make Heavy attacks.Ring Pommel (50 points): If you make a heavy attack that the target defends against, you do not trigger attacks of opportunity from them until the start of your next turn.

A horse trained to be used for combat. Stats:HP: 30Focus: 3Power: 3Agility: 3Toughness: 3Speed: 50ftSize: Large Special Qualities:Line Movement: You may only move in a straight line when making a movement action.

A piece of paper inscribed with a single Kiraran character of ‘Lock’. When placed on a door, chest or similar object it prevents any person from opening it. The person who placed it can safely remove it, but for everyone else it counts as a tier 1 bounded field. Destroying the seal itself through physical force is impossible by normal means, but if the object it's placed on is sufficiently damaged, then the seal is broken.

A series of boxes, microphones and earplugs that is used for long range communications. It can connect to other devices by inputting a code unique to the artifice its connecting to. Any sound spoken into the microphone is broadcasted to all other artifices connected to it. It has unlimited range.

A pair of goggles that link themselves to the wielder’s eyes. Once put on, they are always active. A medium cylinder of magical fuel that is used to power artifices. Most weapon-type artifices automatically eject the shell when they are emptied… along with a burst of steam to prevent overheating.

A spherical object that can record memories. A person can record up to 1, 2 or 5 minutes of memory into the object depending on the type. After a memory is recorded onto this artifice, no further memories can be recorded even if the time is not fully spent. After a memory is recorded, other people can view the memory. When using this object, they view the memory from the point of view of the recorder.

A large and heavy pair of gloves. Once the wearer inserts their hand into them, they will secure themselves properly around their hands. When activated, the wearer’s unarmed attacks do normal weapon damage instead of their normal unarmed damage. If the wearer already has a feature that lets them do this, the gauntlets instead give them +1 Power to unarmed attacks. While wearing these gauntlets, even if they are inactive, the wearer suffers a -10 penalty to all checks that require finesse movements with their hands. A small box that comes with two earplugs. It can connect to other devices within a mile by inputting a code unique to the box its connecting to. When a person speaks into the box, their voice can be heard through the earplugs as normal volume, regardless of how loud the person speaks. Only a person wearing at least 1 earplugs can hear sounds coming through it.

A special crystal ball that records sounds and images. It can be used to playback what it has recorded with illusionary magic. The shell is built-in and the device records up to 1 minute in a 10ft radius around the orb. When used again it will project an illusion of the recording around itself. The illusion appears slightly distorted and is clearly an illusion. The orb can only record once, but may playback for up to a year.

If you hit the ground while they are active, you do not take any falling damage. Lasts for 5 minues or until you hit the ground.
